job.title: PPC Strategist
job.description:
Location: Remote (USA, Canada or South Africa)
Department: Marketing
Role Type: Full Time / Independent Contractor if outside of the USA

About the Role
Blacksmith Agency is scaling its Marketing division to support a growing portfolio of PPC and SEO clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. We are looking for an Account Strategist who can run the strategies and the PPC campaigns underneath it. This is not a role for a strategist who hands off execution and hopes it lands right. You will build the media plan, set up the tracking and be the one auditing the account when performance moves.

You will join sales calls to shape strategy, manage Google Ads, Meta and Microsoft campaigns directly, oversee PPC contractors where necessary, and ensure every client engagement delivers measurable outcomes. This is a senior, hybrid role that blends strategic ownership with hands-on paid media execution.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy and Leadership

- 

Lead strategy for all PPC clients across multiple industries.

- 

Join sales calls with AEs to validate scope, pitch technical recommendations and help close deals.

- 

Build 90 day, 6 month and annual growth roadmaps for clients.

- 

Translate complex marketing recommendations into simple, clear explanations for executives.

Hands-On PPC Execution

- 

Plan, launch and manage paid search campaigns in Google Ads across multiple client accounts, including search, display, remarketing and Performance Max structures.

- 

Conduct keyword research, audience targeting and write and edit ad copy.

- 

Set up conversion tracking and ensure attribution accuracy via GA4, GTM and CRM integrations.

- 

Monitor daily spend and pacing to keep campaigns within budget while hitting CPA and CPL goals.

- 

Identify and manage negative keywords to improve efficiency.

- 

Manage additional paid channels as needed, including Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Microsoft Ads.

Performance Ownership

- 

Own client performance across Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft and organic search channels.

- 

Audit existing PPC campaigns, keyword strategies, bidding structures, landing pages and CRO opportunities.

- 

Ensure KPI tracking, conversion attribution and analytics accuracy across every account.

Execution Oversight

- 

Provide weekly direction and QA for campaign optimizations and deliverables from specialists and contractors.

- 

Coordinate priorities with the Marketing PM to keep timelines and client expectations aligned.

Reporting and Communication

- 

Prepare monthly and quarterly performance reports with clear takeaways and next-step recommendations.

- 

Present performance summaries directly to clients.

- 

Oversee reporting accuracy and insights delivered by the PM or specialists.

Qualifications
Required

- 

5+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns, with first-party data proving results (CTR, CPL, ROAS, rankings).

- 

4 to 7 years of experience in PPC, SEO or multi-channel full-funnel strategy, including experience managing paid and organic channels concurrently.

- 

Proficient in Google Ads Editor, Google Keyword Planner, GA4 and Google Search Console.

- 

Strong understanding of campaign structure, bidding strategy, optimization and ROI tracking.

- 

Ability to create and articulate strategic recommendations to clients and AEs.

- 

Demonstrated ability to oversee execution teams and manage deliverable quality.

- 

Strong analytical skills and the ability to diagnose performance issues quickly.

- 

Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a remote team environment.

Preferred

- 

Google Ads Certification.

- 

Agency experience managing multiple clients at once.

- 

Experience with Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Microsoft Ads.

- 

Experience joining sales calls and influencing close rates.

- 

Familiarity with multifamily, real estate or high-intent lead generation.

- 

Understanding of landing page optimization and CRO

- 

Experience with project management tools such as Jira, ClickUp or Asana.

Who Succeeds in This Role

- 

People who can both think strategically and manage execution.

- 

People who can simplify complex marketing ideas for clients.

- 

People who own the results and take full accountability, good and bad.

- 

People who work well with distributed teams.

- 

People who enjoy building rather than inheriting polished systems.

What You Will Own from Day One

- 

All marketing performance and strategy across PPC

- 

The roadmap for each client.

- 

Direct management of paid search campaigns across the client portfolio.

- 

Reporting frameworks, playbooks and best practices.

- 

Supporting AEs on sales calls.

job.title: Performance Marketing Specialist
job.description:
CareerSwift is a technology company focused on making the job search process simpler, faster, and more effective. Our platform combines AI-powered tools and practical career solutions to help job seekers create stronger applications, improve their professional profiles, and navigate their job search with greater confidence.

We are growing our marketing team and are looking for a data-driven Performance Marketing Specialist to help increase CareerSwift's online reach, generate qualified traffic, and improve the performance of our digital marketing campaigns.

## About the Role

As a Performance Marketing Specialist, you will plan, launch, monitor, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across relevant channels. You will work closely with the marketing, content, and design teams to test campaigns, analyze results, and identify opportunities to improve acquisition and conversion.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining creativity with data and wants to work with a growing AI-powered technology product.

## Responsibilities

- 

Plan and manage paid digital marketing campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, or similar channels.

- 

Monitor campaign performance, budgets, traffic, conversions, and other key metrics.

- 

Analyze campaign data and identify opportunities to improve performance and ROI.

- 

Test different audiences, messages, creatives, and landing pages to improve results.

- 

Work with content and design teams to develop effective advertising materials.

- 

Prepare regular performance reports and communicate key findings to the marketing team.

- 

Stay up to date with digital advertising trends, platform changes, and new acquisition opportunities.

## What We Are Looking For

- 

1–3 years of experience in performance marketing, digital advertising, paid media, or a related field.

- 

Understanding of paid advertising platforms and campaign optimization.

- 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- 

Comfortable working with marketing metrics and performance data.

- 

Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities independently.

- 

Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote team.

## Nice to Have

- 

Experience with SaaS, technology, AI, or digital products.

- 

Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or similar tools.

- 

Experience with conversion rate optimization or A/B testing.

- 

Basic understanding of SEO, email marketing, or marketing automation.

## Compensation

$55,000 - $75,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

Additional benefits and employment details will be discussed during the hiring process.

## What We Offer

- 

Fully remote work environment.

- 

Opportunity to work on marketing for an innovative AI-powered product.

- 

Hands-on experience across multiple digital acquisition channels.

- 

Collaborative and supportive team environment.

- 

Opportunities for professional growth as CareerSwift expands.

Apply today and help CareerSwift reach more job seekers through smarter, data-driven marketing.

## 

Location: Remote

Salary Range: 55,000 - 72,000 USD (gross, annually)

job.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
job.description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

### About the role

LemFi exists to serve people the financial world has largely ignored. Every campaign we run is a chance to reach a diaspora customer who needs a faster, fairer way to send money home, save in multiple currencies, or access credit for the first time. Performance marketing is not a support function here - it is one of the sharpest levers we have for scaling into new corridors and deepening product adoption in the markets we already serve.

As Senior Performance Marketing Manager, you will own paid acquisition end to end across our core channels and geographies. You will set strategy, run the numbers, brief the creatives, and be accountable for CAC, ROAS and volume targets - not just the dashboards that report them. You will work closely with Product, Growth, Creative and Data to make sure every pound, dollar or naira of media spend earns its place. If you treat a budget like it is your own money, read the data before forming an opinion, and push through the noise to find what actually moves the needle, this role is for you.

### What you'll build and own

- 

Own paid media strategy and execution across Meta, Google, TikTok and programmatic, covering customer acquisition and product cross-sell across LemFi's active markets.

- 

Manage and optimise significant media budgets with a clear eye on CAC, LTV, ROAS and payback periods - make the numbers work, not just look good in a report.

- 

Design and run a rigorous test-and-learn programme across audience segmentation, creative angles, bidding strategies and landing pages, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and iteration.

- 

Translate campaign data into clear, actionable insight for senior stakeholders - lead with what it means and what to do next, not just what happened.

- 

Partner with the Creative team to brief and iterate on paid assets that speak plainly to diaspora audiences across different corridors and cultures, cutting through the noise in crowded feeds.

- 

Work cross-functionally with Product and Growth to align paid campaigns with product launches, corridor expansions and seasonal remittance peaks, so spend lands when it matters most.

- 

Develop and maintain attribution and measurement frameworks that give the business confidence in channel contribution, flagging gaps and pushing for better data where it does not yet exist.

### Your experience

- 

5+ years of experience in performance marketing for a mobile app product, with a proven track record of managing substantial paid media budgets across at least Meta and Google, ideally within a high-growth consumer fintech, payments, or marketplace business.

- 

Full-funnel approach to growth, naturally thinking beyond acquisition and considering the entire customer lifecycle.

- 

Hands-on experience acquiring and retaining users for a mobile app product (iOS and Android), including working with mobile measurement partners, attribution tooling and incrementality testing.

- 

Demonstrably strong analytical skills - you move fluently between a campaign dashboard, a spreadsheet model and a conversation with a data analyst, and you know when instinct must give way to evidence.

- 

Ability to write a sharp creative brief and give structured feedback - you do not need to design, but you know what good looks like for a paid social ad.

- 

Comfort working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where priorities shift and you are expected to figure things out without a large supporting team.

- 

A genuine bias for action - you spot a problem or an opportunity, form a view, and move without waiting for permission to test.

### Nice to have

- 

Experience running paid campaigns in emerging markets across Africa, the Middle East or South Asia, with an understanding of how channel mix and creative norms differ from Western markets.

- 

Familiarity with AI-powered creative testing or media planning tools, and a habit of using them to do more with less.

- 

Exposure to multi-product growth loops - for example using remittance acquisition as an entry point to drive adoption of Savings, Credit or eSIM products.

## 
Why Join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play. 

## Recruitment Agencies Notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

As Senior Performance Marketing Manager, you will own paid acquisition end to end across our core channels and geographies. You will set strategy, run the numbers, brief the creatives, and be accountable for CAC, ROAS and volume targets - not just the dashboards that report them. You will work closely with Product, Growth, Creative and Data to make sure every pound, dollar or naira of media spend earns its place. If you treat a budget like it is your own money, read the data before forming an opinion, and push through the noise to find what actually moves the needle, this role is for you.

### What you'll build and own

- 

Own paid media strategy and execution across Meta, Google, TikTok and programmatic, covering customer acquisition and product cross-sell across LemFi's active markets.

- 

Manage and optimise significant media budgets with a clear eye on CAC, LTV, ROAS and payback periods - make the numbers work, not just look good in a report.

- 

Design and run a rigorous test-and-learn programme across audience segmentation, creative angles, bidding strategies and landing pages, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and iteration.

- 

Translate campaign data into clear, actionable insight for senior stakeholders - lead with what it means and what to do next, not just what happened.

- 

Partner with the Creative team to brief and iterate on paid assets that speak plainly to diaspora audiences across different corridors and cultures, cutting through the noise in crowded feeds.

- 

Work cross-functionally with Product and Growth to align paid campaigns with product launches, corridor expansions and seasonal remittance peaks, so spend lands when it matters most.

- 

Develop and maintain attribution and measurement frameworks that give the business confidence in channel contribution, flagging gaps and pushing for better data where it does not yet exist.

### Your experience

- 

5+ years of experience in performance marketing for a mobile app product, with a proven track record of managing substantial paid media budgets across at least Meta and Google, ideally within a high-growth consumer fintech, payments, or marketplace business.

- 

Full-funnel approach to growth, naturally thinking beyond acquisition and considering the entire customer lifecycle.

- 

Hands-on experience acquiring and retaining users for a mobile app product (iOS and Android), including working with mobile measurement partners, attribution tooling and incrementality testing.

- 

Demonstrably strong analytical skills - you move fluently between a campaign dashboard, a spreadsheet model and a conversation with a data analyst, and you know when instinct must give way to evidence.

- 

Ability to write a sharp creative brief and give structured feedback - you do not need to design, but you know what good looks like for a paid social ad.

- 

Comfort working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where priorities shift and you are expected to figure things out without a large supporting team.

- 

A genuine bias for action - you spot a problem or an opportunity, form a view, and move without waiting for permission to test.

### Nice to have

- 

Experience running paid campaigns in emerging markets across Africa, the Middle East or South Asia, with an understanding of how channel mix and creative norms differ from Western markets.

- 

Familiarity with AI-powered creative testing or media planning tools, and a habit of using them to do more with less.

- 

Exposure to multi-product growth loops - for example using remittance acquisition as an entry point to drive adoption of Savings, Credit or eSIM products.

## 
Why Join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play. 

## Recruitment Agencies Notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

# About Lunar Solar Group:  

Lunar Solar Group is a high-impact advertising agency that collaborates with consumer-focused brands to identify growth opportunities and implement disruptive marketing strategies. We combine digital marketing expertise and a suite of creative services to help brands scale. As a globally recognized growth consultancy, technology studio, and full-service digital marketing agency, we solve complex growth challenges and build brands through proprietary technology, innovative strategy, channel expertise, and flawless execution. Lunar has built a track record of excellence across various verticals, including durable goods, consumer packaged goods, and SaaS. While highlighting potential growth opportunities for clients, Lunar itself continues to expand rapidly. 

# 
Our Culture

We’re a fast-moving, highly collaborative team of senior strategists, creatives, and technologists who push the boundaries of what performance creative can achieve. We value ownership, rigor, curiosity, and the confidence to challenge assumptions—with data.

Working at Lunar means operating at a high bar. We celebrate wins, learn quickly from failures, and invest deeply in our people. Whether remote or hybrid, our team shows up as thoughtful partners to one another and trusted advisors to our clients.

## Job Responsibilities:

Technical:

- 

Media Buying: Demonstrates expertise in media buying, building, optimizing, benchmarking, measuring, and reporting on campaign performance within Google Ads and Microsoft Ads for DTC ecommerce businesses.

- 

Media Strategy: Understands the various funnel stages and the messaging tactics needed to make an impact across each.

- 

Performance Monitoring: Monitors and reports on key performance metrics, including conversion rates, CPA, and ROAS. Ensures that budgets are not exceeded.

- 

Blueprint Implementation: Proficiently implements the Lunar Solar Group Google Ads blueprint for success and adopts all products when applicable.

- 

AI Enablement: Effectively utilizes AI in day-to-day functions to improve efficiency, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation.

Client Success:

- 

Client Onboarding: Facilitates successful onboarding of new clients, develops initial digital marketing strategies, and ensures smooth transition to the junior team members.

- 

Client Relationship Management: Builds and maintains strong client relationships, contributes to business development efforts, and advances the agency’s reputation and market position. Identifies opportunities and supports in the process to upsell additional marketing channels and agency lines of services to help clients advance their impact.

Qualifications:

- 

Experience: 3-6 years of in-platform experience with Google Ads. Bing is a plus. Experience working with DTC/ecommerce businesses is required

- 

Feed Management: Experience optimizing product feeds

- 

Strategic Thinking: Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to develop and implement innovative digital marketing strategies.

- 

Analytical Skills: Analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets and provide actionable insights.

- 

Communication: Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively. A strong understanding of digital marketing, specifically in SEM advertising and specifically in the DTC ecomm space.

Preferred Qualifications:

- 

Location: U.S - 100% remote 

- 

Experience: Agency experience, working on multiple e-commerce brands at once with a strong emphasis on customer acquisition and brand growth through conversion tactics.

- 

Verticals: Fashion, Beauty, and Wellness experience are a plus.

- 

SEO Knowledge: SEO knowledge is a plus, but not required

# Top Reasons You’ll Love It Here:

- 

Accelerated career growth and leadership opportunities.

- 

Direct mentorship and collaboration with senior leaders across departments.

- 

A talented, supportive, and passionate team that loves what we do.

- 

Competitive benefits including 100% paid Medical, Dental, Vision, STD, LTD, and Life insurance.

- 

401K with company match.

- 

Generous PTO and holidays, plus a day off during your birthday week!

job.title: PPC Manager (Meta Ads)
job.description:
## About the role

We are a US marketing agency that helps dental practices win new patients, mainly for clear aligner treatment such as Invisalign. Today, the founder runs every Meta Ads account himself. We are hiring our first Meta Ads Specialist to take over campaign management and client communication, so he can focus on growing the agency.

You will work directly with the founder and own Meta Ads performance for our dental clients in the US. You start with one client account and take on more as you settle in, up to five current clients, each spending about $1,500–2,000 per month. We are looking for someone who wants to own results and grow into the agency's go-to Meta Ads expert.

## What you will do

- 

Plan, launch, and manage Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) lead-generation campaigns for US dental practices.

- 

Set up new client ad accounts from scratch: Business Manager, pixel and tracking, campaign structure.

- 

Research creatives, write and build ads, and run structured tests on audiences, offers, and creative angles.

- 

Optimize for cost per lead (target $25–50) and for booked and attended consultations, not just form fills.

- 

Send each client a performance report every two weeks, using our existing templates.

- 

Answer ad-hoc client questions promptly and clearly. Dentists are busy, so daily contact is rare.

## What we are looking for

Must have:

- 

5+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience, including building accounts and campaigns from scratch. Strong candidates with 3–4 years are also considered.

- 

Proven lead-generation results for US local-service clients, with numbers you can show (CPL, lead quality, booked appointments).

- 

A structured approach to creative and audience testing.

- 

Hands-on tracking setup and troubleshooting: Pixel, Conversions API, lead and booking events.

- 

Strong spoken and written English for direct calls and reports with US clients.

- 

Willingness to learn, take feedback well, and adjust your approach.

- 

Clear, reliable communication and an easy-to-work-with attitude.

Nice to have:

- 

Dental, clear aligner (Invisalign), or other healthcare lead-gen experience.

- 

Agency background managing several client accounts at once.

- 

Using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to prepare clear reports.

## Why join

- 

Work directly with the founder, with real ownership of campaigns and client relationships.

- 

A focused niche: US dental and clear aligner lead generation, with clear KPIs.

- 

Gradual onboarding, one account at a time, and a possible path to full-time.

## Terms

- 

Part-time, 20–25 hours per week, Monday to Thursday.

- 

Daily overlap with US Pacific time for client calls, ideally 10 AM–2 PM PT (9 AM–1 PM PT also works); the rest of your hours are flexible.

- 

Fully remote; candidates from outside the US are welcome.

- 

$45–50 per hour.

- 

B2B / independent contractor agreement; no benefits during the part-time stage.

- 

90-day trial period with clear KPIs, starting with one client account.

- 

Possible move to full-time after the trial, depending on your results and the agency's growth.

- 

Start: as soon as possible.

## Hiring process

- 

Screening call with an OnHires recruiter, including technical Meta Ads questions.

- 

Finalist case with the founder: 30 minutes to prepare a short plan for a dental lead-gen scenario, then present and discuss it live.

We aim to give feedback within 2–3 days at each step.

5+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience, including building accounts and campaigns from scratch. Strong candidates with 3–4 years are also considered.

Proven lead-generation results for US local-service clients, with numbers you can show (CPL, lead quality, booked appointments).

A structured approach to creative and audience testing.

- 

Hands-on tracking setup and troubleshooting: Pixel, Conversions API, lead and booking events.

- 

Strong spoken and written English for direct calls and reports with US clients.

- 

Willingness to learn, take feedback well, and adjust your approach.

Clear, reliable communication and an easy-to-work-with attitude.

Dental, clear aligner (Invisalign), or other healthcare lead-gen experience.

Agency background managing several client accounts at once.

Using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to prepare clear reports.

Gradual onboarding, one account at a time, and a possible path to full-time.

Part-time, 20–25 hours per week, Monday to Thursday.

Daily overlap with US Pacific time for client calls, ideally 10 AM–2 PM PT (9 AM–1 PM PT also works); the rest of your hours are flexible.

Fully remote; candidates from outside the US are welcome.

- 

$45–50 per hour.

B2B / independent contractor agreement; no benefits during the part-time stage.

90-day trial period with clear KPIs, starting with one client account.

- 

Start: as soon as possible.

Screening call with an OnHires recruiter, including technical Meta Ads questions.

Finalist case with the founder: 30 minutes to prepare a short plan for a dental lead-gen scenario, then present and discuss it live.

- Working knowledge of at least one programming language used in data work (e.g., Python) for scripting, automation, or ETL.

- Understanding of relational data models and how CRM/marketing-automation data is structured (leads, contacts, accounts, campaigns, opportunities).

job.title: Sr Paid Media Buyer
job.description:
Paid Media Buyer

Location: Fully Remote 

Job Type: Full-Time

 

About the role

We're hiring a Paid Media Buyer to live inside our ad accounts across Meta, TikTok, and AppLovin, while helping us expand across additional channels including Snapchat, X/Twitter, Google/YouTube, native, and other emerging platforms. You'll own the technical execution and day-to-day optimization of paid campaigns: building structure, reading the data, finding the leaks, and pulling the right levers to scale.

This is a performance ownership role. You won’t be creating assets yourself, but you’ll work closely with creative teams to understand why ads win, identify performance patterns, and turn data into better creative decisions.

Must-Have Platform Experience

Candidates must have hands-on, performance marketing experience with:

- 

Meta

- 

TikTok

- 

AppLovin

You should be comfortable independently building, launching, optimizing, and scaling campaigns across all three platforms.

Nice-to-Have Platform Experience

Additional experience with any of the following is a plus:

- 

Snapchat

- 

Twitter/X

- 

Google/YouTube

- 

Native advertising, including Taboola and Outbrain

Ideal Background

The strongest candidates for this role have scaled DTC/ecommerce brands through Meta-first performance marketing environments where they owned significant spend, testing, optimization, and business outcomes.

You likely come from a high-growth consumer brand or performance marketing agency where you managed multiple direct-response ecommerce accounts and had direct responsibility for profitable scale.

Strong signals:

- 

Managed $750K–$1M+ monthly paid media spend

- 

Deep Meta Ads expertise as the primary growth channel

- 

Scaled DTC/ecommerce products through paid acquisition

- 

Owned budget allocation, testing strategy, and performance decisions

- 

Experience working closely with creative teams to turn data into winning ads

 

What you'll do

Daily / Weekly Cadence

- 

Run weekly account optimizations across every platform you own. Increase budgets on ad sets and campaigns hitting their primary KPI over rolling 3/7/14-day windows, pull back spend from underperformers, and restart ads where delayed attribution masked early performance.

- 

Maintain a weekly creative testing cadence per platform: brief tests, launch with clean hypotheses, read them against pre-set spend or conversion thresholds, then kill or scale on schedule.

- 

Run pacing checks daily, weekly, and MTD against budget and KPI goals. Adjust spend distribution before the gap becomes a problem, not after.

- 

On Google specifically: negative keyword mining on Search and Shopping, smart bidding strategy reviews, Merchant Center diagnostics, quality score and ad strength reviews, and placement exclusions on Display and YouTube.

- 

Lead routine reporting (weekly and monthly) for the accounts you own. Performance, leading indicators, blended view across platforms, and the insights and next moves, not just the numbers.

Strategic Ownership

- 

Build, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Applovin,  as core acquisition channels

- 

Support and help scale additional channels including Snapchat, Twitter/X, Google/YouTube, native, and new platforms we test into.

- 

Continuously audit accounts. Spot bottlenecks at the ad level vs. the site level, kill waste, double down on what's working.

- 

Read multi-platform data and explain what's actually happening, not just what each platform reports about itself.

- 

Make the call on how to allocate budget across platforms based on incrementality, scale capacity, and unit economics.

- 

Brief creative needs to the creative team based on data signal, then test outputs against pre-defined success criteria.

 

Tools you'll use

- 

Native ad platforms: Meta Ads Manager, ApplLovin, Google Ads, NewsBreak, Pinterest Ads, Taboola/Outbrain

- 

Analytics: GA4, Northbeam, Hex, BigQuery, Shopify backend

- 

Planning and reporting: Notion, ClickUp, Sheets/Excel

Equivalents are fine. We care about the muscle, not the brand of the tool.

 

What we're looking for

- 

3+ years buying paid media at meaningful scale ($750K–$1M+ monthly preferred), with hands-on Meta as the foundation

- 

Hands-on Meta, TikTok, and AppLovin experience is required

- 

Meta-first paid acquisition expertise: Deep Meta Ads expertise with Google Ads experience as a plus.

- 

Experience scaling DTC/ecommerce brands through paid acquisition

- 

Experience operating in direct-response environments where spend efficiency and creative performance drive growth

- 

Strong analytical chops: at home in Sheets/Excel, can pull the right view in Looker Studio or equivalent, and read a P&L well enough to translate ad metrics into business impact

- 

Comfort with attribution chaos: you can reconcile what Meta says, what Shopify says, and what GA4 says, and explain it to a CFO without hand-waving

- 

Sharp on tracking and measurement: pixels, CAPI, server-side events, conversion APIs, UTMs

- 

A clear point of view on testing: how to design clean tests, when to call a winner, when to kill a loser

- 

Deep curiosity around performance: constantly asks why something worked or failed, identifies patterns, and turns insights into action.

- 

Strong written communication: Slack updates, weekly performance reports, ad-hoc explanations to non-paid-media stakeholders

- 

Asks the right questions before acting. We'll trust you with real money in real accounts; you need to know what you don't know, and ask for it

- 

Comfortable juggling multiple accounts in parallel with shifting priorities, without dropping balls

 

Nice to have

- 

Snapchat paid media experience

- 

Twitter/X paid media experience

- 

Google Ads and YouTube experience

- 

Native advertising experience, including Taboola / Outbrain

- 

Mobile UA experience

- 

MMM / incrementality testing experience

- 

Server-side tracking setup experience

- 

Shopify / ecommerce analytics depth

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

💻 Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (not digital nomad)

📊 Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)

 

Benefits & Compensation

- 

Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure

- 

Fully remote - work from anywhere in the US, Canada, or Europe

- 

Paid time off

- 

Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire

- 

Fully covered medical insurance, including health, dental, and vision. (US-based employees)

- 

Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy

- 

Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business

 

Ready to Apply?

If you're a performance-driven media buyer who knows Meta, TikTok, and AppLovin inside and out, understands how creative and media buying work together, and wants ownership over meaningful spend in a high-output, high-accountability environment, apply now.

job.title: Digital Strategist, Performance Marketing
job.description:
Digital Strategist Account Manager 

📍 USA & Canada. Remote or in-person SF.

⏰ Working hours are PST

## About Valid

Founded in July 2023, Valid is a seed-stage company operating at Series A scale, headquartered in San Francisco.

In under two years, we’ve grown from 5 people to 40+, deployed over $1B in ad spend, and built a full-stack, tech-enabled advertising company serving enterprise consumer customers.

We’re well-capitalized and backed by top Silicon Valley investors including Canaan, Neo, and others.

## This Role is for you if you are:

- 

A consumer obsessed full-funnel marketing strategist

- 

First in line to try the newest AI marketing tools

- 

Well versed in navigating the Ads Managers for the main paid social and search ad platforms, leveraging the latest tools/features

- 

Run campaigns focused on sales, CPAs and ROAS, not traffic and awareness.

- 

Passionate about ad networks and performance marketing strategy for consumer digital products

- 

Obsessed with discovering and tracking social media trends

- 

Customer obsessed (we put it in their twice on purpose!)

- 

Focused on paid media, we don’t do SEO or other digital paths, we are 100% focused on ROI-based ads.

- 

Preferred: savvy on app growth marketing for iOS and app user acquisition.

We believe that the best form of marketing is AI-assisted, data-driven and human in-the-loop. This role is for an account manager who can help set strategy based on a clients needs and business objectives.

## Role & Responsibilities

Digital Strategy (30% of your time)

- 

Understand a client’s business objectives and KPIs

- 

Define strategy for the account based on budget and objectives

- 

Analyze results and in market trends to devise the best path forward

- 

Manage a team of marketers to use tooling you to deliver a best-in-class ads experience

Account Management (60% of your time)

- 

Interface directly with clients on a weekly basis

- 

Present reports, give update on campaigns, give guidance on using Valid tools and assistance on media related queries

- 

Be the clients first and primary point of contact at Valid

Product (10% of your time)

- 

Interface directly with engineering & PMs to translate marketing processes into real products

## Required Qualifications

- 

Strong english and client-facing communication skills

- 

5+ years of performance marketing experience with at least 2+ years of full-funnel performance marketing experience within an agency

- 

Manage +$150,000/month of ad spend across the following platforms:

- 

Meta

- 

TikTok

- 

Google

- 

Other advertising channels

- 

Comfortable analyzing data and deploying statistical methods to “read the tea leaves” of an ad account.

- 

Served in client facing roles as senior POC

Nice to Have

- 

Managed and hired a team of marketers

- 

Advertising for mobile apps:

- 

Experience with MMPs (Adjust, Appsflyer, AirBridge, Singular, etc.)

- 

AppleSearchAds

- 

Understand SKAN and iOS attribution

- 

Experience with in-app growth analytics (tools like RevenueCat, Adapty, Mixpanel/Amplitude)

You’re Probably a Good Fit If:

- 

Applying the latest tech in novel ways to delight customers excites you

- 

Your goal is to maximize ownership

- 

You want to join something early stage

- 

The idea of organized chaos is what you want

- 

Organized: Build with purpose, work efficiently, communicate clearly, especially in writing.

- 

Chaos: We think the best place to learn is in market and will do what it takes to ship as quickly as possible.

## What You’ll Be Getting

- 

Work on a global team with flexibility and a collaborative startup culture

- 

Annual company offsite - we gather in a new location each year to connect and celebrate

## Compensation Range

- 

Competitive salary based on experience and location

- 

Benefits: 401k, healthcare, FSA, lunch (for in-person days)

- 

Location: Remote friendly in USA or Canada with a preference for in-person out of our office in San Francisco.

job.description:
CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.
Location: Remote (USA or Canada)

CSC Generation is looking for a Vice President of Performance Marketing to own paid media strategy and the paid media P&L across our portfolio of 13 brands, including Sur La Table, Backcountry, and One Kings Lane. As Vice President, Performance Marketing, you will set multi-year direction, build the team and agency bench to execute against it, and represent performance marketing on CSC Generation's leadership team.

In your first year, success means establishing a unified performance marketing strategy across the portfolio, standing up the right team structure, and demonstrating measurable improvement in blended CAC and media efficiency. You will partner closely with Creative, Merchandising, and eCommerce leadership to ensure paid investment, assortment, and creative strategy reinforce each other.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

#### Performance Marketing Strategy

- Own the performance marketing P&L and multi-year strategy across the brand portfolio, spanning paid search, paid social, shopping/feed, display, affiliate, video/TV, and emerging channels.

- Set channel and budget allocation based on incrementality, LTV, and blended CAC targets, and defend those trade-offs to the executive team.

- Translate company revenue and margin targets into a multi-year paid media investment plan.

- Build repeatable playbooks for launches, promotions, and seasonal peaks that scale across brands.

- Track competitor activity and market trends to spot new channels, formats, and positioning opportunities.

#### Team Leadership & Organization

- Build and lead a team of performance marketing leaders and specialists, plus supporting agencies.

- Set operating standards for testing velocity, reporting rigor, and channel expertise, and hold your leadership team accountable to them.

- Stay close enough to the numbers to catch problems early, coach through them, and step in directly when needed.

- Hold agency partners accountable to performance benchmarks, media efficiency, and clear scopes of work.

- Own new channel expansion, including hands-on execution of initial campaigns in new channels.

- Champion a continuous A/B and multivariate testing culture across creative, landing pages, and audience targeting, turning results into scaled learnings.

- Drive adoption and demonstrated use of AI and automation tools across the team to improve decisions, increase output, and free up time for high-value work.

#### Executive & Cross-Functional Leadership

- Sit on CSC Generation's marketing leadership team and represent performance marketing in company-level strategy and planning.

- Partner with Creative to ensure ad concepts and assets are built for performance from the start.

- Partner with Merchandising to align paid spend with inventory, margin, and assortment priorities.

- Partner with eCommerce, Product, and Web Development to ensure landing pages, site experience, and conversion funnels support paid traffic quality.

- Translate performance data into clear commercial recommendations for the executive team—not just channel-level metrics.

- Flag risks and opportunities early and bring solutions rather than just problems.

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.

- 12+ years of experience in performance marketing or paid media, including 5+ years leading managers or team leads (not just individual contributors).

- Proven ownership of a paid media budget spanning multiple channels (search, social, shopping/feed, display) at a scale consistent with a multi-brand or multi-hundred-million-dollar revenue business.

- Track record of owning performance marketing across multiple brands or business units simultaneously.

- Strong command of performance marketing economics: CAC, LTV, incrementality, marginal ROAS, and blended efficiency.

- Demonstrated ability to influence and align Creative, Merchandising, eCommerce, and executive stakeholders without direct authority over their teams.

- Proven experience building and leading teams of leaders, and managing agency relationships at scale.

- Strong executive presence and communication skills, with experience reporting directly to the C-suite or serving on a leadership team.

- Demonstrated experience using AI and automation tools to improve decisions, increase output, or improve team efficiency.

- Hands-on fluency with major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager) and analytics/reporting tools (Google Analytics, Tableau or Looker Studio), even if day-to-day execution sits with the team.

- Experience across multiple retail or ecommerce verticals (such as outdoor, home, or specialty goods).

- Experience with multi-brand or multi-site paid media management (shared team supporting several storefronts).

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

- Executive Access: Work directly with C-suite leadership and brand CEOs, shaping how paid media investment drives growth across a $1B+ portfolio.

- Leadership at Scale: Build and lead a performance marketing organization that spans 13 brands—few roles offer this breadth of strategic ownership.

- Portfolio-Level Impact: Set the strategy, build the team, and own the P&L. Your decisions will directly shape revenue and margin outcomes across the entire brand portfolio.

- Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

- Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

- Recruiter Screen - A 45-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.

- Hiring Manager Interview - A deeper conversation focused on your performance marketing leadership experience, portfolio-level strategy approach, and team-building philosophy.

- Executive Interview - Discussion with senior CSC Generation leadership on strategic vision, cross-functional partnership, and P&L accountability.

- In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at one of our hub offices (Salt Lake City, Austin, or Toronto). Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.

- Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.

- Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

- Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer.  Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.   

 CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact hrbenefits@cscshared.com.
Employment is contingent on a background check, including verification of prior employment dates.
This posting is for an existing vacancy. This position is not open to and cannot be filled by a B.C. Resident.

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talents with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries. Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor 

### Job Summary

We are looking for a strategic and numbers-driven Head of Paid Media. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for the vision, execution, and optimization of all paid channels to drive sustainable growth. As a senior leader, you will bridge the gap between creative strategy and technical performance, ensuring every dollar spent translates into measurable impact. This is a high-visibility opportunity for a performance marketing expert to own a significant budget and shape the future of this company’s customer acquisition engine.

### Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute a comprehensive paid media strategy across Search, Social, Display, and emerging channels.

- Own the global paid media budget, ensuring optimal allocation to meet CAC, ROAS, and LTV targets.

- Lead and mentor a high-performing team of media buyers and external agency partners.

- Architect a rigorous A/B testing framework for creative, landing pages, and audience targeting.

- Collaborate with the Data and Engineering teams to ensure accurate tracking, attribution, and reporting.

- Partner with the Creative team to brief and iterate on high-converting assets based on performance data.

- Stay ahead of industry trends, platform updates, and privacy changes (e.g., iOS 14+, cookie deprecation) to maintain competitive advantage.

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.

- Proven track record of managing multi-million dollar annual budgets with a focus on scaling profitably.

- Deep technical expertise in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and programmatic platforms.

- Advanced analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

- Experience managing cross-functional projects and leading both internal teams and external vendors.

- Strong understanding of attribution modeling and the modern marketing tech stack.

- Exceptional communication skills and the ability to present performance metrics to executive leadership.

- Experience in a high-growth SaaS or D2C environment.

- Familiarity with SQL or data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker).

- Previous experience managing high-growth international expansion campaigns.

- Direct experience with influencer whitelisting and creator-led paid social strategies.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor 

### Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Head of Paid Media to own strategy, execution, and scaling of performance marketing engines. This is a high-impact leadership role designed for a data-driven expert who thrives on conversion optimization and profitable growth. As the primary architect of paid strategy, you will bridge the gap between creative excellence and analytical rigor, ensuring every dollar spent translates into measurable business success. This is a rare opportunity to lead from the front in a fast-paced, remote environment where you will have the autonomy to shape the future of our digital footprint.

### Key Responsibilities

- Architect and execute a comprehensive paid media strategy across search, social, display, and emerging channels.

- Manage and optimize significant monthly budgets, ensuring maximum ROI and efficient CAC.

- Lead the testing roadmap for creative, copy, and landing pages to continuously improve conversion rates.

- Analyze complex data sets to extract actionable insights and report on key performance indicators to executive leadership.

- Collaborate with the creative team to develop high-performing assets that resonate with our target personas.

- Stay ahead of industry trends, platform updates, and privacy changes to keep the team at the forefront of digital marketing.

- Oversee the technical setup of tracking, attribution models, and pixel management to ensure data integrity.

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in performance marketing with a proven track record of scaling paid accounts successfully.

- Deep expertise in Google Ads (Search, Shopping, YouTube) and Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram).

- Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in Google Analytics, Looker Studio, or similar BI tools.

- Direct experience managing six or seven-figure monthly media spends.

- Exceptional understanding of direct-response marketing principles and funnel architecture.

- Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, strategic narratives.

- Experience with TikTok Ads, Pinterest, or programmatic platforms.

- Background in high-growth B2B SaaS or D2C high-ticket industries.

- Hands-on experience with SQL or advanced data modeling.

- Previous experience leading a small team of media buyers or agencies.

job.title: Senior Performance-Marketing Manager
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager based in United States.

Join a performance-driven marketing environment supporting more than 100 leading German B2C brands across diverse industries. As a Senior Performance Marketing Manager, you will lead the creative process behind high-impact paid social campaigns, combining strategic thinking, creative development, and data-driven optimization. You will oversee the full creative lifecycle, from audience research and concept development to copywriting, media buying, and performance analysis. Working closely with the founders, you will help shape campaign strategies and continuously improve the effectiveness of advertising assets. This role offers the opportunity to influence brand growth, develop innovative marketing approaches, and scale campaigns for established consumer brands. With flexible working arrangements, advanced creative training, and an attractive compensation package, you can strengthen your expertise while delivering measurable business results.

You will take ownership of creative strategy and performance optimization, ensuring that paid social campaigns deliver strong results while continuously improving creative quality and marketing processes. Your responsibilities will include:

- 

Leading the creative process and scaling paid social campaigns for leading brands across the DACH market.

- 

Developing creative concepts, advertising scripts, and content for both paid and organic channels.

- 

Managing the full-funnel performance marketing process, from audience research and creative angles to copywriting and media buying.

- 

Collaborating closely with the founders to align marketing initiatives with business objectives and brand growth strategies.

- 

Analyzing campaign KPIs and advertising performance to identify opportunities for improvement.

- 

Continuously testing and optimizing creative assets, messaging, and campaign strategies to improve results.

- 

Contributing to the development of performance marketing processes, creative best practices, and scalable campaign frameworks.

- 

Staying informed about emerging creative trends and applying new approaches to improve campaign effectiveness.

## Requirements:

We are looking for an experienced, data-driven, and creative performance marketer who combines strategic expertise with hands-on execution and has a proven track record of managing substantial advertising budgets. The ideal candidate will bring:

- 

Strong full-funnel performance marketing expertise, covering audience research, creative angles, copywriting, and media buying.

- 

Demonstrable experience in performance marketing, ideally within an agency or consumer brand environment.

- 

Previous responsibility for managing advertising spend at a seven-figure level or above.

- 

A strong understanding of paid social advertising, creative testing, campaign scaling, and performance optimization.

- 

The ability to translate campaign data and KPIs into actionable creative and strategic improvements.

- 

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a strong understanding of audience behavior and consumer motivations.

- 

A proactive, results-oriented mindset and the ability to take ownership of projects from concept through execution.

- 

Full-time availability and a willingness to go the extra mile to achieve ambitious objectives.

## Benefits:

- 

Competitive compensation: The job listing specifies €4,000–€6,000 per month, while the benefits section lists €5,000–€7,000 per month. The applicable salary range should be confirmed during the recruitment process.

- 

Permanent employment contract offering long-term professional stability.

- 

Remote work: The flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in the world.

- 

Flexible working hours to support an adaptable work environment.

- 

Professional development: Access to ongoing training and opportunities to expand your performance marketing expertise.

- 

Advanced creative training: Access to top-tier creative training valued at over €100,000.

- 

Performance-based rewards: Opportunity to participate in the company's success through a success-based compensation component.

- 

Direct founder collaboration: Work closely with leadership and contribute to strategic marketing decisions.

- 

High-impact projects: Drive creative and campaign performance for more than 100 established consumer brands.

 How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
 Why Apply Through Jobgether? 
 
Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Recruiter, Performance Marketing based in the United States.

As a Performance Marketing Recruiter, you will identify and attract exceptional talent across performance marketing, creative, and agency operations.
You will manage the full recruitment lifecycle, partnering with hiring managers and recruiting leadership to define hiring priorities and deliver high-quality candidates.
Through targeted sourcing, structured interviews, and evidence-based assessments, you will evaluate candidates’ expertise, individual contributions, and potential to drive measurable results.
You will build strong relationships with both active and passive candidates, ensuring a transparent and engaging experience throughout a multi-stage hiring process.
Working in a fast-paced, high-growth digital marketing environment, you will help shape teams that deliver outstanding results for clients.
You will also leverage AI-powered tools and recruiting technology to improve sourcing efficiency, candidate evaluation, and operational workflows.
This remote opportunity is ideal for a strategic, detail-oriented recruiter who combines sound judgment, strong communication, and a commitment to hiring excellence.

You will own recruitment processes from initial search strategy through offer acceptance, ensuring hiring decisions are informed, efficient, and aligned with business needs. Your responsibilities will include:

- 

Define recruitment strategies: Partner with hiring managers and recruiting leadership to clarify role requirements, hiring priorities, and the skills and results that define exceptional performance.

- 

Manage the full recruitment lifecycle: Lead sourcing, outreach, screening, candidate assessment, hiring team coordination, feedback, offer discussions, and closing conversations.

- 

Source high-performing talent: Identify and engage passive candidates through targeted research, personalized outreach, referrals, and long-term relationship building.

- 

Recruit across specialized functions: Build candidate pipelines for paid media, performance marketing, creative, and agency operations roles, developing a strong understanding of relevant platforms, technical skills, and performance expectations.

- 

Conduct in-depth interviews: Assess candidates’ individual contributions, technical knowledge, professional judgment, career goals, and compensation expectations through structured conversations and thoughtful follow-up questions.

- 

Provide evidence-based recommendations: Present candidates to hiring teams with clear assessments of their strengths, relevant experience, and areas requiring further exploration.

- 

Manage the candidate experience: Guide candidates through technical assessments, culture interviews, and executive discussions, keeping them informed and engaged at every stage.

- 

Coordinate hiring activities: Work with recruiting coordinators and interviewers to organize interviews, collect timely feedback, resolve outstanding questions, and maintain hiring momentum.

- 

Maintain accurate recruitment records: Update candidate profiles, interview notes, feedback, and pipeline stages in Workable.

- 

Support hiring administration: Use Workday to track requisitions, maintain accurate records, support approvals, and coordinate offer processes.

- 

Maintain job documentation: Keep job descriptions and requisition details current as hiring requirements and business priorities evolve.

- 

Support compensation and offers: Facilitate compensation discussions, help candidates make informed decisions, and ensure a smooth transition after offer acceptance.

- 

Improve recruiting operations: Apply AI tools to sourcing, research, outreach, and workflow optimization while retaining independent judgment in candidate assessment and communication.

- 

Enhance hiring quality: Identify opportunities to improve assessment methods, recruitment processes, and the overall candidate experience.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced recruiter who can manage complex searches, assess specialized talent, and build trusted relationships with candidates and hiring stakeholders. You should bring:

- 

At least 5 years of recruiting experience, ideally within a marketing or advertising agency, staffing agency, or another fast-paced environment.

- 

A proven track record of identifying and engaging high-performing passive candidates for specialized positions.

- 

Experience partnering directly with hiring managers and managing multiple searches with competing priorities and diverse stakeholders.

- 

The ability to evaluate candidates’ actual contributions, depth of expertise, practical skills, and alignment with role requirements.

- 

Strong interviewing skills, including the ability to ask insightful follow-up questions and distinguish demonstrated expertise from rehearsed responses.

- 

Sound professional judgment when advocating for candidates, identifying concerns, and adjusting search strategies.

- 

Excellent candidate relationship management and communication skills, particularly throughout detailed, multi-stage interview processes.

- 

Confidence discussing compensation, managing offer negotiations, and supporting candidates through informed career decisions.

- 

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail across candidate pipelines, requisitions, interview feedback, and hiring documentation.

- 

Experience using applicant tracking systems (ATS); familiarity with Workable and Workday is an advantage.

- 

Curiosity about emerging recruiting technologies and practical applications of AI to sourcing, assessment, and workflow efficiency.

- 

The ability to collaborate effectively, manage changing priorities, and maintain high recruitment standards in a dynamic environment.

Benefits:

- 

Competitive compensation: Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses. A specific salary range is not provided in the available job description.

- 

Uncapped compensation model: The organization describes a revenue-sharing approach in which approximately 40% of top-line revenue is shared with the team monthly; the precise eligibility and application of this model to this position are not specified.

- 

Remote work flexibility: Freedom to work remotely from a location where you feel comfortable, with access to an office environment if preferred.

- 

Health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

- 

Retirement benefits: 401(k) matching plan.

- 

Paid time off: Paid leave and holidays.

- 

Insurance protection: Life and accident insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability plans.

- 

Family support: Paid parental leave and family-forming benefits.

- 

Employee well-being: Employee Assistance Programs and access to virtual health services.

- 

Healthcare spending options: Health Savings Account (HSA), Health Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Limited Purpose FSA, and Dependent Care FSA.

- 

Additional support: Access to MetLife Legal Plan Services and Cigna Secure Travel.

- 

Professional development: Opportunities for learning, career growth, and continued skill development.

- 

Work equipment: New MacBook Pro.

- 

Collaborative culture: An environment that values problem-solving, ownership, innovation, execution, thought leadership, and teamwork.

- 

Meaningful impact: The opportunity to help build high-performing teams in a growing digital performance marketing environment.

job.title: Manager, Performance Marketing
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Manager, Performance Marketing based in the United States.

The Manager, Performance Marketing will lead paid acquisition strategy, channel diversification, and website conversion optimization in a mission-driven healthcare environment focused on improving access to substance use disorder treatment. This hands-on leadership role will expand beyond established search campaigns to build and scale affiliate, programmatic, streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit channels. You will oversee budget allocation, develop rigorous experimentation programs, and optimize the digital journey from first impression to lead submission. Working closely with analytics, content, design, and patient access teams, you will connect marketing investment to meaningful business outcomes. Success will be measured by the ability to reduce the cost of acquiring new members who complete their first visit, rather than simply generating leads. This is an opportunity to combine analytical rigor, creative testing, and collaborative leadership to drive sustainable growth while helping more people access effective, compassionate care.

- Paid Media Strategy and Performance: Own quarterly paid cost-per-new-member targets, manage budget allocation and pacing across acquisition channels, and optimize investment based on measurable outcomes. Lead the diversification of paid acquisition beyond search by launching, testing, and scaling affiliate, programmatic, streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit campaigns. Establish clear performance targets and scale-or-stop criteria for every channel, accounting for seasonality and evolving acquisition costs.

- Campaign Management and Optimization: Build and optimize campaigns in emerging channels, manage external partners, and ensure advertising efforts prioritize member-level outcomes over platform-reported leads. Direct paid search specialists by setting priorities, reviewing performance, and independently auditing Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts. Test emerging bidding strategies and campaign types, including AI Max, and maintain offline conversion tracking and value-based bidding wherever supported.

- Affiliate and Partner Development: Build and manage the affiliate program, including partner recruitment, qualification, commercial terms, performance tracking, and ongoing quality assessment. Collaborate with Legal and Compliance to structure partner compensation in accordance with applicable healthcare regulations, including EKRA and Anti-Kickback requirements. Ensure all partners meet advertising, privacy, and member-quality standards.

- Website Conversion and Experimentation: Own website-visitor-to-lead conversion performance, including landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. Develop a structured testing roadmap based on expected business impact, using documented hypotheses, predefined success metrics, and clear post-test analysis. Partner with content and design specialists to improve landing pages and collaborate with the Organic & AI Acquisition team on changes that support both conversion and discoverability.

- Funnel Measurement and Reporting: Monitor the acquisition funnel from initial impression to lead submission, establish reliable conversion baselines, and identify the steps with the greatest improvement potential. Report paid cost per new member, channel-level performance, and member quality, accounting for attribution limitations and using incrementality testing when appropriate. Maintain clear attribution between paid and non-paid acquisition, report monthly results against targets, and proactively explain performance variances.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Access team and the lifecycle marketing function to understand how lead quality, insurance verification, appointment scheduling, follow-up communications, and first-visit attendance affect acquisition outcomes. Participate in regular intake funnel reviews and use shared insights to improve the full path from marketing engagement to treatment entry.

- Team and Vendor Leadership: Set expectations, provide regular feedback, and develop paid media specialists. Manage affiliate networks, programmatic and audio partners, and other vendors with clear performance expectations. Maintain a quarterly operating plan outlining priorities, expected impact, owners, and timelines.

- Compliance and Responsible Marketing: Ensure paid campaigns comply with LegitScript certification requirements, advertising platform policies, patient privacy standards, and applicable healthcare marketing regulations. Apply sound judgment when evaluating new channels, partner relationships, and measurement practices in a regulated environment.

## Requirements:

- Experience: Approximately five or more years of experience in performance marketing, paid acquisition, or growth marketing, including at least two years managing substantial paid media budgets.

- Paid Channel Expertise: Hands-on experience with at least three of the following channel groups: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate marketing, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. Demonstrated depth in at least one of affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, or Reddit is essential; experience across two or more is strongly preferred. Paid search expertise alone is insufficient for this role.

- Channel Development: Proven ability to launch a paid acquisition channel from the ground up, establish reliable measurement, and scale or discontinue investment based on customer- or member-level economics rather than platform-reported conversions.

- Paid Search Knowledge: Working knowledge of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads sufficient to guide priorities, evaluate performance, and independently audit the work of paid search specialists.

- Conversion Rate Optimization: Demonstrated experience designing and running structured experimentation programs, including A/B testing, landing page optimization, creative testing, and documented analysis of both successful and unsuccessful experiments.

- Analytics and Measurement: Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to connect marketing investment to downstream outcomes. Experience with imperfect attribution, offline conversion tracking, value-based bidding, and incrementality testing is highly valuable.

- Leadership and Vendor Management: Experience directing specialists, contractors, agencies, or external vendors, with the ability to set clear expectations and maintain accountability. Direct people-management experience is a plus.

- Strategic and Operational Judgment: Strong prioritization, budget management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution, maintain focus under constraints, and adapt plans as market conditions change.

- Communication and Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain performance trends, document decisions, and work effectively with teams outside your direct reporting structure.

- Compliance Awareness: Sound judgment regarding patient privacy, healthcare advertising policies, partner compensation, and regulatory requirements. Familiarity with regulated industries and compliance-sensitive marketing practices is an advantage.

- Mission Alignment: A thoughtful, compassionate approach to healthcare marketing, with an appreciation for the role that accessible, clear, and effective digital experiences can play in helping people enter treatment.

Additional experience that would be beneficial, but is not required:

- Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, addiction treatment, or another regulated industry.

- Familiarity with LegitScript certification and advertising policies for substance use disorder treatment.

- Experience building and managing affiliate programs through dedicated networks or platforms.

- Knowledge of customer data platforms, call tracking, or related marketing measurement tools.

- Experience partnering with contact centers, intake teams, or patient access functions on shared conversion goals.

- Experience managing acquisition across multiple states, regions, or markets.

## Benefits:

- Competitive Compensation: Target annual compensation of $105,000–$115,000, depending on qualifications, relevant experience, specialized skills, education, certifications, and geographic location.

- Remote Work: Remote position open to candidates based in the United States.

- Paid Time Off: 12 vacation days, 12 wellness and sick days, three floating holidays, and nine company-observed holidays. Additional leave may be available for jury duty, voting, and other qualifying circumstances. Vacation entitlement may be prorated for new employees.

- Health Coverage: Employer-paid medical and dental insurance plans, with affordable vision coverage.

- Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 3% employer match to support long-term financial well-being.

- Disability Coverage: Short-term disability coverage and employee-paid long-term disability insurance.

- Life Insurance: Employer-provided and employee-paid life insurance options.

- Family and Medical Leave: Paid Family & Medical Leave benefits for approved qualifying family and medical circumstances, including childbirth, adoption, fostering, and serious health conditions.

- Mental Health and Wellness: Mindfulness app reimbursement, an Employee Assistance Program with eight face-to-face sessions, and virtual health and wellness visits covered by the medical plan.

- Purpose-Driven Work: The opportunity to contribute to a mission-focused healthcare organization working to improve access to evidence-based substance use disorder treatment and whole-person care.

- Collaborative Environment: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams in a performance-focused culture that values accountability, continuous improvement, and compassionate care.

This is an opportunity to combine analytical rigor, creative testing, and collaborative leadership to drive sustainable growth while helping more people access effective, compassionate care.

- Paid Media Strategy and Performance: Own quarterly paid cost-per-new-member targets, manage budget allocation and pacing across acquisition channels, and optimize investment based on measurable outcomes. Lead the diversification of paid acquisition beyond search by launching, testing, and scaling affiliate, programmatic, streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit campaigns. Establish clear performance targets and scale-or-stop criteria for every channel, accounting for seasonality and evolving acquisition costs.

- Campaign Management and Optimization: Build and optimize campaigns in emerging channels, manage external partners, and ensure advertising efforts prioritize member-level outcomes over platform-reported leads. Direct paid search specialists by setting priorities, reviewing performance, and independently auditing Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts. Test emerging bidding strategies and campaign types, including AI Max, and maintain offline conversion tracking and value-based bidding wherever supported.

- Affiliate and Partner Development: Build and manage the affiliate program, including partner recruitment, qualification, commercial terms, performance tracking, and ongoing quality assessment. Collaborate with Legal and Compliance to structure partner compensation in accordance with applicable healthcare regulations, including EKRA and Anti-Kickback requirements. Ensure all partners meet advertising, privacy, and member-quality standards.

- Website Conversion and Experimentation: Own website-visitor-to-lead conversion performance, including landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. Develop a structured testing roadmap based on expected business impact, using documented hypotheses, predefined success metrics, and clear post-test analysis. Partner with content and design specialists to improve landing pages and collaborate with the Organic & AI Acquisition team on changes that support both conversion and discoverability.

Report paid cost per new member, channel-level performance, and member quality, accounting for attribution limitations and using incrementality testing when appropriate. Maintain clear attribution between paid and non-paid acquisition, report monthly results against targets, and proactively explain performance variances.

Participate in regular intake funnel reviews and use shared insights to improve the full path from marketing engagement to treatment entry.

- Team and Vendor Leadership: Set expectations, provide regular feedback, and develop paid media specialists. Manage affiliate networks, programmatic and audio partners, and other vendors with clear performance expectations. Maintain a quarterly operating plan outlining priorities, expected impact, owners, and timelines.

- Compliance and Responsible Marketing: Ensure paid campaigns comply with LegitScript certification requirements, advertising platform policies, patient privacy standards, and applicable healthcare marketing regulations. Apply sound judgment when evaluating new channels, partner relationships, and measurement practices in a regulated environment.

- Channel Development: Proven ability to launch a paid acquisition channel from the ground up, establish reliable measurement, and scale or discontinue investment based on customer- or member-level economics rather than platform-reported conversions.
