- Analytics and Measurement: Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to connect marketing investment to downstream outcomes. Experience with imperfect attribution, offline conversion tracking, value-based bidding, and incrementality testing is highly valuable.

- Leadership and Vendor Management: Experience directing specialists, contractors, agencies, or external vendors, with the ability to set clear expectations and maintain accountability. Direct people-management experience is a plus.

- Strategic and Operational Judgment: Strong prioritization, budget management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution, maintain focus under constraints, and adapt plans as market conditions change.

- Communication and Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain performance trends, document decisions, and work effectively with teams outside your direct reporting structure.

- Compliance Awareness: Sound judgment regarding patient privacy, healthcare advertising policies, partner compensation, and regulatory requirements. Familiarity with regulated industries and compliance-sensitive marketing practices is an advantage.

- Mission Alignment: A thoughtful, compassionate approach to healthcare marketing, with an appreciation for the role that accessible, clear, and effective digital experiences can play in helping people enter treatment.

Additional experience that would be beneficial, but is not required:

- Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, addiction treatment, or another regulated industry.

- Familiarity with LegitScript certification and advertising policies for substance use disorder treatment.

- Experience building and managing affiliate programs through dedicated networks or platforms.

- Knowledge of customer data platforms, call tracking, or related marketing measurement tools.

- Experience partnering with contact centers, intake teams, or patient access functions on shared conversion goals.

- Experience managing acquisition across multiple states, regions, or markets.

- Competitive Compensation: Target annual compensation of $105,000–$115,000, depending on qualifications, relevant experience, specialized skills, education, certifications, and geographic location.

- Remote Work: Remote position open to candidates based in the United States.

- Paid Time Off: 12 vacation days, 12 wellness and sick days, three floating holidays, and nine company-observed holidays. Additional leave may be available for jury duty, voting, and other qualifying circumstances. Vacation entitlement may be prorated for new employees.

- Health Coverage: Employer-paid medical and dental insurance plans, with affordable vision coverage.

- Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 3% employer match to support long-term financial well-being.

- Disability Coverage: Short-term disability coverage and employee-paid long-term disability insurance.

- Life Insurance: Employer-provided and employee-paid life insurance options.

- Family and Medical Leave: Paid Family & Medical Leave benefits for approved qualifying family and medical circumstances, including childbirth, adoption, fostering, and serious health conditions.

- Mental Health and Wellness: Mindfulness app reimbursement, an Employee Assistance Program with eight face-to-face sessions, and virtual health and wellness visits covered by the medical plan.

- Purpose-Driven Work: The opportunity to contribute to a mission-focused healthcare organization working to improve access to evidence-based substance use disorder treatment and whole-person care.

job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Agentic Performance Marketing Manager based in the United States.

Take ownership of paid acquisition in a fast-moving, AI-native marketing environment where experimentation and automation drive growth. As a Senior Agentic Performance Marketing Manager, you will lead campaign strategy and execution across Meta and Google while building AI agents that streamline optimization, reporting, and budget management. You will combine hands-on media buying with data analysis, conversion rate optimization, and creative experimentation to improve acquisition efficiency. Working closely with a small paid marketing team, designers, developers, and creative strategists, you will turn performance insights into measurable business outcomes. You will also launch campaigns for new products, track the full customer journey, and optimize key metrics such as customer acquisition cost, payback period, and lifetime value. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for an ambitious marketer who thrives on autonomy, embraces AI-driven workflows, and continuously looks for ways to improve performance.

In this role, you will own paid acquisition performance while developing practical AI-powered systems that make campaign management more efficient and scalable. You will balance hands-on execution with experimentation, automation, and strategic decision-making. Your responsibilities will include:

- 

Build, launch, manage, and optimize paid acquisition campaigns across Meta and Google.

- 

Own trial cost-per-acquisition (CPA) targets within monthly spending limits, reallocating budgets toward the best-performing campaigns and creative concepts.

- 

Lead and support a four-person paid marketing team, establishing high performance standards and taking responsibility for overall results.

- 

Build and maintain AI agents and automations to handle recurring advertising tasks, including daily account checks, budget adjustments, and reporting across AI models.

- 

Identify and automate repetitive manual processes to improve efficiency and campaign management.

- 

Analyze campaign and audience performance to develop actionable creative briefs for creative strategists.

- 

Collaborate with design and development teams to build and test paid landing pages, improve conversion rates, and reduce CPA.

- 

Monitor the customer journey from initial click through activation, tracking acquisition costs, payback periods, and customer lifetime value.

- 

Launch and optimize advertising campaigns for new products without historical performance data, using structured experimentation to identify opportunities.

- 

Investigate performance fluctuations, diagnose CPA changes, and communicate findings clearly to leadership.

- 

Allocate time across media buying, analytics, AI agent development, landing page testing, and conversion rate optimization.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is a hands-on performance marketer with a strong track record of scaling paid campaigns and a practical ability to build AI-powered automations. You should combine analytical rigor with independent problem-solving, sound judgment, and a willingness to challenge existing approaches. The key qualifications include:

- 

At least five years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing Meta and Google advertising campaigns, with monthly advertising budgets of $100,000 or more.

- 

Deep expertise in Meta advertising, including campaign structure, creative strategy, and scaling successful concepts.

- 

Strong experience with Google Search and Performance Max campaigns.

- 

Agency-side experience managing paid acquisition campaigns.

- 

Experience in SaaS or B2B marketing, particularly businesses using free-trial or book-a-demo conversion funnels.

- 

Demonstrated ability to build and maintain AI agents or automations that actively support advertising workflows, with the technical understanding to explain, troubleshoot, and repair them.

- 

Strong analytical skills and practical experience with GA4, PostHog, advertising platform reporting, and spreadsheets.

- 

Experience running creative and landing page experiments that have demonstrably improved conversion rates or reduced CPA.

- 

Ability to interpret performance data, identify issues proactively, and communicate complex findings clearly to founders and other stakeholders.

- 

Strong ownership, initiative, prioritization, and decision-making skills in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

- 

Comfort working independently, managing ambiguity, responding to platform volatility, and meeting demanding deadlines.

- 

A proactive mindset, with a willingness to experiment, challenge assumptions, and continuously improve campaign performance.

Additional experience with SQL, LinkedIn Ads, sales-led or book-a-demo funnels, HubSpot, and Stripe is considered an advantage.

-

- 

Working hours: Ability to work within the Eastern Standard Time (EST) time zone.

job.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager (Paid Media)
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Demand Generation Manager (Paid Media) based in the United States.

Join an innovative technology environment at the intersection of AI, cloud infrastructure, and global connectivity, where marketing is powered by intelligent automation and data-driven decision-making. As the Senior Demand Generation Manager, you will build and lead a dedicated demand generation program from the ground up, with ownership of strategy, budget, and measurable business outcomes. You will manage full-funnel paid media campaigns across search, social, programmatic advertising, and emerging AI-powered advertising channels. Working with advanced AI agents, you will combine automated campaign execution with strategic judgment to optimize performance, improve efficiency, and scale growth. You will also lead account-based marketing initiatives, develop creator partnerships, and collaborate closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing. This role offers significant autonomy, access to cutting-edge AI tools, and the opportunity to shape how modern B2B marketing operates. Success will be measured by your ability to generate qualified pipeline, drive product activations, and contribute directly to revenue growth.

- Lead paid media strategy and execution: Plan, launch, manage, and optimize full-funnel campaigns across search, social, programmatic, and emerging AI advertising platforms, overseeing campaign quality assurance, budget pacing, creative refreshes, and landing page performance across channels and regions.

- Build AI-powered marketing operations: Direct a fleet of autonomous AI agents that support campaign management and optimization. Develop and refine prompts, evaluate machine-generated recommendations and confidence scores, manage approval workflows, and determine when human intervention is necessary.

- Own budget allocation and performance: Manage monthly budgets across advertising platforms, monitor spending, reallocate investment based on performance data, and maintain disciplined budget controls and transparent spending records.

- Optimize campaigns continuously: Conduct weekly performance reviews, identify creative fatigue, analyze search terms and audience segments, diagnose acquisition costs and funnel performance, and make data-backed decisions about scaling or discontinuing campaigns.

- Drive account-based marketing (ABM): Define ideal customer profiles, develop target account lists, build audience segments and Salesforce account pools, coordinate regional campaigns with Sales, and ensure targeting data remains accurate and synchronized across advertising platforms.

- Align cross-functional teams: Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing to review high-priority accounts, analyze wins and losses, improve lead routing and attribution, and refine positioning and messaging using paid media insights.

- Manage influencer and creator initiatives: Identify relevant creators, develop campaign briefs, coordinate sponsorships, amplify creator content through paid media, and measure audience engagement and conversion outcomes.

- Deliver actionable reporting: Provide weekly and monthly performance updates to marketing, sales, and executive stakeholders, communicating results clearly, identifying opportunities, and recommending concrete next steps.

- Build and scale a new growth program: Establish the strategy, processes, channel mix, and operating standards for a dedicated marketing program, using AI automation and continuous experimentation to improve efficiency and business impact.

## Requirements

- Relevant experience: At least 5 years of experience in B2B demand generation, ideally within developer tools, cloud infrastructure, telecommunications, or another technical B2B market.

- Paid media expertise: Demonstrated hands-on experience managing full-funnel paid media campaigns across at least three major advertising platforms, with a strong understanding of acquisition, conversion, and performance optimization.

- AI and automation proficiency: Practical experience using AI agents or automated workflows in marketing operations. You should be comfortable writing precise prompts, critically evaluating AI-generated recommendations, and designing workflows in which AI handles execution while people retain appropriate oversight.

- Account-based marketing: Proven experience developing and executing ABM campaigns, including account targeting, audience segmentation, and measurable pipeline generation.

- Data analysis and attribution: Strong analytical skills and the ability to reconcile advertising platform conversion data with CRM and attribution reporting. You must be comfortable challenging unreliable metrics and making decisions based on validated performance data.

- Budget ownership: Experience managing marketing budgets, adjusting channel investment, monitoring acquisition costs, and connecting spending decisions to pipeline, activation, and revenue outcomes.

- Strategic and operational ownership: The ability to build programs from scratch, navigate ambiguity, establish effective processes, and take responsibility for measurable results.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with Sales, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, and other teams.

- Continuous optimization mindset: A structured, experimental approach to marketing, with the ability to identify opportunities, test new ideas, learn from results, and scale successful initiatives.

- Adaptability and innovation: Enthusiasm for emerging advertising technologies, AI agents, agentic runtimes, frontier AI models, and new approaches to demand generation.

## Benefits

- Competitive compensation: A dedicated budget and direct ownership of marketing investment, with performance evaluated against meaningful business outcomes. A specific salary range was not provided in the original job description.

- Significant ownership: Build a new demand generation program from the ground up, with autonomy over strategy, channel selection, budget allocation, and execution.

- Cutting-edge AI technology: Work directly with advanced AI agents, agentic runtimes, frontier models, voice AI, and inference APIs as part of your daily marketing workflow.

- Early access to new tools: Experiment with emerging AI technologies and contribute feedback that can influence how tools and workflows evolve.

- AI-powered marketing infrastructure: Benefit from an existing fleet of AI agents that handles campaign operations, allowing you to focus on strategic decisions, performance, and growth.

- High-impact work: Own a full-funnel marketing program and contribute directly to pipeline generation, product activations, and revenue.

- Collaborative environment: Work alongside experienced professionals who manage their own marketing programs and share responsibility for business results.

- Professional development: Gain hands-on experience at the intersection of demand generation, AI automation, and modern technology infrastructure.

- Financial stability: Join a profitable technology organization that invests in innovation, operational efficiency, and long-term growth.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

job.description:
About the Job
Mars Men is one of the fastest growing DTC brands in the US, achieving $100M run rate in less then 18 months. Recently backed by L Catterton, Mars Men is positioned to become the leading men’s health brand in the supplement space. We operate across DTC, retail, and emerging channels, and are entering our next phase of growth as we continue scaling the business.

We’re looking for an exceptional Paid Search & YouTube Manager to help scale Mars Men’s next stage of growth. You’ll own the strategy, execution, and day-to-day performance of our Google Ads and YouTube Ads channels, driving efficient customer acquisition while growing revenue and acquisition volume.
You’ll work closely with our Growth, Creative, and Analytics teams to translate business goals into campaign strategy, build a structured testing roadmap, and continuously improve performance. This is a role for a highly analytical, hands-on performance marketer who takes ownership of channel results, knows how to turn data into action, and thrives in a fast-moving environment where their work has a direct impact on the business.

- Own and scale the day-to-day performance of our Google Ads and YouTube Ads channels, deploying budgets effectively to hit CPA, acquisition volume, and revenue targets while identifying opportunities to scale efficiently.

- Develop and execute campaign strategies aligned with business goals across keyword targeting, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, campaign structure, and budget allocation.

- Build and lead a structured testing roadmap across ad copy, creative, landing pages, audiences, and bidding strategies, using performance insights to continuously improve results.

- Analyze and optimize full-funnel performance to identify trends, diagnose account inefficiencies, investigate fluctuations in results, and uncover opportunities to improve conversion rates and drive profitable growth.

- Strengthen measurement and attribution by optimizing conversion tracking, improving signal quality, and partnering with Analytics to ensure accurate reporting and effective performance-based bidding.

- Collaborate and stay ahead by working closely with Growth and Creative on campaign performance and funnel efficiency while keeping up with changes in search, paid media, and AI-driven advertising.

- 3–5+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience, ideally at a fast-growing DTC, eCommerce, subscription, or consumer brand, with a track record of improving performance and scaling acquisition.

- Deep expertise in paid search and Google Ads, with the ability to independently build, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize campaigns and translate business objectives into effective channel strategy. Experience with YouTube Ads is strongly preferred.

- Proven ability to own performance against CPA and ROAS targets, balancing acquisition volume, revenue growth, and efficiency while making sound decisions about when and where to scale spend.

- Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to problem-solving, with advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and experience using GA4, Northbeam, or similar analytics and attribution tools.

- A deep understanding of conversion tracking and measurement, including attribution, conversion signals, and performance-based bidding, with the ability to identify data quality issues and turn insights into actionable improvements.

- A strong bias toward ownership and action, with the ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, communicate clearly, and move work forward in a fast-paced startup environment.

 Life at Mars Men
Competitive Compensation - We offer a strong salary and benefits package, tailored to attract top talent
Remote Work Environment - Our team is remote, offering full flexibility to work from home
Autonomy & Ownership - You’ll have the freedom to run your own systems and make real impact
Time Off - 15 PTO days per year (prorated), 9 company holidays, plus your birthday off
Parental Leave - Generous paid parental leave for growing families
Health Benefits - 100% premium coverage for health, dental, and vision plans, with 25% coverage for dependents
401(k) - Company-sponsored plan with a 2% match through Guideline (elective participation)
$200 Annual Superpower Membership
Growth & Development - We invest in your professional development with ongoing learning opportunities

job.description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

About the Role

Our Sr. Account Managers, Paid Search are responsible for driving KPI improvements and developing cutting-edge strategies tailored to client goals. Your core responsibilities in this role include strategy development, tactical execution, and management of client relationships.

  • Taking on clients in month 1, you will build & optimize Google and Bing search campaigns for a roster of B2B, lead generation, and/or ecommerce clients across various industries
    • Client assignments will be a mix of leading paid search efforts on small-spending clients and acting as a supporting paid search team member on medium to enterprise clients
  • Define, monitor and analyze trends in clients’ KPIs
  • Develop both short & long term paid search strategy based on client-specific goals
  • Actively test and analyze keywords, advertising copy, landing pages, campaign types and positioning to drive results in line with client's goals
  • Communicate performance results and strategy recommendations to clients clearly & secure buy-in from decision-makers
    • Create slides with good design & strong storytelling for clients
  • Create quarterly business reviews & other client-facing presentations that outline performance, insights from testing, and key strategic opportunities
  • Delegate work to junior team members & provide clear direction & feedback when needed
  • Stay current on SEM industry trends, contribute to internal agency conversations around SEM (including but not limited to monthly department meetings, trainings, case studies, etc.)

About You

The essentials:

  • 2+ years of direct paid search client management including paid search strategy development, execution & client relationship management
  • Passion for crunching numbers, analyzing data, and navigating Excel/Google sheet spreadsheets
  • Possess high attention to detail and be able to execute with a high degree of accuracy
  • Performance Max experience is a must
  • Hands-on product feed management and shopping experience a plus
  • You are a communication guru both on calls and through written communication
  • ‘Driven’ and ‘Innovative’ are attributes commonly associated with you
  • You are proactive & willing to raise your hand to support your team members
  • Highly collaborative & works well with a team
  • 4-year college degree or equivalent work experience

 

At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.

#LI-Remote

  • Excellent, full coverage medical, dental, and vision insurance - more about our coverage here!
  • Generous PTO and 15 company-wide holidays
  • 401k with company contribution
  • Paid parental leave
  • Work-life balance with an emphasis on personal well-being
  • Career growth in a disruptor space & entrepreneurial opportunities within the Monks network 
  • A globally diverse & inclusive culture with employee resource groups such as S4 Melanin, Pride.Monks, Cultura.Monks, and more!

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

About the Role

Our Sr. Account Managers, Paid Search are responsible for driving KPI improvements and developing cutting-edge strategies tailored to client goals. Your core responsibilities in this role include strategy development, tactical execution, and management of client relationships.

  • Taking on clients in month 1, you will build & optimize Google and Bing search campaigns for a roster of B2B, lead generation, and/or ecommerce clients across various industries
    • Client assignments will be a mix of leading paid search efforts on small-spending clients and acting as a supporting paid search team member on medium to enterprise clients
  • Define, monitor and analyze trends in clients’ KPIs
  • Develop both short & long term paid search strategy based on client-specific goals
  • Actively test and analyze keywords, advertising copy, landing pages, campaign types and positioning to drive results in line with client's goals
  • Communicate performance results and strategy recommendations to clients clearly & secure buy-in from decision-makers
    • Create slides with good design & strong storytelling for clients
  • Create quarterly business reviews & other client-facing presentations that outline performance, insights from testing, and key strategic opportunities
  • Delegate work to junior team members & provide clear direction & feedback when needed
  • Stay current on SEM industry trends, contribute to internal agency conversations around SEM (including but not limited to monthly department meetings, trainings, case studies, etc.)

About You

The essentials:

  • 2+ years of direct paid search client management including paid search strategy development, execution & client relationship management
  • Passion for crunching numbers, analyzing data, and navigating Excel/Google sheet spreadsheets
  • Possess high attention to detail and be able to execute with a high degree of accuracy
  • Performance Max experience is a must
  • Hands-on product feed management and shopping experience a plus
  • You are a communication guru both on calls and through written communication
  • ‘Driven’ and ‘Innovative’ are attributes commonly associated with you
  • You are proactive & willing to raise your hand to support your team members
  • Highly collaborative & works well with a team
  • 4-year college degree or equivalent work experience

 

At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.  

#LI-OG1 #LI-Hybrid

What We Offer

Benefits

  • Excellent, full coverage medical, dental, and vision insurance - more about our coverage here!
  • Generous PTO and 15 company-wide holidays
  • 401k with company contribution
  • Paid parental leave
  • Work-life balance with an emphasis on personal well-being
  • Career growth in a disruptor space & entrepreneurial opportunities within the Monks network 
  • A globally diverse & inclusive culture with employee resource groups such as S4 Melanin, Pride.Monks, Cultura.Monks, and more!
  • Authentic commitment to DEI efforts and sustainable growth. (Why Sir Martin Sorrell signed The Climate Pledge here!)

 

This role is subject to our Return to Office (RTO) policy. If you reside within a commutable distance of one of our office locations, you will be expected to work from the office a set number of days per week. The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.

 

Monks has provided a compensation range that represents its good faith estimate of what Monks may pay for the position at the time of posting. Monks may ultimately pay more or less than the posted compensation range. The salary offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on job-related factors, but not based on a candidate’s sex or any other protected status.

 

 

 

Salary Range:
$69,000—$81,000 USD

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.
 
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

job.title: Performance Marketing Manager - Google Ads, Meta Ads & Paid Acquisition | Remote
job.description:
### Performance Marketing Manager – Google Ads, Meta Ads & Paid Acquisition | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

### About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid customer acquisition and drive profitable growth across digital advertising channels.

This is a hands-on performance role focused on Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, conversion tracking, campaign optimization, and ROAS. You’ll own campaigns from strategy and budget allocation through testing, optimization, and reporting.

### What You’ll Do

- Manage and optimize Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other paid channels

- Develop campaign structures, targeting, and audience strategies

- Own advertising budgets, spend allocation, and pacing

- Monitor and improve CAC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rates

- Test creatives, messaging, audiences, and landing pages

- Optimize campaigns based on performance and conversion data

- Implement and validate conversion tracking and attribution

- Build weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights

- Identify opportunities to scale profitable campaigns

- Collaborate with creative, sales, and leadership teams

### Requirements

- 3+ years of performance marketing or paid media experience

- Strong hands-on expertise with Google Ads and Meta Ads

- Experience managing meaningful paid advertising budgets

- Strong understanding of:

- ROAS and CAC

- CPL and CPA

- Conversion tracking

- Attribution

- Campaign optimization

- Demonstrated success improving ROAS or customer acquisition efficiency

- Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills

- Experience with creative and landing-page testing

- Ability to independently manage and optimize paid campaigns

- Strong written and verbal English communication

### What Success Looks Like

- Improved ROAS and customer acquisition efficiency

- Lower CAC, CPA, and CPL

- Consistent growth in qualified conversions

- Efficient budget allocation and campaign scaling

- Accurate conversion tracking and attribution

- Clear, actionable performance reporting

### Interview Process

- Initial Screening Call

- Spark Hire Video Interview

- Recruiter Interview

- Client Interview

- Offer & Onboarding

### Apply Now

If you’re a performance marketer who knows how to manage paid acquisition, optimize Google and Meta campaigns, analyze conversion data, and scale profitable growth, we’d love to hear from you.

#PerformanceMarketing #GoogleAds #MetaAds #PaidMedia #PaidAcquisition #PPC #ROAS #DigitalMarketing #GrowthMarketing #RemoteJobs

job.title: Performance Marketing Specialist
job.description:
### Performance Marketing Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Time Zone
 Location: Remote (Pakistan, LATAM, South Africa, Philippines Preferred)

### About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-focused Performance Marketing Specialist to develop, manage, and optimize paid marketing campaigns across multiple digital advertising platforms.

This role is ideal for a data-driven marketer who understands how to build scalable acquisition systems while balancing creativity, experimentation, and ROI optimization. You will oversee campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and additional paid channels, ensuring every campaign is optimized for measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments, understands full-funnel marketing, and continuously improves campaign performance through testing, analytics, and strategic optimization.

### What You’ll Own

### Campaign Strategy & Execution

• Develop and manage performance-driven advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other paid platforms
 • Plan and execute campaigns focused on lead generation, customer acquisition, sales, and brand growth
 • Create, test, and optimize ad creatives, messaging, audience targeting, and campaign structures
 • Collaborate with marketing, content, and creative teams to ensure alignment across campaigns and brand messaging
 • Manage campaign launches, scaling initiatives, and ongoing optimization efforts

### Optimization & Growth

• Monitor campaign performance daily and identify optimization opportunities
 • Conduct A/B testing across creatives, audiences, landing pages, and bidding strategies
 • Optimize budgets, bids, placements, and targeting to improve ROAS and reduce CPA/CPL
 • Experiment with new campaign formats, acquisition strategies, and audience segments
 • Stay updated on advertising platform updates, algorithm changes, and industry best practices

### Analytics & Reporting

• Track and analyze KPIs including CTR, CPC, CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, and funnel performance
 • Use Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and advertising dashboards to evaluate campaign effectiveness
 • Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights and optimization recommendations
 • Identify trends, attribution insights, and opportunities for scalable growth through data analysis

### Funnel & Conversion Strategy

• Understand and optimize the full customer acquisition funnel from ad click through conversion
 • Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to improve lead quality and conversion performance
 • Support landing page optimization and conversion-focused marketing initiatives
 • Ensure campaigns align with broader business growth and revenue objectives

### Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with design, content, sales, and marketing teams to improve campaign outcomes
 • Provide data-backed feedback on ad creatives, messaging, and conversion assets
 • Contribute to integrated marketing strategies across paid, organic, and outbound channels

### What Makes You a Great Fit

• Data-driven marketer who enjoys testing, analyzing, and optimizing campaigns
 • Strong understanding of performance marketing and customer acquisition funnels
 • Analytical thinker with the ability to turn campaign data into actionable growth strategies
 • Organized and detail-oriented while managing multiple campaigns simultaneously
 • Proactive problem-solver focused on continuous improvement and scalability
 • Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution

### Required Experience & Skills

• 3+ years of hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns
 • Proven experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or related paid platforms
 • Strong understanding of PPC, attribution models, conversion tracking, and paid funnel optimization
 • Experience using Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and related reporting tools

job.description:
### E-Commerce PPC Specialist (Amazon Focused)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Location: Remote
 Working Hours: Flexible with Partial U.S. Business Hours Overlap

### About the Role

We’re hiring a performance-driven E-Commerce PPC Specialist with deep Amazon advertising experience to help scale revenue across Amazon, Facebook Ads, and email marketing channels.

This role combines hands-on campaign execution with strategic growth marketing across the full customer journey. You will be responsible for optimizing Amazon PPC campaigns, improving product visibility, increasing ROAS, and supporting long-term eCommerce growth through multi-channel marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate understands Amazon Seller Central deeply, thinks analytically, and knows how to combine advertising, conversion optimization, and retention marketing to drive measurable business results.

This is not a passive campaign management role — we’re looking for someone who actively tests, optimizes, scales, and improves performance.

### What You’ll Own

### Amazon PPC Strategy & Optimization

• Build, launch, and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display
 • Conduct keyword research, bid optimization, and product targeting strategies
 • Analyze campaign performance and make data-driven scaling decisions
 • Reduce wasted ad spend while improving conversions and profitability
 • Support seasonal promotions, launches, and ranking strategies

### Amazon Seller Central & Marketplace Operations

• Manage and optimize Amazon product listings and marketplace performance
 • Monitor product rankings, reviews, inventory health, and listing quality
 • Identify marketplace trends and growth opportunities
 • Improve listing visibility, CTR, and conversion rates across product pages

### Facebook Ads & Cross-Channel Marketing

• Build and optimize Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns
 • Align paid social campaigns with Amazon traffic and conversion goals
 • Test creatives, audiences, hooks, and offers to improve campaign performance
 • Support broader customer acquisition and retargeting strategies

### Email Marketing & Retention

• Build and manage email marketing campaigns using Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar platforms
 • Create retention-focused campaigns to improve customer lifetime value (LTV)
 • Develop flows for abandoned carts, post-purchase follow-ups, and promotions
 • Support cross-channel customer engagement and repeat purchases

### Analytics & Performance Reporting

• Monitor KPIs across Amazon, Facebook Ads, and email campaigns
 • Generate weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights
 • Analyze ROAS, CTR, CAC, conversion rates, and revenue performance
 • Recommend strategic optimizations based on campaign and customer data

### What Makes You a Great Fit

• You are highly analytical and performance-driven
 • You understand the full eCommerce customer journey
 • You enjoy testing, optimizing, and scaling campaigns
 • You can balance strategy with hands-on execution
 • You stay current with Amazon advertising trends and platform changes
 • You thrive in fast-moving eCommerce environments

### Required Experience & Skills

• 3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC management experience
 • Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Ads
 • Experience managing Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns
 • Familiarity with email marketing platforms such as Klaviyo or Mailchimp
 • Strong understanding of campaign analytics and performance optimization
 • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
 • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

### Preferred Experience

• Experience with fast-growing D2C or eCommerce brands
 • Familiarity with Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or additional paid media platforms
 • Strong copywriting skills for ads and email campaigns
 • Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) and A/B testing
 • Understanding of customer retention and lifecycle marketing

### What a Typical Day Looks Like

An E-Commerce PPC Specialist’s day revolves around monitoring campaigns, optimizing performance, and scaling growth opportunities. You will:
 • Review campaign performance across Amazon, Facebook, and email marketing channels
 • Optimize bids, targeting, keywords, and creatives
 • Analyze ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, and profitability metrics
 • Update product listings and monitor marketplace health
 • Launch and test new campaigns or audience segments
 • Build reports and communicate insights to leadership and stakeholders
 • Collaborate with creative and marketing teams on growth initiatives

In short: you are responsible for driving profitable growth across Amazon and digital marketing channels through data-driven optimization and strategic execution.

### Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

• Increased ROAS and campaign profitability
 • Growth in Amazon sales and conversion rates
 • Improved CTR and engagement across paid campaigns
 • Increased email revenue and retention performance
 • Reduced wasted ad spend and improved CAC efficiency
 • Timely reporting with actionable growth recommendations

### Interview Process

• Initial Interview with Pavago Recruitment Team
 • Client Interview with Hiring Manager
 • Practical Assessment (Campaign Optimization Exercise)
 • Final Discussion & Offer

### Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)

Location: Remote in Austin Texas, USA. This is a remote position, but candidates must be based in the Austin metropolitan area or near by to support regular in-person collaboration with colleagues and partners. PetLab Co. does not currently maintain an office in Austin.

### About the Role

PetLab Co. is a world leader in the DTC pet supplement market with a 9-figure revenue, profitable and rapidly growing globally.

In the world of performance marketing (especially for brands like PetLabCo.), a Creative Strategist is the bridge between the Media Buying team (the numbers) and the Creative team (the visuals).

Think of them as a data-driven storyteller. Their job is to ensure that every pixel and every word in an ad is designed to convert, based on actual performance data rather than gut feeling.

This role sits at the intersection of creative thinking, data analysis, and growth marketing. You’ll partner closely with our Paid Media, Video Producers, Organic Social, and Influencer teams to develop high-performing ad creatives that scale customer acquisition and revenue.

### Who Will You Report Into? 

Hi, I’m Jesper Mansson, Director of Creative Strategy, and we’re seeking a senior-level creative thinker who is obsessed with direct response, passionate about performance, and knows how to lead content strategy that scales.

You’ll be a core strategic partner to our paid, organic, and influencer teams, with a direct impact on how we acquire and retain customers.

If you live and breathe performance creative and want to help shape the future of a 9-figure DTC business, let’s talk

### What You'll be Responsible For:

1. Data Analysis & Performance Auditing – You’ll spend a significant amount of time inside ad platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube) Identifying what’s working and why. This will include:

- Analyzing performance metrics such as Hook Rate (3-second views / impressions), Hold Rate (average watch time), CTR, CPA, and ROAS

- Identifying winning creative patterns — for example whether a UGC “vlogger” style outperforms highly produced brand content

- Conducting creative audits to identify which customer pain points resonate most with audiences (e.g., “stinky breath” vs. “expensive vet bills”)

- Translating performance data into clear creative insights and opportunities

- The goal: turn data into creative direction.

2. Creative Ideation & Scriptwriting - Once the data reveals opportunities, You will design the next creative tests. This will include:

- Concept development creating the “big idea” for campaigns and ad series

- Direct-response scriptwriting using proven frameworks such as AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action)

- Writing high-impact hooks, body copy, and calls-to-action designed to drive conversions

- Storyboarding content to ensure something visually engaging happens every 2–3 seconds to maintain retention

- Developing creative angles aligned with DTC customer journeys and content funnels

You will be responsible for generating large volumes of structured creative tests designed to scale winning concepts.

3. Production Management & Creative Briefing- You willact as the director and translator between strategy and production. This will include:

- Briefing UGC creators and influencers, including hooks to film, key talking points, and specific B-roll shots Providing detailed production briefs that editors and creators can execute quickly Reviewing and providing feedback on drafts from editors and creators

- Ensuring text overlays, pacing, and visual storytelling align with performance best practices

- Maintaining a library of high-performing assets and reusable footage

- Your goal is to turn strategy into scalable content production.

4. Testing Strategy & Iteration – You will design and manage the creative testing roadmap for our paid channels. This will include:

- Designing structured A/B tests that isolate one variable at a time (e.g., Hook A vs Hook B)

- Iterating on winning ads by refining hooks, pacing, messaging, or visuals

- Identifying drop-off points in videos and optimizing content accordingly

- Conducting competitor and market research to stay on top of emerging creative trends

- Ensuring PetLab’s ads remain native to each platform’s

The goal: continuously improve creative performance through structured experimentation.

### What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like:

- 50% Creative ideation and content strategy development

- 25% Campaign briefing, scripting, and production QA

- 25% Performance analysis and data-driven iteration

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who combines creative instincts with analytical rigor.

You likely have:

- 3+ years of experience in creative strategy or performance creative roles

- Experience working in high-growth, paid social-led DTC brands

- Deep expertise in Meta and TikTok advertising ecosystems

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret performance data to inform creative decisions

- A portfolio of direct-response ad concepts, scripts, or campaigns that delivered measurable results

- A proven track record of driving revenue growth through paid creative

- Experience briefing or directing creators, influencers, or UGC production

- Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics (ROAS, CPA, CTR, Hook Rate, etc.)

- Excellent communication skills — able to present insights and defend creative decisions with data

Benefits

-   20 days PTO excluding bank holidays

-  Company Bonus

-  Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance

-  Generous Learning and development budget 

-   Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

-   Life Insurance

-   401K

-  Work Remote

-  Monthly Uber coffee/bagel and lunch

-  Monthly Internet Stipend

We encourage all applications irrespective of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, nationality, marital status, and disability. We believe that diversity is at the heart of innovation and we welcome passionate candidates from all backgrounds. Come join the family and see for yourself!

Salary: $80,000 to $125,000 plus Bonus and Benefits

### About the Role

PetLab Co. is a world leader in the DTC pet supplement market with a 9-figure revenue, profitable and rapidly growing globally.

In the world of performance marketing (especially for brands like PetLabCo.), a Creative Strategist is the bridge between the Media Buying team (the numbers) and the Creative team (the visuals).

Think of them as a data-driven storyteller. Their job is to ensure that every pixel and every word in an ad is designed to convert, based on actual performance data rather than gut feeling.

This role sits at the intersection of creative thinking, data analysis, and growth marketing. You’ll partner closely with our Paid Media, Video Producers, Organic Social, and Influencer teams to develop high-performing ad creatives that scale customer acquisition and revenue.

### Who Will You Report Into? 

Hi, I’m Jesper Mansson, Director of Creative Strategy, and we’re seeking a senior-level creative thinker who is obsessed with direct response, passionate about performance, and knows how to lead content strategy that scales.

You’ll be a core strategic partner to our paid, organic, and influencer teams, with a direct impact on how we acquire and retain customers.

If you live and breathe performance creative and want to help shape the future of a 9-figure DTC business, let’s talk

### What You'll be Responsible For:

1. Data Analysis & Performance Auditing – You’ll spend a significant amount of time inside ad platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube) Identifying what’s working and why. This will include:

- Analyzing performance metrics such as Hook Rate (3-second views / impressions), Hold Rate (average watch time), CTR, CPA, and ROAS

- Identifying winning creative patterns — for example whether a UGC “vlogger” style outperforms highly produced brand content

- Conducting creative audits to identify which customer pain points resonate most with audiences (e.g., “stinky breath” vs. “expensive vet bills”)

- Translating performance data into clear creative insights and opportunities

- The goal: turn data into creative direction.

2. Creative Ideation & Scriptwriting - Once the data reveals opportunities, You will design the next creative tests. This will include:

- Concept development creating the “big idea” for campaigns and ad series

- Direct-response scriptwriting using proven frameworks such as AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action)

- Writing high-impact hooks, body copy, and calls-to-action designed to drive conversions

- Storyboarding content to ensure something visually engaging happens every 2–3 seconds to maintain retention

- Developing creative angles aligned with DTC customer journeys and content funnels

You will be responsible for generating large volumes of structured creative tests designed to scale winning concepts.

3. Production Management & Creative Briefing- You willact as the director and translator between strategy and production. This will include:

- Briefing UGC creators and influencers, including hooks to film, key talking points, and specific B-roll shots Providing detailed production briefs that editors and creators can execute quickly Reviewing and providing feedback on drafts from editors and creators

- Ensuring text overlays, pacing, and visual storytelling align with performance best practices

- Maintaining a library of high-performing assets and reusable footage

- Your goal is to turn strategy into scalable content production.

4. Testing Strategy & Iteration – You will design and manage the creative testing roadmap for our paid channels. This will include:

- Designing structured A/B tests that isolate one variable at a time (e.g., Hook A vs Hook B)

- Iterating on winning ads by refining hooks, pacing, messaging, or visuals

- Identifying drop-off points in videos and optimizing content accordingly

- Conducting competitor and market research to stay on top of emerging creative trends

- Ensuring PetLab’s ads remain native to each platform’s

The goal: continuously improve creative performance through structured experimentation.

### What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like:

- 50% Creative ideation and content strategy development

- 25% Campaign briefing, scripting, and production QA

- 25% Performance analysis and data-driven iteration

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who combines creative instincts with analytical rigor.

You likely have:

- 3+ years of experience in creative strategy or performance creative roles

- Experience working in high-growth, paid social-led DTC brands

- Deep expertise in Meta and TikTok advertising ecosystems

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret performance data to inform creative decisions

- A portfolio of direct-response ad concepts, scripts, or campaigns that delivered measurable results

- A proven track record of driving revenue growth through paid creative

- Experience briefing or directing creators, influencers, or UGC production

- Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics (ROAS, CPA, CTR, Hook Rate, etc.)

- Excellent communication skills — able to present insights and defend creative decisions with data

Benefits

-   20 days PTO excluding bank holidays

-  Company Bonus

-  Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance

-  Generous Learning and development budget 

-   Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

-   Life Insurance

-   401K

-  Work Remote

-  Monthly Uber coffee/bagel and lunch

-  Monthly Internet Stipend

Petlab Co is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage all applications irrespective of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, nationality, marital status, and disability. We believe that diversity is at the heart of innovation and we welcome passionate candidates from all backgrounds. Come join the family and see for yourself!

job.description:
Company Description

At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

Brief Overview 

This role produces member-facing content across Amwell's service lines and is accountable for how that content performs once it reaches members. Content is a shared capability across the Engagement pillar: the account owners brief and approve, and this role produces at the volume and quality the book requires.

The role covers content strategy across service lines, the Engagement Hub content library, and the production of case studies and enablement assets that the account owners design. It also directs contractor and AI-assisted capacity, which is how volume is met with a single full-time position. Content engagement is a shared measure with the execution side, which owns timing and deliverability

Core Responsibilities 

What the role owns:

• Content strategy and production across service lines, the engagement showcase, and content libraries

• Inputting email content into the email CMS (Knak) — copy and image selection

• The Engagement Hub content library and its maintenance

• Case-study and enablement-asset production, against designs set by the account owners

• AI-assisted drafting and direction of contractor capacity for volume, within the approved content guidelines

• Brand-voice consistency across member-facing content

How success is measured:

• Content engagement across member-facing email and hub content, as the content contribution to open and click performance (primary measurable output)

• Content throughput and turnaround against briefs

• Brand-voice and quality consistency across the library

• Coverage of the service lines against the content plan

What the role does not own:

Scope boundaries are explicit so accountability is single-owned and hand-offs are clean.

• Campaign strategy or the customer relationship — the account owners

• The CMS platform itself, its branding rules, templates, and access — Manager, Campaign Production and Platform

• Campaign build, QA, and send — the campaign production team

• Timing and deliverability of sends, which share the engagement measure

• Foundational B2B content such as case studies, playbooks, and whitepapers — Commercialization

• PHI governance standards, which are set by Compliance

Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years producing consumer, member, or patient-facing content at volume

• Demonstrated ability to move a content engagement measure, not only to ship content on time

• Experience writing within regulated or clinically sensitive constraints, and the judgment to know when to route something to Compliance or Legal

• Experience directing freelance, agency, or contractor capacity against a brief

• Working fluency with AI-assisted drafting, and the editorial judgment to hold quality across it

• Comfort operating as shared capacity across competing internal demands

Preferred

• Healthcare, health plan, or behavioral health content experience

• Knak, Braze, or comparable content and email production platforms

• Accessibility standards for member communications

• Experience building or restructuring a content library

Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell. 

Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.  

Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members.    

We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.  

Benefits 

  • Flexible Personal Time Off (Vacation time)
  • 401K match
  • Competitive healthcare, dental and vision insurance plans
  • Paid Parental Leave (Maternity and Paternity leave)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Free access to Amwell’s Telehealth Services, SilverCloud and The Clinic by Cleveland Clinic’s second opinion program
  • Free Subscription to the Calm App
  • Tuition Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance 

Salaried, Exempt Roles

The typical base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $110,000.  The actual salary offer will ultimately depend on multiple factors including, but not limited to, knowledge, skills, relevant education, experience, complexity or specialization of talent, and other objective factors.  In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and employee performance. Long-term incentive and short-term variable compensation may be offered as part of the compensation package dependent on the role. Some roles may be commission based, in which case the total compensation will be based on a commission, and the above range may not be an accurate representation of total compensation.

Further, the above range is subject to change based on market demands and operational needs and does not constitute a promise of a particular wage or a guarantee of employment. Your recruiter can share more during the hiring process about the specific salary range based on the above factors listed.

Fraud Prevention Notice

As part of Amwell's commitment to maintaining a secure and trusted hiring process, Amwell uses fraud detection capabilities within its hiring platform to help identify potentially suspicious, fraudulent, or unauthorized activity during the recruitment process.

These tools are designed to help protect candidates, Amwell, and the integrity of the hiring process by identifying indicators that may be associated with impersonation, account misuse, or other forms of recruiting fraud. Information generated through fraud detection is reviewed by authorized personnel and is not used as the sole basis for hiring decisions.

Personal information collected or processed in connection with fraud detection will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws and Amwell's Applicant Privacy Notice.

Identity Verification Notice

As part of Amwell's commitment to maintaining a secure and trusted hiring process, candidates for this role are required to complete an identity verification step through Greenhouse Identity Verification powered by CLEAR during the interview process. 

Identity verification is used solely to confirm a candidate's identity and help prevent fraud and impersonation within the hiring process. It is not a background check and does not independently determine hiring decisions. 

Because this role has been designated as requiring identity verification, completion of the verification process is a condition of continuing in the recruitment process. Candidates who do not complete the identity verification process will not be eligible to advance to subsequent stages of consideration for this role. 

Personal information collected as part of the identity verification process will be handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws and Amwell's Applicant Privacy Notice. 

https://business.amwell.com/company/privacy-notice-US-applicants

 

 

Privacy Notice

• Case-study and enablement-asset production, against designs set by the account owners

• AI-assisted drafting and direction of contractor capacity for volume, within the approved content guidelines

• Brand-voice consistency across member-facing content

How success is measured:

• Content engagement across member-facing email and hub content, as the content contribution to open and click performance (primary measurable output)

• Content throughput and turnaround against briefs

• Brand-voice and quality consistency across the library

• Coverage of the service lines against the content plan

Scope boundaries are explicit so accountability is single-owned and hand-offs are clean.

• Campaign strategy or the customer relationship — the account owners

• The CMS platform itself, its branding rules, templates, and access — Manager, Campaign Production and Platform

• Campaign build, QA, and send — the campaign production team

• Timing and deliverability of sends, which share the engagement measure

• Foundational B2B content such as case studies, playbooks, and whitepapers — Commercialization

• PHI governance standards, which are set by Compliance

• Demonstrated ability to move a content engagement measure, not only to ship content on time

• Experience directing freelance, agency, or contractor capacity against a brief

• Working fluency with AI-assisted drafting, and the editorial judgment to hold quality across it

• Comfort operating as shared capacity across competing internal demands

Preferred

• Healthcare, health plan, or behavioral health content experience

• Knak, Braze, or comparable content and email production platforms

• Accessibility standards for member communications

• Experience building or restructuring a content library

job.description:
## Job Description

CareerSwift is a technology company focused on making the job search process simpler, faster, and more effective. Our platform combines AI-powered tools and practical career solutions to help job seekers create stronger applications, improve their professional profiles, and navigate their job search with greater confidence.

We are growing our marketing team and are looking for an organized and analytical Marketing Operations Specialist to help manage the systems, processes, and data that support our marketing activities.

## About the Role

As a Marketing Operations Specialist, you will help ensure that CareerSwift's marketing activities run efficiently across campaigns, CRM systems, marketing tools, and reporting processes.

You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and content teams to maintain accurate data, coordinate campaigns, improve workflows, and provide insights that help the team make better decisions.

## Responsibilities

- 

Support the planning, setup, and execution of marketing campaigns across digital channels.

- 

Maintain and organize marketing data, contact lists, CRM records, and campaign information.

- 

Coordinate marketing workflows, processes, and timelines across different teams.

- 

Monitor campaign and funnel performance and prepare regular reports.

- 

Help identify opportunities to improve marketing processes, automation, and data quality.

- 

Support email campaigns, lead management, segmentation, and other marketing activities.

- 

Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to ensure smooth lead and campaign handoffs.

## What We Are Looking For

- 

1–3 years of experience in marketing operations, digital marketing, marketing coordination, or a related field.

- 

Strong organizational and analytical skills.

- 

Comfortable working with spreadsheets, CRM systems, and marketing tools.

- 

Good understanding of digital marketing processes and campaign workflows.

- 

Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.

- 

Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently in a remote environment.

## Nice to Have

- 

Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, Mailchimp, or similar platforms.

- 

Familiarity with marketing automation and lead management.

- 

Experience with Google Analytics, Looker Studio, or similar reporting tools.

- 

Experience working with SaaS, AI, technology, or digital products.

## Compensation

$55,000 - $72,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

Additional benefits and employment details will be discussed during the hiring process.

## What We Offer

- 

Fully remote work environment.

- 

Opportunity to work with an innovative AI-powered technology product.

- 

Hands-on experience across marketing, analytics, CRM, and automation.

- 

Collaborative and supportive team environment.

- 

Opportunities for professional growth as CareerSwift expands.

Apply today and help us build the systems and processes behind smarter, more effective marketing at CareerSwift.

## Job Overview

Location: Remote

Seniority Level: Junior

Salary Range: 55,000 - 72,000 USD (gross, annually)

job.title: VP, Demand Generation
job.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

CoLab is the AI platform for engineering design. Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design. Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Bombardier use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster.

Founded in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown rapidly to over 250 employees. In 2025, CoLab raised a $72M Series C and was recognized by Deloitte Fast 500TM as the #57 fastest growing company in North America.

About the Role

We’re hiring a VP of Demand Generation to own marketing-sourced pipeline and scale our demand function into the next stage of growth. You’ll step in as the leader of an existing 4-person team with a mandate to take what’s working today and evolve it into a mature, scalable demand engine.

Your job is to own the portfolio of channels, allocate resources, and make clear bets that maximize pipeline, conversion rates, and CAC efficiency. You’ll architect and oversee integrated multi-channel programs across paid, OOH, events, and emerging channels — ensuring the mix works together as one system and budget flows to where it will have the most impact.

This is primarily a leadership role, but not a hands-off one. You’ll have the mandate, resources, and team to make it happen — and when needed, you’ll roll up your sleeves to shape new motions, like standing up CoLab’s first ABM program. You’ll collaborate closely with Sales and the exec team, bringing clarity and data-driven insight into how marketing drives revenue.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • You have a track record of improving pipeline, revenue, and CAC and you hold yourself to those results
  • You architect integrated programs where channels reinforce each other, and you know when to shift budget or double down.
  • You’ve built, mentored, and scaled in-house demand gen teams before
  • You’re an analytical storyteller: equally comfortable running the numbers, forming a hypothesis, and presenting a clear, compelling story to execs
  • You’re willing to be hands-on in the right moments, especially when shaping a new motion like ABM
  • You thrive in a growth-stage SaaS environment where complexity increases fast, channels mature quickly, and new bets need to turn into repeatable engines.
  • You thrive in enterprise B2B SaaS environments, building pipeline for high-ASP products with long sales cycles, complex buying committees, and nuanced messaging.

Responsibilities

  • Own marketing-sourced pipeline creation, conversion, and efficiency (including CAC).
  • Architect and oversee integrated demand gen programs across digital, paid, field marketing, and ABM.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing demand gen team (currently four direct reports, with ongoing growth expected)
  • Stand up CoLab’s first ABM motion and refine it into a repeatable program.
  • Own demand gen budget, forecasting, and ROI tracking with direct accountability to the executive team.
  • Scale proven channels while experimenting quickly with new ones, turning them into repeatable, mature programs.
  • Jump in with your team when needed to shape execution and accelerate new initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales to ensure alignment on pipeline goals, conversion rates, and revenue outcomes.
  • Translate data into insights and executive-ready narratives that drive alignment on pipeline strategy and results.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of B2B SaaS demand generation experience, with at least 3+ years in a senior leadership role (VP, Head of Demand Gen, or similar).
  • Proven track record of building and scaling demand gen teams that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated success building and maturing pipeline for small target account lists with high ASPs and complex buying committees
  • Demonstrated success partnering with product marketing to deliver nuanced messaging at scale across channels, using personalization where most effective
  • Strong quantitative skills with an exceptional ability to use data to understand pipeline drivers
  • Experience designing and executing multi-channel programs (paid, SEO/SEM, third party and owned events, ABM).
  • Exceptional ability to influence at the executive level with data-backed storytelling.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic work with being hands-on when needed.

Extra Details

  • This is a full-time, permanent position with a compensation package that includes stock options.
  • Extended health and benefits package, including unlimited paid vacation and RRSP matching.
  • Our main office is in St. John’s, NL, with hybrid and remote opportunities. This role has the flexibility to work from anywhere in North America.
  • You'll be expected to travel 4-6 times per year for team weeks, on sites, and leadership team meetings.

Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

CoLab is hiring a Senior Director of Brand Marketing to lead brand design, multimedia, brand content, and communications. This is a team leadership role, with an existing team of 6. You will also build two competencies we don’t have today: executive communications and integrated brand campaigns. 

If you are a passionate operator with insanely high standards, this is an opportunity to build an organization you can be proud of  — with a clear philosophy, operating model, creative process, and reputation inside CoLab.

This is your chance to make technical ideas feel consequential: to take something complex and create work that makes people understand why it matters and want to be part of the future it represents.

Our Ideal Candidate

You have a brand worldview. You don’t just know the mechanics of brand; you have beliefs about what makes one distinctive, memorable, and worth caring about.

You have taste backed by conviction. You push the work further. You might watch a video six times before finally realizing the first five seconds are wrong, then sit with the producer until you figure out what will make them right.

The details of the brand should be more top-of-mind for you than they are for our CEO or CMO. For some people, that sounds exhausting. For you, it’s probably your natural operating mode.

You know how to win support for your ideas. You can walk into a room where an ambitious creative idea feels too big, make the strategic case for it, and get executives excited to take the bet.

Job Responsibilities

Build the brand function and protect the standard

  • Shape CoLab’s brand function across design, multimedia, brand content, communications, and campaigns.
  • Establish the standards, operating model, and creative processes that enable exceptional work without turning the team into an internal creative-services desk.
  • Own how the brand shows up across every touchpoint and develop principles that make the brand easier to recognize and harder to forget
  • Stay close enough to the work to know when something is almost right but not right and help the team make it better.

Create memorable campaigns that make technical ideas feel consequential

  • Partner with Product Marketing to identify the ideas CoLab should amplify, then turn them into bold, integrated campaigns.
  • Make complex ideas in AI, engineering, and manufacturing understandable, compelling, and worth remembering.
  • Push beyond safe creative when the strategy warrants it, and build the internal support required to take bigger bets.

Build an executive communications platform

  • Own a cohesive communications strategy for our CEO, CTO, and Chief Strategy Officer across earned media, bylines, social, conferences, and CoLab events.
  • Identify the ideas each executive can credibly own and create opportunities for them to contribute meaningfully to relevant conversations.
  • Oversee media relations, press releases, executive visibility, and proactive communications opportunities.

Develop an exceptional team

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning brand design, multimedia, content, and communications.
  • Give clear feedback, create shared context, and help talented specialists do the best work of their careers.
  • Identify where new talent, agencies, or partners can materially raise the standard of the function.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience across brand marketing, creative strategy, communications, design, or related disciplines, including meaningful ownership of a brand or creative function.
  • A body of work that demonstrates taste backed by conviction: distinctive judgment, unusually high standards, and the ability to explain why something works or doesn’t.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across several of the following: design, video, content, communications, production, and campaigns.
  • Exceptional executive communication skills. You can challenge an idea, advocate for a bigger one, and earn trust because your point of view is grounded in strategy.
  • The ability to move comfortably between setting direction and getting close to the work. You care about the big idea and the five-second edit.
  • Experience making complex or technical subject matter (B2B software, AI, engineering, manufacturing, or another technically complex category) compelling without oversimplifying it.
