job.title: Head of Marketing
job.description:
## About Us

Cracken is an applied AI lab building world’s first full kill chain proactive cyber platform. Built by cyber warfare-experienced operators and AI researchers Cracken keeps digital infrastructure resilient so businesses and societies operate.

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing to build and lead this function from the ground up. This is a foundational role, not just for the go-to-market team, but for how we tell our story to the world.

## What You’ll Do

- 

Execute at All Marketing Levels: take ownership of market research, create technical content, enable sales teams, and build marketing strategies that accelerate customer engagement and adoption.

- 

Define and evolve company positioning, messaging, and narrative for a technical security audience.

- 

Own and drive product launches end-to-end - from messaging to content to internal enablement.

- 

Work directly with the CEO and other founding members to expand the marketing function.

- 

This is an IC-heavy role to start, with the opportunity to grow the team as we scale.

## Who You Are

- 

Marketing Experience: Proven product marketing background in enterprise software and cybersecurity.

- 

Technical Expertise: You translate complex security concepts into clear, impactful messaging for diverse audiences.

- 

Content Creation: A track record of producing compelling technical content tailored to various stakeholder needs.

- 

Data-Driven Growth Hacker: You experiment, measure, and iterate - letting outcomes guide every move.

- 

Founder Mentality: No task is too small, no ambition too large - you own every initiative from start to finish.

- 

Strategy and Execution: A collaborative operator who loves jumping between strategy and execution.

### 

## Why Cracken?

- 

Real-World Impact: Validated in nation-state operations and supported by internal researches.

- 

Team's Unique Motivation & Expertise: Ukrainian-heavy international team with Ph.D.s, professors, and top-tier industry veterans, driven by intrinsic passion forged through exposure to the hardships of war.

- 

Impeccable Timing & Positioning: At the cutting edge of AI, cybersecurity, and autonomous systems, Cracken is best positioned to win the race against adversaries.

- 

Adaptive Role: We shape positions around exceptional talent - your drive will define your path.

Ready to drive massive reach and help Cracken reshape cybersecurity? Apply now and join us in pioneering the future of security.

job.title: AP - Digital Marketing Specialist (Remote)
job.description:
Note: This is for active pooling purposes only. Submitting your application does not guarantee employment. Your details will be kept on file and considered for future opportunities as they become available.

We are seeking a dedicated and organized Digital Marketing Specialist to join our team at D2B. In this remote role, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing marketing campaigns that promote our brand, products, or services. You’ll play a key role in increasing brand awareness, driving traffic, and generating leads across digital channels.

Position: Digital Marketing Specialist

Salary: PHP 50,000 - PHP 70,000/month

Working Hours & Conditions: Mondays to Fridays, 7:00AM to 4:00PM; full-time (remote)

Holidays: TBD

Responsibilities:

- Plan, create, and execute digital marketing campaigns across channels (social media, email, search engines, display ads, etc.). 

-  Manage social media accounts and content calendars. 

-  Conduct SEO and SEM strategies to improve website visibility and ranking. 

-  Analyze website traffic, campaign performance, and other key metrics to optimize strategies. 

-  Collaborate with the design and content teams to create engaging marketing materials. 

-  Manage email marketing campaigns and automation workflows. 

-  Stay up-to-date with digital marketing trends, tools, and best practices. 

-  Assist in managing paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.). 

-  Monitor competitor activity and market trends to identify opportunities.

Requirements

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

- At least 1 to 3 years proven experience in digital marketing or related field. 

- Must have digital marketing experience with Australian or New Zealand clients, companies, or agencies.

-  Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, PPC, email marketing, and social media marketing. 

-  Experience with digital marketing tools (Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, etc.). 

-  Proficient in content creation, copywriting, and basic graphic design is a plus. 

-  Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret data to make informed decisions. 

-  Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 

-  Familiarity with CRM tools and marketing automation platforms is a plus.

- PORTFOLIO is required.

Benefits

### Benefits

-  Competitive salary based on experience and skill set 

-  100% remote role — work from home anywhere in the Philippines 

-  Paid local holidays aligned with the Australian business calendar 

-  Opportunities for training and professional growth 

-  Work directly with a supportive Australian team — no agency middleman 

-  Long-term engagement with a stable and growing business

Position				 : Part-Time Digital Marketing & Social Media Specialist

Salary				 : PHP 35,000 - 65,000 

Working Hours & Conditions : AU Time

ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

We are a premier, established hospitality and entertainment group based in the heart of the Sydney CBD. Operating a portfolio of high-end, exclusive venues, we specialize in delivering world-class, premium experiences to a discerning clientele.

Because we operate in a highly competitive, age-gated lifestyle and entertainment niche, our brand requires sophisticated, compliant, and highly creative marketing strategies. We pride ourselves on maintaining an exceptional reputation offline, and we are looking for a digital specialist to help us scale that luxury experience across our organic online channels.

OVERVIEW:

We are seeking a highly creative, strategic, and technically savvy Digital Marketing & Social Media Specialist to manage and grow our online presence across multiple platforms.

Because we operate in a highly regulated, age-gated lifestyle and entertainment industry, this is not a standard social media role. Success in this position requires someone who deeply understands how social media algorithms work, knows how to maximize organic reach while navigating strict platform content restrictions, and can continually adapt as community guidelines evolve.

The ideal candidate is highly experienced in SEO, AI-powered content creation, and organic social media growth, with the ability to think strategically while executing daily marketing activities.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

### Social Media Growth

- Plan, create and publish engaging content across:

- Instagram

- Facebook

- TikTok

- Post daily (often multiple times per day) to maximise organic reach.

- Schedule and manage content calendars.

- Monitor engagement and optimise posting times.

- Build audience growth through organic strategies.

- Respond to trends quickly and capitalise on viral opportunities.

### Algorithm & Platform Strategy

A critical part of this role is understanding how modern social media algorithms operate.

You will be expected to:

- Stay ahead of Instagram, Facebook and TikTok algorithm changes.

- Develop strategies that maximise visibility and engagement.

- Minimise content suppression ("shadow banning") where possible.

- Understand platform policies and work within them.

- Continually test new content formats and posting strategies.

- Analyse performance and adjust campaigns accordingly.

This role requires someone who enjoys experimenting, testing and improving—not simply scheduling posts.

### SEO & Website Marketing

- Improve website search rankings.

- Conduct keyword research.

- Optimise website content.

- Create SEO-friendly blog articles.

- Monitor Google Search Console and Analytics.

- Identify new organic traffic opportunities.

### AI Content Creation

The successful candidate should be highly competent with modern AI tools.

Responsibilities include:

- Using AI to generate high-quality content.

- Creating images and marketing assets.

- Producing captions, articles and campaign ideas.

- Building AI workflows to improve productivity.

- Researching and implementing new AI tools as they emerge.

We're looking for someone who understands how AI works, not someone who simply copies and pastes from ChatGPT.

### Digital Marketing

Assist with broader digital marketing initiatives including:

- Email marketing campaigns.

- Landing page optimisation.

- Campaign reporting.

- Competitor research.

- Marketing analytics.

- Promotional campaign planning.

### Digital Billboard Campaigns

Support outdoor digital advertising campaigns by:

- Creating digital billboard artwork.

- Coordinating campaign schedules.

- Managing creative updates.

- Monitoring campaign performance where applicable.

### Reporting

Provide regular reports covering:

- Website traffic

- SEO performance

- Social media growth

- Engagement metrics

- Content performance

- Recommendations for continual improvement

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS:

### Essential

- 3+ years' experience in Digital Marketing.

- Strong SEO knowledge.

- Advanced Instagram knowledge.

- Strong Facebook Business Suite experience.

- Strong TikTok marketing experience.

- Experience growing social media accounts organically.

- Excellent understanding of social media algorithms.

- Experience using AI tools for marketing.

- Strong written English.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Highly organised and proactive.

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

### Highly Desirable

- Experience marketing in highly regulated or restricted industries.

- Experience working around advertising limitations while remaining compliant with platform policies.

- Graphic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar).

- Video editing (CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar).

- Google Analytics.

- Google Search Console.

- SEMrush, Ahrefs or similar SEO platforms.

- Experience with digital outdoor advertising.

- Basic bookkeeping or administrative skills to support the business as it grows.

### Personal Attributes

The successful candidate will be:

- Creative and innovative.

- Analytical and data-driven.

- Adaptable to constant platform changes.

- Curious and always learning.

- A problem solver who enjoys testing new ideas.

- Self-motivated and reliable.

- Commercially minded with a focus on business growth.

job.title: Digital Marketing, AI & Operations Coordinator (NZ - Remote) - 6 Months Contract
job.description:
Position				:  Digital Marketing, AI & Operations Coordinator

Salary				:  Php 63,000-80,000 per month

Working Hours & Conditions: 6 Months contract with a possibility of extension based on performance

Holidays: TBC

ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

We are a Māori-owned adventure tourism business based in Rotorua, New Zealand, with more than 25 years in the tourism industry. We operate a range of adventure and cultural tourism experiences and are preparing for our busy summer season from November through April. We are looking for a capable, organised and tech-savvy remote team member who can support our digital marketing, social media, online presence and day-to-day operational administration. This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable moving between creative marketing tasks, technology, data and general business administration. 

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We’re looking for a Digital Marketing, AI & Operations Coordinator to become an extension of our New Zealand-based team. The role will have four main areas of responsibility: 

● Social media and digital content 

● Rotorua Combos website and digital channels 

● Operational and administrative support 

● Email marketing and AI integration. You will be working within established systems and brands, helping us keep our digital channels active, information accurate, and operational workload under control. A strong understanding of tourism and travel language, excellent written English, attention to detail, and respect for Māori and indigenous cultural context are important. 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Social Media & Content: Manage and support content across: 

● Facebook 

● Instagram 

● TikTok 

● YouTube 

Responsibilities will include: 

● Create, edit, schedule, and publish regular social media content. 

● Turn raw GoPro, phone, and guide-captured footage into engaging content. 

● Edit short-form video for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. 

● Assist with longer-form YouTube content where required. 

● Maintain and work from an agreed social media content calendar. 

● Repurpose content across different platforms rather than creating everything from scratch. 

● Help identify strong content opportunities from our existing photo and video library. ● Ensure content is accurate, engaging, on-brand and culturally appropriate. 

● Monitor comments, messages and engagement where required. 

● Assist with reporting on social media performance and identifying what content is working. 

2. Website & Social Media (hibernated website) 

Take responsibility for helping maintain and grow the digital presence of Rotorua Combos. This includes: 

● Maintain and update the Rotorua Combos website. 

● Keep product information, pricing, imagery and links current. 

● Upload and update website content as required. 

● Manage Rotorua Combos social media channels. 

● Create and schedule social content promoting Rotorua experiences and combination products. 

● Work with supplied content from tourism partners and operators. 

● Support basic SEO and ensure website content is search-friendly. 

● Identify outdated or incorrect content and proactively arrange updates. 

● Help build Rotorua Combos into a useful digital platform for visitors planning activities in Rotorua. 

3. Operational & Administrative Support 

Provide remote administrative support to our operational team, including: 

● Monitor and respond to allocated business emails.

● Assist with customer and agent enquiries. 

● Complete basic invoicing and invoice administration. 

● Enter and maintain accurate business data. 

● Update our Master Report and other internal reporting systems. 

● Assist with booking and customer data entry. 

● Maintain organised digital records and files. 

● Assist with online reviews and customer responses where required. 

● Complete other routine administrative tasks that can be handled remotely. 

● Identify repetitive administrative processes that could be simplified or automated. Accuracy and attention to detail are particularly important in this part of the role.

 4. Email Marketing Support regular communication with customers, agents and our wider database. Responsibilities will include: 

● Create and format email newsletters. 

● Assist with planning a simple email marketing calendar. 

● Prepare promotional emails for products, seasonal campaigns and special offers. 

● Help segment customer and trade databases where appropriate. 

● Maintain clean and accurate email lists. 

● Track basic newsletter performance such as open rates, click-throughs and engagement. 

● Repurpose existing website and social media content for email campaigns. 

5. AI Integration & Process Improvement 

We actively want to use AI to make the business more efficient. 

This person does not need to be an AI developer, but they should be confident using AI tools and interested in finding practical ways to integrate them into everyday business processes. 

This may include: 

● Use AI tools to assist with social media content and content repurposing. 

● Assist with video, image and written-content workflows. 

● Use AI to help draft and improve newsletters, blogs and website content. 

● Identify repetitive administration that could be automated or streamlined. 

● Help develop simple AI-assisted workflows for email, reporting, data entry and marketing. 

● Research new AI tools that could save the team time. 

● Document successful workflows so they can be repeated by the wider team. 

● Look for practical ways to connect our existing systems and reduce double-handling. 

We are particularly interested in someone who naturally thinks, “There must be a faster or smarter way to do this. 

        

Requirements

The successful candidate should have: 

● Experience managing business social media accounts. 

● Strong understanding of Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. 

● Good short-form video editing skills. 

● Experience working with websites or CMS platforms such as WordPress. 

● Strong written English. 

● High attention to detail. 

● Strong organisational and data-entry skills. 

● Confidence working with spreadsheets and web-based business systems. 

● Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or similar platforms. 

● Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. 

● Confidence learning new software and digital systems. 

● Cultural awareness and care when representing a Māori-owned New Zealand business. 

● An interest in tourism, travel and adventure experiences. 

Nice to Have Experience with any of the following would be beneficial: 

● New Zealand or international tourism. 

● Adventure tourism. 

● WordPress. 

● Canva or similar design tools. 

● Video editing software. 

● Xero. 

● Email marketing platforms. 

● Google Workspace. 

● Online booking systems. 

● Tourism distribution or OTA platforms. 

● Basic SEO. 

● AI automation or workflow tools. 

● Social media scheduling platforms. 

● Reporting dashboards or spreadsheet-based reporting. 

What Success Looks Like: Within the first few months, we would expect to see: 

● Consistent, professional content appearing across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. 

● Existing photo and video content being actively repurposed rather than sitting unused. 

● Rotorua Combos' website and social channels being actively maintained and developed. 

● Newsletters being produced and sent consistently. 

● Emails, invoicing and data-entry tasks being completed accurately and on time. 

● The Master Report being kept current. 

● Simple repetitive tasks beginning to be streamlined through AI and automation. 

● Clear systems and processes being documented. 

● Our New Zealand-based team spending less time on repetitive digital and administrative tasks. Most importantly, we want someone who becomes a reliable remote member of the team, someone who can be given an area of responsibility, take ownership of it, and look for ways to continually improve how the work is done. 

Benefits

- Remote Work

- New Zealand Timezone

job.title: AP - Marketing Manager/Lead (Remote)
job.description:
Note: This is for active pooling purposes only. Submitting your application does not guarantee employment. Your details will be kept on file and considered for future opportunities as they become available.

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Marketing Manager / Marketing Lead to join our team at D2B. In this remote role, you will lead the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing initiatives that drive brand growth, lead generation, and customer engagement. You will oversee marketing strategy across multiple digital channels and ensure alignment with business objectives, particularly within the Australian mortgage or related financial services industry.

Position: Marketing Manager / Marketing Lead

Salary: PHP 80,000 – PHP 120,000/month (depending on experience)

Working Hours & Conditions: Mondays to Fridays, 7:00AM to 4:00PM; full-time (remote)

Holidays: TBD

Responsibilities:

- Develop and own the overall digital marketing strategy to support brand growth and lead generation goals. 

-  Lead, manage, and optimize multi-channel marketing campaigns across social media, email, search engines, and paid advertising platforms. 

-  Oversee SEO, SEM, and PPC strategies to improve online visibility, traffic, and conversion rates. 

-  Manage and guide social media strategy, content calendars, and brand messaging. 

-  Analyze campaign performance, website traffic, and key metrics, using insights to continuously optimize marketing efforts. 

-  Collaborate closely with design, content, and sales teams to ensure cohesive branding and messaging. 

-  Manage email marketing strategies, automation workflows, and CRM integrations. 

-  Plan, manage, and optimize paid advertising budgets across platforms such as Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and LinkedIn Ads. 

-  Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities. 

-  Stay up to date with digital marketing trends, tools, and best practices, recommending improvements where needed. 

-  Provide guidance, direction, and mentorship to junior marketing team members or external partners, as required.

Requirements

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 

-  2–5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with proven experience in a Marketing Manager or Lead role. 

-  Must have digital marketing experience with Australian or New Zealand clients, companies, or agencies. 

-  Strong expertise in SEO, SEM, PPC, email marketing, and social media marketing. 

-  Hands-on experience with digital marketing tools such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, and similar platforms. 

-  Strong leadership, project management, and decision-making skills. 

-  Highly analytical, with the ability to translate data into actionable marketing strategies. 

-  Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

-  Experience with CRM tools and marketing automation platforms is a plus. 

-  Portfolio is required.

Benefits

### Benefits

-  Competitive salary based on experience and skill set 

-  100% remote role — work from home anywhere in the Philippines 

-  Paid local holidays aligned with the Australian business calendar 

-  Opportunities for training and professional growth 

-  Work directly with a supportive Australian team — no agency middleman 

-  Long-term engagement with a stable and growing business

job.title: Campaigns & Memberships Marketing Manager
job.description:
# Campaigns & Memberships Marketing Manager 

## Company description:

Elliptic is the leader in digital asset decisioning, we have built the most comprehensive platform for efficiently extracting crypto data and intelligence across blockchains with the greatest accuracy.

Our platform’s unrivalled uptime, scalability, depth and breadth of our data and intelligence means exacting organisations choose Elliptic for their compliance, risk management, intelligence operations and blockchain infrastructure needs.

Founded in 2013, Elliptic is headquartered in London with offices in New York, Washington D.C., Miami, San Francisco, UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo. To learn more, visit www.elliptic.co and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

## The Role 

We’re looking for a data-driven marketer with a passion for delivering impactful, integrated campaigns and for maximizing the value of key industry partnerships. This is a high-impact role for someone ready to take full ownership of campaign delivery and continuously optimize engagement across the buyer journey.

## The impact you will have:

Elliptic is at an inflection point, shifting from crypto compliance tool to data and AI intelligence platform. This role puts you at the centre of that story. You will own the campaign engine that moves prospects through the buyer journey across our four core segments: financial institutions, PSPs, crypto natives, and government. You will also own the industry relationships that keep Elliptic visible and credible in the markets that matter. Done well, this role directly shapes the pipeline, not just awareness.

## What you will do:

Plan and execute integrated multi-channel campaigns from brief to measurement, with clear accountability for business contribution at each stage, from awareness to pipe generation.

- 

Own Elliptic's industry memberships and associations end to end: selecting the right ones, managing the relationships, and making sure each one delivers measurable return.

- 

Build and run a newsletter and nurture programme that earns its audience rather than just occupying inboxes.

- 

Design, build, and manage a data-driven newsletter and nurture programme that delivers engaging content and strengthens relationships with our audience.

- 

Own the social calendar with a clear point of view on what Elliptic should be saying and where.

- 

Partner with Field Marketing to adapt global campaigns for regional markets without losing precision.

- 

Brief the Creative team with rigour: clear audience, clear objective, clear measure of success.

- 

Partner with the Events team to ensure the success of global events and webinars - supporting end-to-end execution, driving registrations, and amplifying post-event impact.

- 

Work closely with the Content Strategist to identify gaps, develop high-performing assets and ensure that content supports each stage of the buyer lifecycle.

- 

Continuously explore new channels, creative approaches, and tools—using data to refine and strengthen campaign performance.

- 

Measure performance using marketing analytics. Present insights and actionable recommendations for improving campaign ROI and audience engagement.

- 

Use AI tools and modern marketing practices to streamline processes, increase productivity, and foster innovation.

## You will be a great fit if you:

- 

Take ownership of outcomes, not just activities. You care whether the campaign worked, not just whether it shipped.

- 

You are comfortable with data and use it to make decisions rather than to report backwards.

- 

You think in buyer journeys: you know how to move someone from unaware to in-conversation and you design accordingly.

- 

You have genuine curiosity about the crypto and digital assets space, not as a box to tick but because you find it interesting.

- 

You can work at pace without losing quality, and you hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is checking.

## Our ideal candidate has:

- 

Proven experience planning and executing integrated B2B campaigns with measurable pipeline impact.

- 

Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or an equivalent marketing automation platform.

- 

Experience managing industry partnerships or memberships with a commercial lens, not just an admin one.

- 

Solid understanding of LinkedIn, X, Reddit etc as B2B channels, including both organic and paid.

- 

Experience in a regulated sector, fintech, or crypto environment, or a strong, demonstrable interest in the space.

- 

Excellent written communication: clear, direct, and built for the channel it is on.

- 

Previous experience or knowledge of the crypto space or regulated sector

## How we work:

- 

Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

- 

£500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

> Learning & Development:

- 

£1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

> Vacation/ Leave:

- 

Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays

- 

An extra day for your birthday

- 

Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

> Benefits:

- 

Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa!

- 

Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

- 

Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries

- 

Cycle to Work Scheme

We know Diversity and Inclusion is much deeper than just hiring, but it’s important for us to mention it here.  We welcome and embrace individuals of all backgrounds and identities at Elliptic, and this is an ongoing priority for us.  We know incredible people don’t all think in the same way.  We want to be challenged every day.  We believe our diverse team of individuals underpins this by bringing creative thinking and innovation to Elliptic every day.  We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace, so we welcome applications from everyone, even if you may not think you fit all of the requirements of our roles.  We foster an environment of psychological safety, where everyone feels comfortable to bring their whole self to work.

## About Feathery

Feathery is the AI operating system for financial institutions. With hundreds of clients and over $30 million raised, Feathery is the fast-growing leader in financial agentic automation. Industry leaders like Tokio Marine, Sequoia Financial, and Cerity Partners run their client-facing workflows on Feathery, from onboarding and risk assessment to reconciling systems and generating proposals and reports.

At the center of it all is Robin, our AI operations assistant. Robin scans client documents, configures and deploys workflows, assists users in their day-to-day work, takes notes during meetings, and supports a growing range of operational tasks across the client lifecycle.

We're building a future where financial operations shift from paperwork, manual data entry, and disconnected systems to intelligent, automated workflows that let firms spend their time on clients instead of process. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Portage Ventures, Allstate Ventures, and Index Ventures, among others.

We're driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Own the Problem, Grit Beats Gloss, Say It Straight — shape how we work and grow as a team.

## Why We’re Hiring

As Feathery scales across financial services, we’re investing in a world-class go-to-market motion to keep pace. With growing enterprise demand and new product capabilities rolling out quickly, we need strong product marketing to sharpen our positioning, accelerate adoption, and enable our Sales and Customer Success teams to win.

We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to own strategic positioning, competitive differentiation, product launches, and the voice of the customer. You’ll help shape how Feathery tells its story internally and externally, translating complex product capabilities into clear narratives that resonate with enterprise buyers.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership to refine our market strategy, influence product direction, and build the messaging and enablement that help win enterprise deals.

## About the Role

What makes this an exciting role to step into? You’ll have significant ownership, with a few things that make this opportunity stand out:

- 

Driving an AI-native marketing organization, shaping marketing in the AI era

- 

We have lots of fun making videos for launches: see examples for our Robin launch and Proposals

- 

Ability to build and hire a team, and grow into a marketing leader

You’ll play a key role in shaping how Feathery tells its product story and brings it to market, with direct impact on customer adoption and growth.

## What You’ll Do

### Go-to-Market, Positioning & Product Launches

- 

Define and evolve Feathery’s core messaging, positioning, and value propositions across insurance and wealth management

- 

Lead go-to-market strategy for new products and feature launches, from narrative and positioning through enablement and launch execution

- 

Translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling messaging for enterprise buyers

- 

Partner with Product and Marketing to bring new capabilities and use cases to market

### Sales Enablement & Competitive Intelligence

- 

Develop customer-centric collateral including decks, one-pagers, case studies, product pages, and other GTM assets

- 

Partner with Sales and Customer Success to build enablement that helps win competitive deals, shorten deal cycles, and expand accounts

- 

Analyze competitors, market trends, and buyer insights to strengthen Feathery’s differentiation

- 

Ensure internal teams are aligned on the latest product updates, positioning, and GTM priorities

### Customer & Market Insights

- 

Champion customer research and voice-of-customer initiatives to refine messaging and identify new opportunities

- 

Develop customer stories and case studies that demonstrate Feathery’s impact

- 

Partner with Product to inform roadmap priorities based on customer insights, usage patterns, and feedback from the field

- 

Identify emerging customer needs, use cases, and market opportunities across insurance and wealth management

## About You

- 

5+ years of B2B SaaS Product Marketing experience, including ownership of product launches and go-to-market programs

- 

Proven track record of positioning technical or workflow automation products for enterprise customers

- 

Exceptional storytelling and communication skills — able to distill complex technology into compelling narratives

- 

Experience building sales enablement and competitive intelligence programs

- 

Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing

- 

Deep curiosity about customers and how they evaluate and buy technology

- 

Ability to operate both strategically and tactically in a fast-paced environment

## Bonus

- 

Experience in financial services, insurance, wealth management, or other regulated industries

- 

Technical proficiency or familiarity with APIs, workflow automation, or data platforms

- 

Experience with AI-powered products

- 

Background in high-growth B2B SaaS environments

## 
What We Offer

- 

Competitive compensation and equity

- 

HRA health plan

- 

Unlimited PTO

- 

Retirement: 401(k) plan

- 

A supportive, low-ego team that values ownership and growth

- 

Company offsites to connect and recharge

 

Feathery is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic. We’re committed to building an inclusive team and provide reasonable accommodations upon request.

job.title: Lifecycle & Email Marketing Manager
job.description:
Lifecycle & Email Marketing Manager

Fresh Prints' email channel is our oldest and highest-potential channel — and the one we've leveraged the least. We've built a strong technical foundation, but we're missing the layer that actually makes email work: content. Emails that land at the right moment, in the right way, and create real value for the people on our list.

We're looking for someone who is first and foremost a great marketer — someone who understands what makes an email get opened, get read, and drive a click. You'll own both our campaign email and our full lifecycle program, and you'll extend that same craft into SMS as we build it into a real channel.

This isn't a role where you inherit a machine and keep it running. You're building the content engine on top of the plumbing we already have. If you've been waiting for a channel with this much upside and this little baggage, this is it.

This role is about:

  • Owning every word that goes out — subject lines, body, CTAs — across email and SMS
  • Turning a solid technical setup into a channel people actually look forward to hearing from
  • Building lifecycle flows that feel like a conversation, not a drip someone got trapped in
  • Writing for a college-age audience in a voice that feels made for them, not blasted at them
  • Bringing a real point of view on performance — not just reading the numbers, but knowing what they're telling you to do next

What You'll Own

Campaign Email & SMS Content

  • Own email and SMS conceptualization — final say on subject lines, preview text, headers, body, and CTAs across all of Fresh Prints' major marketing moments
  • Work with our brand and creative teams on design and copy so every send feels on-brand
  • Develop a campaign content calendar that ladders into the broader marketing calendar, so email and SMS amplify the right message at the right time
  • Own A/B testing for subject lines, content approaches, and CTAs — with the discipline to learn from the results and apply them
  • Write messages that resonate with a college-age audience: content that feels like it's actually written for them, not generic marketing

Lifecycle Program (Email & SMS)

  • Own the strategy and content for Fresh Prints' lifecycle flows: welcome series for new subscribers, post-purchase nurture, cart and browse abandonment, re-engagement, and win-back — across email and SMS
  • Audit the existing lifecycle program, identify gaps, underperforming flows, and moments in the customer journey where we're leaving engagement on the table
  • Own segmentation: define the audiences and journey logic that decide who gets what, when
  • Write and test improved lifecycle content, and build flows that feel like a conversation with the customer, not a sequence they got dropped into for checking a box

Deliverability & Performance

  • Monitor deliverability and engagement metrics — open rates, click-through rates, unsubscribe rates, spam complaints, bounce rates — and maintain a healthy sender reputation
  • Follow email and SMS deliverability best practices: list hygiene, warm-up protocols, segmentation for engaged vs. unengaged audiences, suppression management, and compliance
  • Report on performance on a regular cadence — what's working, what isn't, and what you're changing based on the data
  • Bring a point of view: not just "open rate was 28%," but "here's what that tells us about the subject-line approach, and here's what I'm testing next"

Who You Are

  • You're a strong marketer, and you know it. Your subject lines get opened. Your body copy gets read. Your CTAs get clicked. You have a feel for what makes someone actually engage with a message rather than glance at it before archiving.
  • You understand lifecycle marketing at a real level — you know the difference between a nurture message and a conversion message, and you write them differently.
  • You're fluent in email (and increasingly SMS) as a channel: you know what deliverability means, you care about list health, and you can look at an open rate and know whether it's a subject-line problem or a segmentation problem.
  • You own your own output. Nobody has to check your sends before they go — you hold the standard yourself, and it stings when something ships with a mistake.
  • You work well with technical partners, brand, and creative, and you can translate what Fresh Prints' audience cares about into messaging that lands.
  • You're comfortable with data and let it sharpen your instincts rather than replace them.

Requirements

  • 4-8 years of experience in email, lifecycle, or CRM marketing, or a closely related role where writing was a primary responsibility
  • Hands-on experience with an ESP or marketing automation platform (Iterable, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Braze, or similar); SMS platform experience a plus
  • Demonstrated understanding of lifecycle programs: welcome series, post-purchase flows, re-engagement, cart abandonment, and the segmentation logic behind them
  • Comfort with email/SMS performance metrics — open rate, CTR, unsubscribe rate, deliverability indicators — and the ability to draw real insight from them
  • Basic HTML/CSS comfort for email (able to troubleshoot and adjust templates)
  • Strong written communication — you write clearly and with personality, not in marketing speak
  • Experience writing for a consumer audience is a strong plus; B2C or DTC background preferred over B2B or enterprise

Details and other benefits

  • Work From Home / Remote
  • Competitive annual salary
  • Learning opportunities
  • Working in a great culture
  • At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees

Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity, actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ+, and those with disabilities to apply.

  • You're fluent in email (and increasingly SMS) as a channel: you know what deliverability means, you care about list health, and you can look at an open rate and know whether it's a subject-line problem or a segmentation problem.
  • You own your own output. Nobody has to check your sends before they go — you hold the standard yourself, and it stings when something ships with a mistake.
  • You work well with technical partners, brand, and creative, and you can translate what Fresh Prints' audience cares about into messaging that lands.
  • You're comfortable with data and let it sharpen your instincts rather than replace them.

Requirements

  • 4-8 years of experience in email, lifecycle, or CRM marketing, or a closely related role where writing was a primary responsibility
  • Hands-on experience with an ESP or marketing automation platform (Iterable, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Braze, or similar); SMS platform experience a plus
  • Demonstrated understanding of lifecycle programs: welcome series, post-purchase flows, re-engagement, cart abandonment, and the segmentation logic behind them
  • Comfort with email/SMS performance metrics — open rate, CTR, unsubscribe rate, deliverability indicators — and the ability to draw real insight from them
  • Basic HTML/CSS comfort for email (able to troubleshoot and adjust templates)
  • Strong written communication — you write clearly and with personality, not in marketing speak
  • Experience writing for a consumer audience is a strong plus; B2C or DTC background preferred over B2B or enterprise

Details and other benefits

  • Work From Home / Remote
  • Competitive annual salary
  • Learning opportunities
  • Working in a great culture
  • At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees

Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity, actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ+, and those with disabilities to apply.

job.title: SEO/AEO Growth Director
job.description:
Graphite is a technology-enabled growth agency that helps fast-growing companies like Masterclass, Notion, and BetterUp unlock sustainable revenue through content, SEO, and AEO. 

We are a fully distributed company with team members located across North America, Latin America, and Europe. 

We’re obsessed with impact— it’s foundational to who we are, why we’re successful, and how we approach delivering outcomes for clients and ultimately, everyone on the internet. 

We seek an experienced Growth Director (SEO + AEO + Content) to lead growth strategies for high-growth tech companies. You will develop and execute SEO, AEO, content, and conversion optimization strategies to drive business results for our partners. Success requires strong problem-solving skills, creativity, and ownership of complex, large-scale projects.

This opportunity is full-time and fully remote, offering the flexibility to work from home.

Come join us and help us create the best content, everywhere that matters!

What you’ll do:

• Lead growth strategies for consumer tech companies.

• Own execution of web and app SEO/AEO projects.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve targets.

• Present insights and outcomes to executives.

• Develop data-driven, scalable content solutions.

What expertise you’ll need:

• 6+ years of technical and programmatic SEO experience or 6+ years of Digital Marketing experience with a keen interest in SEO.

• Strong leadership and communication skills.

• Proficient in data analysis and growth marketing tools (Google Analytics, SEMRush, Ahrefs).

•Experience with user acquisition and product development for web and mobile platforms.

How we’ll help:

Graphite’s mission is to create an environment where you build the best work of your career. In order to facilitate this, we provide:

Process As Needed - We view the process as a way to empower better work, not as a series of dogmatic rules. We develop the best internal processes the same way we develop products - through iteration, measurement, and continuous improvement.

Autonomy - We trust you to be excellent at what you do. We will provide as much support as needed when needed, but no more. You will have autonomy and agency to drive projects forward, and own decisions and outcomes.

Flexible Work Environment - Everyone’s optimal work style is unique. We operate as a distributed team across North & Latin America and Asia. We optimize for productivity and performance, not time spent in an office. Help us build an optimal work environment that fits you as an individual.

Compensation - We want to work with the best people in the World and compensate accordingly.

Vacation & Time Off - In order to be the best version of yourself, you need time to recharge. We offer flexible PTO. Take time when you need it.

Benefits - We will ensure you have quality healthcare coverage and opportunities to further your education.

Graphite provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected classification.

job.title: VP Product Marketing
job.description:
Hevo (www.hevodata.com) is a simple, intuitive, and powerful No-code Data Pipeline platform that enables companies to consolidate data from multiple software for faster analytics.

Hevo powers data analytics for 2000+ data-driven companies across multiple industry verticals including Shopify, DoorDash, Deliverr, Neo4J, Arhaus, Marqeta, and Postman. By automating complex data integration tasks, Hevo allows data teams to focus on deriving groundbreaking insights and driving their businesses forward.

Hevo’s mission is simple, but bold: Build technology that is simple to adopt and easy to access so that everyone can unlock the potential of data.

Headquartered in San Francisco and with offices in India, Hevo has seen exponential growth since its inception. Hevo’s revenue and customer base has expanded by a staggering 3X in just the last two years.

With total funding of $42 Mil (Series B) from Sequoia India, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, Hevo is now entering a new phase of hyper-growth.

Hevoites are a bunch of thoughtful, helpful problem solvers, who are obsessed with making a difference in the lives of their customers, colleagues, and their own individual trajectory.

If you are passionate about redefining the future of technology, then Hevo is the place for you.

Product Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p0XGLDgvCo8

What you’ll own as a Product Marketing Leader:
 
- Conduct primary and secondary research to discover user and buyer personas, their pains and expected gains, and the competitor landscape to refine positioning

- Build a deep understanding of our product, use cases and competitive landscape (direct and indirect) to develop an SSOT of value-prop and external messaging that resonates with the intended audience

- Conduct quantitative and qualitative win/loss and competition analysis to drive effective objection handling and consistency in our sales conversations

- Collaborate with functional leads to turn intel into effective collaterals - pitch decks, demos, case studies, and the like, and own its adoption to improve win rates and lower sales cycles

- Collaborate with product and customer success teams to drive the adoption and usage of features

- Develop and nurture customers into advocates across a spectrum ranging from external reviews, beta-testing groups, customer advisory board, and external evangelists

- Build a deep understanding of our product, competition, and the larger ecosystem to play an active role in pricing and packaging decisions

- Own the GTM for new features by collaborating with product and sales teams to establish the plan and orchestrate marketing execution to achieve those goals

- Collaborate with the Sales and Product team to do 0-1 market discovery and development for new products

- Hiring: Plan and hire for headcount to keep up with the scope of PMM responsibilities

- Mentor and coach team members to improve overall team performance and ensure continuous learning and career growth

- Collaborate with industry analysts, experts, and influencers to create and maintain relevance, brand awareness, and visibility for Hevo

- Develop thought leadership to position Hevo as one of the key stakeholders in the Modern Data Stack space

- 10+ years of experience in Product Marketing. Experience in building processes about user research messaging, persona research, and GTM strategy for scaling product marketing

- Preference: Worked at an infrastructure product company/dev tools company marketing to developers and created an impact

- Preference: Should have experience in doing Product Marketing at companies with Mid Market and Enterprise customers

- Excellent communication skills - verbal and written

- Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills for cross-functional collaboration

- Ability to empathetically understand and solve customer issues

- Deep understanding of the business and the market trends

- Experience in driving business impact at a growth-stage startup in a senior or leadership role

job.title: Content Marketing Manager
job.description:
Influ2 brings ABM to the contact level. With Influ2, you can act on contact-level intent, reach specific buyers with ads, orchestrate journeys across channels, and make the revenue impact clear.

200+ enterprises and mid-market companies worldwide, including industry leaders such as Snowflake, AppsFlyer, and Capgemini, love our technology. We hope you will love it too.

Who we are looking for:

We're looking for a Content Marketing Manager who knows the difference between content that's worth someone's time and content that just fills a page.

A content creator with a perspective that goes beyond what AI can generate, strong writing skills, a feel for what resonates with people, and a sharp editorial instinct.

You'll own Influ2's content strategy and execution across channels, from website and blog content to thought leadership and email marketing.

You'll work closely with every marketing function, especially SEO, to make sure our content is both genuinely good and effective.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys shaping the direction and doing the work.

- Content strategy: Own our content strategy and editorial calendar. Identify the topics, stories, and formats worth investing in, and connect content priorities to our goals.

- Content creation: Write, edit, and produce content across our website, blog, thought leadership, customer stories, reports, and other formats.

- SEO and GEO growth: Partner closely with SEO to create content that earns visibility without sacrificing quality.

- Email marketing content: Own the content and copy for email marketing, including newsletter, nurture sequences, campaign emails, and customer comms.

- Content distribution: Work with channel owners to find opportunities to extend the life and impact of strong content.

- Editorial quality: Set and maintain a high editorial standard across everything we publish, making sure our content is clear, distinctive, and worth someone's attention.

 

What success looks like: Influ2 produces content that people recognize, remember, and want to engage with, and that impact shows up in the pipeline. Marketing teams see you as a creative and strategic partner who brings strong ideas.

- 5+ years of experience in content marketing or editorial roles, preferably within B2B technology or SaaS. Experience in martech, adtech, or ABM is a strong plus.

- A strong portfolio of content you've personally written that shows original thinking, excellent writing, and the ability to work across formats.

- Experience owning content strategy and execution, from developing ideas to production and performance analysis that informs editorial and strategic decisions.

- You have strong editorial instincts. You can recognize a great idea, spot a boring one, and explain what would make it better.

- You're an excellent writer and editor. You can make complicated topics feel simple without stripping away what makes them valuable.

- You have a point of view. You follow what's happening in marketing and technology, question familiar approaches, and come up with ideas that aren't obvious.

- You're curious about customers, their challenges, and how they make decisions. You know how to find useful insights through conversations, research, and data.

- You can move between big-picture thinking and hands-on execution.

 

At Influ2, we highly appreciate a wide range of experiences and backgrounds. So, even if your history doesn't perfectly match our list, we would still be delighted to receive your application and learn more about you!

- Have a direct impact on how Influ2 tells its story and builds its voice in the market.

- Own content across the business, with room to experiment, introduce new formats, and bring your own ideas to life.

- Remote work flexibility with no fixed working hours; work where and when it suits you.

- Unlimited vacation policy to support a healthy work-life balance.

- Generous parental leave and other well-structured PTO policies.

- A well-rounded health package with comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 

We’ve raised a total of $15 million in our Series A round, maintaining a cash-positive business for the past 24 months while achieving 50% growth.

 

We're convinced that the diverse ideas and experiences every Influ2encer brings are the key to our success. To make sure our culture and products reflect this blend of viewpoints and backgrounds, there's no room for discrimination here. Our approach to hiring, training, promoting, and compensating individuals is grounded in merit and competence.

 

We're committed to offering equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, no matter their race, age, religion, where they come from, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Everyone at Influ2 plays a part in keeping our workplace welcoming and free from discrimination and harassment.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to shape how Influ2 is positioned and brought to market. You’ll work across product launches, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, positioning, and customer education. The role will evolve with the business, so we’re looking for someone who can quickly understand what matters most, take ownership, and move it forward.

You’ll report to the Senior Manager of Product and Lifecycle Marketing and work alongside two other team members.

- Sales enablement: Identify what our AEs and Sales Development teams need to position Influ2 effectively, then develop the tools, and training that help them communicate its value, handle objections, and win deals.

- Go-to-market strategy: Take new products and features to market, from positioning and launch strategy through front-line readiness and adoption.

- Customer education: Set the approach to customer education and develop programs that help customers understand and adopt Influ2’s capabilities.

- Product positioning and messaging: Define how Influ2 and its products are positioned. Turn product capabilities, customer needs, and market context into clear messaging that differentiates us.

- Content and enablement: Translate our positioning into the materials people need, from product demos and sales decks to videos, white papers, and presentations.

- Performance: Determine how product marketing impact should be measured, track results, and use what you learn to set priorities and improve programs.

 

What success looks like: You’ll shape how Influ2 is positioned and differentiated, how effectively our AEs and Sales Development teams communicate its value, and how new products and features are brought to market and adopted. Your work will directly impact competitive win rates, sales effectiveness, and product adoption.

- 7+ years of experience in product marketing within the B2B technology industry. Experience in martech, ABM, or an adjacent space is a strong plus.

- Proven success in developing and executing go-to-market strategies.

- Strong understanding of mid-market and enterprise buying cycles at sales-led organizations.

- Background in leading competitive intelligence efforts or win/loss analysis.

- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including product management, sales, and customer success.

- Proficiency with tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Storylane, and Claude.

- A degree in marketing, business, or a related field is preferred but optional; what matters most is your proven track record.

- You can turn complex products into clear positioning and messaging that makes sense to buyers and sellers.

- You understand enterprise sales cycles and what front-line teams need from product marketing to win.

- You can look at customer feedback, competitive intelligence, sales data, and market signals and decide what matters.

- You’re comfortable making decisions and moving work forward without having every step defined for you.

- You can work across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer teams, including when priorities or perspectives differ.

- You can shift focus as the business changes without losing sight of the outcome you’re working toward.

job.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Foundry
job.description:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a standalone division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. You’re the growth engine for the pods. In the core business, this work splits across product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle teams; here, it’s one person doing all of it — finding the message that lands, filling the early-access pipeline, and turning a working product into paying customers. You’ll set positioning, generate demand, and own the funnel from first touch to renewal, working hand in hand with Pod Founders who are selling as they build. This is a blank-page job: most pods start with no category, no audience list, and no playbook, and you’ll build all three. The role reports to the President, Foundry, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Marketing leadership.

What you’ll do:

- 

Own positioning and messaging. Craft the value proposition, naming, and packaging input for products customers have never heard of, and maintain messaging frameworks by segment across K12, higher education, and business and government.

- 

Run go-to-market and launch. Own go-to-market readiness for pilots, early access, and general availability — timelines, channels, pricing input, and the launch assets that carry the story.

- 

Build the demand engine. Generate pipeline through campaigns, audience building, early-access recruiting, and the top of the funnel that feeds the Founder’s selling.

- 

Drive content. Create the collateral, digital content, and customer-facing assets that build demand and make the differentiation obvious.

- 

Be the market and customer expert. Become the go-to expert on the portfolio’s customers and competitors, and feed that insight back into product and pricing.

- 

Own lifecycle and adoption. Once customers land, drive adoption, expansion, and retention with consistent, value-based messaging.

- 

Measure and adjust. Track funnel and campaign performance against pipeline and revenue, and change course fast when the numbers say so.

What you’ll need:

- 

Five or more years in product, portfolio, or growth marketing, ideally in ed tech or a related industry, with new-product launches under your belt.

- 

A demonstrated ability to drive go-to-market strategy and execute strategic product launches end to end.

- 

Demand-generation range — campaigns, funnel, and audience building — not just positioning and decks.

- 

Strong writing, with a portfolio of strategically focused content and collateral.

- 

The ability to influence executive and cross-functional teams, and to present to groups large and small, virtually and in person.

- 

A full-stack marketer’s range — you do product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle yourself, and you market to fill pipeline and close revenue, not to win awards.

This role isn’t for everyone:

You should probably pass if:

- 

You want to own one slice — just messaging, or just campaigns — and hand off the rest.

- 

You need an established brand and a built-in audience to market into. Here you build the category.

- 

You measure success by impressions and activity rather than by pipeline and revenue.

- 

You want a large marketing organization with clear lanes. This is one person, broad scope, and fast.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

- 

Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

- 

Flexible work culture.  Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

- 

Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

- 

Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

- 

Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

- 

The technology and tools you need to do your best work 

- 

Motivosity employee recognition program

- 

A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a standalone division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. You’re the growth engine for the pods. In the core business, this work splits across product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle teams; here, it’s one person doing all of it — finding the message that lands, filling the early-access pipeline, and turning a working product into paying customers. You’ll set positioning, generate demand, and own the funnel from first touch to renewal, working hand in hand with Pod Founders who are selling as they build. This is a blank-page job: most pods start with no category, no audience list, and no playbook, and you’ll build all three. The role reports to the President, Foundry, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Marketing leadership.

What you’ll do:

- 

Own positioning and messaging. Craft the value proposition, naming, and packaging input for products customers have never heard of, and maintain messaging frameworks by segment across K12, higher education, and business and government.

- 

Run go-to-market and launch. Own go-to-market readiness for pilots, early access, and general availability — timelines, channels, pricing input, and the launch assets that carry the story.

- 

Build the demand engine. Generate pipeline through campaigns, audience building, early-access recruiting, and the top of the funnel that feeds the Founder’s selling.

- 

Drive content. Create the collateral, digital content, and customer-facing assets that build demand and make the differentiation obvious.

- 

Be the market and customer expert. Become the go-to expert on the portfolio’s customers and competitors, and feed that insight back into product and pricing.

- 

Own lifecycle and adoption. Once customers land, drive adoption, expansion, and retention with consistent, value-based messaging.

- 

Measure and adjust. Track funnel and campaign performance against pipeline and revenue, and change course fast when the numbers say so.

What you’ll need:

- 

Five or more years in product, portfolio, or growth marketing, ideally in ed tech or a related industry, with new-product launches under your belt.

- 

A demonstrated ability to drive go-to-market strategy and execute strategic product launches end to end.

- 

Demand-generation range — campaigns, funnel, and audience building — not just positioning and decks.

- 

Strong writing, with a portfolio of strategically focused content and collateral.

- 

The ability to influence executive and cross-functional teams, and to present to groups large and small, virtually and in person.

- 

A full-stack marketer’s range — you do product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle yourself, and you market to fill pipeline and close revenue, not to win awards.

This role isn’t for everyone:

You should probably pass if:

- 

You want to own one slice — just messaging, or just campaigns — and hand off the rest.

- 

You need an established brand and a built-in audience to market into. Here you build the category.

- 

You measure success by impressions and activity rather than by pipeline and revenue.

- 

You want a large marketing organization with clear lanes. This is one person, broad scope, and fast.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

- 

Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

- 

Flexible work culture.  Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

- 

Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

- 

Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

- 

Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

- 

The technology and tools you need to do your best work 

- 

Motivosity employee recognition program

- 

A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

job.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Real Assets
job.description:
## About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

## About your role

Commercial real estate and real assets is one of the most important and fastest-growing segments of our business, and how we win there depends on product marketing expertise that sits shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales. We're seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Real Assets to own the messaging, positioning, and enablement that move real assets deals forward, from the first conversation with IR, a CFO or COO to the final stage of a competitive evaluation.

In this role, you'll be the internal expert on how real estate and real assets managers buy, who sits in the buying group, what they care about, and what makes them choose Juniper Square over the alternative. You'll translate that understanding into the persona-specific narratives, competitive positioning, content and deal support that help our sellers win.

This role reports to the Head of Product Marketing and partners closely with Sales leadership and Demand Gen, all teams that operate as trusted partners in driving pipeline and revenue.

 

## What you’ll do

Real Assets strategy, positioning & messaging

- 

Partner on Juniper Square's strategy, positioning and messaging for the real assets segment, articulating a differentiated value proposition for each stakeholder in the CRE buying group; CFOs, COOs, Heads of Asset Management and Fund Operations, Fund Controllers, Investor Relations, and technical evaluators.

- 

Build the real assets persona and industry playbooks: buyer and influencer roles, priorities, objections, and content needs at every stage of the sales journey.

Sales enablement & deal strategy

- 

Work directly with Sales leadership and top sellers to co-create the collateral that wins CRE deals: executive briefs, ROI narratives, competitive battlecards, and stakeholder-specific decks for each stage of the buying process.

- 

Act as the internal expert on CRE deal dynamics, playing an active role in shaping messaging and strategy on high-stakes opportunities.

Voice of customer & market intelligence

- 

Conduct deep voice-of-customer research through customer interviews, win/loss analysis, and Sales feedback to continuously enrich our understanding of real assets personas and use cases.

- 

Own competitive intelligence for the real assets segment and disseminate actionable insights to Sales, Growth Marketing, and Product so the whole go-to-market motion stays aligned around how real estate and real assets managers actually buy.

Build AI-native

- 

Use AI agents and tooling as core infrastructure to research accounts, synthesize customer and competitive inputs, which measurably accelerates the production of messaging and enablement assets.

- 

Apply judgment to what AI produces: know where automation accelerates the work and where human insight matters.

Cross-functional partnership

- 

Partner with Demand Gen to ground real assets campaigns in strong, persona-relevant messaging and provide the inputs that drive message-market fit.

- 

Work with Product to translate complex platform capabilities into clear, resonant value propositions for real assets buyers.

- 

Support Customer Marketing in surfacing the real assets customer stories that validate our messaging with real-world proof.

Software application ownership

- 

Own a subset of Juniper Square's apps as their dedicated product marketing lead, from positioning through go-to-market.

- 

Lead launches for your apps: own the messaging, positioning, and launch plan that bring each release to market.

- 

Own the feedback loop for your apps, gathering signal from Sales, customers, and the field and channeling it back to Product to shape the roadmap.

- 

Own competitive intelligence for your apps, tracking competing products and arming Sales with the positioning and enablement to win.

### 

## Qualifications

- 

3+ years of experience in the commercial real estate or real assets ecosystem is required (at a real estate investment manager, a fund administrator, or a company selling into CRE); you understand how these firms operate, who the buyers are, and what they care about.

- 

Experience in B2B product marketing or GTM strategy roles is advantageous but not required, with a strong bias toward supporting Sales and influencing deal outcomes.

- 

AI Fluency: experience using LLMs, agents, and AI automation tools to measurably accelerate your work, and understanding where human judgment is critical.

- 

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; the ability to translate nuanced market insights into clear, compelling GTM artifacts.

## Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $115,000 - $215,000 USD and the Canadian base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $137,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

- 

Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

- 

Life insurance

- 

Mental wellness coverage

- 

Fertility and growing family support

- 

Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

- 

Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

- 

Retirement saving plans

- 

Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

- 

Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.
