If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

## About your role

Sitting within Corporate Marketing, the SEO & AEO Manager owns Juniper Square's visibility across organic search, AEO, and GEO: how we're found, ranked, and cited, in traditional search and in the AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) that GPs and fund operations teams increasingly use to research vendors and ideas. Working across the broader GTM organization, you'll set the strategy, then own execution end to end, from technical foundation to AI visibility to authority building.

GPs come to Juniper Square for software, for fund administration services, or increasingly both, and each entry point carries its own nuance (terminology, competitive set, audience expectations, etc.) so your strategy has to flex across the full platform rather than run one generic playbook. AEO and GEO add another layer: there's no industry-established playbook yet, and you're expected to help write one for Juniper Square rather than just execute someone else's. The right candidate uses AI as standard infrastructure and pairs technical rigor with the discipline to build processes that compound over time.

The application deadline for this role is October 5th, 2026.

## What you’ll do

Own Technical SEO
Success here means organic traffic and rankings grow measurably against a defined set of priority terms across Juniper Square's full platform.

- 

Own SEO across junipersquare.com: on-page optimization, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, and regular technical audits, partnering with our web engineering agency to scope and ship fixes.

- 

Monitor and improve sitewide crawl efficiency and indexing. Manage structured data (JSON-LD) and emerging AI crawling protocols, including llms.txt and plain-text/markdown alternates of priority pages.

- 

Own the brief and quality bar for agency and vendor relationships across SEO, AEO, and content production, deciding what stays in-house.

- 

Monitor Juniper Square's rankings against named competitors, in both traditional search and AI answer engines. When a competitor overtakes us on a priority term, diagnose why and drive the fix, whether that's a technical change, a content update, or an authority play.

Win Citations Across the Open Web

Success here means Juniper Square gets cited by name in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews for the private markets questions that matter, tracked against named competitors.

- 

Optimize content for LLM and AI-search visibility: schema and structured data, answer-first formatting, and semantic reinforcement that makes Juniper Square content easy for AI systems to extract and cite.

- 

Extend that visibility beyond junipersquare.com to Reddit threads, YouTube (titles, descriptions, chapters, and metadata built to rank in video results), review sites, and other community content LLMs treat as trusted sources, and direct that content to work for two readers at once, crawlers and humans, using AI-assisted workflows to scale production without lowering the quality bar.

- 

Contribute to the broader social content strategy, including LinkedIn, so format and structure support search and AI-citation goals across channels, not just engagement.

- 

Run controlled experiments to isolate what actually moves AI citations rather than treating AEO as guesswork, and turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook.

- 

Track how AI platforms retrieve, summarize, and attribute Juniper Square content, report regularly on citation share alongside organic traffic and rankings, and use that data to reprioritize the roadmap.

- 

Treat technical SEO and GEO as one program with shared priorities instead of running them as separate workstreams.

Build Category Authority

Success here means referring domains and citations from private markets and financial media keep growing: real evidence Juniper Square is gaining authority on private markets ideas, not just its own product terms.

- 

Build Juniper Square's authority on the ideas that define private markets, not just on product and brand terms, so we're the source search engines and AI systems point to on GP operations, fund administration, and other core private markets topics.

- 

Tailor authority-building work to how a GP is engaging us, whether that's software, fund administration, or both, since the competitors and publications that matter shift with the entry point.

- 

Partner with content and subject-matter experts to identify where Juniper Square should be the definitive answer to a private markets question but isn't yet, and close those gaps.

## Qualifications

- 

5+ years in SEO, including hands-on ownership of a technical SEO program at a large B2B organization.

- 

Real, hands-on AEO/GEO experience, not just familiarity with the concept. You should be able to point to a specific citation you've earned in an AI answer engine and explain exactly how you did it.

- 

A track record of earning backlinks and media citations built on original research or data, not outreach templates alone.

- 

Experience with SEO/GEO tooling, including rank trackers, log-file analysis, and AI-citation monitoring platforms. Plus hands-on experience with AEO/GEO or AI-citation monitoring tools, such as Profound, Airops, etc.

- 

Enough technical fluency with structured data and schema markup (JSON-LD) to spec work precisely and partner directly with engineers on implementation.

- 

Strong writing and editorial judgment: this role often means shaping how a piece of content is framed and structured, not just tagging it after the fact.

- 

Comfort operating with real ambiguity. AEO/GEO best practices are still being defined industry-wide, and this role is as much about building Juniper Square's playbook as running it.

- 

Experience optimizing social media and video content for search.

- 

Experience in financial services, fintech, or private markets, or a demonstrated ability to get up to speed quickly on a technical, regulated industry.

## Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary of $116,000 - $160,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

- 

Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

- 

Life insurance

- 

Mental wellness coverage

- 

Fertility and growing family support

- 

Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

- 

Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

- 

Retirement saving plans

- 

Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

- 

Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

About your role

Sitting within Corporate Marketing, the SEO & AEO Manager owns Juniper Square's visibility across organic search, AEO, and GEO: how we're found, ranked, and cited, in traditional search and in the AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) that GPs and fund operations teams increasingly use to research vendors and ideas. Working across the broader GTM organization, you'll set the strategy, then own execution end to end, from technical foundation to AI visibility to authority building.

GPs come to Juniper Square for software, for fund administration services, or increasingly both, and each entry point carries its own nuance (terminology, competitive set, audience expectations, etc.) so your strategy has to flex across the full platform rather than run one generic playbook. AEO and GEO add another layer: there's no industry-established playbook yet, and you're expected to help write one for Juniper Square rather than just execute someone else's. The right candidate uses AI as standard infrastructure and pairs technical rigor with the discipline to build processes that compound over time.

Own Technical SEO
Success here means organic traffic and rankings grow measurably against a defined set of priority terms across Juniper Square's full platform.

  • Own SEO across junipersquare.com: on-page optimization, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, and regular technical audits, partnering with our web engineering agency to scope and ship fixes.

  • Monitor and improve sitewide crawl efficiency and indexing. Manage structured data (JSON-LD) and emerging AI crawling protocols, including llms.txt and plain-text/markdown alternates of priority pages.

  • Own the brief and quality bar for agency and vendor relationships across SEO, AEO, and content production, deciding what stays in-house.

  • Monitor Juniper Square's rankings against named competitors, in both traditional search and AI answer engines. When a competitor overtakes us on a priority term, diagnose why and drive the fix, whether that's a technical change, a content update, or an authority play.

Success here means Juniper Square gets cited by name in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews for the private markets questions that matter, tracked against named competitors.

  • Optimize content for LLM and AI-search visibility: schema and structured data, answer-first formatting, and semantic reinforcement that makes Juniper Square content easy for AI systems to extract and cite.

  • Extend that visibility beyond junipersquare.com to Reddit threads, YouTube (titles, descriptions, chapters, and metadata built to rank in video results), review sites, and other community content LLMs treat as trusted sources, and direct that content to work for two readers at once, crawlers and humans, using AI-assisted workflows to scale production without lowering the quality bar.

  • Contribute to the broader social content strategy, including LinkedIn, so format and structure support search and AI-citation goals across channels, not just engagement.

  • Run controlled experiments to isolate what actually moves AI citations rather than treating AEO as guesswork, and turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook.

  • Real, hands-on AEO/GEO experience, not just familiarity with the concept. You should be able to point to a specific citation you've earned in an AI answer engine and explain exactly how you did it.

  • Experience optimizing social media and video content for search.

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary of $116,000 - $160,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

## About your role

Fund administration is one of the most important and fastest-growing areas of the Juniper Square business, and how we win there depends on product marketing expertise that sits shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales. We're seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Fund Administration to partner with leadership on GTM strategy, as well as own the messaging, positioning, and enablement that move fund administration deals forward.

What sets this role apart: fund administration is a service, so understanding the offering means understanding the people who deliver it. You'll know our fund administration leaders and experts cold, including where each one is strongest, and you'll know our reference clients and how they differ across size, asset class, and profile. Keeping that picture current as the team scales fast is one of the most important parts of the job.

This role reports to the Head of Product Marketing and partners closely with Sales leadership and Pipeline.

## What you'll do

### Fund Administration strategy, positioning & messaging

- 

Own Juniper Square's go-to-market strategy, positioning and messaging for the fund administration business unit, articulating a differentiated value proposition for each stakeholder in the buying group; CFOs, fund controllers, Heads of Finance and Fund Operations, leaders across investor services, accounting, treasury, compliance, and loan operations, and technical evaluators.

- 

Position Juniper Square's fund administration service so buyers understand not just what it delivers but how it changes the way their teams work, and prepare Sales and Customer Success to have credible, informed conversations about it.

- 

Build the fund administration persona and industry playbooks: buyer and influencer roles, priorities, objections, and content needs at every stage of the sales journey.

### Fund administration expertise & references

- 

Build and maintain a living map of Juniper Square's fund administration leaders and experts: who presents well, where each one is strongest, and who to bring into a given deal or moment.

- 

Keep that picture current through constant data-gathering as the fund administration team grows fast, so sales always knows who to pull in and when.

- 

Maintain deep knowledge of our fund administration reference clients and how they vary by customer size, asset class, and profile, so sellers can match the right proof to the right prospect.

### Fund administration launches

- 

Own every fund administration product and feature launch end to end with repeatable frameworks that scale from major product announcements to quarterly release moments.

- 

Define what launch readiness looks like and drive the cross-functional plan that gets there, so each release lands with Sales, Customer Success, and the market ready.

- 

Close the loop after launch, feeding adoption signal and customer feedback back to Product to shape what ships next.

### Sales enablement & deal support

- 

Work directly with Sales leadership and top sellers to co-create the collateral that wins fund administration deals: executive briefs, ROI narratives, competitive battlecards, demo narratives, and stakeholder-specific decks for each stage of the buying process.

- 

Drive pipeline, upsell, and cross-sell velocity across the GP experience and fund administration suite, maintaining a cohesive release narrative that keeps prospects and customers engaged across the lifecycle.

- 

Act as the internal expert on fund administration deal dynamics, playing an active role in shaping messaging and strategy on high-stakes opportunities.

### Voice of customer & competitive intelligence

- 

Conduct deep voice-of-customer research through customer interviews, win/loss analysis, and Sales feedback to continuously enrich our understanding of fund administration personas and use cases across investor services, accounting, treasury, compliance, and loan operations.

- 

Create the fund administration customer stories that validate our messaging with real-world proof.

- 

Own competitive intelligence for the fund administration segment and disseminate actionable insights to Sales, Growth Marketing, and Product so the whole go-to-market motion stays aligned around how these teams actually buy.

### Build AI-native

- 

Use AI agents and tooling as core infrastructure to research accounts, synthesize customer and competitive inputs, which measurably accelerates the production of messaging and enablement assets.

- 

Apply judgment to what AI produces: know where automation accelerates the work and where human insight matters.

## Qualifications

- 

3+ years of experience in or adjacent to fund administration is required (at a fund administrator, on a fund CFO, controller, or finance operations team, or at a company selling fund administration technology or services); you understand how these teams operate, who the buyers are, and what they care about.

- 

Experience in B2B product marketing or GTM strategy roles is advantageous but not required, with a strong bias toward supporting Sales and influencing deal outcomes.

- 

AI Fluency: experience using LLMs, agents, and AI automation tools to measurably accelerate your work, and understanding where human judgment is critical.

- 

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; the ability to translate nuanced market insights into clear, compelling GTM artifacts.

## Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $115,000 - $215,000 USD and the Canadian base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $137,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

 

Benefits include:

- 

Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

- 

Life insurance

- 

Mental wellness coverage

- 

Fertility and growing family support

- 

Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

- 

Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

- 

Retirement saving plans

- 

Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

- 

Annual professional development stipend

 

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

job.title: Director, Demand Generation
job.description:
KPA has spent over four decades earning a reputation as the company automotive businesses trust with compliance. More than 15,000 of them count on us to protect their people, their customers, and their operations across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Sales, Advertising, Privacy, and HR.
Underneath it is one conviction: that documented is not the same as safe. A binder of current paperwork has never prevented an injury, so we built the company to close that gap. Software that's always watching out, training that reaches the newest person on the floor, and 150 consultants who keep finding what actually goes wrong. We think that work is worth doing somewhere people want to be, and Built In Colorado has named KPA one of the state's Best Places to Work seven years running.

Why This Role Exists
That kind of trust is a rare foundation for a marketing team, and it is the raw material for one of the best demand engines in B2B. Dealer groups are consolidating, and buyers increasingly start their research inside AI answer engines rather than a list of search results. Both shifts favor the company that builds for them first.
This role builds that engine: automation that meets buyers where they are, campaigns that run as one program rather than five, measurement clear enough that every dollar has an answer, and AI woven throughout it so a small team moves like a much larger one. You'd own it end to end, the automation, the campaigns, the data, and the pipeline outcomes, on top of a story nobody else in our industry can tell.
This is a builder's job at a company worth building for: if you'd rather design the whole engine than tune someone else's single channel, this is it.
The Role
The Manager, Demand Generation drives the execution and performance of KPA's demand programs across all paid, owned, and automated channels, and is a critical partner in improving the systems and measurement that underlie them. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with budget decision-making authority and a direct line to pipeline.
You'll spend your weeks in HubSpot, ZoomInfo, GA4, Salesforce, in the ad platforms and analytics, and in the space between marketing and revenue operations where demand engines drive results. You'll also use AI the way a team twice this size would use headcount, to research, produce, test, and operate, and to build workflows the rest of marketing can use too.
Success is measured in qualified pipeline that Sales agrees is qualified, a funnel everyone can see, and a cost per opportunity that improves quarter over quarter, with a clear decision and data behind each improvement you make.
What You'll Do
Own Omnichannel Demand Execution
Plan, build, launch, and optimize integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, display and retargeting, email, content syndication, trade media, and webinars, with consistent measurement.
Own the digital media budget, recommending where the next dollar goes and moving it when the data changes.
Set strategy and targets for paid search, paid social, and trade publication advertising, including managing agency partners, building creative in-house when needed, and audit agency output against our standard.
Run integrated campaign calendars so brand, content, product marketing, events, and the SDR team are working the same plays in the same weeks.
Ensure seamless Go-to-Market performance and coordination with Sales and Client Success, including supporting continuous lead capture, scoring, routing, and speed-to-lead improvements.
Help coordinate and manage the project calendar, ensuring our team is aligned and operating efficiently.
Support Marketing Automation and Lifecycle Marketing
In partnership with Marketing Operations, execute confidently in HubSpot Marketing Hub end-to-end: lists and segmentation, workflows, lifecycle stages, forms and progressive profiling, landing pages, smart content. 
Design and operate the nurture architecture: acquisition, segmentation, mid-funnel education, sales-assist, recycled leads, dormant reactivation, and post-sale cross-sell.
Collaborate with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations to enhance tech stack and integration integrity, ensuring marketing's numbers and Sales' numbers are the same.
Identify funnel conversion optimization opportunities that enable GTM teams to convert more leads into sales.
Put AI to Work Across the Funnel
Deploy AI workflows that compress the production, deployment, and analytics lifecycle: campaign briefs, ad and email variants, A/B testing, landing pages, audience research, competitive monitoring, and analysis.
Design agentic and automated workflows across the stack so routine operations run without a person in the loop: monitoring, alerting, reporting, campaign QA, and follow-up.
Use AI for creative and audience testing at a volume that manual production cannot reach, then use the results to decide what gets real investment.
Help the Senior Manager, Brand & Communications, keep KPA visible in AEO, GEO, and SEO: structured data, answer-shaped content, source authority, and citation tracking.
Support Measurement, Analytics, and Attribution (in Partnership With Revenue Operations)
Help mature KPA's marketing attribution model (first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch), so every program has a defensible pipeline and revenue number attached to it.
Help Marketing, Sales and Finance align on and report against funnel definitions and stage conversion logic.
Deploy dashboards that leadership actually uses. Illuminate funnel and conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, pipeline and revenue by source, program ROI, and other trends across GA4, HubSpot, and Salesforce.
Run a real A/B and multivariate testing program to continually learn, optimize, and enhance results. 
 
Run Account-Based Programs
In partnership with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations, build and maintain tiered target account lists, focused on the multi-rooftop dealer groups where KPA's growth is concentrated.
Run coordinated one-to-many and one-to-few account plays: account-level advertising, intent-triggered outreach, personalized landing page experiences, and executive programs, sequenced with the SDR and AE motion.
Use intent and technographic signals to prioritize the accounts most likely to move, and report account engagement and progression. Build the expansion motion into the installed base in partnership with Sales and Client Success. 
 
What You Bring
Experience
A minimum of 6 years in B2B digital, growth, or performance marketing, ideally in SaaS or technology, with a track record you can talk about in numbers.
Demonstrated ownership of an end-to-end demand engine, You've built programs, not just managed a channel or a vendor.
Experience in a lean team where you were the person who executed the work.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Marketing automation. Advanced HubSpot Marketing Hub (or Marketo, Pardot, or similar with a demonstrated ability to move fast in HubSpot). Workflows, lifecycle architecture, segmentation, and deliverability.
Omnichannel campaign management. Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Microsoft Ads, paid social, retargeting, content syndication, email, and webinars run as one program rather than five. Your ability to manage our partner agencies like a subject matter expert is crucial.
AI automation. Fluency with modern AI tools for campaign content production, research, analysis, and workflow automation across a marketing stack, plus the judgment to know what still needs a human. 
Analytics. GA4, Salesforce reports and dashboards, HubSpot reporting, and strong spreadsheet fluency. Comfort with attribution methodology and its limits. Familiarity with a BI layer such as Tableau is a strong plus.
Strong Working Knowledge
Marketing operations. Lead lifecycle and funnel definitions, scoring, data hygiene, campaign taxonomy, and CRM administration adjacent to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
Account-based marketing. Account tiering, intent data, account-level targeting, and running marketing and sales as one motion against a named list. Hands-on experience with an ABM or intent platform (ZoomInfo, 6sense, Demandbase, Clay, or similar).
Search. SEO and SEM fundamentals strong enough to help direct an agency and audit its work: technical health, content strategy, keyword and query economics, and the emerging discipline of visibility inside AI answer engines. Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent. 
Nice to Have
Automotive retail, fleet, insurance, EHS, HR, or another regulated B2B category.
Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft), conversation intelligence (Chorus, Gong), and CMS work in HubSpot.
The Intangibles
Owner, not operator of a queue. When something in the funnel needs fixing, you go find it rather than reporting that it needs fixing.
Evidence over instinct. You have opinions, and you hold them loosely. You would rather run the test than win the meeting.
Builder's patience. Some of this job is unglamorous plumbing that pays off two quarters later. You can do that work and still ship something this month.
Plain speech. You can explain marketing concepts to non-marketers and executives without either one glazing over.
Force multiplier. You make the people around you faster with the automation you build, the documentation you leave, and the standard you hold.
Physical Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
This is a primarily sedentary role performed at a workstation, requiring extended periods of computer use and frequent verbal and written communication. Occasional travel is required as described above.
 
Compensation
Annual base salary between $110-130k commensurate with experience
Bonus potential up to 10% annually
 Don’t meet every job requirement? At KPA, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. Studies have shown some people are less likely to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you’re excited about the role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply! You might just be the right candidate for this or other roles.
As a growing company KPA values its employees by supporting them with a full benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, PTO, Paid and Floating Holidays, 401k with Company match and immediate vesting, Company-funded Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Programs, and No-cost Mental Health Benefits.
Please note: we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
KPA is committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, promotion, transfer, and compensation, to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, religious dress/grooming, color, ethnicity, sex (including sex stereotyping), sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, creed, uniform service member status, military or veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, breast-feeding and/or pregnancy-related conditions, age, protected medical condition, leave status, physical or mental disability, genetic characteristics, or any other legally-protected status in accordance with the requirements of all federal, state and local laws. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hr@kpa.io.
Please see our Candidate Privacy Notice here

details.full_description_markdown:
KPA has spent over four decades earning a reputation as the company automotive businesses trust with compliance. More than 15,000 of them count on us to protect their people, their customers, and their operations across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Sales, Advertising, Privacy, and HR.
Underneath it is one conviction: that documented is not the same as safe. A binder of current paperwork has never prevented an injury, so we built the company to close that gap. Software that's always watching out, training that reaches the newest person on the floor, and 150 consultants who keep finding what actually goes wrong. We think that work is worth doing somewhere people want to be, and Built In Colorado has named KPA one of the state's Best Places to Work seven years running.

Why This Role Exists
That kind of trust is a rare foundation for a marketing team, and it is the raw material for one of the best demand engines in B2B. Dealer groups are consolidating, and buyers increasingly start their research inside AI answer engines rather than a list of search results. Both shifts favor the company that builds for them first.
This role builds that engine: automation that meets buyers where they are, campaigns that run as one program rather than five, measurement clear enough that every dollar has an answer, and AI woven throughout it so a small team moves like a much larger one. You'd own it end to end, the automation, the campaigns, the data, and the pipeline outcomes, on top of a story nobody else in our industry can tell.
This is a builder's job at a company worth building for: if you'd rather design the whole engine than tune someone else's single channel, this is it.
The Role
The Manager, Demand Generation drives the execution and performance of KPA's demand programs across all paid, owned, and automated channels, and is a critical partner in improving the systems and measurement that underlie them. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with budget decision-making authority and a direct line to pipeline.
You'll spend your weeks in HubSpot, ZoomInfo, GA4, Salesforce, in the ad platforms and analytics, and in the space between marketing and revenue operations where demand engines drive results. You'll also use AI the way a team twice this size would use headcount, to research, produce, test, and operate, and to build workflows the rest of marketing can use too.
Success is measured in qualified pipeline that Sales agrees is qualified, a funnel everyone can see, and a cost per opportunity that improves quarter over quarter, with a clear decision and data behind each improvement you make.
What You'll Do
Own Omnichannel Demand Execution
Plan, build, launch, and optimize integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, display and retargeting, email, content syndication, trade media, and webinars, with consistent measurement.
Own the digital media budget, recommending where the next dollar goes and moving it when the data changes.
Set strategy and targets for paid search, paid social, and trade publication advertising, including managing agency partners, building creative in-house when needed, and audit agency output against our standard.
Run integrated campaign calendars so brand, content, product marketing, events, and the SDR team are working the same plays in the same weeks.
Ensure seamless Go-to-Market performance and coordination with Sales and Client Success, including supporting continuous lead capture, scoring, routing, and speed-to-lead improvements.
Help coordinate and manage the project calendar, ensuring our team is aligned and operating efficiently.
Support Marketing Automation and Lifecycle Marketing
In partnership with Marketing Operations, execute confidently in HubSpot Marketing Hub end-to-end: lists and segmentation, workflows, lifecycle stages, forms and progressive profiling, landing pages, smart content. 
Design and operate the nurture architecture: acquisition, segmentation, mid-funnel education, sales-assist, recycled leads, dormant reactivation, and post-sale cross-sell.
Collaborate with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations to enhance tech stack and integration integrity, ensuring marketing's numbers and Sales' numbers are the same.
Identify funnel conversion optimization opportunities that enable GTM teams to convert more leads into sales.
Put AI to Work Across the Funnel
Deploy AI workflows that compress the production, deployment, and analytics lifecycle: campaign briefs, ad and email variants, A/B testing, landing pages, audience research, competitive monitoring, and analysis.
Design agentic and automated workflows across the stack so routine operations run without a person in the loop: monitoring, alerting, reporting, campaign QA, and follow-up.
Use AI for creative and audience testing at a volume that manual production cannot reach, then use the results to decide what gets real investment.
Help the Senior Manager, Brand & Communications, keep KPA visible in AEO, GEO, and SEO: structured data, answer-shaped content, source authority, and citation tracking.
Support Measurement, Analytics, and Attribution (in Partnership With Revenue Operations)
Help mature KPA's marketing attribution model (first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch), so every program has a defensible pipeline and revenue number attached to it.
Help Marketing, Sales and Finance align on and report against funnel definitions and stage conversion logic.
Deploy dashboards that leadership actually uses. Illuminate funnel and conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, pipeline and revenue by source, program ROI, and other trends across GA4, HubSpot, and Salesforce.
Run a real A/B and multivariate testing program to continually learn, optimize, and enhance results. 
 
Run Account-Based Programs
In partnership with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations, build and maintain tiered target account lists, focused on the multi-rooftop dealer groups where KPA's growth is concentrated.
Run coordinated one-to-many and one-to-few account plays: account-level advertising, intent-triggered outreach, personalized landing page experiences, and executive programs, sequenced with the SDR and AE motion.
Use intent and technographic signals to prioritize the accounts most likely to move, and report account engagement and progression. Build the expansion motion into the installed base in partnership with Sales and Client Success. 
 
What You Bring
Experience
A minimum of 6 years in B2B digital, growth, or performance marketing, ideally in SaaS or technology, with a track record you can talk about in numbers.
Demonstrated ownership of an end-to-end demand engine, You've built programs, not just managed a channel or a vendor.
Experience in a lean team where you were the person who executed the work.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Marketing automation. Advanced HubSpot Marketing Hub (or Marketo, Pardot, or similar with a demonstrated ability to move fast in HubSpot). Workflows, lifecycle architecture, segmentation, and deliverability.
Omnichannel campaign management. Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Microsoft Ads, paid social, retargeting, content syndication, email, and webinars run as one program rather than five. Your ability to manage our partner agencies like a subject matter expert is crucial.
AI automation. Fluency with modern AI tools for campaign content production, research, analysis, and workflow automation across a marketing stack, plus the judgment to know what still needs a human. 
Analytics. GA4, Salesforce reports and dashboards, HubSpot reporting, and strong spreadsheet fluency. Comfort with attribution methodology and its limits. Familiarity with a BI layer such as Tableau is a strong plus.
Strong Working Knowledge
Marketing operations. Lead lifecycle and funnel definitions, scoring, data hygiene, campaign taxonomy, and CRM administration adjacent to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
Account-based marketing. Account tiering, intent data, account-level targeting, and running marketing and sales as one motion against a named list. Hands-on experience with an ABM or intent platform (ZoomInfo, 6sense, Demandbase, Clay, or similar).
Search. SEO and SEM fundamentals strong enough to help direct an agency and audit its work: technical health, content strategy, keyword and query economics, and the emerging discipline of visibility inside AI answer engines. Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent. 
Nice to Have
Automotive retail, fleet, insurance, EHS, HR, or another regulated B2B category.
Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft), conversation intelligence (Chorus, Gong), and CMS work in HubSpot.

In partnership with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations, build and maintain tiered target account lists, focused on the multi-rooftop dealer groups where KPA's growth is concentrated.
Run coordinated one-to-many and one-to-few account plays: account-level advertising, intent-triggered outreach, personalized landing page experiences, and executive programs, sequenced with the SDR and AE motion.
Use intent and technographic signals to prioritize the accounts most likely to move, and report account engagement and progression. Build the expansion motion into the installed base in partnership with Sales and Client Success. 
 
What You Bring
Experience
A minimum of 6 years in B2B digital, growth, or performance marketing, ideally in SaaS or technology, with a track record you can talk about in numbers.
Demonstrated ownership of an end-to-end demand engine, You've built programs, not just managed a channel or a vendor.
Experience in a lean team where you were the person who executed the work.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Marketing automation. Advanced HubSpot Marketing Hub (or Marketo, Pardot, or similar with a demonstrated ability to move fast in HubSpot). Workflows, lifecycle architecture, segmentation, and deliverability.
Omnichannel campaign management. Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Microsoft Ads, paid social, retargeting, content syndication, email, and webinars run as one program rather than five. Your ability to manage our partner agencies like a subject matter expert is crucial.
AI automation. Fluency with modern AI tools for campaign content production, research, analysis, and workflow automation across a marketing stack, plus the judgment to know what still needs a human. 
Analytics. GA4, Salesforce reports and dashboards, HubSpot reporting, and strong spreadsheet fluency. Comfort with attribution methodology and its limits. Familiarity with a BI layer such as Tableau is a strong plus.
Strong Working Knowledge
Marketing operations. Lead lifecycle and funnel definitions, scoring, data hygiene, campaign taxonomy, and CRM administration adjacent to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
Account-based marketing. Account tiering, intent data, account-level targeting, and running marketing and sales as one motion against a named list. Hands-on experience with an ABM or intent platform (ZoomInfo, 6sense, Demandbase, Clay, or similar).
Search. SEO and SEM fundamentals strong enough to help direct an agency and audit its work: technical health, content strategy, keyword and query economics, and the emerging discipline of visibility inside AI answer engines. Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent. 
Nice to Have
Automotive retail, fleet, insurance, EHS, HR, or another regulated B2B category.
Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft), conversation intelligence (Chorus, Gong), and CMS work in HubSpot.
The Intangibles
Owner, not operator of a queue. When something in the funnel needs fixing, you go find it rather than reporting that it needs fixing.
Evidence over instinct. You have opinions, and you hold them loosely. You would rather run the test than win the meeting.
Builder's patience. Some of this job is unglamorous plumbing that pays off two quarters later. You can do that work and still ship something this month.
Plain speech. You can explain marketing concepts to non-marketers and executives without either one glazing over.
Force multiplier. You make the people around you faster with the automation you build, the documentation you leave, and the standard you hold.
Physical Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
This is a primarily sedentary role performed at a workstation, requiring extended periods of computer use and frequent verbal and written communication. Occasional travel is required as described above.
 
Compensation
Annual base salary between $110-130k commensurate with experience
Bonus potential up to 10% annually
 Don’t meet every job requirement? At KPA, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about the role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply! You might just be the right candidate for this or other roles.
As a growing company KPA values its employees by supporting them with a full benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, PTO, Paid and Floating Holidays, 401k with Company match and immediate vesting, Company-funded Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Programs, and No-cost Mental Health Benefits.

job.title: Sr Product Manager - Growth Marketing Enablement
job.description:
# Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

## The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Consumer Trading is a full-stack team behind the Consumer experience in Kraken mobile and web applications. Our flagship product allows our clients to instantly buy, sell, convert any combination of stocks, cryptocurrencies and cash. We are constantly working on extending the product suite with new features and improvements.

 

## The opportunity

- 

Own the connective tissue between marketing and product at Kraken Consumer — a remit with real scope to shape how millions of people discover and return to our products.

- 

Build something from the ground up: the roadmap, the intake model and the standards for how marketing and product work together are all yours to define.

- 

Sit at the centre of the acquisition funnel, where small improvements in conversion compound into meaningful growth.

- 

Unlock new acquisition channels by building the product surfaces they depend on — paid social, search, affiliates and offline campaigns.

- 

Shape a fast-growing mobile acquisition motion, including in-product social, creator partnerships, community and friend-referral mechanics.

- 

Own both halves of the lifecycle: bringing new users in, and giving existing users compelling reasons to come back.

- 

Work in one of the most competitive corners of consumer fintech, where conversion craft and product quality genuinely decide who wins.

 

 

## What you bring

- 

Own the marketing product roadmap end to end, and build the process that turns campaign ideas into shipped product work.

- 

Design and launch tailored campaign experiences — the in-app and web journeys users land in from push, email, social and paid.

- 

Raise the bar on lifecycle messaging so push and email feel useful rather than noisy, and convert accordingly.

- 

Own the incentives layer for new and returning users: offers, referral mechanics, recurring deposits and earn-led campaigns.

- 

Apply user psychology and sharp UX thinking to find where the funnel leaks, then run the experiments that close the gaps.

- 

Improve landing page and search performance, and build the product foundations that make paid and offline channels measurable and worth the spend.

- 

Partner with marketing, design, engineering and data as the single point of ownership for growth enablement.

- 

Define the acquisition and reactivation metrics that matter, and report on them honestly — including when an experiment doesn't land.

 

 

## 

 

 

 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

# Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

job.title: Marketing Operations Lead
job.description:
The Marketing Operations Lead owns the engine behind our marketing team the tech stack, the processes, the data, and the systems that let every campaign run smoothly and every result get measured. This person keeps HubSpot humming, brings AI tools into everyday workflows, and partners across Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to keep projects moving and reporting sharp.

- Own and optimize the marketing technology stack, with HubSpot as the core platform — administration, workflows, integrations, and data hygiene

- Design and continuously improve marketing processes to increase team efficiency and campaign velocity

- Build and maintain analytics and reporting frameworks that give leadership a clear, accurate view of marketing performance and ROI

- Lead cross-functional projects that span Marketing, Sales, and other departments, keeping timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables aligned

- Identify and implement AI-powered tools and workflows to improve marketing productivity, personalization, and speed to execution

- Manage lead scoring, segmentation, and lifecycle automation within HubSpot

- Serve as the internal expert and go-to resource for MarTech questions, training, and best practices

- Monitor data quality across marketing systems and ensure clean handoffs with sales and CRM data

- 5+ years in marketing operations, demonstrated HubSpot administration/expertise (certifications a plus)

- Proven experience with marketing analytics, reporting, and dashboarding

- Track record leading cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders

- Hands-on experience applying AI tools to marketing workflows (content, personalization, automation, or analysis)

- Strong process-design and documentation skills

- Excellent communication skills — able to translate data and systems into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders

- B2B SaaS or real estate industry experience a plusequirem

job.title: Account Based Marketing Manager
job.description:
Lone Wolf empowers real estate customers to succeed and grow. As we deepen relationships with our highest-value accounts, we're seeking a strategic Account Based Marketing function to turn account insight into targeted, revenue-driving campaigns—and we need a leader to own it.
We're looking for a strategic, self-directed marketer who designs and executes targeted, data-driven campaigns for our highest-value accounts. You'll work in close alignment with sales teams, but you own the strategy.
This means evaluating and prioritizing accounts with sales, determining what success looks like, and building the measurement framework to track it. You'll collaborate closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Marketing Operations, while leading the strategic direction of account-based marketing initiatives.

 

### Account-Based Marketing Strategy

- Partner with Sales to evaluate target accounts and develop account selection criteria.

- Define the strategic rationale for account prioritization and segmentation.

- Determine which accounts represent the greatest opportunity and why.

- Develop go-to-market strategies tailored to target account segments.

- Use account, market, and performance data to continuously refine targeting strategies.

- Deliver account recommendations and insights that help Sales improve account prioritization over time.

### Account-Based Campaign Development & Execution

- Design and execute multi-channel ABM programs, including:

- Email marketing

- Digital advertising

- Direct mail campaigns

- Events and webinars

- Content marketing initiatives

- Create account-specific messaging and campaign strategies.

- Partner with Content, Design, and Marketing Operations teams to bring campaigns to life.

- Ensure campaigns align to revenue goals and account engagement objectives.

### Sales Partnership & Strategic Planning

- Collaborate with Sales teams to understand account priorities and opportunities.

- Evaluate whether ABM is the most effective approach for target accounts.

- Challenge assumptions and validate account strategies using market intelligence and data.

- Provide strategic guidance on account engagement and expansion opportunities.

- Act as a trusted advisor to Sales while maintaining an objective, data-driven perspective.

### Measurement & Performance Strategy

- Define campaign success metrics and measurement frameworks.

- Partner with Marketing Operations to establish reporting for:

- Campaign performance

- Account engagement

- Pipeline influence

- Revenue impact

- Analyze results and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

- Use performance data to optimize future campaign strategy and investment decisions.

### Personalization & Optimization

- Leverage account, customer, and intent data to build personalized experiences.

- Segment audiences to improve campaign relevance and effectiveness.

- Monitor campaign outcomes and identify drivers of success or underperformance.

- Continuously test, learn, and optimize campaign approaches based on performance insights.

### Account Advocacy

- Serve as the voice of target accounts within the marketing organization.

- Share market and account insights with Product Marketing, Sales, and leadership.

- Help influence broader marketing, messaging, and product strategies based on customer needs and feedback.

- 5-7 years of B2B marketing experience.

- Proven experience building, managing, and optimizing:

- Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs

- Field marketing initiatives

- Revenue-focused campaign strategies

- Experience partnering directly with Sales organizations on strategic account planning.

- Demonstrated ability to make data-driven marketing decisions and influence business outcomes.

- Strong strategic thinking and ability to operate independently.

- Experience developing multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to:

- Interpret performance data

- Identify trends and opportunities

- Make strategic recommendations

- Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

### Preferred

- Experience in:

- B2B SaaS organizations

- Real estate technology (PropTech)

- Real estate-related industries

- Experience with:

- HubSpot

- Salesforce

- Marketing automation platforms

- CRM systems

- Familiarity with account intent platforms and ABM technologies.

### Strategic Independence

- Self-directed and highly accountable.

- Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

- Challenges assumptions and validates ideas through data.

- Focuses on business outcomes, not just campaign execution.

### Data-Driven Decision Making

- Understands the difference between engagement metrics and business impact metrics.

- Uses data to guide strategy development and optimization.

- Asks thoughtful questions and translates insights into action.

### Cross-Functional Partnership

- Builds strong relationships across Sales, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Sales Enablement.

- Influences stakeholders without direct authority.

- Balances collaboration with strategic conviction.

### Critical Thinking

- Takes a first-principles approach to problem solving.

- Evaluates strategies based on account needs and business objectives rather than industry "best practices."

- Maintains intellectual curiosity and adaptability in a changing market.

job.title: Product Marketing Manager
job.description:
Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, you will own a segment of the Lone Wolf portfolio from end to end. You will drive positioning, product launches, pricing strategy, and the core content our sales team carries to market. When a broker or agent decides whether your product is worth their investment, your work directly shapes that decision.

•    Keep your product story strictly aligned with the broader Lone Wolf narrative.
•    Translate AI capabilities into practical, undeniable value for real estate professionals.
•    Maintain competitive intelligence for your suite of products and build it directly into your positioning.
•    Serve as the internal subject matter expert for your product line and target buyers.

 

Go to Market & Strategy
•    Lead go to market launches for your products, covering everything from market segmentation through final sales readiness.
•    Execute pilot programs to test positioning and pricing before wider release.
•    Track launch impact strictly against pipeline, adoption, and revenue.
•    Recommend strategic pricing and packaging for your products within the overall portfolio framework.
•    Partner with Demand Generation to build campaigns that drive pipeline and product adoption.

 

Sales & Revenue Enablement
•    Build comprehensive enablement materials that empower reps to sell and demo your products with absolute confidence.
•    Deliver high impact product training and webinars to internal teams and customer audiences.
•    Equip the sales team with targeted battle cards, objection handling guides, and competitive positioning strategies.
•    Collaborate with Customer Success to build resources that drive account expansion and retention.
•    Partner closely with Demo Engineering to ensure technical demonstrations perfectly match your messaging.

 

Market Intelligence & Content
•    Conduct direct customer interviews and run detailed win and loss analysis on your products.
•    Analyze market trends and product usage data to inform future roadmap priorities.
•    Own the vital content that carries your products to market, including one pagers, pitch decks, web copy, and case studies.
•    Direct content partners and hold their output to an exceptionally high standard.
•    Partner with product management to translate the technical roadmap into compelling market language.

- 4 to 7 years of product marketing experience fully owning a product or product line

- .Working knowledge of residential real estate, proptech, or adjacent industries.

- Proven success building positioning and messaging that the sales team actually uses in the field

- .Track record of leading successful launches through cross-functional influence and alignment.

- Demonstrated ability to use data and metrics to track performance and influence business decisions.

- Daily proficiency using AI tools to accelerate research and content creation.Exceptional and highly direct writing skills.

- Ability to move fast and deliver results with limited direction.

Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, you will own a segment of the Lone Wolf portfolio from end to end. You will drive positioning, product launches, pricing strategy, and the core content our sales team carries to market. When a broker or agent decides whether your product is worth their investment, your work directly shapes that decision.

•    Keep your product story strictly aligned with the broader Lone Wolf narrative.
•    Translate AI capabilities into practical, undeniable value for real estate professionals.
•    Maintain competitive intelligence for your suite of products and build it directly into your positioning.
•    Serve as the internal subject matter expert for your product line and target buyers.

 

Go to Market & Strategy
•    Lead go to market launches for your products, covering everything from market segmentation through final sales readiness.
•    Execute pilot programs to test positioning and pricing before wider release.
•    Track launch impact strictly against pipeline, adoption, and revenue.
•    Recommend strategic pricing and packaging for your products within the overall portfolio framework.
•    Partner with Demand Generation to build campaigns that drive pipeline and product adoption.

 

Sales & Revenue Enablement
•    Build comprehensive enablement materials that empower reps to sell and demo your products with absolute confidence.
•    Deliver high impact product training and webinars to internal teams and customer audiences.

•    Collaborate with Customer Success to build resources that drive account expansion and retention.

job.title: Media Buyer — Meta Lead Gen & Creative Strategy
job.description:
# Paid Social Media Buyer — Meta Lead Gen & Creative Strategy

Remote · Contractor · Long-term opportunity

## Read this before applying.

NEW ERA Digital Marketing helps painting contractors across the U.S. and Canada grow through paid advertising.

We do not work with every industry.

We work with painting companies.

That means our campaigns need to do more than generate cheap leads.

They need to generate real homeowner interest, booked estimates, and results our clients can feel in their business.

That is why we are hiring a Paid Social Media Buyer — Meta Lead Gen & Creative Strategy.

This role is for someone who can help manage Facebook and Instagram lead-generation campaigns, improve campaign performance, think through creative angles, protect lead quality, and communicate clearly with the team.

This is not just a “boost posts and check CPL” role.

You need to understand campaign setup, lead forms, creative testing, optimization, reporting, and what happens after a lead comes in.

## The Mission

Help NEW ERA deliver better campaign results for painting contractors.

That means:

- 

Leads are being generated.

- 

Lead quality is being watched.

- 

Campaigns are being reviewed consistently.

- 

Creative angles are being tested.

- 

Client feedback is being used.

- 

Changes are being documented.

- 

Updates are clear.

Issues are escalated before they become bigger problems.

Your job is to help make the paid ads side of the business cleaner, sharper, and more reliable.

## What You Will Own

You will help with:

- 

Creating, launching, and managing Meta ad campaigns

- 

Setting up Facebook lead forms

- 

Reviewing campaign performance

- 

Optimizing ads based on data, lead quality, and client feedback

- 

Testing new ad creatives, hooks, angles, and copy

- 

Reviewing CTR, link CTR, CPM, CPL, booked appointments, and lead quality

- 

Helping identify why campaigns are underperforming

- 

Documenting campaign changes and test results

- 

Sending or preparing weekly/biweekly Loom updates

- 

Communicating campaign issues, ideas, and next actions clearly

- 

Working with the creative team to request or improve ad assets

- 

Helping maintain campaign logs, reports, and optimization notes

The internal role package for this position already includes campaign setup, lead-form QA, routing/tracking checks, launch QA, optimization cadence, lead-quality troubleshooting, creative angle iteration, AI-assisted creative workflow, campaign logs, Loom updates, and escalation expectations.

## What Good Media Buying Looks Like Here

Good media buying at NEW ERA is not just low CPL.

A campaign with cheap leads but poor booked appointments is not a win.

A campaign with higher CPL but better estimate quality may be more valuable.

You need to think beyond surface-level metrics.

We care about:

- 

ROAS

- 

CPA

- 

Cost per booked estimate

- 

ABR %

- 

CPL

- 

Lead quality

- 

No-shows

- 

Spam or bad-fit leads

- 

Client feedback

- 

Creative fatigue

- 

Downstream business results where available

Your job is to help us understand what is actually happening, not just what the ad dashboard says.

## What Success Looks Like

### First 30 Days

You understand our clients, offer, campaign structure, SOPs, and quality standards.

You can review accounts, identify obvious issues, help with campaign QA, and document what you’re seeing.

You complete supervised campaign setup or optimization work.

You send a practice Loom or written update for review.

### First 60 Days

You can help manage 2–4 accounts with review.

You understand our optimization cadence.

You can identify lead-quality issues, recommend form/copy/creative changes, and document your work clearly.

You are no longer waiting to be told every small next step.

### First 90 Days

If you are performing well, you can help manage 4–6 accounts more independently.

You are reviewing campaigns consistently, documenting changes, communicating clearly, and escalating issues when needed.

The manager can trust you with routine campaign work.

Your ramp model matches the People Ops plan: Month 1 is supervised setup and QA, Month 2 is 2–4 accounts with review, and Month 3 is 4–6 accounts independently if the hire is mid-level.

## Optimization Cadence

You should be comfortable reviewing campaigns on a schedule.

Our general cadence:

- 

Testing accounts: review every 2–4 days

- 

Stable/optimized accounts: review every 3–5 days

- 

Urgent lead quality, tracking, or routing issues: escalate immediately

This does not mean changing campaigns randomly.

It means reviewing the right data, making smart decisions, and documenting what changed.

## Tools You May Work With

You do not need to be an expert in every tool, but you should be comfortable learning and working inside tools like:

- 

Meta Ads Manager

- 

Meta Business Suite

- 

Facebook Lead Forms

- 

ClickUp

- 

Google Sheets

- 

Loom

- 

Canva

- 

CapCut or basic editing tools

- 

GoHighLevel or other client CRMs

- 

Zapier or lead routing tools

- 

ChatGPT / Claude for creative research, hooks, ideas, and draft support

Our existing Media Buyer SOP also references Ads Manager review, performance tracking, A/B tests, client feedback, weekly/biweekly updates, and end-of-day feedback as part of the working rhythm.

## Who We Want

You are a strong fit if:

- 

You have experience running Meta/Facebook lead-generation campaigns.

- 

You understand Facebook lead forms and how form quality affects lead quality.

- 

You can explain what you check when a campaign is underperforming.

- 

You know that low CPL is not always the final answer.

- 

You can think through booked appointments, lead quality, client feedback, and creative fatigue.

- 

You can create or suggest new concepts, hooks, angles, offers, and ad copy ideas.

- 

You can work with creative assets and give useful feedback.

- 

You can document changes clearly.

- 

You can send clear Loom or written updates.

- 

You are organized and consistent.

- 

You can take feedback without ego.

- 

You want long-term work with a focused agency.

## Who We Do Not Want

This is probably not the right role if:

- 

You only care about getting the cheapest CPL.

- 

You cannot explain how you launch or QA a campaign.

- 

You do not understand lead quality.

- 

You ignore client feedback.

- 

You make campaign changes without documenting them.

- 

You need constant hand-holding.

- 

You are only looking for a basic VA/admin role.

- 

You do not like reporting, documentation, or accountability.

- 

You cannot communicate clearly in writing or Loom.

- 

You say you are a “media buyer” but cannot explain the last campaign you actually managed.

## Bonus Experience

Bonus points if you have experience with:

- 

Painting contractors

- 

Home improvement businesses

- 

Local service businesses

- 

Appointment-based lead generation

- 

Facebook lead forms

- 

GoHighLevel / CRM workflows

- 

Zapier / lead routing

- 

Client Loom updates

- 

Static/photo ad creatives

- 

Short-form ad creative strategy

- 

AI-assisted creative research

- 

Agentic OS/assisted systems

## What We Offer

- 

Long-term remote contractor opportunity

- 

Work inside a niche-focused agency

- 

Clear SOPs, training, and expectations

- 

Consistent feedback

- 

Opportunity to grow into more account ownership over time

- 

A team that cares about results, not just activity

- 

Exposure to campaign strategy, creative strategy, reporting, and client delivery

We are not looking for someone to “just run ads.”

We are looking for someone who wants to become a reliable part of our media buying and client delivery system.

## Hiring Process

- 

Application Review

- 

Culture Survey Index Survey

- 

Tool / Experience Screen

- 

Media Buying Work Sample

- 

Technical Media Buying Interview

- 

Practical Campaign Scenario

- 

Final Founder Interview

- 

Reference Check

- 

Offer

We use work samples because we care about how you think.

Polished resumes are not enough.

## The Application

At the top of your application, write:

PAINT

Then include:

- 

Your Meta/Facebook ads experience.

- 

Examples of campaigns you have managed, if available.

- 

Industries or niches you have worked with.

- 

Monthly ad spend or number of accounts managed.

- 

Your experience with lead forms, routing, tracking, or CRMs.

- 

How you diagnose low-quality leads.

- 

How you come up with creative angles or ad tests.

- 

Tools you have used.

- 

Your expected monthly compensation in USD.

- 

Your availability and time zone.

Generic applications will not pass.

If you have campaign examples, screenshots, Looms, reports, or case studies, include them.

## Compensation

Remote contractor role to start.

Compensation depends on experience, country, availability, communication ability, Meta ads experience, creative strategy ability, and how independently you can manage campaign work.

We are open to training the right person, but this is not a pure beginner role.

If you already have strong Meta lead-gen experience, there is room to grow into more account ownership.

## Final Note

If you are the right person for this role, show us how you think.

Do not just say you know Facebook ads.

Show us what you have managed.

Show us how you diagnose problems.

Show us how you improve results.

Show us that you understand media buying is about more than cheap leads.

job.title: Senior Product Manager, Sales, Marketing & Business Solutions
job.description:
Position Summary

The Sales, Marketing  & Business Solutions product team owns the product stack that Natera's Sales and Marketing organizations rely on daily. That includes the tools for generating demand, managing accounts and pipeline, and running campaigns. Salesforce is the center of this portfolio today, and the scope is growing to include marketing automation and other commercial tools around it.

In this role, you will own the roadmap, KPIs, and strategy, while partnering with engineering for delivery, for these platforms. The portfolio has a lot of requests from commercial stakeholders, and part of the job is helping the business choose what matters most, in what order, and how to demonstrate quantifiable success. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, and commercial stakeholders to turn a long list of initiatives into a clear plan with measurable outcomes. You will also help us decide what to build, what to buy, what to configure, and what to retire.

If you like bringing clarity to a high-visibility platform and seeing the business benefit directly, you will enjoy this role.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and backlog for Sales and Marketing platforms, with Salesforce as the system of record and primary user-facing interaction mode for commercial workflows
  • Partner with Sales & Marketing to turn business needs into clear requirements (PRDs, user stories, user flows) and prioritize them by value, effort, and platform impact
  • Manage the integration points between CRM and marketing automation, including lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, and attribution
  • Lead quarterly and annual planning (intake, prioritization, and governance processes) with technical and cross-functional stakeholders so every initiative is visible, sequenced, and tied to an outcome
  • Work with engineering and architecture on data model, integration, and build vs. buy vs. configure decisions
  • Plan releases and manage dependencies across platforms, making sure changes are tested, communicated, and adopted
  • Define and track KPIs such as adoption, data quality, funnel efficiency, and delivery predictability, and use them to guide investment
  • Evaluate new tools and capabilities, including AI-enabled features, and recommend where to consolidate or retire overlapping systems
  • Communicate status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders, including senior leadership

Qualifications

  • Experience partnering directly with Sales & Marketing stakeholders to turn business goals into product roadmaps, features, and defined impact. 
  • A track record of delivering enterprise Sales or Marketing technology (CRM, sales engagement, CPQ, lead routing, analytics) with quantifiable results. 
  • Hands-on Salesforce product experience (required). You have owned or managed product delivery on the Salesforce platform, for example Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Health Cloud. You are comfortable with objects and data model, flows and automation, security and permissions, sandboxes and release management, and org governance.
  • Experience with marketing automation and campaign platforms such as Eloqua, Marketo, Account Engagement, or HubSpot. Eloqua experience is a plus.
  • Experience working alongside Salesforce engineers, admins, and architects. You can weigh integration approaches (APIs, middleware, data pipelines) and know when configuration is enough and when custom development is worth it.
  • Experience bringing order to a loosely governed portfolio (with support from Tech leadership), including intake, prioritization, roadmap management, and aligning stakeholders with competing demands.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and complexity, and the ability to find practical, scalable answers. You can think strategically and still get into the details when the work needs it.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to make product decisions. 
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, or a related field, plus 5+ years of experience in software development, digital product management, or commercial and CRM systems.

Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Business Analyst)
  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or diagnostics commercial environments
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$140,600—$175,700 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. 

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

For more information:
- BBB announcement on job scams 
- FBI Cyber Crime resource page
