  • Partner with Sales & Marketing to turn business needs into clear requirements (PRDs, user stories, user flows) and prioritize them by value, effort, and platform impact
  • Manage the integration points between CRM and marketing automation, including lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, and attribution
  • Lead quarterly and annual planning (intake, prioritization, and governance processes) with technical and cross-functional stakeholders so every initiative is visible, sequenced, and tied to an outcome
  • Work with engineering and architecture on data model, integration, and build vs. buy vs. configure decisions
  • Plan releases and manage dependencies across platforms, making sure changes are tested, communicated, and adopted
  • Define and track KPIs such as adoption, data quality, funnel efficiency, and delivery predictability, and use them to guide investment
  • Evaluate new tools and capabilities, including AI-enabled features, and recommend where to consolidate or retire overlapping systems
  • Communicate status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders, including senior leadership

Qualifications

  • Experience partnering directly with Sales & Marketing stakeholders to turn business goals into product roadmaps, features, and defined impact. 
  • A track record of delivering enterprise Sales or Marketing technology (CRM, sales engagement, CPQ, lead routing, analytics) with quantifiable results. 
  • Hands-on Salesforce product experience (required). You have owned or managed product delivery on the Salesforce platform, for example Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Health Cloud. You are comfortable with objects and data model, flows and automation, security and permissions, sandboxes and release management, and org governance.
  • Experience with marketing automation and campaign platforms such as Eloqua, Marketo, Account Engagement, or HubSpot. Eloqua experience is a plus.
  • Experience working alongside Salesforce engineers, admins, and architects. You can weigh integration approaches (APIs, middleware, data pipelines) and know when configuration is enough and when custom development is worth it.
  • Experience bringing order to a loosely governed portfolio (with support from Tech leadership), including intake, prioritization, roadmap management, and aligning stakeholders with competing demands.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and complexity, and the ability to find practical, scalable answers. You can think strategically and still get into the details when the work needs it.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to make product decisions. 
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, or a related field, plus 5+ years of experience in software development, digital product management, or commercial and CRM systems.

Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Business Analyst)
  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or diagnostics commercial environments
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$140,600—$175,700 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

This role manages end-to-end campaign production, including audience segmentation, email building, rigorous QA, and performance analysis. The ideal candidate is detail oriented who excels at cross-functional collaboration and timely execution.

  • Campaign Execution: Plan and manage the deployment of diverse email campaigns, including newsletters, GTM initiatives, and lifecycle/triggered automations.

  • Experience: 2+ years in email marketing.

  • Knowledge: Deep understanding of deliverability, segmentation, and dynamic content.

job.title: Head of Client Services / digital marketing agency
job.description:
# Head of Client Services\ digital marketing agency

## 
About the Company

Our client is a fully integrated performance marketing agency combining SEO, Paid Media, Creative, Brand Strategy, Web Development, CRO, and Data Analytics under one roof.

The agency partners with small and mid-sized businesses across multiple industries, helping clients grow through long-term digital marketing strategies and measurable business outcomes.

As the company continues to scale, they are building a dedicated Client Services function and are looking for an experienced leader to shape it from the ground up.

## 
About the Role

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role responsible for building and leading the agency's Client Services function.

Rather than inheriting a mature department, you will establish the processes, standards, and operating model that will define how the company manages and grows long-term client relationships.

You'll work closely with the CEO and cross-functional teams to improve client retention, identify growth opportunities, and create a scalable client experience.

## 
Key Responsibilities

- 

Build and improve the overall Client Services function.

- 

Develop scalable account management processes and best practices.

- 

Establish service standards, client communication frameworks, and operational workflows.

- 

Lead, mentor, and support the Account Management team.

- 

Own client retention and long-term relationship management.

- 

Identify opportunities for account expansion and additional services.

- 

Partner closely with Sales to ensure smooth client onboarding and long-term success.

- 

Collaborate with SEO, Paid Media, Creative, Web Development, Analytics, and Strategy teams to deliver outstanding client outcomes.

- 

Monitor account health, client satisfaction, retention metrics, and commercial performance.

- 

Help create a client-centric culture across the organization.

## Team Structure

The company currently has several Account Managers supporting existing clients.

This role introduces dedicated leadership for the Client Services function and will focus on building structure, consistency, and operational excellence as the business continues to grow.

The position reports directly to the CEO.

## 
Success in the Role

During the first months, you will be expected to:

- 

Build clear client service processes and operating standards.

- 

Improve consistency across account management.

- 

Maintain excellent client retention.

- 

Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships.

- 

Create a scalable framework that supports future growth.

## Experience

- 

Proven leadership experience within a digital marketing agency.

- 

Strong background in Client Services, Account Management, or Customer Success leadership.

- 

Experience managing teams responsible for agency clients.

- 

Demonstrated success in improving client retention and long-term relationships.

- 

Experience developing or optimizing client service processes.

- 

Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify account growth opportunities.

- 

Experience working with cross-functional delivery teams.

- 

Strong understanding of digital marketing services, particularly SEO and Paid Media.

- 

Experience serving small and mid-sized business clients.

## Skills & Competencies

- 

Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution.

- 

Excellent relationship management skills.

- 

Outstanding communication and stakeholder management.

- 

Strong organizational and operational leadership.

- 

Data-driven decision-making.

- 

Ability to improve and standardize processes.

- 

High level of ownership and accountability.

- 

Collaborative leadership style.

- 

Commercial awareness with a focus on long-term client value.

- 

Comfortable working in a fast-growing entrepreneurial environment.

## Nice to Have

- 

Experience building a Client Services department from an early stage.

- 

Experience implementing client success frameworks, playbooks, or service standards.

- 

Experience with agency operational metrics and reporting.

- 

Familiarity with CRM and client management platforms.

- 

Experience working across multiple digital marketing disciplines.

- 

Previous exposure to healthcare, legal, home services, retail, or e-commerce clients.

## 
What We Offer

- 

Highly competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

- 

Corporate medical and dental benefits.

- 

Opportunity to build and shape a core business function.

- 

Direct collaboration with the CEO and senior leadership.

- 

A collaborative environment with specialists across SEO, Paid Media, Creative, Brand Strategy, Web Development, CRO, and Analytics.

- 

Clear opportunity to influence company growth and client experience at scale.

## 
Interview Process

- 

Initial interview with the hiring manager.

- 

Interview with the CEO.

- 

Preparation of a 90-day Client Services plan.

- 

Final panel presentation with senior leadership and an investor.

job.title: Demand Generation Lead
job.description:
About Origin

Origin is building the endpoint AI observability platform for AI-adopting organizations. We believe that organizations should not adopt AI on their endpoints without observability in place, and we want to be the platform that maximizes the productivity & safety of that adoption.

The company exists to maximize the diffusion of intelligence inside an organization, maximize the productivity of agentic systems and the humans driving them, keep agent actions traceable end-to-end so that when a user asks for something in a prompt they can verify the agent actually did what was expected, and give organizations one interface to answer the hardest questions they have about how work gets done.

Our platform monitors and protects some of the most important organizations in the world. We are backed by Sequoia Capital, Brightmind Ventures, IA Ventures and other top firms.

Role

Origin is seeking a Demand Generation Lead to build and execute programs that turn awareness into qualified pipeline and sustainable growth. This is a hands-on, strategic individual contributor role for someone who can both do the work and determine what excellence looks like.

You’ll own demand generation across paid search, LinkedIn, Reddit, and emerging channels, developing campaign strategy, launching and optimizing programs, analyzing performance, and identifying new opportunities to reach and engage our ideal customers.

AI is central to how this role operates. You’ll use AI to improve campaign execution, automate repetitive work, and build systems that make demand generation more efficient and scalable, freeing the team to focus on strategy and growth.

You’ll also explore opportunities across media, podcasts, content, and partnerships, bringing a strong understanding of our ideal customers and the cybersecurity market to create relevant, differentiated, and measurable campaigns.

This role offers meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work autonomously within a team, bring a clear point of view, and help shape the demand generation function as Origin grows.

Responsibilities

- 

Develop and execute multi-channel demand generation strategies across paid search, LinkedIn, Reddit and emerging channels to drive qualified pipeline and growth

- 

Own campaigns end-to-end, from strategy and creative development through launch, testing, optimization and performance reporting

- 

Identify and test new opportunities across media, podcasts, content, partnerships and emerging channels to uncover scalable growth opportunities

- 

Analyze campaign performance and customer insights to improve acquisition efficiency and inform future strategy

- 

Partner with Sales, Product and Marketing to align demand programs with our ICP, buyer journey, messaging and go-to-market priorities

- 

Use AI to improve campaign development and execution, automate repeatable processes, and build scalable systems that make demand generation more efficient

Skills and Experience

- 

3+ years of experience in demand generation, performance marketing, growth marketing, or a related discipline

- 

Hands-on experience with paid acquisition, particularly Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, with a strong understanding of campaign optimization and measurement

- 

Strong strategic and analytical judgment with the ability to connect marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes

- 

Experience with marketing automation, CRM and marketing technology platforms such as HubSpot and Clay

- 

Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve the quality, speed and scalability of marketing work

- 

Highly autonomous, curious and comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving environment with a strong experimentation mindset

Nice to Haves

- 

Experience in cybersecurity or information security, ideally in B2B SaaS

- 

Experience marketing technical products to B2B audiences

- 

Experience with Reddit Ads, Webflow, CRO, SEO, or GEO

- 

Experience with Clay, AI-powered marketing workflows, or automation

- 

Experience with media, podcasts, partnerships or other emerging demand generation channels

Working at Origin

Origin is a fully remote team across the US & Canada, built on trust, autonomy, and excellence. We empower our team to take ownership, move with purpose, and continuously improve. Our culture values top performers who align with our mission and embrace high standards. We offer generous healthcare, flexible PTO, and home-office support, ensuring our team has the freedom and resources to thrive. While we move fast, we prioritize quality and collaboration, and we remain committed to building impactful security solutions with precision.

job.title: Marketing Communications Lead
job.description:
Who We Are

At Pave, we're building the industry’s leading compensation platform, combining the world's largest real-time compensation dataset with deep expertise in AI and machine learning. Our platform is perfecting the art and science of pay to give 9,000+ companies unparalleled confidence in every compensation decision.

Top tier companies like OpenAI, McDonald’s, Instacart, Atlassian, Affirm, Ericsson, Synopsys, Stripe, Doordash, Fanatics, Databricks, and Waymo use Pave, transforming every pay decision into a competitive advantage. $190+ billion in total compensation spend is managed in our workflows, and 80% of Forbes AI 50 use Pave to benchmark compensation.

The future of pay is real-time & predictive, and we’re making it happen right now. We’ve raised $175M in funding from leading investors like Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Insight Partners, Atomico, Venture Partners, and Craft Ventures.

The Marketing Team @ Pave

Marketing at Pave builds the brand energy and demand that fuel the business. We take our real-time compensation data and turn it into campaigns, stories, and market-moving moments that earn attention, create pipeline, and make Pave the first name people think of in compensation.

We work shoulder to shoulder across the business, but primarily with revenue and product teams, to ensure we are supporting what’s built and what’s sold.  We sharpen positioning, launch products with impact, and give sellers content that opens doors and helps close deals. We're accountable for results: qualified leads, revenue influence, and a brand people seek out.

We move fast, test boldly, and let the data tell us what's working so we can double down. We celebrate every win together, and we believe great marketing should be as fun to make as it is to read.

What You'll Do

  • Leadership: You will be a critical member of the marketing team and a strong, trusted voice across the business. You will have a track record of influencing and activating work streams within marketing and beyond
  • Marketing communications: You will own Pave's external communications strategy and operating rhythm across our critical channels. You will be the point of contact for reactive communications, moving quickly on market moments while managing reputational risk. You will also prepare executives for media and speaking opportunities
  • Brand marketing: You will work with internal and external creative teams to make our brand world-class, unique, differentiated, and beloved. You will establish Pave as a known, trusted, and loved brand among all our stakeholders, including our internal teams, customers, prospects, and partners. You will ensure a consistent voice, a steady cadence, and measurable impact
  • Public relations: You will hire and engage the right PR resources to grow our earned media position. You will use the valuable data we have to activate stories that directly or indirectly strengthen Pave's position in the marketplace. You will track our reach and take steps to grow it. You will also mobilize internal resources to support these narratives
  • Thought leadership: Pave has access to critical data on one of the most important topics in the world: compensation. You will think creatively about how we shape our own points of view and bring them to market through internal, external, analyst, and media partners
  • Website: You will own the marketing website, including its roadmap and evolution. You will monitor its performance and take the steps needed to ensure it serves our customers and prospects
  • Customer stories: Shining a light on how customers get their jobs done with Pave is a critical part of our GTM. You will find and tell the stories that set Pave apart, from customer impact to product innovation to our point of view on the future of compensation. You will partner with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing to turn them into stronger narratives
  • Development: You will lead and develop members of the marketing team. You will determine the right mix of in-house talent, agencies, and freelancers to scale high-quality output. Your thoughtful approach will help activate the talents and growth of everyone on the team
  • Measurement: You will define and track communications metrics, including share of voice and brand awareness. You will report on results and ROI to marketing leadership, and you will manage agency partnerships and the communications budget.
  • Budget management: You will own and manage a budget so that we are responsible with our spend and successful at creating impact

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years overall experience in Marketing, Demand Growth and or within a similar field
  • Proven experience in marketing communications, PR, or brand marketing, ideally at a B2B technology company, with a track record of owning external communications end to end. Please review the section titled “What you’ll bring” to understand the type of person who we are looking for 
  • Experience leading and developing a team, and managing agencies and freelancers across multiple projects at once
  • Strong storytelling and messaging skills, with experience developing content and thought leadership across the buyer journey and overseeing content development and approval processes
  • Experience with media relations, executive communications, and reputation or crisis communications
  • Fluency in marketing channel metrics and quantitative and qualitative research, with the ability to translate communications results into business value
  • Excellent project management, written and verbal communication, resourcefulness, and problem-solving skills, with a bias for action and accountability
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field preferred
  • Some of the intangibles that we’ll be looking for include a strong curiosity, a bias for action, an ability to solve problems, and a passion for working with the entire Pave team

Compensation, It's What We Do.

At Pave, we believe compensation should be as thoughtful as the people we hire. This role is structured as a B2B contract engagement — and your total rewards package includes meaningful equity, flexible PTO, and region-specific benefits designed around your life, not just your role. Your level and compensation are determined by your experience and how you show up throughout the interview process. We're always happy to walk you through how we think about leveling — just ask.

Targeted cash compensation for this role: 
$160,000-$170,000 Base + Equity

Benefits @ Pave

At Pave, growth isn't a perk — it's the point. As you develop, your role expands, your responsibilities deepen, and your compensation reflects the impact you're making.

What we offer

  • Your Health, Fully Covered: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with a range of options designed to meet you where you are.
  • Time That's Actually Yours: Flexible PTO and the freedom to work from anywhere in the world for up to a month — because life doesn't pause, and neither should you.
  • Fuel for the Work: Lunch and dinner stipends plus fully stocked kitchens, so you can stay energized without thinking twice about it.
  • Room to Keep Growing: A quarterly education stipend to invest in the skills and knowledge that matter most to you.
  • Support When It Matters Most: Robust parental leave so you can be fully present for the moments that count.
  • Getting Here, Made Easier: A commuter stipend to support the in-person collaboration that makes great work happen.

Life @ Pave 

Founded in 2019 with a clear purpose and a team that has never wavered from it, Pave has grown into a global force in compensation management — giving thousands of companies the tools to take control, build confidence, and earn credibility in every pay decision they make. And we're just getting started. Headquartered in San Francisco's Financial District, with regional hubs in New York City's Flatiron District, Salt Lake City, Kraków (Poland), and the United Kingdom — wherever you're based, you'll find the same thing: people who genuinely care about the work, each other, and the customers that rely on Pave.

We run a hybrid culture that brings teams together in person 4 days a week — and every Friday, the whole company gathers for our Team Sync: breakfast, new hire welcomes, product updates, fireside chats, and yes, the occasional Kahoot. It's one of the things people notice when they join us — that we truly enjoy spending time together.

Our culture is shaped by five values we live every day:

  • Be Intellectually Honest — Truth over comfort. We face reality clearly and speak directly, even when it's hard.
  • Play to Win — We're not here to participate. We're here to be the #1 compensation platform in the world, and we act like it.
  • Uphold the Pave Platinum Standard — We hold ourselves to the highest bar — for our customers, our data, and each other.
  • One Team — We win and lose together. Titles don't drive decisions here — shared goals do.
  • Hug of Jawn — Hard to define, impossible to miss. Ask your recruiter.

Our Vision: Unlock a labor market built on trust.

Our Mission: Build confidence in every compensation decision.

We build software that transforms how companies pay their people — and we believe the team behind that software deserves the same thoughtfulness. If you're ready to help shape the future of compensation alongside people who are smart, humble, and genuinely motivated by the problem we're solving, we'd love to meet you. 

Still deliberating? Just apply! We're always excited to meet people who are eager to contribute.

details.full_description_markdown:
Who We Are

At Pave, we're building the industry’s leading compensation platform, combining the world's largest real-time compensation dataset with deep expertise in AI and machine learning. Our platform is perfecting the art and science of pay to give 9,000+ companies unparalleled confidence in every compensation decision.

Top tier companies like OpenAI, McDonald’s, Instacart, Atlassian, Affirm, Ericsson, Synopsys, Stripe, Doordash, Fanatics, Databricks, and Waymo use Pave, transforming every pay decision into a competitive advantage. $190+ billion in total compensation spend is managed in our workflows, and 80% of Forbes AI 50 use Pave to benchmark compensation.

The future of pay is real-time & predictive, and we’re making it happen right now. We’ve raised $175M in funding from leading investors like Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Insight Partners, Atomico, Venture Partners, and Craft Ventures.

The Marketing Team @ Pave

Marketing at Pave builds the brand energy and demand that fuel the business. We take our real-time compensation data and turn it into campaigns, stories, and market-moving moments that earn attention, create pipeline, and make Pave the first name people think of in compensation.

We work shoulder to shoulder across the business, but primarily with revenue and product teams, to ensure we are supporting what’s built and what’s sold.  We sharpen positioning, launch products with impact, and give sellers content that opens doors and helps close deals. We're accountable for results: qualified leads, revenue influence, and a brand people seek out.

We move fast, test boldly, and let the data tell us what's working so we can double down. We celebrate every win together, and we believe great marketing should be as fun to make as it is to read.

What You'll Do

  • Leadership: You will be a critical member of the marketing team and a strong, trusted voice across the business. You will have a track record of influencing and activating work streams within marketing and beyond
  • Marketing communications: You will own Pave's external communications strategy and operating rhythm across our critical channels. You will be the point of contact for reactive communications, moving quickly on market moments while managing reputational risk. You will also prepare executives for media and speaking opportunities
  • Brand marketing: You will work with internal and external creative teams to make our brand world-class, unique, differentiated, and beloved. You will establish Pave as a known, trusted, and loved brand among all our stakeholders, including our internal teams, customers, prospects, and partners. You will ensure a consistent voice, a steady cadence, and measurable impact
  • Public relations: You will hire and engage the right PR resources to grow our earned media position. You will use the valuable data we have to activate stories that directly or indirectly strengthen Pave's position in the marketplace. You will track our reach and take steps to grow it. You will also mobilize internal resources to support these narratives
  • Thought leadership: Pave has access to critical data on one of the most important topics in the world: compensation. You will think creatively about how we shape our own points of view and bring them to market through internal, external, analyst, and media partners
  • Website: You will own the marketing website, including its roadmap and evolution. You will monitor its performance and take the steps needed to ensure it serves our customers and prospects
  • Customer stories: Shining a light on how customers get their jobs done with Pave is a critical part of our GTM. You will find and tell the stories that set Pave apart, from customer impact to product innovation to our point of view on the future of compensation. You will partner with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing to turn them into stronger narratives
  • Development: You will lead and develop members of the marketing team. You will determine the right mix of in-house talent, agencies, and freelancers to scale high-quality output. Your thoughtful approach will help activate the talents and growth of everyone on the team
  • Measurement: You will define and track communications metrics, including share of voice and brand awareness. You will report on results and ROI to marketing leadership, and you will manage agency partnerships and the communications budget.
  • Budget management: You will own and manage a budget so that we are responsible with our spend and successful at creating impact

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years overall experience in Marketing, Demand Growth and or within a similar field
  • Proven experience in marketing communications, PR, or brand marketing, ideally at a B2B technology company, with a track record of owning external communications end to end. Please review the section titled “What you’ll bring” to understand the type of person who we are looking for 
  • Experience leading and developing a team, and managing agencies and freelancers across multiple projects at once
  • Strong storytelling and messaging skills, with experience developing content and thought leadership across the buyer journey and overseeing content development and approval processes
  • Experience with media relations, executive communications, and reputation or crisis communications
  • Fluency in marketing channel metrics and quantitative and qualitative research, with the ability to translate communications results into business value
  • Excellent project management, written and verbal communication, resourcefulness, and problem-solving skills, with a bias for action and accountability
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field preferred
  • Some of the intangibles that we’ll be looking for include a strong curiosity, a bias for action, an ability to solve problems, and a passion for working with the entire Pave team

Compensation, It's What We Do.

At Pave, we believe compensation should be as thoughtful as the people we hire. This role is structured as a B2B contract engagement — and your total rewards package includes meaningful equity, flexible PTO, and region-specific benefits designed around your life, not just your role. Your level and compensation are determined by your experience and how you show up throughout the interview process. We're always happy to walk you through how we think about leveling — just ask.

Targeted cash compensation for this role: 
$160,000-$170,000 Base + Equity

Benefits @ Pave

At Pave, growth isn't a perk — it's the point. As you develop, your role expands, your responsibilities deepen, and your compensation reflects the impact you're making.

What we offer

  • Your Health, Fully Covered: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with a range of options designed to meet you where you are.
  • Time That's Actually Yours: Flexible PTO and the freedom to work from anywhere in the world for up to a month — because life doesn't pause, and neither should you.
  • Fuel for the Work: Lunch and dinner stipends plus fully stocked kitchens, so you can stay energized without thinking twice about it.
  • Room to Keep Growing: A quarterly education stipend to invest in the skills and knowledge that matter most to you.
  • Support When It Matters Most: Robust parental leave so you can be fully present for the moments that count.
  • Getting Here, Made Easier: A commuter stipend to support the in-person collaboration that makes great work happen.

Life @ Pave 

Founded in 2019 with a clear purpose and a team that has never wavered from it, Pave has grown into a global force in compensation management — giving thousands of companies the tools to take control, build confidence, and earn credibility in every pay decision they make. And we're just getting started. Headquartered in San Francisco's Financial District, with regional hubs in New York City's Flatiron District, Salt Lake City, Kraków (Poland), and the United Kingdom — wherever you're based, you'll find the same thing: people who genuinely care about the work, each other, and the customers that rely on Pave.

We run a hybrid culture that brings teams together in person 4 days a week — and every Friday, the whole company gathers for our Team Sync: breakfast, new hire welcomes, product updates, fireside chats, and yes, the occasional Kahoot. It's one of the things people notice when they join us — that we truly enjoy spending time together.

Our culture is shaped by five values we live every day:

  • Be Intellectually Honest — Truth over comfort. We face reality clearly and speak directly, even when it's hard.
  • Play to Win — We're not here to participate. We're here to be the #1 compensation platform in the world, and we act like it.
  • Uphold the Pave Platinum Standard — We hold ourselves to the highest bar — for our customers, our data, and each other.
  • One Team — We win and lose together. Titles don't drive decisions here — shared goals do.
  • Hug of Jawn — Hard to define, impossible to miss. Ask your recruiter.

Our Vision: Unlock a labor market built on trust.

Our Mission: Build confidence in every compensation decision.

We build software that transforms how companies pay their people — and we believe the team behind that software deserves the same thoughtfulness. If you're ready to help shape the future of compensation alongside people who are smart, humble, and genuinely motivated by the problem we're solving, we'd love to meet you. 

Still deliberating? Just apply! We're always excited to meet people who are eager to contribute.

job.title: Customer & Field Marketing Manager - US Remote
job.description:
What is PerfectServe? 

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:
  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.
At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

The Opportunity 

You own two things that are easy to under-invest in and expensive to ignore: the customers we already have, and the rooms where buyers gather. You run customer and expansion marketing in partnership with Customer Success, and you execute the field and event motion that the segment owners scope. 

You also own the proof. References, case studies, and advocates are how we win deals and how an acquirer values us. That program is yours to build. 

What You’ll Own 

Sales enablement 

  • Build custom sales decks and assets for client engagements, with a focus on enterprise deals. 
  • Run broader enablement: operationalize the master pitch and battlecards PMM owns, onboard reps to the materials, and keep deal assets current. 
  • Be the bridge between marketing’s narrative and what reps actually present in the room. 

Field and event execution 

  • Execute the events the segment owners scope and recommend: booth, on-site meetings, and follow-through. 
  • Own on-site ROI and the pre- and post-event motion with sales and CS. 

References, case studies, and advocacy 

  • Own the reference and advocacy program; recruit advocates and turn outcomes into proof. 
  • Partner with Content to produce and PMM for the outcome data. 

Field enablement 

  • Own field and event enablement materials in partnership with PMM’s core positioning. 

What You Don’t Own  

  • New-logo demand creation — the segment owners. 
  • Which events we attend (the thesis) — segment owners decide; you execute. 
  • Core positioning and battlecards — PMM. 

Key Performance Indicators 

  • Expansion pipeline influenced. Customer and expansion pipeline, with Customer Success. 
  • Net revenue retention contribution. Marketing’s influence on retention and expansion. 
  • Event execution ROI. Pipeline and qualified meetings per event, on budget. 
  • Proof produced. References and case studies created — exit-critical. 
  • Field contribution to acute pipeline. Field-influenced pipeline supporting the ABM motion. 

What We’re Looking For 

  • 4+ years in customer marketing, field marketing, or events in B2B SaaS; healthcare IT preferred. 
  • A program builder who can run events and customer motions at the same time without dropping either. 
  • Comfort partnering closely with Customer Success and Sales. 
  • A reference and advocacy track record. 
  • An AI-first approach to scaling field and customer content. 
  • Ability to travel up to 25% travel 

Nice to Have 

  • Experience building a customer advocacy or reference program from scratch. 
  • Experience supporting diligence with customer proof points. 

Why Join PerfectServe?
At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of $75,000-$85,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team.
The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support.
We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations.

 

Benefits:

  • Remote first work environment
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
  • 401K - with match and immediately vested.
  • 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
  • Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

Position Summary:

Reporting to the Director, Marketing Analytics & Marketing Technology, this role defines the vision, architecture, and governance of the marketing automation platform while enabling scalable, data-driven customer engagement across the buyer lifecycle. - Enterprise Integrations & MarTech Ecosystem: Own and optimize the Marketo/Salesforce integration (synchronization, lifecycle logic, field mappings, data integrity); manage integrations with webinar, event, LeanData, live chat, and CMS platforms; act as primary technical liaison with Adobe Marketo Support.

- Lead Scoring & Lifecycle Management: Own the strategy, governance, and continuous optimization of lead scoring models and lifecycle frameworks in partnership with Sales Operations and Analytics to improve lead quality, conversion, and pipeline performance.

- Technical Leadership, Security Communications & Enablement: Serve as subject matter expert and mentor for the Marketing Operations team; own governance of customer-facing security and service communications with Security, Product, Legal, and Corporate Communications; lead continuous improvement and AI adoption initiatives.

- Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent combination of education, certifications, and experience.

- 8+ years of experience administering and architecting Adobe Marketo Engage within complex B2B enterprise environments.

- Extensive experience designing enterprise marketing automation strategies, lifecycle programs, lead scoring frameworks, and scalable automation solutions.

- Deep expertise integrating Marketo with Salesforce CRM and enterprise marketing technology platforms.

- Demonstrated success establishing platform governance, standards, and operational best practices.

- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, and IT.

- Adobe Marketo Engage Certified Expert certification required or strongly preferred

- Strong analytical mindset, excellent troubleshooting and solution design capabilities, and clear communication skills.

- Salesforce certification considered an asset.

- AI fluency and/or experience leveraging Microsoft 365 Copilot to improve productivity, collaboration, and marketing operations.

- Hands-on experience with LeanData, webinar platforms, and other event technologies beyond core Marketo/Salesforce administration.

- Working knowledge of privacy regulations including CASL and GDPR, and of marketing analytics, attribution, and dashboard development.

job.title: Lead, Growth Marketing
job.description:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

## Why would you love this job?

Redis is the platform developers trust for real-time data—and the platform an increasing share of AI applications are built on. Now, the audience discovering and evaluating Redis is no longer exclusively human. AI agents can identify a need, decide which solution fits, review technical documentation, and create a new account within one continuous session.

The Lead, Growth Marketing owns the Redis digital surface for both agents and humans. This includes the website, SEO, answer engine optimization, generative engine optimization, conversion-rate optimization, and the measurement system that connects discovery to pipeline, account creation, and activation.

Your central challenge is to streamline agent-led growth: making Redis easy for agents to discover, understand, recommend, evaluate, and select while ensuring the same digital experience converts human developers and buyers.

This is a hands-on strategic leadership role for a builder who wants to create a new kind of digital growth system at a high-growth, pre-IPO company. You’ll define the strategy, direct external specialists, contribute to the highest-priority work, measure the outcomes, and continuously improve the system with data.

You should be as comfortable presenting a strategy to executives as you are opening an AI tool and building a working campaign prototype from a blank page in 30 minutes.

## What you’ll do

- 

Own the Redis digital surface. Set the strategy for how agents and humans discover, understand, evaluate, and convert across Redis’s website, documentation pathways, organic presence, and AI surfaces.

- 

Lead agent-driven growth. Build a low-friction journey in which an agent can identify the right Redis solution, review the relevant documentation, and create an account in a single session.

- 

Own SEO, AEO, and GEO. Establish the strategy for search engines, AI answer engines, generative search, assistants, and coding agents so Redis is accurately represented, cited, recommended, and selected.

- 

Own website strategy. Define the platform story, information architecture, page priorities, content pathways, and contextual-conversion model. Partner with web engineering on implementation and feasibility.

- 

Lead CRO and experimentation. Maintain a rigorous testing roadmap across high-intent pages, documentation journeys, sign-up flows, and other critical conversion points.

- 

Build the measurement system. Connect human and agent discovery to meaningful outcomes, including visibility, citations, recommendations, documentation engagement, account creation, conversion, activation, and pipeline.

- 

Turn data into action. Use performance data to improve the strategy, prioritize the roadmap, reallocate resources, and decide what to scale, revise, or stop.

- 

Direct external specialists. Set priorities and scopes of work for contractors and an agency partner, review output, and redirect capacity as business needs change.

- 

Align the digital growth engine. Partner with content, developer relations, product, engineering, paid media, and executive leadership so Redis presents one connected path from discovery to adoption.

## What you’ll need to have

- 

Typically 7+ years in digital growth or GTM marketing, including meaningful experience inside high-growth B2B SaaS, infrastructure, or AI-adjacent companies.

-

job.title: Digital Marketing Specialist - Work From Anywhere
job.description:
Location: Remote (Work from Home)
Schedule: Monday – Friday | 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (PST, CST, EST)
Compensation: $1,250 USD/month for the first 90 days / $1,500 USD/month after that.

### About the Role

This is not a marketing role where you simply schedule posts and wait for results. We’re looking for someone who understands performance, owns the numbers, and knows how to turn marketing activity into measurable growth.

You’ll manage and optimize digital campaigns across paid media, SEO, email, and other channels while tracking performance and identifying opportunities to improve lead generation and conversions.

### What You'll Actually Do

- Manage and optimize Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

- Track CPL, CAC, ROAS, conversions, and campaign budgets.

- Support SEO, email marketing, and lead-generation initiatives.

- Monitor performance through GA4, Search Console, and marketing platforms.

- Run A/B tests across ads, audiences, and landing pages.

- Build performance reports and recommend improvements.

- Coordinate with content, design, and sales teams.

### Expectations

- Take ownership of campaign performance and deadlines.

- Consistently monitor and optimize campaigns based on data.

- Identify underperforming campaigns before they become a problem.

- Maintain accurate reporting across marketing channels.

- Proactively recommend ways to improve leads, conversions, and ROI.

### Requirements

- 3+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience.

- Proven experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Strong understanding of PPC, SEO, email marketing, and analytics.

- Experience with GA4 and marketing reporting tools.

- Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret campaign data.

- Advanced written and spoken English.

- Experience working independently in a remote environment.

### Benefits

- Faster Hiring Process: Clear communication and a streamlined recruitment process.

- Better Role Matching: Opportunities aligned with your experience and strengths.

- Real Upside: Strong performers can unlock raises and long-term opportunities.

- Work With U.S. Operators: Direct exposure to growing U.S.-based businesses.

- Real Ownership: Your work directly impacts marketing performance and business growth.

Proactive Recruiting: We’re actively building our talent network for current and upcoming client opportunities. While this posting may not represent an immediate opening, qualified candidates may be considered as matching roles become available.

Requirements

- Professional home office setup and reliable internet.

- Introductory video submission required as part of the recruitment process.

job.title: Product Marketing Manager, Launches & Core Platform
job.description:
What do we do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern commmerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it hurts your bottom line.


We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the only AI harness in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.


The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

About the role

Triple Whale is looking for a creative product marketer to own our go-to-market launches and support product marketing for our platform team.

You’ll combine a content creator’s instincts with a launch manager’s organization to lead weekly drops and larger monthly launches. Inspired by how consumer brands build anticipation, you’ll create content across formats that gets people to notice, share, and try our products. You’ll bring an AI-first mindset to move quickly from idea to execution.

Our platform team focuses on the technology that makes Triple Whale exceptional, including data, infrastructure, and UI components. You’ll translate that work into clear positioning, messaging, and customer communications that explain what’s changing, why it matters, and how customers benefit.

What you’ll own

Go-to-market launches and weekly drops

  • Own the launch calendar and execution. Coordinate weekly drops and monthly launches with clear timelines, owners, and deliverables. Keep teams aligned on product readiness and messaging while reducing coordination work for other product marketers.
  • Build a recognizable weekly drop program. Develop its creative approach and keep formats fresh. Feature new capabilities, useful improvements, and existing features customers have yet to discover.
  • Shape the story and create the content. Partner with product marketers on the audience, customer benefit, and desired action. Write copy, record demos, and produce videos, carousels, or simple visual assets without requiring a full production cycle.
  • Make social and creators central to launches. Collaborate on product reveals, walkthroughs, and other formats worth sharing. Match the format to the story; weekly drops do not require a blog post.
  • Coordinate the customer experience. Work with Growth, Lifecycle, and other channel owners to align social, email, in-app messages, and supporting launch activity.
  • Measure and improve. Define success for each launch, from reach and engagement to activation and adoption. Use focused debriefs and audience feedback to improve the next drop.

Platform product marketing

  • Lead product marketing for the platform team. Partner with Product on the roadmap, prioritize marketing support, and translate technical or behind-the-scenes improvements into clear customer value.
  • Own positioning and messaging. Explain what changes, who benefits, and why it matters. Develop stories that connect platform capabilities to customer needs.
  • Bring customer and market insights into product decisions. Conduct research, gather feedback from Sales and Customer Success, and assess competing approaches to inform the roadmap and messaging.
  • Support customer understanding and adoption. Partner with Lifecycle and Customer Success on communications and education. Equip customer-facing teams with demos, talk tracks, and FAQs, then track adoption and feedback with Product.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, launch marketing, integrated campaigns, or a related role. We welcome backgrounds in B2B SaaS, consumer software, and D2C or e-commerce brands.
  • Experience taking launches from idea through execution, with a clear understanding of what drove results and what you would improve.
  • Strong creative instincts and confidence creating content yourself across formats, including written copy, short-form video, product demos, and visual storytelling.
  • An AI-first mindset. You actively use AI for research, ideation, content production, and repeatable workflows, while applying your own judgment to accuracy and quality.
  • Product marketing fundamentals, including customer research, positioning, and translating features into benefits. You’re comfortable learning software and demonstrating it through recorded or on-camera content.
  • Strong project management and collaboration skills. You can manage overlapping timelines, resolve blockers, and drive accountability without adding unnecessary process.
  • Good judgment about scope and measurement. You know when a release needs a larger campaign, when a well-made video is enough, and how to distinguish attention from adoption.

Especially relevant experience

  • Building recurring content series, product drops, or creator collaborations that give audiences a reason to return.
  • Marketing to e-commerce operators or working within the tools and communities they use.

What success looks like

Triple Whale has a consistent launch rhythm, with creative weekly drops and well-coordinated monthly launches. Product marketers spend less time chasing deliverables. Customers understand platform changes and how to use them, and launch results inform what we do next.

The expected base salary for this role is $115,000–$125,000 per year. 

Eligible employees receive medical coverage; a 401(k) with a company match of up to 3%; 30 days of paid time off accrued monthly after the first 30 days of employment; five sick days; and nine paid company holidays. Triple Whale also offers paid parental leave for eligible employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Referred?  Got here thanks to a friend? Splash some gratitude their way!  They'll need to submit your application through our referral system to make it official.

job.description:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it bites.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the most actionable AI in commerce — Moby 2 — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby 2 doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

What You're Applying for

Triple Whale is looking for a Context Engineer to help ecommerce brands successfully adopt Moby, our AI teammate for marketing analysis, planning, and execution.

This is a customer-facing activation role for someone with strong performance marketing instincts, practical AI fluency, and the ability to help customers turn Moby into a trusted part of how they work. You will not be the long-term operator inside the customer’s business. Your job is to enable the customer’s own operators - founders, marketers, agencies, and growth teams to use Moby confidently and effectively.

*This is a remote role with a strong preference for candidates based on the West Coast. The person in this role must be able to consistently work Pacific Time (PT) hours.*

What You’ll Do 

  • Lead customer activation for Moby, helping new users identify the first use cases most likely to create value.
  • Translate each customer’s goals, team structure, marketing motion, and growth challenges into practical Moby workflows.
  • Enable customer operators to use Moby in their day-to-day work across paid media, measurement, creative, and growth planning.
  • Coach customers on how to evaluate Moby’s recommendations, ask better questions, and turn AI outputs into decisions.
  • Be prescriptive during onboarding: diagnose opportunities, recommend workflows, and help customers build early trust in Moby.
  • Maintain strategic relationships with customers to help them discover and adopt new Moby use cases over time.
  • Identify repeatable activation patterns and turn them into playbooks the broader team can use.
  • Partner with product, design, and engineering to share customer feedback and improve the Moby experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • Hands-on experience in media buying, growth marketing, ecommerce marketing, or agency strategy.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon, Shopify, Klaviyo, or similar ecommerce/growth tools.
  • Strong understanding of marketing metrics like CAC, ROAS, MER, LTV, AOV, contribution margin, retention, and payback.
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Cursor, Replit, Lovable, n8n, or similar systems.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with founders, marketers, operators, and agencies.
  • The confidence to be prescriptive without taking over: you can recommend what to do while teaching the customer how to operate.
  • Curiosity, speed, and a collaborative attitude in a fast-moving environment.
  • Bonus: 
    • Agency experience or experience managing multiple brands/accounts.
    • Experience scaling DTC or retail brands.
    • Familiarity with attribution, incrementality, MMM, or marketing measurement.
    • Comfort with SQL or BI tools.
    • Experience in customer success, solutions consulting, or performance marketing leadership.

The expected base salary for this role is $120,000–$150,000 per year.

Eligible employees receive medical coverage; a 401(k) with a company match of up to 3%; 30 days of paid time off accrued monthly after the first 30 days of employment; five sick days; and nine paid company holidays. Triple Whale also offers paid parental leave for eligible employees.

Triple Whale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • Enable customer operators to use Moby in their day-to-day work across paid media, measurement, creative, and growth planning.
  • Coach customers on how to evaluate Moby’s recommendations, ask better questions, and turn AI outputs into decisions.
  • Be prescriptive during onboarding: diagnose opportunities, recommend workflows, and help customers build early trust in Moby.
  • Maintain strategic relationships with customers to help them discover and adopt new Moby use cases over time.
  • Identify repeatable activation patterns and turn them into playbooks the broader team can use.
  • Partner with product, design, and engineering to share customer feedback and improve the Moby experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • Hands-on experience in media buying, growth marketing, ecommerce marketing, or agency strategy.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon, Shopify, Klaviyo, or similar ecommerce/growth tools.
  • Strong understanding of marketing metrics like CAC, ROAS, MER, LTV, AOV, contribution margin, retention, and payback.
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Cursor, Replit, Lovable, n8n, or similar systems.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with founders, marketers, operators, and agencies.
  • The confidence to be prescriptive without taking over: you can recommend what to do while teaching the customer how to operate.
  • Curiosity, speed, and a collaborative attitude in a fast-moving environment.
  • Bonus: 
    • Agency experience or experience managing multiple brands/accounts.
    • Experience scaling DTC or retail brands.
    • Familiarity with attribution, incrementality, MMM, or marketing measurement.
    • Comfort with SQL or BI tools.
    • Experience in customer success, solutions consulting, or performance marketing leadership.

The expected base salary for this role is $120,000–$150,000 per year.

Eligible employees receive medical coverage; a 401(k) with a company match of up to 3%; 30 days of paid time off accrued monthly after the first 30 days of employment; five sick days; and nine paid company holidays. Triple Whale also offers paid parental leave for eligible employees.

Triple Whale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Head of Marketing
job.description:
Company Overview:
At Wayvia, we help the world’s top brands stay ahead—using AI, data, and innovation to shape the future of commerce. Whether you’re charting a new path or leveling up your journey, Wayvia is where your career can go further. We’d love to meet you.
 
We help global brands connect with their shoppers in ways that are relevant, respectful, and real. And we do the same for each other—with trust, transparency, and the human connection that makes great work possible.
 
At Wayvia, you’ll find a team that’s curious, collaborative, and always up for solving what’s next. We move fast, think boldly, and support one another in building something that matters—for our clients, for shoppers, and for each other. 

 

Job Brief 

The Head of Marketing will own the marketing function at Wayvia, including demand generation, market positioning, product marketing, brand and communications, agency partnerships and budget management. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and leading a team, this role will be accountable for marketing-sourced pipeline, strategy, programs and execution.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities 

  • Demand Generation and Pipeline — Own the programs that produce marketing-sourced pipeline. 
  • Market and Positioning Strategy — Form and defend a view of how the market is changing — buying behavior, pricing models, category definition — and get the business to act on it, working closely with Sales leadership. 
  • Product Marketing — Own positioning, launch and enablement across the product line, working as a counterpart to Product.
  • Brand, Communications and Agencies — Own the brand, core messaging and all marketing communications, including the agency and PR relationships.
  • Team Leadership — Lead and develop a team across product marketing, growth, brand and marketing operations.
  • AI-Enabled Operating Model — Build marketing as a system, with AI agents doing real work in strategy, campaign execution and iteration.
  • Customer Community — Stand up a marketing-led customer community — user groups and focus groups — that produces product input and references.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 6+ years in a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment. 
  • Demonstrated ownership of demand generation.
  • People management of a multi-function marketing team. 
  • Fluency with AI as an operating capability.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Product marketing depth across launch and enablement. 
  • Commerce intelligence, retail media, martech or adtech experience. 
  • Institutional investor and board-level presentation experience. 
  • A category creation or thought-leadership track record. 
  • MBA or advanced degree. 

Wayvia is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity.

job.title: Organic Growth Manager, SEO & AEO
job.description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

We’re hiring an Associate SEO and AEO Manager to build the foundation of YipitData’s discoverability and organic growth engine.

Buyers increasingly find answers through search engines and AI assistants before they ever talk to a vendor. YipitData sits on a limitless engine of proprietary insight, and this role is about pointing that engine at the market so prospects find us on their own, engage with our content, and raise their hands to talk to us. You’ll own our SEO and AEO strategy for the YipitData organization end to end: mapping the questions our buyers ask across their journey, turning that map into a content roadmap designed to be the definitive answer, and building the systems that track whether it’s working. You’ll partner closely with the YipitAgent team to produce and verify content at scale, and with marketing, product, and sales to connect organic traffic to pipeline.

This is a builder’s role. You’ll bring bleeding-edge, AI-informed tactics to a program you get to shape from the ground up, with the data, tooling, and support to move quickly.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Non-branded organic sessions and AI-sourced sessions grow quarter over quarter.
  • YipitData is cited as a source in AI-generated answers for the questions our buyers ask.
  • Content ships at a consistent, measurable velocity and gets refreshed when performance slips.
  • Organic becomes a reliable, attributable source of conversions and pipeline.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding. 

As Our Associate SEO and AEO Manager You Will:

  • Own YipitData’s overall SEO and AEO strategy, from technical foundations and on-page optimization to how our content gets surfaced and cited in AI answer engines.
  • Own keyword, query, and question mapping across the full buyer journey, identifying where prospects are searching, what they’re asking, and where we can be the definitive answer.
  • Translate that mapping into a prioritized content roadmap and detailed article briefs, including structure, target queries, entities, and the proof points that make a piece authoritative.
  • Coordinate with the YipitAgent team on content production, and own verification and quality review of content before it goes live.
  • Build and maintain our tracking and reporting system for content velocity, non-branded organic sessions, AI-sourced sessions and visibility, AI answer citation share, organic conversion rate, and organic-sourced pipeline.
  • Continuously iterate on content performance, including a disciplined refresh program that updates, consolidates, or retires pages based on data.
  • Build and manage our third-party presence on platforms that influence both human buyers and AI models, such as Reddit, Quora, Crunchbase, G2, and industry directories.
  • Work with PR on our citation strategy so our proprietary data becomes the source that publishers, analysts, and AI systems reference.
  • Implement structured data, schema, internal linking, and technical SEO best practices in partnership with web and engineering stakeholders.
  • Run a steady cadence of experiments on titles, formats, structure, and distribution.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 4+ years of hands-on experience in SEO, content marketing, or organic growth, ideally at a B2B SaaS or data company, and have owned measurable outcomes like organic traffic, rankings, or organic-sourced pipeline. Direct experience with AEO, generative engine optimization, or AI search visibility is required.
  • You’re fluent in the modern SEO toolkit and are actively experimenting with AI visibility and citation tracking tools.
  • You think in questions and answers, not just keywords, and can build a buyer-journey map that connects what people ask to what we should publish.
  • You write clear, specific content briefs and have a sharp editorial eye for what makes a piece genuinely authoritative versus merely optimized.
  • Testing is in YipitData’s DNA. You’d rather run a scrappy experiment this week than debate the perfect plan for a month. You treat failed tests as data and you’re always exploring new tools, channels, and ideas to see what they can do.
