job.title: Technical Product Manager (Marketing Technology), Remote
job.description:
As a Technical Product Manager you will be a key member of the team that designs solutions to support Aledade’s Growth (marketing and sales) team in their mission to enroll and engage new Aledade clients.  The Technical Product Manager works alongside business owners, data analysts, and developers to define project goals, scope solutions, execute and roll out solutions. They are the interface between strategic business owners and development and ensure that Aledade creates a high-quality product with the ability to scale. 
In this role, you will lead product discovery, definition and execution for the platforms that drive Aledade's top-of-funnel marketing engine. You will work closely with our Growth partners and end users to uncover business needs, frame problems and opportunities, and turn them into clear product requirements, user stories, and measurable success criteria. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll connect business strategy to technical delivery so that Aledade's martech investments produce high-quality, scalable products and measurable business outcomes.

- Partner with business owners to cultivate a shared vision for the problem space, constraints, priorities and ideal end state, and be able to articulate and advocate for this perspective.

- Ongoing optimization of live user workflows and capabilities including monitoring of key metrics & user feedback

- Work with internal teams and end users to develop a deep understanding of requirements, perform thoughtful solution design, use data to test hypotheses, and support teams throughout execution.

- Write detailed user stories for new features, capturing detailed descriptions of business rationale, requirements, and success criteria that are defined by measurable outcomes.

- Develop short- and long-term roadmaps that deliver maximum value with minimum risk and assume ongoing iteration.

- 5+ years of product management experience in marketing technology, technology-enabled services industry, or a SaaS product.

- Experience using data and primary research to inform solution design and build internal business understanding.

- Experience with and understanding of the software development lifecycle and software development methodologies.  Preferably experience with Agile / Scrum teams.

- Product development experience in the context of the development of a healthcare technology product.

- Strong product-oriented martech domain expertise, with a clear understanding of how marketing and sales platforms, data and processes work together to drive pipeline and revenue outcomes.

- Broad knowledge of the martech landscape (e.g. CDP, DAM, CMS, Marketing automation, etc.), including how unified data enables personalization and agentic marketing.

- Experience identifying and deploying high-impact AI and agentic marketing use cases that drive pipeline growth and operational efficiency.

- Experience working on or owning platforms in the marketing technology space (eg Hubspot, Salesforce, Seismic, Gong, ZoomInfo, Chili Piper, etc).

- Knowledge of Salesforce CRM capabilities and constraints, including its standard objects, data model and processes.

- Familiarity with customer data platforms (CDPs), identity resolution and consent and preference management. Working knowledge of SQL.

- Track record of delivering practical martech solutions that improve marketing and sales effectiveness, from process and data improvements to new platform capabilities and integrations.

- Comfortable working in ambiguity and with competing stakeholder needs, bringing structure to complex problems and driving alignment on the right solution.

- Excellent organizational and communication skills with an emphasis on problem-solving and building subject matter expertise.

Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

 Who We Are:
Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.
 
What Does This Mean for You?
At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
 
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
 
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
 
At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

- Partner with business owners to cultivate a shared vision for the problem space, constraints, priorities and ideal end state, and be able to articulate and advocate for this perspective.

job.title: Senior Director, Corporate Marketing
job.description:
About the Role

The Senior Director, Corporate Marketing owns how A-LIGN is seen, heard, and trusted, leading corporate communications, brand marketing, and the creative design function, translating company strategy into a differentiated presence in the market. In this role, you will be responsible for the strategic direction and day-to-day execution of corporate communications, brand marketing, and creative across every channel A-LIGN goes to market through. As the Senior Director, Corporate Marketing, you will build and lead a multidisciplinary team spanning design and communications, while managing public relations (PR) agency and freelance partners to extend capacity. A-LIGN will depend on you to define brand architecture and messaging standards, govern visual and verbal identity globally, elevate corporate and executive thought leadership, and use artificial intelligence (AI) and self-service tools to scale creative delivery. This role partners closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, People Operations, and executive leadership to ensure corporate marketing investment tracks to business outcomes. The ideal candidate is a senior marketing leader with brand and communications depth who pairs genuine craft standards with commercial accountability, builds durable process, and thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

Reports to

Senior Vice President, Marketing

Pay Classification

Full-Time, Exempt

Responsibilities

BRAND MARKETING

  • Own A-LIGN’s global brand strategy (architecture, corporate positioning, messaging framework, and verbal identity) and govern its consistent application across every market-facing channel
  • Define and maintain the messaging hierarchy that connects the corporate narrative to service line, industry, and persona-level messaging so every go-to-market team works from a single source of truth
  • Partner with Product Marketing, which owns content strategy and production, to ensure content reflects corporate positioning, messaging, and brand standards
  • Plan and lead brand marketing campaigns that build awareness, authority, and reputation, partnering with Demand Generation and Product Marketing so brand investment amplifies pipeline programs
  • Own brand health measurement, including awareness, share of voice, brand sentiment, reputation, and message resonance, and present performance and recommendations to executive leadership on a regular cadence
  • Conduct ongoing research into industry trends, customer insights, and the competitive landscape to identify white space and keep A-LIGN’s voice ahead of a crowded compliance market
  • Protect the A-LIGN brand by governing trademark and logo use, partner and co-branding standards, and the accuracy and compliance of public claims, in partnership with Legal

CORPORATE COMMUNICATIONS 

  • Own the external communications strategy, including press releases, media relations, and announcement planning for certification, product, partnership, and corporate milestones, directing the PR agency to earn coverage that builds authority
  • Build and run the LinkedIn and social program across the corporate channel and executive and practitioner voices, setting the editorial approach, publishing cadence, and engagement standards
  • Direct the corporate and executive thought leadership program, working with internal subject matter experts and the global go-to-market function to define areas of focus and convert practitioner expertise into differentiated market commentary
  • Build and run the awards and speaking program: identify high-value awards, conferences, and industry events, and prepare and submit nominations and speaking proposals that position A-LIGN leaders and practitioners as industry authorities
  • Partner with executive leadership to build executive visibility, including media and speaking preparation, bylines, and executive social presence
  • Amplify external news, brand messaging, and company milestones to employees through internal channels, and support executive leadership on company-wide announcements in partnership with People Operations
  • Serve as the final review on external-facing communications, holding accuracy, tone, and message alignment
  • Partner with Sales, Partnerships, and People Operations to extend brand messaging into customer, partner, and employer brand communications
  • Own crisis and reputation management, including the issues and crisis communications playbook, reputation monitoring, and spokesperson readiness, and lead the cross-functional response with Legal, Security, and executive leadership when an issue could affect A-LIGN’s credibility

CREATIVE 

  • Lead the creative function end to end, setting the standard for design and campaign creative while building the briefing structure, review cadence, and production process that allow the team to deliver at speed
  • Hire, develop, and lead the creative design team, and manage agency, freelance, and production partners to extend capacity without diluting quality
  • Own brand guidelines, visual identity, and templates, and govern their consistent application across the company, including video, web, and event content produced by other teams
  • Optimize creative delivery with AI by evaluating and adopting AI-enabled design and workflow tools and setting guardrails that protect brand quality, accuracy, and intellectual property
  • Build self-service creative capabilities, including templates, brand asset libraries, and intake workflows, so teams across the company can fulfill routine creative requests without creating a bottleneck for the creative team
  • Maintain tight working alignment with the Product Marketing content team on video and multimedia production, setting shared briefs, brand standards, and review processes so content is on brand and delivered at speed
  • Partner with Demand Generation and Product Marketing to integrate creative into program planning from the outset, ensuring brand and messaging directly strengthen campaign performance

LEADERSHIP & OPERATIONS

  • Build, develop, and lead the corporate marketing team across communications, brand, and creative, defining the structure, hiring plan, and goals as the function scales
  • Set the annual corporate marketing plan, priorities, and key performance indicators (KPIs) in step with the company go-to-market strategy, and report results to the Senior Vice President, Marketing, and executive leadership on a regular cadence
  • Plan and manage the corporate marketing budget, allocating investment across communications, brand, and creative programs and across in-house and external resources, including the PR agency and freelance partners, and hold the team accountable to output and outcome targets
  • Lead corporate messaging and communications planning for major company moments, such as acquisitions, leadership changes, new service launches, and rebrands

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Design, Business, or other relevant field

EXPERIENCE

  • 10+ years of corporate marketing, communications, brand, or creative experience, including 4+ years leading and developing teams
  • Proven track record of building and executing brand and communications strategies that delivered measurable business results in a B2B environment
  • Experience leading corporate communications, brand, and creative functions, including direct management of designers and communications professionals
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, and production partners against scope, budget, and quality standards
  • Experience leading executive visibility, media relations, and crisis or issues communications, including working directly with C-suite leaders and PR agencies
  • Hands-on experience adopting AI tools and self-service workflows to improve creative or communications productivity while protecting brand quality
  • Proficiency with social media, media monitoring, and creative production tools, and reporting platforms used to measure brand, reputation, and communications performance
  • Exposure to the cybersecurity, compliance, or professional services industry is a plus

SKILLS

  • Exceptional writing and editing ability, with the judgment to set editorial standards for others and raise the quality of work you did not create yourself
  • Strong creative point of view; you can direct design and brand creative work, give specific and actionable feedback, and defend a creative decision with clear reasoning
  • Comfortable translating brand, communications, and reputation activity into commercial metrics; you can build a performance dashboard and present it to an executive audience
  • Highly organized operator who builds structure around creative and communications work: briefs, calendars, review cycles, and clear ownership
  • Sound judgment and composure under pressure, with the executive presence to advise senior leaders on reputation-sensitive decisions and communicate with credibility in high-stakes moments
  • Effective cross-functional collaborator with a track record of working well with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Legal, and People Operations to launch integrated programs
  • Self-motivated and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and agility is valued
  • Strong attention to detail, with a drive to continuously raise the quality and impact of your team's work

Benefits

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance and Disability Insurance
  • EAP - Employee Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Plan with Employer Matching
  • Competitive Bonus Structure
  • Home Office Reimbursement
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Personalized Career Coaching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Paid Office Closure December 25-January 1
  • Vacation Bonus
  • Summer Hours

About A-LIGN

A-LIGN is the leading provider of high-quality, efficient cybersecurity compliance programs. Combining experienced auditors and audit management technology, A-LIGN provides the widest breadth and depth of services including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HITRUST, FedRAMP, and PCI. A-LIGN is the number one issuer of SOC 2 and HITRUST and a top three FedRAMP assessor. To learn more, visit a-lign.com.

Come Work for A-LIGN!

Apply online today at A-LIGN.com and learn about life at A-LIGN by following us on LinkedIn.

A-LIGN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Minorities, women, disabled, and veterans encouraged to apply!

job.title: Experiential Marketing Manager
job.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

In this role, you will work closely with marketing and business partners to plan and execute go-to-market programs for a portfolio of physical and live experiences. You will help bring a globally recognized entertainment brand to life through theme park attractions, location-based experiences, events, exhibitions, and other experiential programs. You will work with operators, venues, production companies, creative agencies, and cross-functional marketing partners to develop campaigns from strategy through execution, while managing timelines, budgets, assets, approvals, and performance reporting. The role is remote with flexibility to accommodate time-zone differences and will be measured by the successful execution of go-to-market campaigns

 Key Responsibilities

• Develop and activate brand marketing programs for a portfolio of theme park lands and attractions, location-based experiences, traveling exhibitions, fan events, and experiential brand activations.

• Partner with experience operators, production companies, venue partners, and creative agencies to develop opening campaigns, ongoing marketing programs, and seasonal campaigns that drive awareness, attendance, and brand engagement.

• Own end-to-end brand marketing for experiences, from strategy and positioning through go-to-market planning and in-market execution.

• Translate franchise and business priorities into clear marketing briefs, messaging frameworks, creative direction, and integrated campaigns that resonate with audiences and guests.

• Build scalable frameworks, toolkits, and operating models that enable experiences marketing programs to scale across partners, venues, regions, and major franchise moments while maintaining brand consistency.

• Identify opportunities to extend the brand into culture and community through fan events, conventions, pop-ups, live moments, and other experiential programs that generate earned media and reinforce broader franchise engagement.

• Develop integrated communications plans across owned, earned, paid, partner, retail, and on-site channels, collaborating with editorial, social, web, PR, influencer, community, media, and regional marketing partners.

• Manage program operations including scopes, timelines, budgets, contracts, approvals, creative assets, on-site execution, invoicing, and reporting.

• Monitor program performance, including attendance, audience growth, brand impact, and earned reach, and use insights to support continuous improvement and test-and-learn initiatives.

 

 Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of marketing experience in theme parks, location-based entertainment, experiential or event marketing, live entertainment, or destination marketing.

• Direct experience working at or alongside established experience operators, IP holders, theme park organizations, location-based entertainment companies, traveling exhibitions, large-scale live events, or experiential agencies.

• Proven experience managing partnerships with operators, venues, production companies, and agencies while balancing brand integrity with commercial objectives.

• Strong understanding of place-based and experiential marketing, including opening campaigns, ongoing attendance marketing, seasonal programs, and on-site guest experience marketing.

• Experience developing and executing integrated marketing programs across owned, earned, paid, partner, retail, and on-site channels.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs while balancing scope, timelines, budgets, venues, and external partners.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills within matrixed organizations and external partner environments.

• Strong business communication, writing, and relationship-building skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

 

 Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience marketing theme park lands, attractions, location-based entertainment, or large-scale live events for IP-led experience operators.

• Experience marketing global entertainment properties, gaming franchises, or other large consumer brands across both physical and digital touchpoints.

• Familiarity with player- and fan-driven communities and experience creating programs that build cultural relevance, audience engagement, and repeat visitation.

 Salary Range 

Pay ranges vary based on multiple factors including, without limitation, skill sets, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographical market. The pay range for this position reflects geographic based ranges for Washington state: $90,000- $100,000 USD annually. The salary/wage and job title for this opening will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and experience and may be outside this range. 

Location: Remote

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Competitive paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicant Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.

job.title: Growth Marketing Manager (Remote)
job.description:
Reports to: CEO

Do you geek out on Media Buying, Creatives, Building Sales Funnels and love driving revenue through direct response marketing?  

Would you consider yourself a LEADER of people?  

If you’ve built and guided multiple teams, if you have at least 3+ years of experience with Media Buying, Sales Funnel Building, writing world class copy and want to trailblaze and lead a full pod of performance marketers - keep reading. 

As our Growth Marketing Manager, you’ll be the CEO of a highly skilled team of digital marketers and the CMO for CA clients, operating from a strong basis of industry knowledge and relational confidence. The Growth Marketing Manager acts as the catalyst for growth of our clients’ businesses. You are excited about the complexities of a business and love identifying solutions to growth problems. Both your team and your clients will look to you to point them in the right direction.

This is a position where you’ll work directly with the CEO on strategizing new sales funnels, writing copy, media buying, and driving ROAS.

Here are all the positions you will need to strategize with, build, lead and grow:

- Media Buyers

- Copywriters

- Videographers

- Business Intelligence

- Account Managers

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership - Hiring & Leading Others (Must Have)
This is an absolute must in this position. You need to have hired and built multiple teams. Considering that you will oversee many different roles of our performance marketing, we expect you to develop our current leaders, delegate to them and lead their growth. You will be ultimately accountable for the KPIs and goals of the pod you will be overseeing. 

Funnel Strategy & Execution
You will help strategize, develop, & launch new marketing funnels for our top clients (Low Ticket Straight Sale Funnels, Webinar Funnels, Call Funnels, etc..)

You will work with the project manager in the pod to disseminate work to the various members in the pod, in order to fully launch the funnel in our timeline.

Forecasting HR
Assist in forecasting hiring needs for your pod. The GMM is responsible for collaborating with our HR dept. to ensure we are placing appropriate talent in each open role in our performance division, as well as onboarding, and training new Media Buyers properly.

Client Strategy & Quarterly Objectives
We are obsessed with client results, that’s why we need to make sure we’re constantly improving clients metrics. We want to implement monthly/quarterly/annual marketing metric reviews, including but not limited to analysis of campaign performance, lead conversion, customer database growth/quality and pipeline growth

Data-Driven Decision Making
In this company, our entire team is data-driven, we do not make decisions without data to support them. You will monitor key performance indicators of success for your pod, and make adjustments based upon targets.

Creative Ideation & Management

You will work with our copywriters & senior media buyers to ideate & launch hard hitting direct response video ads that drive ROAS.

Media Buying Strategy

You will work with the Senior Media Buyer in the pod to strategize the media buying for every client in the pod on a quarterly, monthly, and annual basis.

RESULTS

These are the results you will be responsible for delivering in this position.

-  Hit 95% of Projected Quarterly Bonus For Your Pod

- Own forecasting the quarterly bonus for all of the clients in the pod

- Track and report on the pacing of the bonus weekly

-  Achieve 90% of Client’s Growth KPIs

- Own forecasting profit, ROAS, booked calls, & overall spend for current & new clients

- Collaborate with media buyers to strategize and execute growth campaigns for clients.

- Drive initiatives to test new channels and diversify ad spend.

- Ensure timely and efficient optimization based on performance data.

-  Ensure Pod Maintains 65% Gross Profit Margin

- Pod must maintain 2x payroll before the bonus

- Ensure all time tracking sheets are submitted by Project Manager weekly

- GMM is the hiring manager for the pod and must make sure the pod has adequate resources to run successfully

-  Fully Build Out 1 New Sales Funnel Per Quarter

- Work with team to build out a full funnel for either 1 new client or existing client

- Develop overall strategy, big idea, products, and pricing strategy for funnel

- Ensure all marketing tech is setup correctly and sequences are all built out for the different stages of contacts lifecycle

- Measure and analyze the performance, refining strategies based on outcomes.

Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of experience working in the info product / consulting niche

- A proven track record for scaling consulting / information businesses.

- Experience managing advertising budgets on social media platforms in excess of $50,000 per month.

- Experience with email marketing preferred.

- Experience managing Google/YouTube advertising budgets preferred.

- Minimum 1-year experience managing a team or leading cross-functional projects.

- Agency experience and/or experience in a client-facing role preferred.

- Bachelor's Degree or similar experience preferred, but not necessary.

- Experience developing a holistic digital growth strategy through a deep understanding of organic and paid revenue sources.

COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS

We use Slack for Client & Internal Communications

We value over-communication (more context the better)

We value speed in communication (be prompt in responding or provide context as to why you may be slow to respond)

Weekly Full Team Meetings

Daily Stand Ups with Pods

WHO ARE WE?

Client Accelerators is the 'go to' company for coaches, consultants, experts, & authors who want to achieve sustained growth through paid acquisition channels like YouTube, Facebook, TikTok & Google. 

We were the 207th fastest growing company on the Inc 5000 list last year, and have had record growth for an advertising agency, growing an incredible 2,574% over the past 3 years.

We’ve been able to have this record growth because of the incredible results we’ve been able to get for our clients, which has allowed us to speak on stages all over the world on our strategies & tactics to doubling, tripling or even 10x their profits by working with us.

We take a hands-on approach to growing each client we bring in by scripting all of their creatives, video production, tracking, & running their ads on these channels to hit agreed upon targets. 

Our proven approach has allowed us to spend over $150 Million Dollars & generate over $300 Million Dollars in verified sales in the past 5 years. Currently, our company is focused on founder-led businesses across the e-learning, SaaS and service-based internet space.

We believe great people are at the center of every successful business. Employees are provided a full suite of benefits, including competitive compensation, healthcare, unlimited paid time off, and a fully remote working environment. (We also have offices in New Jersey & Florida if you’d prefer to work in-person 😃).

What makes Client Accelerators so different? For one, our founder, Mike Buontempo is a consultant himself, who has been consulting with different companies & entrepreneurs for the past 13 years. 

Our vision is to attract and hire the very best people to help our clients grow profitably and systematically through paid media. 

Client Accelerators Core Values

- We are problem solvers: If you spot a problem in our company or a client’s company, provide a solution. There’s millions of problems, and not as many problem solvers, be the solution.

- Open Source Code: We share what’s working with everyone

- Empty The Bucket: Picture this, if you just spent two hours cleaning your car, you put all of the cleaning materials away, but you notice you missed a spot. What do you do? You go back, get everything back out, and complete the job to perfection

- We’re a ‘TEAM’ not a Family: Leaders at CA hire, develop, and cut smartly, so we have Superstars at every position

- Ownership Thinking: Going out of your way to make sure your actions and the actions of your peers are in the best interest of the company

- Being The Best: Mastering your domain so you’re the best in the world at it

Benefits

MEDICAL | Full health, dental, and vision benefits (W2 Employees)

Great career growth opportunity - You’ll be working with ‘A’ players in Operations, Sales, Creative, and Media Buying

Company Leadership Events and Industry Conferences

job.title: Senior Campus Marketing Manager
job.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (US), with travel about once a month
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Head of Higher Ed
Compensation: $110,000 to $150,000 per year

More than 50 colleges and universities offer CodePath courses for credit, taught by their own faculty or by CodePath. For a student, a seat in one of those courses means industry-vetted learning and career support built into the degree they're already earning. The courses only change outcomes if students know they exist and sign up.

That's your job. Students find us through a professor who mentions the course before registration opens, an advisor who forwards a note, a club event, or a friend who took the course last term. Most of that reach happens through people on campus, so your work is making it easy for faculty, advisors, career services, club leaders, alumni, and Tech Fellows to carry the message for us. You'll build all of it: the toolkits and campaigns they share, the campus presence, and the student community that recruits the next cohort. You'll be measured on how many students enroll and stay through add/drop, because each filled seat is one more student getting the training we exist to provide.

You'll be a dedicated partner to our Higher Education partnerships team, who own the relationships with faculty and campus leadership, and you'll own the student side of every partner campus. Some weeks that means building a one-pager a department chair can forward on Monday, tuning an email sequence on a Wednesday, and representing CodePath at a hackathon on Friday. You'll be building this function from the ground up and you need to decide in advance how we show up and what we expect back.

What you'll own

Partner activation and campaign development

  • Build and run a term playbook for each for-credit partner, from awareness through add/drop
  • Equip faculty, advisors, career services, and club leaders to market CodePath courses with toolkits, talking points, and assets they can forward
  • Turn national for-credit applicants into enrolled students: find where they drop off and test what moves conversion
  • Run virtual info sessions and campus landing pages that end with a clear path to register
  • Own email and SMS to opted-in students: build the list, run the campaigns, and work with our lifecycle contractor so campus and direct touches land as one sequence

Student community building

  • Design how alumni, Tech Fellows, and instructors show up on campus and engage students, and build the online side of that community (Discord and similar)
  • Own relationships with student clubs, CS and AI organizations, hackathon organizers, and campus chapters of national organizations like ColorStack, NSBE, and SHPE
  • Plan the event calendar a term ahead, with a clear standard for which events we do and what each should return

Measurement

  • Tie every sign-up to a channel and a partner, test timing, message, and channel, and move time and budget to what works
  • Use AI to run the playbook at 50+ campuses without adding headcount: toolkits per campus, calendars and send dates, results in one view

What success looks like in your first year

  • Every partner runs a term playbook, and fill rate and melt improve at for-credit partners
  • National for-credit conversion is measurably higher
  • Every new partner launches with a full first section
  • A student advocate network is live at our largest partners
  • The opted-in student list grows, and every sign-up traces to a channel

This role may be right for you if

  • You've owned an enrollment, sign-up, or acquisition number and moved it. You set up the tracking and can show which efforts drove the result
  • You've gotten partners to market on your behalf: individuals who carried your message because you made it easy for them, and you can show what it produced
  • You've built a campus, ambassador, or community program from the ground up and can show what it produced
  • You’ve built campaigns from concept to launch, including copy and creative, and run email or SMS to a list you built, changing them based on the numbers
  • You've decided where to spend time and money (events, channels, sponsorships) based on expected return, and cut what didn't deliver
  • You've run a program across many sites at once (campuses, chapters, regions) on a fixed calendar, and kept it on schedule without a team under you
  • You’ve built AI into how you work to automate the repetitive parts, and you can show what it changed
  • You want your growth work to widen who gets into tech careers

Bonus

  • Experience in enrollment or admissions marketing in higher education 
  • You’ve built or scaled a technical community (a student developer org, hackathon community, Discord, or dev rel program) and can show how it grew
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience
  • You're comfortable speaking at events and on panels on behalf of CodePath

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for a Senior Manager level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $150,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

details.full_description_markdown:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (US), with travel about once a month
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Head of Higher Ed
Compensation: $110,000 to $150,000 per year

More than 50 colleges and universities offer CodePath courses for credit, taught by their own faculty or by CodePath. For a student, a seat in one of those courses means industry-vetted learning and career support built into the degree they're already earning. The courses only change outcomes if students know they exist and sign up.

That's your job. Students find us through a professor who mentions the course before registration opens, an advisor who forwards a note, a club event, or a friend who took the course last term. Most of that reach happens through people on campus, so your work is making it easy for faculty, advisors, career services, club leaders, alumni, and Tech Fellows to carry the message for us. You'll build all of it: the toolkits and campaigns they share, the campus presence, and the student community that recruits the next cohort. You'll be measured on how many students enroll and stay through add/drop, because each filled seat is one more student getting the training we exist to provide.

You'll be a dedicated partner to our Higher Education partnerships team, who own the relationships with faculty and campus leadership, and you'll own the student side of every partner campus. Some weeks that means building a one-pager a department chair can forward on Monday, tuning an email sequence on a Wednesday, and representing CodePath at a hackathon on Friday. You'll be building this function from the ground up and you need to decide in advance how we show up and what we expect back.

What you'll own

Partner activation and campaign development

  • Build and run a term playbook for each for-credit partner, from awareness through add/drop
  • Equip faculty, advisors, career services, and club leaders to market CodePath courses with toolkits, talking points, and assets they can forward
  • Turn national for-credit applicants into enrolled students: find where they drop off and test what moves conversion
  • Run virtual info sessions and campus landing pages that end with a clear path to register
  • Own email and SMS to opted-in students: build the list, run the campaigns, and work with our lifecycle contractor so campus and direct touches land as one sequence

Student community building

  • Design how alumni, Tech Fellows, and instructors show up on campus and engage students, and build the online side of that community (Discord and similar)
  • Own relationships with student clubs, CS and AI organizations, hackathon organizers, and campus chapters of national organizations like ColorStack, NSBE, and SHPE
  • Plan the event calendar a term ahead, with a clear standard for which events we do and what each should return

Measurement

  • Tie every sign-up to a channel and a partner, test timing, message, and channel, and move time and budget to what works
  • Use AI to run the playbook at 50+ campuses without adding headcount: toolkits per campus, calendars and send dates, results in one view

What success looks like in your first year

  • Every partner runs a term playbook, and fill rate and melt improve at for-credit partners
  • National for-credit conversion is measurably higher
  • Every new partner launches with a full first section
  • A student advocate network is live at our largest partners
  • The opted-in student list grows, and every sign-up traces to a channel

This role may be right for you if

  • You've owned an enrollment, sign-up, or acquisition number and moved it. You set up the tracking and can show which efforts drove the result
  • You've gotten partners to market on your behalf: individuals who carried your message because you made it easy for them, and you can show what it produced
  • You've built a campus, ambassador, or community program from the ground up and can show what it produced
  • You’ve built campaigns from concept to launch, including copy and creative, and run email or SMS to a list you built, changing them based on the numbers
  • You've decided where to spend time and money (events, channels, sponsorships) based on expected return, and cut what didn't deliver
  • You've run a program across many sites at once (campuses, chapters, regions) on a fixed calendar, and kept it on schedule without a team under you
  • You’ve built AI into how you work to automate the repetitive parts, and you can show what it changed
  • You want your growth work to widen who gets into tech careers

Bonus

  • Experience in enrollment or admissions marketing in higher education 
  • You’ve built or scaled a technical community (a student developer org, hackathon community, Discord, or dev rel program) and can show how it grew
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience
  • You're comfortable speaking at events and on panels on behalf of CodePath

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for a Senior Manager level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $150,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings
Pay range
$110,000—$150,000 USD

job.title: Marketing Director (Remote)
job.description:
DemandFactor is a data-driven B2B growth and demand-generation company helping brands find, engage, and convert their next customers. We run full-funnel programs across intent, ABM, content syndication, and performance marketing, all tied to measurable pipeline impact.

We’re looking for a Marketing Director to build and scale our marketing function. This is a hands-on and strategic role owning brand, demand gen, content, digital, and performance.

What you’ll do

  • Own and execute DemandFactor’s marketing strategy
  • Lead demand-gen, ABM, and digital performance programs
  • Build a strong brand and high-impact content engine
  • Partner closely with Sales to drive full-funnel results
  • Manage marketing KPIs, analytics, attribution, and budget
  • Build and grow the marketing team

What we’re looking for

  • 7–10+ years in B2B marketing (demand gen, performance, growth)
  • Proven success in driving measurable pipeline and ROI
  • Experience building marketing functions from the ground up
  • Strong analytical, strategic, and leadership skills
  • Excellent communication and execution abilities

Why DemandFactor

  • High-impact leadership role
  • Full ownership and autonomy to shape marketing
  • Data-driven, innovative environment
  • Flexible, remote workplace

job.title: SEO and Content Marketing Strategist - Contract
job.description:
About Digital Reach Agency:

Digital Reach Agency is a leading B2B digital marketing agency specializing in SaaS and tech industry clients. We empower businesses by aligning their brand, connecting systems, and generating pipeline through comprehensive audits and strategic marketing initiatives. We’re a fully remote company with a dynamic team that values autonomy, communication, and collaboration.

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced SEO and Content Marketing Strategist to join our team. This contract role requires a dual focus on developing and executing advanced SEO strategies while supporting content marketing initiatives for B2B and enterprise clients. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of SEO best practices, be highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing complex SEO projects from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities:

- Content Strategy & Development:

- Work closely with the content team to align SEO objectives with content strategy, ensuring that content is optimized for both search engines and user experience.

- Develop and execute content strategies for websites, landing pages, and other digital assets, focusing on SEO-driven content that aligns with client goals.

- Utilize Voice of Customer (VoC) insights and keyword research to inform content creation, ensuring that messaging resonates with target personas.

- Conduct content audits to identify gaps and opportunities, recommending improvements to boost organic search visibility.

- Optimize existing content for SEO, ensuring that all digital assets adhere to the latest SEO guidelines and best practices.

- SEO Strategy & Execution:

- Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive SEO strategies tailored to the specific needs of B2B clients, with an emphasis on increasing organic traffic and improving search engine rankings.

- Perform in-depth keyword research, focusing on high-intent keywords that drive qualified traffic and conversions.

- Conduct technical SEO audits, identifying and resolving issues related to site architecture, crawlability, and indexing.

- Optimize on-page elements, including meta tags, headers, content, and internal linking structures, to enhance SEO performance.

- Collaborate with the development team to ensure that SEO best practices are followed during website updates and redesigns.

- Drive off-page SEO strategies, including link building, outreach, and digital PR, to enhance domain authority and backlink profiles.

- Analyze competitors' SEO strategies to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.

- Client Management & Reporting:

- Lead client calls, presenting SEO performance reports, discussing strategic initiatives, and managing expectations effectively.

- Prepare and deliver detailed SEO reports, including analysis of traffic, rankings, conversions, and other key metrics.

- Provide clients with actionable insights and recommendations based on data-driven analysis, helping them achieve their digital marketing objectives.

- Continuous Improvement & Collaboration:

- Stay updated on the latest SEO trends, algorithm updates, and industry developments, continuously refining strategies to maintain and improve performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including web developers, designers, and content creators, to deliver cohesive and impactful digital marketing campaigns.

- Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and team development by staying abreast of emerging SEO tools and techniques.

Requirements

- 4+ years of experience in SEO, with a strong focus on B2B campaigns.

- Proven experience in content strategy development, particularly for websites, landing pages, and digital marketing assets.

- Deep understanding of SEO principles, including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and link building.

- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, and other related platforms.

- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to lead client calls and manage expectations effectively.

- Experience in the B2B, SaaS, or tech industry.

- Strong project management skills, with the ability to work autonomously in a remote environment, managing multiple projects and deadlines.

- Experience with content management systems and project management software (e.g., Asana).

Major Pluses:

- Previous experience at a digital marketing agency.

- Proven track record with case studies or a personal portfolio of successful SEO and content strategy work.

- Experience with WordPress development, marketing automation, and CRMs.

- Knowledge of cross-domain strategies (CRO, UI/UX, Paid Media, etc.).

- Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and time-tracking software.

- Familiarity with GIF-based communication (we love a good GIF!).

Benefits

Location: Remote

Position: Contract

Salary: $40 - 50/ hour

job.title: Senior Content & Customer Marketing Manager
job.description:
Do you enjoy turning complex products, government operations, and customer outcomes into clear, credible stories? Are you energized by building both the content engine and the customer programs that help a growing organization earn trust? If so, you may be the right fit for Grant Street Group.
Grant Street Group builds software that helps government agencies deliver critical financial and public services. We’re looking for a senior marketer who can turn client expertise and outcomes into a credible market presence and stronger client relationships. This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll set the strategy, build practical processes, and create high-quality work—from interviewing executives, subject-matter experts, and government clients to turning ideas into published content.

- 

Build and manage an editorial roadmap aligned with GSG’s priorities, deciding which stories to tell, for whom, and in what format.

- 

Research, interview, write, and edit thought leadership, market perspectives, client stories, case studies, reports, emails, web content, campaign assets, executive bylines, webinar narratives, and social content.

- 

Create a repeatable process for identifying customer outcomes and proof points, then develop a bench of client references, speakers, and advocates for case studies, webinars, events, sales references, and co-marketing.

- 

Draw out strong points of view from GSG executives and subject-matter experts and turn their expertise into distinctive market-facing content.

- 

Partner with Client Success and operations leaders on voice-of-client programs, including relationship surveys or NPS; own communications, response capture, analysis, reporting, and insight-sharing.

- 

Establish lightweight standards for content intake, prioritization, review, approvals, voice, reuse, distribution, and performance measurement.

-

job.title: Sales Executive (SEO/Digital Marketing)
job.description:
### About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms across SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. Unlike traditional outsourcing, you’ll be placed directly with a client as an in-house team member, with long-term growth opportunities and performance-based rewards.

### About the Company

Our client is a rapidly growing digital marketing agency specializing in SEO and performance marketing, helping businesses scale through data-driven organic growth strategies. They work with a diverse portfolio of international clients and are known for delivering measurable ROI and long-term growth outcomes.

Role Type: Full-time, On-site

Engagement: Independent Contractor 

Location: Remote, Quarterly meet-ups in Cape Town

Job Summary

We are hiring a Sales Executive with proven experience in SEO or digital marketing agency sales. This is a high-impact role focused on driving new business through outbound sales.

This role is fully remote but requires candidates to be based in Cape Town for quarterly in-person team meetups and strategy sessions.

### Key Responsibilities

- Drive outbound sales through cold calling, email outreach, and LinkedIn prospecting 

-  Identify, qualify business opportunities in the SEO/digital marketing space 

-  Conduct discovery calls and present tailored SEO solutions to potential clients 

-  Maintain and update pipelines using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) 

-  Collaborate with internal marketing and delivery teams to ensure seamless client onboarding 

-  Meet and exceed monthly revenue targets and KPIs 

-  Stay up to date with SEO trends and digital marketing innovations

Requirements

- Proven sales experience within an SEO, digital marketing, or marketing agency environment 

-  Minimum 2+ years in a Sales Executive or Business Development role 

-  Strong understanding of SEO services and digital marketing solutions 

-  Demonstrated track record of closing deals and hitting revenue targets 

-  Experience with outbound sales and high call volumes 

-  Proficiency in CRM tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce 

-  Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills 

-  Must be based in Cape Town (required for quarterly meetups)

Benefits

🌎 Remote-first role with flexibility and autonomy

 ✈️ Quarterly in-person team meetups in Cape Town

 🚀 Work with a fast-growing international digital marketing agency

 📈 Clear progression into Senior Sales or Account Executive roles

 🎯 Performance-based bonuses and incentives

 🤝 Exposure to global clients and high-growth industries

🧠 Continuous training in SEO, digital marketing, and sales

job.title: Marketing Automation Specialist - GHL
job.description:
### About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect high-performing B2B sales professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top sales talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.

As part of our talent pool, you’ll have access to exclusive SDR opportunities matched to your background and preferences.

Job Type: Part-time 1st month / Full time after

Location: Remote (EST time zone)

### Job Summary

We are hiring a Senior GoHighLevel Automations & AI Specialist for a remote marketing automation role focused on building, optimizing, and scaling workflows across multiple client accounts.

This is a high-impact, client-facing role where you will design and implement advanced automation systems, integrate AI-driven processes, and ensure seamless execution of marketing operations.

The role begins part-time with a clear pathway to full-time based on performance, reliability, and quality of output.

### Key Responsibilities

- Build, manage, and optimize GoHighLevel automations and workflows 

- Implement AI-driven automation systems to improve marketing and operational efficiency 

- Test all automations rigorously to ensure accuracy, performance, and zero errors before deployment 

- Create and maintain detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and workflow documentation 

- Collaborate with internal teams and communicate directly with clients when required 

- Maintain consistent responsiveness and clear communication across all projects 

- Continuously improve systems for scalability, efficiency, and performance 

Requirements

- Must-Have:

-  Proven hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) 

-  Strong English communication skills (written and verbal) 

-  Ability to work 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (strict requirement) 

-  High attention to detail with a strong quality control mindset 

-  Experience documenting workflows and building SOPs 

-  Ability to manage multiple automation projects simultaneously 

-  Spanish language skills 

- Nice-to-Have:

-  Experience working in a marketing agency environment 

-  Familiarity with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, or Make (Integromat) 

-  Understanding of paid advertising platforms (Meta Ads) 

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

job.description:
### About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, and tech companies across SaaS, eCommerce, and FinTech. Unlike traditional outsourcing, you’ll be placed directly with a client as a valued, long-term member of their team.

### About the Company

This opportunity is with a performance-driven digital marketing agency focused on scaling revenue through data-led paid media strategies. The company specializes in Google Ads, paid social, and conversion optimization, helping clients maximize ROI across multiple industries.

### Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Google Ads Specialist with 4–5+ years of hands-on experience managing, optimizing, and scaling high-performing Google Ads campaigns.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven performance marketer with a proven track record of managing significant advertising budgets, improving return on ad spend (ROAS), and driving measurable business growth.

You should be confident taking full ownership of Google Ads accounts, developing paid search strategies, analyzing campaign performance, and delivering consistent results.

### Key Responsibilities

- Plan, launch, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, and Performance Max.

- Develop and execute paid advertising strategies focused on lead generation, conversions, and revenue growth.

- Manage and optimize advertising budgets to maximize ROAS and reduce cost per acquisition (CPA).

- Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, audience targeting, and campaign restructuring.

- Implement and troubleshoot conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Google Ads.

- Continuously run A/B tests on ad copy, landing pages, bidding strategies, and targeting.

- Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and profitability.

- Create clear performance reports and communicate actionable insights to stakeholders.

- Stay updated on Google Ads platform changes, automation, and industry best practices.

- Take full ownership of campaign performance and proactively recommend improvements.

Requirements

- 4–5+ years of proven, hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns.

- Advanced knowledge of Google Ads, including Search, Shopping, Display, and Performance Max.

- Demonstrated success managing and scaling advertising budgets while maintaining strong performance.

- Strong understanding of ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, conversion rates, and other key performance metrics.

- Proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

- Experience with campaign optimization, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and remarketing.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable strategies.

- Experience working with international clients, preferably in the UK, US, or Australian markets.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple campaigns, and meet performance targets.

### Nice to Have

- Google Ads certifications.

- Experience managing paid media for digital marketing agencies.

- Experience with eCommerce, SaaS, B2B lead generation, or service-based businesses.

- Familiarity with Looker Studio, Google Merchant Center, and landing page optimization.

- Experience managing high-budget or multi-account Google Ads portfolios.

Benefits

🌎 Fully remote role with flexible work environment 

🚀 Work with high-growth companies and performance-driven teams 

📈 Opportunity to scale campaigns with significant ad budgets 

🎯 Performance-based bonuses tied to campaign success 

🤝 Direct collaboration with international clients and marketing leaders

job.title: Cosmetics/Ecommerce - Digital Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cosmetics/Ecommerce – Digital Marketing Specialist based in the United States.

The Digital Marketing Specialist will drive brand awareness, customer engagement, and e-commerce growth for an innovative skincare brand focused on microbiome science and skin health. This role combines digital marketing strategy, creative content development, performance advertising, and marketplace management. You will plan and execute campaigns across channels such as Amazon, Google Ads, search engines, and social media to strengthen brand visibility and increase sales. Working collaboratively with the wider team, you will shape brand messaging, develop influencer marketing initiatives, and create compelling content for a global audience. You will also use analytics to measure campaign performance, identify opportunities, and optimize marketing activities. This is an opportunity to contribute to a growing beauty brand as it expands its retail presence and reaches new customers.

As a Digital Marketing Specialist, you will manage and execute digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels, combining creative planning with data-driven optimization to support brand growth and e-commerce performance.

- 

Develop and execute digital marketing strategies aligned with brand objectives and growth priorities.

- 

Plan, launch, and manage advertising campaigns, promotional activities, and digital marketing initiatives.

- 

Develop and implement SEO and SEM strategies to improve search visibility and attract relevant traffic.

- 

Plan and create social media content in collaboration with the team.

- 

Coordinate influencer marketing content and initiatives to strengthen brand awareness and audience engagement.

- 

Develop brand messaging, product positioning, marketing copy, and reusable content templates.

- 

Manage and analyze digital advertising campaigns across platforms, including Amazon and Google Ads.

- 

Use analytics tools such as Google Analytics to monitor performance, interpret data, and identify optimization opportunities.

- 

Operate and manage social media accounts and online advertising channels.

- 

Oversee Amazon marketplace sales activities and plan promotions to support e-commerce growth.

- 

Contribute to global marketing content and ensure consistent brand communication across digital touchpoints.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate has practical digital marketing experience, preferably in beauty or skincare, and combines strong analytical capabilities with creative communication skills and an understanding of e-commerce channels.

- 

Approximately 3–6 years of experience in digital marketing.

- 

Experience in the beauty or skincare industry.

- 

Native or advanced proficiency in English.

- 

Native or fluent Korean language skills are a strong plus.

- 

Strong knowledge of SEO and SEM strategy, implementation, and optimization.

- 

Experience using Google Analytics to measure and evaluate digital marketing performance.

- 

Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

- 

Familiarity with digital advertising platforms and social media marketing.

- 

Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across marketing activities.

- 

Availability to coordinate with U.S. business hours, which may occasionally require additional flexibility due to the time difference with Portugal.

- 

Preferred qualifications:

- 

Ability to create basic graphic designs.

- 

Experience managing Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

- 

Experience with Amazon marketing and marketplace operations.

- 

Strong English copywriting skills and the ability to plan marketing content for global audiences.

Benefits:

- 

Annual compensation ranging from $22,000 to $28,000, paid under a contractor agreement.

- 

Remote work opportunity.

- 

Opportunity to contribute to the growth of a skincare brand operating across major retail and e-commerce channels.

- 

Exposure to international digital marketing, performance advertising, influencer campaigns, and marketplace management.

- 

Opportunity to combine creative content development with analytics-driven marketing strategy.

 How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
 Why Apply Through Jobgether? 
 
Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). job.title: Senior Email Marketing Technology & CRM Manager
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Email Marketing Technology & CRM Manager based in the United States.

The Senior Email Marketing Technology & CRM Manager will lead the technical planning and optimization of large-scale email marketing and lifecycle programs. This role focuses on Salesforce Marketing Cloud, email deliverability, audience segmentation, and the data infrastructure needed to power effective marketing campaigns. You will translate business objectives into technical requirements, ensuring that marketing initiatives are scalable, measurable, and operationally sound. Working closely with marketing, analytics, data, engineering, and operations teams, you will drive alignment and successful program execution. You will help strengthen email performance by improving audience quality, data integrity, inbox placement, and campaign readiness. This position offers the opportunity to influence marketing technology strategy and build efficient, repeatable processes within a complex enterprise environment. The role is remote, with New York preferred, and is offered as a six-month contract with a full-time, 40-hour workweek.

- 

Marketing Technology and Salesforce Marketing Cloud: Provide technical guidance on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) configuration, setup, and operational best practices. Support the planning and implementation of large-scale email marketing and lifecycle programs.

- 

Technical Strategy and Optimization: Evaluate existing marketing technology workflows and recommend improvements that enhance scalability, operational efficiency, and campaign execution.

- 

Requirements Definition: Translate marketing objectives into actionable technical specifications covering data inputs, audience logic, tracking, measurement, and governance.

- 

Email Deliverability: Advise on sender reputation, email authentication, suppression strategies, list hygiene, and inbox placement. Identify technical and operational factors that may affect deliverability and campaign performance.

- 

Audience Segmentation and Data Readiness: Define and document audience creation requirements, including eligibility criteria, exclusions, segmentation logic, and holdout groups. Partner with analytics and data teams to validate audience availability, data quality, and segmentation accuracy.

- 

Cross-Functional Program Execution: Collaborate with marketing operations, analytics, engineering, data, and campaign execution teams to ensure technical requirements are understood and programs are delivered successfully.

- 

Stakeholder Alignment: Translate complex technical concepts into clear implementation plans for business and technical stakeholders. Influence decisions and build consensus across cross-functional teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

- 

Campaign Readiness and Risk Management: Assess technical readiness before campaign launches, considering data availability, audience logic, measurement frameworks, and governance requirements. Identify potential execution risks and recommend practical solutions.

- 

Documentation and Process Improvement: Develop technical documentation, implementation guidelines, operational playbooks, and stakeholder communications to promote consistency, knowledge sharing, and scalable execution.

- 

Operational Excellence: Help establish more efficient marketing technology processes and improve the technical foundation supporting sophisticated email and lifecycle marketing initiatives.

## Requirements

- 

Professional Experience: At least 8 years of experience in email marketing technology, marketing operations, lifecycle marketing, CRM, or a related technical marketing discipline. Candidates with slightly less experience may be considered if they demonstrate exceptional expertise.

- 

Salesforce Marketing Cloud: Strong working knowledge of SFMC, including audience segmentation, data models, platform configuration, and operational workflows.

- 

Email Deliverability Expertise: Demonstrated understanding of sender reputation, authentication protocols, suppression strategies, list hygiene, and inbox placement optimization.

- 

Large-Scale Campaign Implementation: Experience supporting the technical implementation and operational execution of large-scale email marketing and lifecycle programs.

- 

Technical Requirements and Data Management: Ability to translate marketing goals into technical specifications involving audience definitions, data inputs, tracking, measurement, and governance.

- 

Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical capabilities and experience collaborating with analytics, data, and engineering teams to validate requirements, resolve issues, and improve campaign effectiveness.

- 

Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to collaborate across complex, matrixed organizations and influence stakeholders without direct managerial authority.

- 

Communication and Documentation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, document implementation processes, and facilitate stakeholder alignment.

- 

Project Coordination: Ability to coordinate implementation timelines, manage competing priorities, assess operational readiness, and drive projects forward in a dynamic environment.

- 

Preferred Qualifications: Experience supporting large-scale content strategies or lifecycle marketing programs, broader expertise in email marketing strategy and campaign planning, and familiarity with consumer technology, digital platforms, enterprise marketing environments, and distributed teams.

- 

Language: Professional proficiency in English is required.

- 

Work Authorization: Candidates must be prepared to indicate whether they require current or future employment visa sponsorship in the United States.

## Benefits

- 

Contract duration: Six-month contract position.

- 

Work arrangement: Remote work within the United States, with New York preferred.

- 

Working hours: Full-time commitment of 40 hours per week, typically eight hours per day, Monday through Friday.

- 

Health insurance: Medical coverage options to support employee health and well-being.

- 

Dental and vision insurance: Coverage options for dental and vision care.

- 

Health Savings Account (HSA): Access to a health savings account.

- 

Life insurance: Life insurance coverage.

- 

Retirement plan: Access to a retirement savings plan.

- 

Paid time off: Paid leave to support personal needs and work-life balance.

- 

Professional impact: The opportunity to shape the technical infrastructure behind sophisticated email marketing programs and improve marketing effectiveness at scale.
