job.title: Head of Marketing & Growth
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Marketing & Growth based in United States.

We are looking for a strategic marketing leader to take ownership of the entire marketing function and accelerate the growth of a rapidly expanding brand in the German-speaking coaching and personal transformation market. You will shape the long-term marketing strategy, lead high-performing teams, and turn individual initiatives into a cohesive, results-driven growth system. Your scope will span performance marketing, CRM, email marketing, social media, content, product launches, and live events. Working closely with executive leadership, you will make data-informed decisions, optimize budgets, and build scalable processes that support sustainable business growth. This role combines strategic responsibility with hands-on leadership in a dynamic, people-focused environment. Although remote work is possible, frequent travel to events, productions, and team meetings in Germany and occasionally elsewhere in Europe is an essential part of the position.

As Head of Marketing & Growth, you will lead the marketing function from strategy through execution, ensuring that teams, campaigns, and budgets contribute to the organization's broader business objectives. Your responsibilities will include:

- 

Marketing strategy: Develop and implement a comprehensive marketing and growth strategy in collaboration with executive leadership, aligned with long-term business goals.

- 

Team leadership: Lead, develop, and motivate the internal marketing team while managing external agencies, contractors, and service providers.

- 

Campaign and launch management: Plan and oversee product launches, marketing campaigns, sales funnels, and promotional initiatives.

- 

Performance marketing: Drive performance marketing activities and optimize acquisition strategies to improve campaign effectiveness and business results.

- 

CRM and lifecycle marketing: Oversee CRM, email marketing, social media, and content initiatives to strengthen audience engagement and customer relationships.

- 

Live events and productions: Coordinate marketing activities connected to live events, content productions, and other brand experiences.

- 

Performance analysis: Monitor relevant KPIs, evaluate campaign results, identify opportunities, and translate data into actionable improvements.

- 

Budget ownership: Manage marketing budgets, allocate resources effectively, and take responsibility for marketing performance.

- 

Process development: Build efficient marketing processes, establish clear structures, and improve collaboration across the marketing function.

- 

Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with executive leadership, sales, event management, and fulfillment teams to ensure coordinated execution and a consistent customer experience.

- 

Brand development: Contribute to the long-term positioning and growth of the brand across coaching, personal development, health, and transformation offerings.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced marketing leader who combines strategic vision, strong people management, analytical thinking, and an entrepreneurial approach. You should be comfortable taking ownership of business outcomes while leading teams through a fast-moving growth environment. Key qualifications include:

- 

Several years of experience in a senior marketing leadership position.

- 

Proven experience building, managing, and developing high-performing marketing teams.

- 

Strong strategic and commercial thinking, with the ability to translate business objectives into effective marketing and growth plans.

- 

Excellent analytical skills and confidence working with marketing KPIs, performance metrics, and budgets.

- 

Experience managing product launches, marketing funnels, and digital marketing processes.

- 

Broad understanding of performance marketing, CRM, email marketing, social media, and content strategy.

- 

Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

- 

A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented working style, with a high degree of autonomy and accountability.

- 

The ability to manage multiple initiatives, coordinate internal and external stakeholders, and prioritize effectively.

- 

Willingness to travel frequently and enthusiasm for attending live events, content productions, and in-person team meetings.

- 

Flexibility to work remotely while maintaining close collaboration with colleagues across different locations.

Benefits:

- 

Employment type: Full-time, permanent employment.

- 

Work arrangement: Flexible remote work combined with regular business travel.

- 

Leadership opportunity: Take ownership of the entire marketing function and play a central role in business growth.

- 

Strategic influence: Work directly with executive leadership on long-term marketing strategy and key business decisions.

- 

Creative autonomy: Enjoy significant scope to shape marketing initiatives, processes, and team structures.

- 

Collaborative environment: Join an ambitious team with short decision-making paths and close collaboration across functions.

- 

High-visibility projects: Lead impactful campaigns, product launches, live events, and content productions.

- 

Travel opportunities: Participate in events, productions, and team meetings in Germany and occasionally other European locations.

- 

Professional development: Access opportunities for personal and professional growth while expanding your leadership experience.

- 

Brand-building impact: Help shape the future of a growing brand in the coaching and personal transformation market.

- 

Start date: As soon as possible.

-

Join a fast-growing blockchain ecosystem working to expand the adoption of decentralized technology across businesses and financial markets. Go-to-Market Collaboration: Work closely with business development, go-to-market, and content teams to understand pipeline priorities, identify partnership opportunities, and determine where collaborative marketing can generate the greatest impact.

- 

Campaign Measurement and Optimization: Define campaign objectives and success metrics upfront, monitor performance, evaluate outcomes, and use insights to improve future marketing initiatives.

A solid understanding of the cryptocurrency and blockchain ecosystem, with the ability to communicate credibly with both crypto-native organizations and traditional businesses.

Familiarity with decentralized finance (DeFi), payments, stablecoins, tokenization, or financial infrastructure is a strong advantage.

job.title: Manager, Product Marketing
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Manager, Product Marketing based in the United States.

The Manager, Product Marketing will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing go-to-market strategies for enterprise B2B SaaS solutions within the digital supply chain technology sector. You will drive product positioning, messaging, launches, and promotional initiatives that strengthen market differentiation and accelerate business growth. Working closely with product, sales, and marketing teams, you will translate complex technology capabilities into compelling value propositions that resonate with enterprise buyers. Through customer research, competitive intelligence, and market analysis, you will identify opportunities to refine target audiences, optimize product packaging, and improve commercial performance. You will also equip sales teams with the resources and insights they need to increase pipeline generation, deal velocity, and conversion rates. This remote opportunity is ideal for a strategic, customer-focused marketing professional who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is passionate about transforming supply chain operations through technology.

- Go-to-Market Strategy and Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies, product positioning, messaging, packaging, and promotional plans across a portfolio of enterprise SaaS solutions. Partner with sales and marketing leaders to refine ideal customer profiles (ICPs), establish quarterly growth priorities, and align initiatives with broader business objectives.

- Product Launches and Portfolio Management: Lead end-to-end product launch planning, coordination, and execution, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful releases, effective market communication, and strong customer adoption across multiple products.

- Market Research and Competitive Intelligence: Conduct customer research, analyze industry trends, and evaluate the competitive landscape to identify market opportunities, strengthen differentiation, and inform product marketing priorities, packaging decisions, and campaign strategies.

- Sales Enablement and Revenue Growth: Develop and deliver sales enablement materials, competitive positioning tools, and practical resources that help sales teams communicate product value, accelerate sales cycles, improve win rates, and drive pipeline and revenue growth.

- Customer-Centric Messaging and Content Development: Collaborate with content and marketing teams to create compelling marketing assets, including case studies, product videos, whitepapers, blog posts, and solution-focused materials. Translate complex technical concepts into clear, persuasive messaging tailored to different buyer personas and stages of the purchasing journey.

job.title: Director, Newsletter & Email Marketing
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Newsletter & Email Marketing based in the United States.

We are seeking a hands-on email marketing leader to oversee and scale a high-volume, revenue-generating newsletter program serving audiences across 22 markets. In this role, you will drive newsletter strategy, campaign execution, audience engagement, deliverability, and commercial performance while protecting the subscriber experience. You will manage more than 40 campaigns per week alongside automated lifecycle journeys, sponsored placements, and targeted product marketing initiatives. Working closely with marketing leadership, advertising sales, merchant partners, and analytics teams, you will turn campaign data into actionable insights that strengthen monetization and long-term audience value. As a player-coach, you will combine strategic direction with hands-on execution, technical expertise, and team development. This is an opportunity to shape a global email marketing operation, improve performance at scale, and build a more personalized, data-driven communication experience.

- 

Lead newsletter strategy and monetization: Develop and execute a global newsletter roadmap across 22 markets, balancing sponsored placements, commissionable offers, campaign frequency, audience engagement, and long-term subscriber health.

- 

Manage high-volume campaign execution: Oversee more than 40 newsletter campaigns per week, managing planning, creative development, quality assurance, scheduling, deployment, and post-campaign analysis.

- 

Optimize commercial performance: Partner with advertising sales and merchant teams to advise on inventory, placements, targeting, and campaign best practices, using reliable performance data to improve partner outcomes and revenue potential.

- 

Own deliverability and sender reputation: Manage inbox placement, sending-domain health, IP and domain warm-up, email authentication protocols (SPF, DKIM, and DMARC), list hygiene, audience data quality, and mailbox-provider requirements across multiple markets.

- 

Drive experimentation and optimization: Develop mobile-first, flexible email templates and run continuous A/B testing across creative, offers, segmentation, personalization, and send timing to improve engagement and campaign effectiveness.

- 

Build audience segmentation and personalization: Deliver targeted messaging based on market, client, member behavior, and relevant preferences, ensuring that audience selection and campaign placements respect client-specific settings.

- 

Develop lifecycle marketing journeys: Design and optimize automated activation, welcome, re-engagement, and win-back campaigns that increase engagement, improve retention, and strengthen long-term member value.

- 

Support product marketing and go-to-market initiatives: Oversee targeted campaigns that increase awareness and adoption of proprietary products and service categories, collaborating with marketing stakeholders on launch objectives and execution.

- 

Establish performance measurement and reporting: Define and monitor key performance indicators across engagement, deliverability, lifecycle, and commercial outcomes, including open rates, click-through rates (CTR), click-to-open rates (CTOR), and sender reputation.

- 

Ensure trustworthy analytics: Maintain accurate, defensible campaign and partner reporting, accounting for bots, email scanners, prefetch activity, and other invalid traffic that may distort engagement metrics, in partnership with analytics teams.

- 

Lead and develop the email marketing team: Coach and manage a growing team of email marketers and specialists, establishing clear expectations, encouraging professional development, and maintaining high execution standards.

- 

Improve operational processes: Strengthen campaign intake, approvals, quality assurance, reporting, and cross-functional communication to improve efficiency, consistency, and accountability.

- 

Manage technology and vendor relationships: Oversee relationships with email service providers (ESPs), customer data platforms (CDPs), and deliverability vendors, contributing to platform strategy, capability assessments, and potential migrations.

- 

Maintain regulatory compliance: Ensure email marketing practices comply with applicable privacy and email regulations, including CAN-SPAM, CASL, and GDPR, while overseeing consent, subscription, and preference management.

- 

Collaborate with senior leadership: Serve as a strategic partner to marketing leadership, communicating campaign performance, emerging trends, risks, and priorities while recommending data-driven improvements.

## Requirements:

- 

Extensive email marketing experience: At least nine years of hands-on email marketing experience in a high-volume environment, including seven or more years managing newsletters or email programs monetized through sponsored placements, affiliate revenue, or commissionable offers.

- 

Newsletter monetization expertise: Demonstrated experience operating recurring newsletter programs, maintaining campaign and inventory calendars, balancing paid placements with audience needs, and optimizing commercial performance.

- 

Advanced deliverability knowledge: Deep practical expertise in inbox placement, sender reputation, IP and domain warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, list hygiene, and mailbox-provider relationships.

- 

Enterprise marketing technology proficiency: Hands-on mastery of a major enterprise email service provider and CDP or marketing automation stack. Experience with Iterable, Lytics, or comparable platforms is particularly relevant.

- 

Segmentation and automation expertise: Strong command of audience segmentation, behavioral targeting, dynamic content, personalization, triggered campaigns, automated lifecycle journeys, and marketing automation workflows.

- 

Campaign optimization skills: Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, developing reusable email templates, improving campaign quality, and translating findings into practical optimization strategies.

- 

Analytics and attribution expertise: Advanced understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, performance measurement, KPI development, and dashboard reporting, including the ability to distinguish genuine engagement from invalid traffic.

- 

People leadership: A proven track record of managing, mentoring, and developing high-performing email marketing teams while maintaining a hands-on approach to execution and problem-solving.

- 

Commercial and cross-functional judgment: Ability to balance revenue objectives, partner requirements, audience experience, deliverability, and long-term subscriber value while collaborating across marketing, sales, merchant, and analytics functions.

- 

Communication and stakeholder management: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present performance insights and strategic recommendations clearly to partners, executives, and cross-functional teams.

- 

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

- 

Preferred industry background: Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, employee perks and benefits, affiliate marketing, deals, newsletter publishing, or media monetization.

- 

Additional preferred experience: Familiarity with HR benefits and employee engagement, multi-tenant marketing programs, product marketing and go-to-market campaigns, global email operations, and ESP evaluation or migration.

- 

Working style: A strategic yet execution-oriented leader who can manage competing priorities, solve technical challenges, continuously test new approaches, and develop scalable processes.

## Benefits:

- 

Annual compensation: $115,000–$130,000 base salary, plus bonus.

- 

Medical and dental insurance: Employer pays 75% of monthly contributions.

- 

Telehealth coverage: 100% employer-paid.

- 

Vision insurance: 100% employer-paid monthly contributions.

- 

Domestic partner coverage: Available across all insurance plans.

- 

Life insurance: 100% employer-paid life insurance.

- 

Retirement savings: 401(k) retirement plan options, including an employer contribution.

- 

Paid time off: Generous paid time off (PTO) and sick time off (STO) programs.

- 

Parental leave: Paid maternity and paternity leave policies.

- 

Paid holidays: 11 holidays annually, including an office closure day after Thanksgiving.

-

job.title: Head of Influencer Marketing
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Influencer Marketing based in United States.

Lead the development and execution of creative influencer marketing strategies for leading B2C brands across the DACH region. In this role, you will shape creator-led campaigns that capture attention, engage audiences, and deliver measurable business results across social media platforms. You will take ownership of creator management processes, develop compelling campaign concepts and scripts, and collaborate closely with company founders to drive creative excellence. By combining a strong understanding of social media trends with data-driven decision-making, you will continuously improve content performance and campaign effectiveness. You will also gain access to advanced creative training designed to help you identify and develop high-performing content. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for a creative, ambitious professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to make a meaningful impact on brand growth.

- Influencer Marketing Strategy: Lead the development and implementation of influencer marketing strategies for major consumer brands across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH).

- Creator Management: Oversee creator-related processes, ensuring effective collaboration with influencers and content creators throughout campaign planning and execution.

- Creative Concepts and Scriptwriting: Develop engaging creative concepts, campaign briefs, and scripts that align with brand objectives, resonate with target audiences, and encourage meaningful engagement.

- Campaign Development: Translate marketing objectives into compelling creator-led campaigns, ensuring creative consistency and alignment with each brand's positioning and goals.

- Founder Collaboration: Work closely with company founders to define priorities, refine creative strategies, and contribute to the overall growth of the business and its clients.

- Performance Analysis: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), evaluate campaign results, and identify opportunities to improve content effectiveness and marketing outcomes.

- Creative Optimisation: Analyse content assets and identify successful creative formats, messaging approaches, and creator partnerships to strengthen campaign performance.

- Trend and Talent Discovery: Stay informed about emerging social media trends, creator opportunities, audience preferences, and high-performing content formats to maintain a competitive edge.

- Continuous Improvement: Apply insights from campaign performance and advanced creative training to refine processes, improve creative output, and support scalable influencer marketing operations.

## Requirements

- Relevant Experience: Proven experience in creative strategy, ideally within a marketing agency or brand environment, with a strong understanding of influencer marketing and creator-led campaigns.

- Influencer and Social Media Expertise: A solid understanding of social media platforms, creator ecosystems, audience engagement, and the factors that contribute to successful influencer campaigns.

- Creative Thinking: The ability to develop original concepts, write compelling scripts, and translate marketing objectives into engaging content ideas that resonate with target audiences.

- Trend Awareness: A strong instinct for identifying emerging social media trends, recognising high-performing content, and understanding what makes creators and campaigns successful.

- Analytical Skills: The ability to interpret campaign KPIs, evaluate creative performance, and use data-driven insights to optimise content and marketing strategies.

- Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a genuine ability to understand people, build relationships, and collaborate effectively with creators and internal stakeholders.

- Strategic Mindset: The ability to connect creative execution with broader business objectives, prioritise effectively, and make informed decisions in a dynamic environment.

- Ownership and Initiative: A proactive, ambitious, and results-oriented approach, with the willingness to take responsibility, solve problems independently, and go the extra mile to achieve outstanding results.

- Commitment and Availability: The ability to dedicate the necessary time and energy to a demanding, growth-oriented role while maintaining high standards of execution.

- Remote Working Skills: Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively in a fully remote environment.

## Benefits

- Competitive Salary: Earn between €5,000 and €10,000 per month, depending on experience and suitability for the role.

- Permanent Employment: Secure a long-term employment opportunity with the potential to grow alongside an expanding business.

- Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Flexible Working Hours: Enjoy flexibility in organising your schedule while remaining focused on campaign delivery and business outcomes.

- Professional Development: Access advanced creative training valued at over €100,000 to strengthen your strategic thinking and creative execution skills.

- Performance-Based Incentives: Opportunity to participate in success-sharing arrangements linked to business performance.

job.title: English to Bosnian (Cyrillic) Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an English to Bosnian (Cyrillic) Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content based in United States.

Take ownership of linguistic quality for a major global technology client, ensuring consistent, accurate, and culturally appropriate content across multiple digital channels. As the English to Bosnian (Cyrillic) Review Lead, you will serve as the primary linguistic expert for your locale, translating client expectations into clear quality standards for reviewers and post-editors. You will work closely with client stakeholders to resolve linguistic questions, manage escalations, and improve localization outcomes. Through coaching, calibration sessions, and data-driven quality analysis, you will strengthen the consistency of UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. This freelance opportunity offers approximately 24 hours of work per month, with remote flexibility and collaboration across international teams. You will contribute to high-visibility technology projects while building a long-term professional partnership.

As the English to Bosnian (Cyrillic) Review Lead, you will oversee linguistic quality, guide the reviewer community, and maintain alignment between client expectations and localization practices. You will be accountable for quality performance, effective arbitration, and continuous improvement across the assigned locale. Your main responsibilities will include:

- 

Analyse style guides, glossary updates, and client requirements to identify their impact on quality categories and content types, documenting changes and communicating expectations clearly.

- 

Track client feedback, corrections, and decisions made during calibration and quality discussions to capture both documented standards and implicit expectations.

- 

Serve as the primary linguistic point of contact for the client's Language Manager, handling clarifications, quality discussions, escalations, and arbitration.

- 

Organise regular alignment roundtables with reviewers and post-editors to establish a consistent understanding of linguistic quality standards.

- 

Prepare structured monthly quality reports covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, recurring errors, and arbitration outcomes.

- 

Coach reviewers individually using concrete examples, conduct shadowing sessions, and deliver targeted training based on real quality and alignment data.

- 

Monitor the locale's review service score, including RQE audit results and alignment performance, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.

- 

Maintain accurate, evidence-based arbitration records and ensure that every issue escalated to the client is valid, well-supported, and aligned with established procedures.

- 

Identify recurring error patterns and justification trends, translating findings into well-reasoned proposals for style guide improvements.

- 

Share cross-locale quality insights with the Quality Manager to support broader quality governance and continuous improvement.

- 

Build a strong working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, ensuring that decisions are implemented consistently and expectations are increasingly aligned.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced localization quality professional with strong linguistic expertise in Bosnian (Cyrillic), proven stakeholder management skills, and a data-driven approach to quality governance. You should be comfortable making informed linguistic decisions, facilitating discussions, coaching reviewers, and resolving complex quality issues in a technology-focused environment. The following qualifications and skills are required:

- 

At least 3–5 years of experience in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), senior language leadership, or quality governance roles.

- 

Native-level proficiency in Bosnian (Cyrillic) and professional-level English.

- 

Direct experience serving as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers or equivalent stakeholders.

- 

Proven experience managing formal arbitration and escalation processes, including evidence-based decision-making and conflict resolution.

- 

Strong practical knowledge of localization quality evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping.

- 

Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and apply appropriate quality tolerances across different content types, including marketing, legal, and UI content.

- 

Hands-on experience facilitating one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment meetings, and structured monthly quality reporting.

- 

Strong analytical skills, including the ability to track error concentrations, severity trends, and alignment scores.

- 

Ability to convert recurring linguistic issues and reviewer justifications into actionable recommendations for improving style guides and quality standards.

- 

Excellent communication, organisation, and stakeholder management skills.

- 

Experience supporting major technology localization programmes and using calibration or alignment tools is an advantage.

- 

Willingness to complete a background check as part of the onboarding process.

- 

Must be physically located in an approved country, including India, for the duration of the engagement.

Benefits:

- 

Fully remote freelance engagement, provided you are based in an approved country.

- 

Approximately 24 hours of work per month, offering flexibility for other professional commitments.

- 

Long-term collaboration on high-visibility products with international teams.

- 

Steady project volume and the opportunity to build an ongoing professional partnership.

- 

Comprehensive onboarding to support a smooth start.

- 

Access to ongoing training, upskilling opportunities, and established linguistic resources.

- 

A dedicated device provided for project-related work.

- 

Opportunity to influence localization quality standards and contribute to continuous improvement across a global technology programme.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an English to Bosnian (Cyrillic) Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content based in United States.

Take ownership of linguistic quality for a major global technology client, ensuring consistent, accurate, and culturally appropriate content across multiple digital channels. As the English to Bosnian (Cyrillic) Review Lead, you will serve as the primary linguistic expert for your locale, translating client expectations into clear quality standards for reviewers and post-editors. You will work closely with client stakeholders to resolve linguistic questions, manage escalations, and improve localization outcomes. Through coaching, calibration sessions, and data-driven quality analysis, you will strengthen the consistency of UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. This freelance opportunity offers approximately 24 hours of work per month, with remote flexibility and collaboration across international teams. You will contribute to high-visibility technology projects while building a long-term professional partnership.

As the English to Bosnian (Cyrillic) Review Lead, you will oversee linguistic quality, guide the reviewer community, and maintain alignment between client expectations and localization practices. You will be accountable for quality performance, effective arbitration, and continuous improvement across the assigned locale. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Analyse style guides, glossary updates, and client requirements to identify their impact on quality categories and content types, documenting changes and communicating expectations clearly.

  • Track client feedback, corrections, and decisions made during calibration and quality discussions to capture both documented standards and implicit expectations.

  • Serve as the primary linguistic point of contact for the client's Language Manager, handling clarifications, quality discussions, escalations, and arbitration.

  • Organise regular alignment roundtables with reviewers and post-editors to establish a consistent understanding of linguistic quality standards.

  • Prepare structured monthly quality reports covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, recurring errors, and arbitration outcomes.

  • Coach reviewers individually using concrete examples, conduct shadowing sessions, and deliver targeted training based on real quality and alignment data.

  • Monitor the locale's review service score, including RQE audit results and alignment performance, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.

  • Maintain accurate, evidence-based arbitration records and ensure that every issue escalated to the client is valid, well-supported, and aligned with established procedures.

  • Identify recurring error patterns and justification trends, translating findings into well-reasoned proposals for style guide improvements.

  • Share cross-locale quality insights with the Quality Manager to support broader quality governance and continuous improvement.

  • Build a strong working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, ensuring that decisions are implemented consistently and expectations are increasingly aligned.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced localization quality professional with strong linguistic expertise in Bosnian (Cyrillic), proven stakeholder management skills, and a data-driven approach to quality governance. You should be comfortable making informed linguistic decisions, facilitating discussions, coaching reviewers, and resolving complex quality issues in a technology-focused environment. The following qualifications and skills are required:

    • At least 3–5 years of experience in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), senior language leadership, or quality governance roles.

    • Native-level proficiency in Bosnian (Cyrillic) and professional-level English.

    • Direct experience serving as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers or equivalent stakeholders.

    • Proven experience managing formal arbitration and escalation processes, including evidence-based decision-making and conflict resolution.

    • Strong practical knowledge of localization quality evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping.

    • Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and apply appropriate quality tolerances across different content types, including marketing, legal, and UI content.

    • Hands-on experience facilitating one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment meetings, and structured monthly quality reporting.

    • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to track error concentrations, severity trends, and alignment scores.

    • Ability to convert recurring linguistic issues and reviewer justifications into actionable recommendations for improving style guides and quality standards.

    • Excellent communication, organisation, and stakeholder management skills.

    • Experience supporting major technology localization programmes and using calibration or alignment tools is an advantage.

    • Willingness to complete a background check as part of the onboarding process.

    • Must be physically located in an approved country, including India, for the duration of the engagement.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote freelance engagement, provided you are based in an approved country.

      • Approximately 24 hours of work per month, offering flexibility for other professional commitments.

      • Long-term collaboration on high-visibility products with international teams.

      • Steady project volume and the opportunity to build an ongoing professional partnership.

      • Comprehensive onboarding to support a smooth start.

      • Access to ongoing training, upskilling opportunities, and established linguistic resources.

      • A dedicated device provided for project-related work.

      • Opportunity to influence localization quality standards and contribute to continuous improvement across a global technology programme.

job.title: Content Marketing Manager
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Content Marketing Manager based in the United States.

Join an innovative B2B technology company transforming how businesses engage with key decision-makers through account-based marketing solutions. As a Content Marketing Manager, you will own the content strategy and execution across multiple channels, shaping the brand's voice and strengthening its market presence. You will create compelling, insight-driven content that goes beyond generic messaging to engage audiences, build credibility, and support revenue growth. Working closely with marketing teams, particularly SEO specialists, you will balance editorial excellence with discoverability and measurable business impact. From website content and thought leadership to email campaigns and customer stories, you will have the autonomy to develop ideas and bring them to life. This fully remote, individual contributor role is ideal for a strategic thinker and hands-on writer who values creativity, originality, and high-quality storytelling.

- 

Content Strategy and Planning: Own the content marketing strategy and editorial calendar, identifying relevant topics, compelling narratives, and effective formats that align with business objectives and audience needs.

- 

Content Creation and Editorial Management: Write, edit, and produce high-quality content across websites, blogs, thought leadership articles, customer success stories, reports, and other marketing assets.

- 

SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Collaborate with SEO specialists to improve organic visibility and discoverability across traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences while maintaining strong editorial standards.

- 

Email Marketing: Develop and manage content and copy for newsletters, email nurture sequences, campaign communications, and customer-facing messages, ensuring consistency and relevance throughout the customer journey.

- 

Content Distribution and Promotion: Partner with channel owners to identify distribution opportunities, repurpose successful content, and extend the reach and impact of key assets across marketing channels.

- 

Editorial Quality and Brand Voice: Establish and maintain high editorial standards, ensuring all published content is clear, distinctive, engaging, accurate, and aligned with the brand's positioning.

- 

Audience Research and Thought Leadership: Research customer challenges, industry developments, and emerging marketing trends to uncover original insights and develop content that offers meaningful value to target audiences.

- 

Performance Analysis and Optimization: Evaluate content effectiveness and use performance data to refine editorial priorities, improve engagement, and strengthen the contribution of content to marketing pipeline growth.

- 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing stakeholders to generate ideas, support campaign objectives, and ensure content initiatives contribute to broader business and revenue goals.

## Requirements

- 

Professional Experience: At least five years of experience in content marketing, editorial, or a related role, preferably within B2B technology or SaaS. Experience in marketing technology, advertising technology, or account-based marketing (ABM) is a strong advantage.

- 

Writing Portfolio: A strong portfolio of personally written content demonstrating original thinking, exceptional writing and editing skills, and the ability to adapt messaging across formats and audiences.

- 

Content Strategy Expertise: Proven experience managing content strategy and execution from ideation and planning through production, distribution, and performance evaluation.

- 

Exceptional Writing and Editing: The ability to simplify complex technical or business concepts without losing their meaning, while producing clear, engaging, and persuasive content.

- 

Strong Editorial Judgment: A demonstrated ability to recognize compelling ideas, challenge conventional approaches, identify opportunities for improvement, and maintain consistently high content standards.

- 

Strategic Thinking and Creativity: A distinctive point of view on marketing and technology, with the curiosity to explore new perspectives and develop original content ideas that stand out in a competitive market.

- 

SEO and Content Optimization: Familiarity with SEO principles, keyword-driven content planning, and emerging approaches to content discoverability, including GEO, is beneficial.

- 

Customer-Centric Mindset: The ability to understand audience needs and buying behavior through research, conversations, industry analysis, and performance data.

- 

Analytical Skills: Comfort using content performance insights to inform editorial decisions, prioritize initiatives, and improve marketing effectiveness.

- 

Ownership and Execution: A proactive, independent working style with the ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on content production in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

- 

Adaptability and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, openness to experimentation, and the ability to work effectively with multiple marketing functions while managing competing priorities.

## Benefits

- 

Fully remote work: Flexibility to work from where you are most productive, without fixed working hours.

- 

Unlimited vacation policy: Time off designed to support work-life balance and personal well-being.

- 

Comprehensive healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage.

- 

Parental leave: Generous parental leave provisions and additional paid time off policies.

- 

Creative autonomy: Direct ownership of content strategy and brand storytelling, with opportunities to experiment, develop new formats, and bring original ideas to life.

- 

Professional impact: The opportunity to influence brand positioning, strengthen market visibility, and contribute directly to marketing pipeline growth.

- 

Growth-oriented environment: Work within an established B2B technology business that has raised $15 million in Series A funding, maintained cash-positive operations for 24 months, and achieved 50% growth, according to the original job posting.

- 

Inclusive culture: A workplace that values diverse perspectives, professional competence, equal opportunity, and respectful collaboration.

 How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). The Senior Growth Marketing Manager will drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across the Business & Government market by building and executing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns. This role connects go-to-market strategy with measurable pipeline generation, combining account-based marketing, digital demand generation, and field event activation. You will own campaign planning and execution from initial brief through launch, optimization, and performance reporting, with direct accountability for pipeline contribution and conversion outcomes. Working closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Customer Growth teams, you will align messaging, audience targeting, and campaign performance with business objectives. You will also lead data-driven event strategies and explore AI-powered workflows to improve personalization, efficiency, and campaign effectiveness. This is an opportunity for a strategic yet hands-on marketer who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and embraces emerging technologies to accelerate growth.

- 

Campaign Strategy and Execution: Own the integrated campaign calendar for new customer acquisition across the Business & Government segment, defining measurable pipeline targets for every program. Translate go-to-market positioning and competitive differentiation into compelling, audience-specific campaigns and assets.

- 

Multi-Channel Demand Generation: Plan and execute campaigns across paid media, email, content syndication, webinars, and field events. Coordinate with channel teams to maximize performance and ensure programs complement one another.

- 

Account-Based Marketing: Design, launch, and optimize account-based marketing programs targeting priority organizations, using account-level insights and buying signals to improve engagement and conversion.

- 

AI-Driven Marketing Innovation: Build and implement AI-powered workflows and automations for campaign analysis, audience personalization, and performance optimization. Support visibility in AI-generated research environments by coordinating generative engine optimization initiatives and adapting strategies to evolving buyer behavior.

- 

Field and Event Marketing: Coordinate regional activations, roadshows, executive dinners, partner-hosted events, and conference participation in collaboration with the Events team. Contribute to flagship customer events by integrating field activities with broader campaign strategies and pipeline objectives.

- 

Pipeline Generation and Attribution: Own a direct pipeline contribution target, monitor results weekly, and adjust campaigns when performance falls short. Partner with Marketing Intelligence to establish campaign-level targets, analyze intent data, track sourced and influenced pipeline, and maintain multi-touch attribution models.

- 

Content and Asset Development: Collaborate with Content, Brand, Creative, and Product Marketing teams to develop landing pages, nurture emails, digital advertisements, one-pagers, sales enablement materials, event briefs, and post-event follow-up sequences.

- 

Marketing Operations and Lead Management: Work with Marketing Operations to support audience segmentation, lead routing, campaign tracking, and reporting through HubSpot or Marketo and Salesforce.

- 

Customer Growth Coordination: Identify customer engagement trends, advocacy opportunities, and expansion signals, sharing relevant insights with Customer Growth and Advocacy teams to inform post-sale initiatives.

- 

Performance Reporting and Optimization: Track key performance indicators, including pipeline contribution, MQL-to-SQL conversion, closed-won rates, cost per opportunity, and event ROI. Test and optimize messaging, creative assets, calls to action, and audience segments.

- 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Present campaign insights and recommendations during weekly pipeline reviews, partner closely with Sales and Customer Success, and influence stakeholders across teams to improve execution and ensure accurate campaign attribution.

## Requirements

- 

Professional Experience: 8–10 years of experience in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, ideally within EdTech, SaaS, or another complex enterprise environment.

- 

Pipeline Generation Expertise: Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns that generate qualified pipeline and contribute measurably to revenue, rather than focusing solely on lead volume.

- 

Account-Based Marketing: Hands-on experience designing, executing, and measuring account-based marketing programs at the target-account level.

- 

Field and Event Marketing: Experience managing conference participation, regional marketing programs, and event budgets from planning through execution, including post-event attribution and ROI measurement.

- 

AI and Automation Skills: Practical experience building AI-enabled workflows and automations as part of day-to-day marketing operations, with examples of implementation and measurable results.

- 

Marketing Technology: Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or Marketo and Salesforce, including lead management, campaign tracking, and attribution processes.

- 

Intent Data and Targeting: Experience using intent data platforms such as 6sense, Demandbase, or similar tools to identify buying signals, prioritize audiences, and personalize campaigns.

- 

Paid Media and Agency Management: Experience managing paid media agency relationships across search, display, and programmatic advertising, as well as coordinating creative production.

- 

Analytics and Optimization: Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, take initiative, and make evidence-based adjustments.

- 

Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex positioning into persuasive campaign copy, clear creative briefs, and executive-ready performance summaries.

- 

Collaboration and Ownership: Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, coordinate cross-functional contributors, and influence Sales and Marketing stakeholders while maintaining productive relationships.

- 

Language Proficiency: Fluency in written and spoken English.

- 

Preferred Qualifications: Experience marketing to corporate, government, or public-sector audiences; familiarity with generative engine optimization (GEO) and improving visibility in AI-generated answers; experience with AI-powered sales development platforms or outbound sequencing tools; and involvement in flagship customer events or user conferences as part of integrated campaign strategies.

Competitive base salary: Expected annual salary range of $105,200–$150,000. The final offer depends on experience, skills, internal equity, and geographic location.

job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Executive Director, Marketing Strategy & Partnerships based in the United States.

The Executive Director, Marketing Strategy & Partnerships will lead enterprise marketing, market development, and strategic partnership initiatives to accelerate growth across defense, government, and commercial markets.
This senior leadership role combines corporate marketing, brand positioning, demand generation, and ecosystem development to strengthen market presence and drive measurable business results.
The successful candidate will shape go-to-market strategies for AI-enabled decision-support technologies, translating complex technical capabilities into compelling value propositions for customers and partners.
A key priority will be building strategic relationships with industry leaders, technology providers, and systems integrators to expand market access and create new business opportunities.
Working closely with executive leadership, product management, business development, and capture teams, the role will connect market intelligence with commercialization strategies and growth priorities.
The Executive Director will also lead thought leadership, customer engagement, and industry representation while developing a high-performing marketing and partnerships function.
This opportunity is ideal for a strategic, commercially minded leader who thrives in a collaborative, mission-driven environment and can turn ambitious growth objectives into measurable impact.

- 

Strategic Growth and Market Development

- 

Develop and execute annual and multi-year marketing strategies aligned with enterprise growth objectives, pipeline generation, and revenue targets.

- 

Lead market intelligence initiatives to assess competitive positioning, customer needs, emerging technologies, and industry trends.

- 

Identify market-entry and expansion opportunities, defining priority segments, target customers, programs, and distribution channels.

- 

Provide executive leadership with data-driven recommendations on market opportunities, competitive strategy, and investment priorities.

- 

Collaborate with product management to inform product roadmaps, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market readiness.

- 

Brand Strategy and Corporate Marketing

- 

Develop and implement corporate marketing strategies that strengthen brand awareness, market positioning, and competitive differentiation.

- 

Establish compelling positioning for AI-enabled decision-support solutions and help define the broader decision-support technology category.

- 

Lead executive thought leadership initiatives, including conference presentations, articles, white papers, podcasts, and media engagement.

- 

Oversee public relations, strategic communications, analyst and influencer relations, and reputation management.

- 

Direct website strategy, digital presence, and content development to reflect organizational capabilities and business priorities.

- 

Demand Generation and Growth Enablement

- 

Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital channels, events, content, and direct customer engagement to generate qualified pipeline.

- 

Align marketing activities with capture and business development strategies to influence requirements and accelerate opportunity creation.

- 

Develop sales and capture enablement materials, including customer profiles, competitive analyses, battle cards, demonstration narratives, and proposal-ready content.

- 

Own trade show and event strategy, from selection and messaging through execution and post-event follow-up.

- 

Gather customer feedback and win/loss insights to inform marketing positioning, product development, and growth planning.

- 

Strategic Partnerships and Ecosystem Development

- 

Define and execute a partnership strategy spanning prime contractors, systems integrators, sensor and effector providers, technology companies, platform providers, academic institutions, and industry associations.

- 

Identify, negotiate, and manage strategic alliances, teaming agreements, channel partnerships, and co-marketing relationships.

- 

Develop joint go-to-market plans with partners, including shared messaging, demonstrations, and business development pursuits.

- 

Collaborate with capture and contracts teams to structure partnership arrangements that strengthen positioning in priority opportunities.

- 

Monitor partner performance and partner-generated pipeline, prioritizing relationships that deliver measurable business value.

- 

Industry Leadership and Corporate Representation

- 

Represent the organization at industry conferences, trade shows, executive meetings, and professional forums.

- 

Build relationships with customers, government leaders, industry influencers, investors, and media representatives.

- 

Expand participation in industry associations, working groups, and innovation networks.

- 

Team Leadership and Operational Excellence

- 

Lead, develop, and scale the marketing and partnerships team, including external agencies and contractors.

- 

Manage the marketing and partnerships budget, allocating resources to the initiatives with the greatest expected return.

- 

Establish performance indicators, dashboards, and reporting processes, reviewing results with growth leadership quarterly and adjusting strategies as needed.

- 

Ensure marketing content and partner activities comply with contractual obligations, export controls, and public-release requirements.

- 

Foster a collaborative, accountable team culture focused on shared goals, continuous learning, resilience, and measurable outcomes.

## Requirements

- 

U.S. citizenship is required.

- 

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a relevant technical discipline; a master’s degree or MBA is preferred.

- 

At least 10 years of progressive experience in marketing, growth strategy, business development, or strategic partnerships, including a minimum of five years in leadership positions.

- 

Demonstrated success building and scaling marketing, brand, and partnership functions within defense, aerospace, national security, government technology, or related markets.

- 

Proven ability to develop and execute marketing strategies, brand-positioning initiatives, demand-generation campaigns, and thought leadership programs that produce measurable pipeline and business growth.

- 

Experience negotiating teaming agreements, strategic alliances, or partnership frameworks with prime contractors and technology partners.

- 

Familiarity with AI and machine learning, command and control, integrated air and missile defense, counter-unmanned aircraft systems (counter-UAS), or related technology markets is preferred.

- 

Understanding of product development lifecycles, defense acquisition processes, and the commercialization of complex technical solutions.

- 

Strong strategic thinking, market analysis, brand development, campaign management, and lead-generation capabilities.

- 

Ability to translate sophisticated technical concepts into clear, persuasive value propositions for operational users, acquisition leaders, senior executives, and external partners.

- 

Exceptional relationship-building, negotiation, and influencing skills, including the ability to engage C-suite executives, senior government officials, and senior military leaders.

- 

Strong executive presence, written communication, presentation, organizational, and time-management skills, with a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.

- 

Ability to balance long-term strategy with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

- 

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, customer relationship management (CRM) systems, and marketing automation tools.

- 

An active U.S. Secret security clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain one.

- 

A strong work ethic, persistence, adaptability, willingness to learn, and commitment to shared team success.

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package; specific compensation figures and individual benefit details are not provided.

Opportunities for professional development, career growth, and expanded leadership responsibilities.

A collaborative, team-oriented work environment centered on a shared mission and mutual accountability.

The opportunity to influence growth strategy, develop strategic industry relationships, and contribute to the adoption of advanced AI-enabled technologies.

- Develop technical proof points: Lead public benchmarking initiatives in collaboration with Engineering, evaluating latency, model quality, throughput, and cost. Translate rigorous benchmark results into credible marketing assets, technical content, and sales materials.

- Build the AI economics narrative: Create total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses, savings calculators, pricing narratives, and competitive positioning that demonstrate the value of the infrastructure against hyperscalers and hosted inference providers.

- Drive integrated demand generation: Partner with Demand Generation to develop competitive campaigns, webinars, paid initiatives, and other programs, defining target audiences, ideal customer profiles (ICPs), campaign briefs, offers, and conversion journeys.

job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead based in Turkey.

As Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead, you will own the digital experience that turns visitors into customers and first-time buyers into loyal, repeat customers. You will lead website optimization, lifecycle marketing, email communication, and brand positioning across multiple product lines. Working closely with leadership, product, design, engineering, and marketing teams, you will translate customer insights into compelling messaging and measurable business outcomes. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, experiment with new ideas, and implement improvements from concept to execution. In a fast-paced, fully remote environment, your work will directly influence conversion rates, customer retention, and recurring revenue. This is an opportunity for a hands-on marketing leader who combines analytical thinking, persuasive copywriting, and a strong sense of ownership to drive meaningful growth.

- 

Website Strategy and Conversion Optimization: Own the structure, messaging, and conversion performance of the website and key product pages. Develop and execute A/B tests, collaborate with design and engineering teams, and implement improvements that increase conversion rates.

- 

Lifecycle Marketing: Design and optimize end-to-end customer journeys, including onboarding, reorder triggers, retention campaigns, win-back initiatives, and repeat-purchase flows. Partner with the Head of Marketing to drive recurring revenue and customer lifetime value.

- 

Positioning and Messaging: Develop clear, differentiated positioning for each product line and customer segment. Maintain a consistent source of truth for messaging across the website, advertising, sales materials, and AI-powered sales tools.

- 

Email Marketing: Plan, write, launch, and optimize lifecycle and marketing email campaigns that support customer acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.

-

job.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager based in the United States.

As Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you will own the end-to-end growth strategy for a veterinary staffing marketplace, helping independent animal hospitals discover, adopt, and consistently use innovative staffing solutions. You will lead acquisition, activation, retention, and reactivation initiatives, with success measured by meaningful business outcomes rather than sign-ups alone. As the first dedicated growth marketer for the hospital business, you will build the growth engine from the ground up, shaping channel strategy, budget allocation, experimentation, and performance measurement. Working closely with Sales, Product, Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing, and Brand teams, you will turn customer insights into scalable growth programs. You will optimize the hospital journey from initial awareness to the first successfully filled shift and long-term engagement. This remote-first opportunity offers significant ownership, cross-functional influence, and the chance to make a tangible difference for veterinary professionals and animal healthcare providers.

- Growth strategy and planning: Develop and execute the hospital growth strategy in partnership with business and product leadership, setting measurable targets for acquisition, activation, reactivation, expansion, customer acquisition cost, and payback.

- Budget and channel management: Own the growth marketing budget and channel mix, allocating investment across geographic markets based on hospital demand, veterinary professional availability, expected shift-fill rates, and long-term customer value.

- Multi-channel acquisition: Lead B2B lead generation and account-based marketing initiatives alongside Sales, as well as direct-to-practice-manager acquisition through paid search, paid social, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), referrals, direct mail, sponsorships, and strategic partnerships.

- Campaign development: Design and execute hospital-focused acquisition campaigns, contribute hospital targeting and conversion strategies to broader brand campaigns, and collaborate on industry conferences, webinars, sponsorships, and community events.

- Lead targeting and sales alignment: Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Analytics to improve hospital targeting, lead scoring, routing, and handoff processes, ensuring the right prospects receive appropriate support through field teams or automated outreach.

- Activation and conversion optimization: Own the conversion rate optimization roadmap, experimentation backlog, and first-fill playbook, improving the customer journey from landing page visits and registration through approval, shift posting, and successful shift fulfillment.

- Experimentation and product collaboration: Work with Product and Growth Analytics to design, launch, and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments that improve sign-up conversion, onboarding, and first-shift completion.

- Funnel analysis and customer insights: Identify friction points and drop-offs throughout the hospital journey by combining quantitative funnel analysis with qualitative feedback from practice owners, managers, and customer-facing teams.

- Lifecycle and incentive strategy: Collaborate with Lifecycle Marketing to develop onboarding, activation, and reactivation journeys, and partner with Pricing to determine incentive eligibility, offer structures, and expected returns relative to hospital lifetime value.

- Messaging and creative development: Work with Brand and Product Marketing to refine hospital positioning, messaging, campaign creative, landing pages, and website experiences using customer insights and campaign performance data.

- Retention and expansion: Lead initiatives to reactivate dormant or churned hospitals and those struggling to fill shifts, while developing programs that increase repeat bookings and adoption across additional veterinary staffing roles.

- Measurement and attribution: Establish a rigorous growth measurement framework covering acquisition costs, cohort activation, shift-fill rates, customer lifetime value, payback periods, attribution, and controlled experiments, including holdout groups to measure incremental impact.

- Performance reporting: Communicate results, budget utilization, and key learnings to business and marketing leadership, reallocating investment toward effective programs and making data-informed decisions when results fall short of expectations.

- Marketplace coordination: Partner closely with the veterinary professional marketplace team to align hospital demand generation with professional supply, prioritizing markets where both sides of the marketplace can grow sustainably.

- Growth infrastructure and leadership: Build repeatable testing frameworks, operating processes, and performance playbooks that establish a scalable foundation for long-term growth while promoting continuous improvement and cross-functional accountability.

## Requirements:

- Demonstrated experience in growth marketing or performance marketing, ideally serving small and medium-sized businesses within a marketplace, vertical SaaS, staffing, healthcare, or related environment.

- Proven ability to own a growth budget and channel mix, make investment decisions, and deliver measurable business outcomes beyond clicks, leads, or registrations.

- Strong understanding of full-funnel growth, including customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, reactivation, and expansion, with experience improving customer activation and repeat usage.

- Hands-on experience with B2B acquisition channels, including paid search, paid social, referrals, sponsorships, partnerships, and direct mail, with the ability to evaluate channel effectiveness and discontinue underperforming investments.

- Experience developing account-based marketing campaigns for high-priority accounts alongside broader demand generation initiatives is an advantage.

- Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, payback periods, attribution, cohort analysis, and incrementality measurement.

- Demonstrated expertise in designing and evaluating controlled experiments, A/B tests, and holdout studies, including the ability to interpret negative results objectively and communicate findings to leadership.

- Experience diagnosing conversion barriers and identifying the underlying causes of customer drop-off, with a track record of translating insights into measurable improvements.

- Familiarity with lead scoring, lead routing, sales handoffs, and collaboration with field sales or account management teams to improve pipeline quality and conversion.

- Ability to analyze geographic performance and allocate resources according to market-level economics, particularly in two-sided marketplaces where customer demand must align with available supply.

- Strong customer understanding, with the ability to communicate clearly and credibly with small business owners, practice managers, and other decision-makers.

- Experience collaborating across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Brand, and Customer Success without relying on formal authority.

- Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to write effective creative briefs and align teams around shared growth objectives.

- A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate in ambiguous environments, build programs from scratch, take ownership, and adapt quickly as priorities evolve.

- Practical familiarity with AI tools for increasing marketing productivity, alongside a thoughtful perspective on using AI agents to automate or improve manual outreach.

- A commitment to customer problem-solving, measurable impact, urgency, continuous learning, constructive collaboration, and maintaining strong relationships in a remote-first environment.

- Experience in veterinary medicine, animal healthcare, staffing, or related marketplaces is a plus.

## Benefits:

- Competitive annual salary: Compensation varies by geographic tier and is based on experience, skills, and location:

- Tier 1 — San Francisco and New York City: $140,000–$195,000 USD.

- Tier 2 — Los Angeles, Boston, Seattle, Washington, DC, San Diego, and Chicago: $125,000–$175,000 USD.

- Tier 3 — Austin, Dallas, Portland, Denver, Philadelphia, Baltimore, and Sacramento: $120,000–$165,000 USD.

- Tier 4 — Minneapolis, Miami, Atlanta, Phoenix, Orlando, Las Vegas, and Salt Lake City: $110,000–$155,000 USD.

- Tier 5 — Madison, Birmingham, San Antonio, Spokane, and other designated locations: $105,000–$145,000 USD.

- Equity participation: Opportunity to share in the organization's success through an equity program.

- Flexible paid time off: Unlimited PTO for eligible full-time US employees, encouraging a healthy work-life balance and time to recharge.

- Comprehensive healthcare: Medical coverage with the base medical plan covered at 100%, alongside optional premium plans and additional health benefits.

- Wellness support: Monthly wellness stipends to support personal health and well-being.

- Home office support: Stipends to help establish and maintain a productive remote workspace.

- Learning and development: Continuing education stipends and opportunities for accelerated professional growth.

- Retirement savings: Access to a 401(k) plan.

- Family and reproductive care leave: Paid maternity, paternity, and reproductive care leave.

- Team connection: Opportunities for domestic travel, including regional team-building events.

- Recognition and appreciation: Birthday and work anniversary gifts.

- Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely across eligible US locations. Employees based in San Francisco should expect a hybrid working arrangement.

- Meaningful mission: Help independent veterinary hospitals access reliable staffing while enabling veterinary professionals to earn more and enjoy greater flexibility in their careers.

- High-impact ownership: Build and lead a dedicated growth marketing function, influence business strategy, and directly shape the acquisition and retention engine.

As the first dedicated growth marketer for the hospital business, you will build the growth engine from the ground up, shaping channel strategy, budget allocation, experimentation, and performance measurement. This remote-first opportunity offers significant ownership, cross-functional influence, and the chance to make a tangible difference for veterinary professionals and animal healthcare providers.

- Growth strategy and planning: Develop and execute the hospital growth strategy in partnership with business and product leadership, setting measurable targets for acquisition, activation, reactivation, expansion, customer acquisition cost, and payback.

- Budget and channel management: Own the growth marketing budget and channel mix, allocating investment across geographic markets based on hospital demand, veterinary professional availability, expected shift-fill rates, and long-term customer value.

- Multi-channel acquisition: Lead B2B lead generation and account-based marketing initiatives alongside Sales, as well as direct-to-practice-manager acquisition through paid search, paid social, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), referrals, direct mail, sponsorships, and strategic partnerships.

- Campaign development: Design and execute hospital-focused acquisition campaigns, contribute hospital targeting and conversion strategies to broader brand campaigns, and collaborate on industry conferences, webinars, sponsorships, and community events.

- Lead targeting and sales alignment: Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Analytics to improve hospital targeting, lead scoring, routing, and handoff processes, ensuring the right prospects receive appropriate support through field teams or automated outreach.

- Activation and conversion optimization: Own the conversion rate optimization roadmap, experimentation backlog, and first-fill playbook, improving the customer journey from landing page visits and registration through approval, shift posting, and successful shift fulfillment.

- Experimentation and product collaboration: Work with Product and Growth Analytics to design, launch, and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments that improve sign-up conversion, onboarding, and first-shift completion.

- Funnel analysis and customer insights: Identify friction points and drop-offs throughout the hospital journey by combining quantitative funnel analysis with qualitative feedback from practice owners, managers, and customer-facing teams.

- Lifecycle and incentive strategy: Collaborate with Lifecycle Marketing to develop onboarding, activation, and reactivation journeys, and partner with Pricing to determine incentive eligibility, offer structures, and expected returns relative to hospital lifetime value.

- Messaging and creative development: Work with Brand and Product Marketing to refine hospital positioning, messaging, campaign creative, landing pages, and website experiences using customer insights and campaign performance data.

- Retention and expansion: Lead initiatives to reactivate dormant or churned hospitals and those struggling to fill shifts, while developing programs that increase repeat bookings and adoption across additional veterinary staffing roles.

- Measurement and attribution: Establish a rigorous growth measurement framework covering acquisition costs, cohort activation, shift-fill rates, customer lifetime value, payback periods, attribution, and controlled experiments, including holdout groups to measure incremental impact.

- Strong understanding of full-funnel growth, including customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, reactivation, and expansion, with experience improving customer activation and repeat usage.

- Hands-on experience with B2B acquisition channels, including paid search, paid social, referrals, sponsorships, partnerships, and direct mail, with the ability to evaluate channel effectiveness and discontinue underperforming investments.

- Experience developing account-based marketing campaigns for high-priority accounts alongside broader demand generation initiatives is an advantage.

- Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, payback periods, attribution, cohort analysis, and incrementality measurement.

- Demonstrated expertise in designing and evaluating controlled experiments, A/B tests, and holdout studies, including the ability to interpret negative results objectively and communicate findings to leadership.

- Experience diagnosing conversion barriers and identifying the underlying causes of customer drop-off, with a track record of translating insights into measurable improvements.

- Familiarity with lead scoring, lead routing, sales handoffs, and collaboration with field sales or account management teams to improve pipeline quality and conversion.

- Ability to analyze geographic performance and allocate resources according to market-level economics, particularly in two-sided marketplaces where customer demand must align with available supply.

- Strong customer understanding, with the ability to communicate clearly and credibly with small business owners, practice managers, and other decision-makers.

- Experience collaborating across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Brand, and Customer Success without relying on formal authority.

- Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to write effective creative briefs and align teams around shared growth objectives.

- A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate in ambiguous environments, build programs from scratch, take ownership, and adapt quickly as priorities evolve.

- Practical familiarity with AI tools for increasing marketing productivity, alongside a thoughtful perspective on using AI agents to automate or improve manual outreach.

- A commitment to customer problem-solving, measurable impact, urgency, continuous learning, constructive collaboration, and maintaining strong relationships in a remote-first environment.

- Experience in veterinary medicine, animal healthcare, staffing, or related marketplaces is a plus.

- Tier 4 — Minneapolis, Miami, Atlanta, Phoenix, Orlando, Las Vegas, and Salt Lake City: $110,000–$155,000 USD.

- Tier 5 — Madison, Birmingham, San Antonio, Spokane, and other designated locations: $105,000–$145,000 USD.

- Flexible paid time off: Unlimited PTO for eligible full-time US employees, encouraging a healthy work-life balance and time to recharge.
