job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Content Marketing Manager based in the United States.

Join an innovative, fast-growing B2B SaaS environment transforming how organizations manage fleet operations and maintenance.
As a Senior Content Marketing Manager, you will lead the content and thought leadership strategy, turning industry trends, original research, and customer insights into compelling stories that influence business decisions.
You will establish a strong industry presence by developing high-impact content that builds credibility, educates audiences, and positions the business as a trusted market authority.
Working cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Creative, and Revenue Marketing, you will connect content strategy with broader business objectives.
You will oversee the entire content lifecycle, from research and editorial planning to production, distribution, and performance optimization.
By combining exceptional storytelling with data-driven marketing and AI-powered workflows, you will help strengthen brand awareness, generate demand, and accelerate pipeline growth.
This is an opportunity to shape the voice of a growing technology business while contributing directly to its long-term marketing and commercial success.

- Lead thought leadership strategy: Develop and execute a comprehensive content strategy that establishes the business as an authority in fleet management, fleet maintenance, and the broader transportation industry.

- Create high-impact content: Produce and oversee industry reports, original research, white papers, articles, webinars, executive thought leadership, conference presentations, and other engaging content assets.

- Transform insights into compelling narratives: Translate industry developments, customer feedback, proprietary data, and subject matter expertise into differentiated stories that resonate with business audiences.

- Build an integrated editorial strategy: Own the editorial calendar, ensuring alignment with business priorities, audience needs, product initiatives, and integrated marketing campaigns.

- Maximize content reach and reuse: Develop cornerstone content and repurpose it across blogs, social media, webinars, email campaigns, paid advertising, and other distribution channels.

- Support organic growth and search visibility: Partner with Growth Marketing to optimize content for search engine optimization (SEO), AI-driven search discovery (AEO), and sustainable organic audience growth.

- Drive demand generation: Collaborate with Revenue Marketing to create content that attracts, engages, and converts prospective customers across small and medium-sized businesses, mid-market organizations, and enterprise accounts.

- Enable integrated campaigns and sales: Develop content that supports lead generation, account-based marketing, sales enablement, and broader marketing initiatives throughout the buyer journey.

- Measure content performance: Track and optimize engagement, organic visibility, lead generation, pipeline influence, and revenue contribution to demonstrate the business value of content investments.

- Manage end-to-end content production: Oversee the complete content development process, from ideation and research through writing, editing, stakeholder reviews, and publication.

- Improve editorial operations: Establish scalable workflows that maintain high editorial standards while ensuring consistent and timely content delivery.

- Leverage AI and innovation: Integrate AI-powered tools into research, ideation, content repurposing, and production workflows without compromising originality, accuracy, or quality.

- Collaborate with internal experts: Build strong relationships with subject matter experts and business leaders to uncover valuable insights and turn complex expertise into accessible, engaging content.

## Requirements:

job.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - Outbound
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager – Outbound based in the United States.

We are seeking a results-driven Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market execution, product launches, messaging, and sales enablement for a portfolio of innovative software solutions. In this role, you will translate product strategy into compelling narratives that resonate with buyers and deliver measurable business outcomes. Working at the intersection of product, sales, marketing, and client success, you will drive product awareness, adoption, and commercial performance. You will take ownership of launch planning, positioning, and enablement initiatives while ensuring teams have the tools and confidence to communicate product value effectively. This client-facing position also offers opportunities to engage directly with customers through advisory boards, executive discussions, interviews, and industry events. You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a collaborative, fast-moving environment that values innovation and continuous improvement. Your success will be measured by the impact of launches, the effectiveness of enablement materials, and sustained product adoption.

- Go-to-Market Strategy and Execution: Translate product strategies and roadmap initiatives into clear go-to-market narratives, launch plans, and marketing programs that support business objectives and customer needs.

- Product Launch Management: Own the planning, coordination, and execution of product releases, ensuring launches are delivered on schedule, aligned across teams, and positioned to generate meaningful business impact.

- Positioning and Messaging: Develop and refine product positioning, value propositions, and messaging that clearly communicate product benefits, differentiate solutions in the market, and resonate with target buyers.

- Sales and Customer Success Enablement: Create and deliver practical enablement resources, including presentations, product demonstrations, marketing collateral, sales decks, and ROI calculators, to strengthen sales effectiveness and customer confidence.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product management, sales, marketing, and client success teams to align messaging, improve win rates, accelerate adoption, and ensure consistent communication throughout the customer journey.

- Customer Engagement: Facilitate Customer Advisory Boards in partnership with product and client success teams, participate in executive-level conversations, conduct customer interviews, and represent the business at relevant company and industry events.

- Performance Measurement: Track, analyze, and report on launch effectiveness, product awareness, adoption, and other key performance indicators. Use insights to optimize marketing strategies and improve future launches.

- AI-Enabled Marketing Innovation: Leverage AI tools to accelerate launch planning, strengthen messaging, improve content quality, and increase the efficiency of product marketing workflows.

- Project and Initiative Management: Manage multiple product marketing initiatives simultaneously, coordinate stakeholders, adapt to changing priorities, and contribute to cross-functional projects that advance broader business goals.

- Continuous Improvement: Gather market and customer insights, incorporate relevant feedback into product messaging, and ensure that launch strategies and enablement materials remain useful, consistent, and aligned with business priorities.

## Requirements

- Professional Experience: 5–7 years of experience in product marketing, marketing, sales enablement, or a related field, with a proven track record of delivering successful product launches.

- Product Launch Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage complex product launches from planning through execution, translating product capabilities and strategies into clear messaging and measurable commercial outcomes.

- AI Proficiency: Practical experience using AI tools to accelerate launch development, refine positioning and messaging, improve content quality, and streamline marketing processes.

- Strategic and Operational Skills: Ability to balance long-term product marketing strategy with hands-on execution, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work within established timelines.

- Communication and Storytelling: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong presentation abilities, and the capacity to communicate product value clearly to diverse audiences, including senior executives.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to influence stakeholders, build alignment across product, sales, marketing, and client success teams, and drive initiatives forward without requiring formal people management authority.

- Project Management: Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to coordinate multiple projects, manage deadlines, and maintain consistency across launch activities and deliverables.

- Commercial and Customer Focus: Understanding of buyer needs, product adoption, sales effectiveness, and customer success, with the ability to turn customer insights into compelling positioning and practical enablement.

- Technology and Marketing Tools: Hands-on experience with tools such as Salesforce, Asana, Klue, Clozd, Gong, Pendo, Claude, and Microsoft Copilot, or comparable platforms used for sales enablement, product analytics, competitive intelligence, and AI-assisted workflows.

- Adaptability and Ownership: A proactive, execution-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to take ownership of initiatives, respond to evolving priorities, and continuously improve marketing effectiveness.

## Benefits

- Remote Work Flexibility: Remote working opportunities for eligible candidates based in the United States.

- Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

- Retirement Savings: 401(k) savings plan with employer matching.

- Paid Time Off: Flexible planned paid time off and generous sick leave.

- Family Support: Employer-paid parental leave.

- Inclusive Workplace: A welcoming and collaborative environment that values diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

- Purpose-Driven Work: The opportunity to support mission-driven organizations through software that helps them strengthen communities, engage members, and achieve meaningful outcomes.

job.title: Head of Influencer Marketing
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Influencer Marketing based in Turkey.

Lead the development and execution of creative influencer marketing strategies for leading B2C brands across the DACH region. In this role, you will shape creator-led campaigns that capture attention, engage audiences, and deliver measurable business results across social media platforms. You will take ownership of creator management processes, develop compelling campaign concepts and scripts, and collaborate closely with company founders to drive creative excellence. By combining a strong understanding of social media trends with data-driven decision-making, you will continuously improve content performance and campaign effectiveness. You will also gain access to advanced creative training designed to help you identify and develop high-performing content. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for a creative, ambitious professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to make a meaningful impact on brand growth.

- Influencer Marketing Strategy: Lead the development and implementation of influencer marketing strategies for major consumer brands across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH).

- Creator Management: Oversee creator-related processes, ensuring effective collaboration with influencers and content creators throughout campaign planning and execution.

- Creative Concepts and Scriptwriting: Develop engaging creative concepts, campaign briefs, and scripts that align with brand objectives, resonate with target audiences, and encourage meaningful engagement.

- Campaign Development: Translate marketing objectives into compelling creator-led campaigns, ensuring creative consistency and alignment with each brand's positioning and goals.

- Founder Collaboration: Work closely with company founders to define priorities, refine creative strategies, and contribute to the overall growth of the business and its clients.

- Performance Analysis: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), evaluate campaign results, and identify opportunities to improve content effectiveness and marketing outcomes.

- Creative Optimisation: Analyse content assets and identify successful creative formats, messaging approaches, and creator partnerships to strengthen campaign performance.

- Trend and Talent Discovery: Stay informed about emerging social media trends, creator opportunities, audience preferences, and high-performing content formats to maintain a competitive edge.

- Continuous Improvement: Apply insights from campaign performance and advanced creative training to refine processes, improve creative output, and support scalable influencer marketing operations.

## Requirements

- Relevant Experience: Proven experience in creative strategy, ideally within a marketing agency or brand environment, with a strong understanding of influencer marketing and creator-led campaigns.

- Influencer and Social Media Expertise: A solid understanding of social media platforms, creator ecosystems, audience engagement, and the factors that contribute to successful influencer campaigns.

- Creative Thinking: The ability to develop original concepts, write compelling scripts, and translate marketing objectives into engaging content ideas that resonate with target audiences.

- Trend Awareness: A strong instinct for identifying emerging social media trends, recognising high-performing content, and understanding what makes creators and campaigns successful.

- Analytical Skills: The ability to interpret campaign KPIs, evaluate creative performance, and use data-driven insights to optimise content and marketing strategies.

- Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a genuine ability to understand people, build relationships, and collaborate effectively with creators and internal stakeholders.

- Strategic Mindset: The ability to connect creative execution with broader business objectives, prioritise effectively, and make informed decisions in a dynamic environment.

- Ownership and Initiative: A proactive, ambitious, and results-oriented approach, with the willingness to take responsibility, solve problems independently, and go the extra mile to achieve outstanding results.

- Commitment and Availability: The ability to dedicate the necessary time and energy to a demanding, growth-oriented role while maintaining high standards of execution.

- Remote Working Skills: Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively in a fully remote environment.

## Benefits

- Competitive Salary: Earn between €5,000 and €10,000 per month, depending on experience and suitability for the role.

- Permanent Employment: Secure a long-term employment opportunity with the potential to grow alongside an expanding business.

- Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Flexible Working Hours: Enjoy flexibility in organising your schedule while remaining focused on campaign delivery and business outcomes.

- Professional Development: Access advanced creative training valued at over €100,000 to strengthen your strategic thinking and creative execution skills.

- Performance-Based Incentives: Opportunity to participate in success-sharing arrangements linked to business performance.

- Strategic Ownership: Take responsibility for creator management processes and influence the creative direction of campaigns for established consumer brands.

- Close Leadership Collaboration: Work directly with company founders, contributing ideas and gaining exposure to strategic business decisions.

- Career Growth: Expand your expertise in influencer marketing, creative strategy, creator partnerships, and performance-driven content development.

job.title: Head of Marketing
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Marketing based in the United States.

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on marketing leader to drive the next phase of growth for an innovative AI-powered platform transforming how government organizations collaborate and deliver essential services. In this role, you will own the marketing strategy across brand, positioning, product marketing, demand generation, and field marketing. You will work closely with the CEO, founders, Sales, Product, and customer-facing teams to turn complex technology into a compelling market story. Leading a lean, talented team, you will balance strategic leadership with direct execution, from shaping campaigns and thought leadership to supporting high-value accounts and industry events. You will help establish a distinctive market category at the intersection of government operations, collaboration, and AI. This is an opportunity to build a scalable marketing function, influence company strategy, and contribute to technology that helps public servants address critical community challenges.

- 

Brand strategy and positioning: Own the brand narrative and market positioning, translating a complex product and emerging category into a clear, differentiated, and compelling value proposition.

- 

Product marketing and storytelling: Transform customer success stories, product developments, and measurable outcomes into impactful campaigns, thought leadership, content, product launches, and sales enablement materials.

- 

Growth strategy and demand generation: Partner with the growth marketing lead to identify priority audiences, channels, campaigns, and investments that generate qualified pipeline and support broader go-to-market objectives.

- 

Field marketing and events: Develop a differentiated field marketing strategy encompassing conferences, roundtables, executive dinners, partnerships, and other relationship-building opportunities that support account growth.

- 

Sales partnership and strategic accounts: Collaborate with Sales to refine messaging, support strategic opportunities, develop account-based campaigns, strengthen sales enablement, and help open, close, and expand government relationships.

- 

Category development and thought leadership: Build market awareness and credibility through public relations, partnerships, creative campaigns, and thought leadership that establish a strong voice in modern government operations and AI.

- 

Marketing team leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the marketing team, set clear priorities, empower functional owners, and identify the people, processes, and capabilities needed as the organization scales.

- 

Performance measurement and optimization: Analyze campaign performance and pipeline contribution, identify effective channels and activities, and translate marketing insights into repeatable growth strategies.

- 

Hands-on marketing execution: Contribute directly to copywriting, editing, campaign development, presentation creation, event planning, marketing operations, and strategic account support when needed.

- 

Cross-functional alignment: Work closely with company leadership and teams across Sales, Product, and customer-facing functions to ensure marketing priorities align with customer needs and business objectives.

- 

AI-enabled marketing innovation: Incorporate AI tools, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies into marketing workflows to improve efficiency, accelerate experimentation, and increase the impact of a lean team.

- 

Marketing organization development: Establish processes, priorities, and operating practices that support rapid execution, continuous learning, and sustainable growth in an evolving market.

### Requirements

- 

Marketing leadership experience: At least eight years of marketing experience at high-growth companies, ideally including early-stage or growth-stage B2B software businesses.

- 

Brand and positioning expertise: Demonstrated ability to clarify complex products, differentiate a company in an emerging market, and evolve brand messaging as products and customer needs develop.

- 

Product marketing and storytelling: Strong experience translating customer insights and product capabilities into compelling messaging, launches, campaigns, content, and sales materials.

- 

B2B growth and pipeline generation: Deep understanding of demand generation and enterprise marketing, including account-based marketing, field marketing, events, partnerships, and pipeline development in relationship-driven markets.

- 

Sales and go-to-market collaboration: Experience partnering closely with Sales on strategic accounts, messaging, sales enablement, and campaigns that support customer acquisition and expansion.

- 

Hands-on execution: Willingness and ability to contribute directly to marketing deliverables, analyze campaign performance, work with marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, develop presentations, and support events and account-level initiatives.

- 

People leadership and team development: Ability to set direction for talented functional specialists, coach and develop team members, encourage ownership, and build a high-performing marketing organization.

- 

Strategic thinking and operational discipline: Strong judgment in prioritizing marketing investments, connecting marketing activities to business outcomes, and building repeatable processes that scale.

- 

Cross-functional communication: Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with executive leadership, Product, Sales, and customer-facing teams.

- 

Startup adaptability: Comfort operating with a lean team, navigating ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, moving quickly, and creating structure while executing.

- 

AI fluency and experimentation: Active use of AI tools and a strong interest in applying AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve marketing effectiveness and team productivity.

- 

Ownership and initiative: A proactive, resourceful approach, with the ability to identify opportunities, test ideas, learn from results, and take responsibility for outcomes.

### Benefits

- 

Competitive compensation: A competitive salary package, with the specific salary range not disclosed in the original posting.

- 

Equity participation: Meaningful equity opportunities, offering the potential to share in the company's growth.

- 

Health benefits: Health benefits as part of the overall employee compensation package.

- 

Flexible work arrangements: Remote work flexibility and arrangements designed to support individual working styles.

- 

Strategic ownership: Direct collaboration with founders and senior leadership, with significant influence over brand strategy, market positioning, and company growth.

- 

Established foundation: An existing, talented, lean marketing team, providing an opportunity to shape the function's future rather than build everything from scratch.

- 

Strong marketing resources: Access to customer success stories, proof points, market momentum, and a product addressing urgent, real-world challenges.

- 

Category-building opportunity: The chance to help define an emerging market at the intersection of government operations, collaboration, and artificial intelligence.

- 

Autonomy and experimentation: The freedom to develop ambitious ideas, launch campaigns, test approaches, and refine the marketing organization as the company grows.

- 

Meaningful impact: The opportunity to support technology that helps public servants tackle important community challenges, including housing access for veterans and emergency preparedness.

 How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Marketing Lead based in the United States.

The Product Marketing Lead will shape the positioning and go-to-market strategy for an enterprise event technology platform serving complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field experiences. This high-impact role combines product storytelling, competitive strategy, product launches, sales enablement, and analyst relations. You will translate sophisticated platform capabilities, including emerging AI-powered and agentic features, into clear value propositions for enterprise buyers. Working closely with Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, you will help strengthen competitive performance and accelerate customer adoption. Reporting directly to the Co-founder and Chief Marketing Officer, you will have significant ownership and the autonomy to build, test, and improve marketing programs. The environment rewards initiative, excellent writing, practical AI adoption, and the ability to deliver measurable results without relying on a large team.

You will lead product marketing across positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales readiness, and customer engagement, ensuring that the product’s value is clearly communicated throughout the buyer and customer journey. Your key responsibilities will include:

- 

Own positioning and messaging: Develop and maintain compelling messaging for the event experience platform, translating AI-powered and agentic capabilities into clear, evidence-based value propositions for enterprise event leaders. Ensure consistency across marketing channels, sales conversations, and customer communications.

- 

Lead go-to-market launches: Partner with Product to understand product strategy and development priorities, then manage launches end to end, including messaging, launch planning, input on pricing and packaging, sales readiness, and customer communications.

- 

Strengthen competitive strategy: Monitor established event management platforms and emerging point solutions. Develop practical battlecards, discovery questions, objection-handling guidance, and competitive intelligence that help sales teams win deals. Conduct win/loss analyses to continuously improve positioning and sales effectiveness.

- 

Drive sales enablement: Create sales narratives, demo storylines, one-pagers, RFP content, and other field resources. Work with Sales and Solutions leadership to train teams and ensure new product capabilities are effectively presented and sold.

- 

Manage analyst relations: Own day-to-day relationships with Forrester and Gartner, coordinate briefings and evaluation submissions, and strengthen the company’s presence on review platforms such as G2, TrustRadius, Capterra, and Gartner Peer Insights.

- 

Build customer proof points: Collaborate with Account Management to develop case studies, customer reference programs, and measurable evidence supporting product claims and demonstrating business value.

- 

Increase product adoption: Partner with Account Management to encourage existing customers to use new capabilities through release communications, targeted programs, relevant content, and executive business reviews.

- 

Maintain the product marketing knowledge base: Keep messaging, product information, and competitive intelligence accurate and accessible, including the knowledge that powers internal AI tools and workflows. Use AI to automate repetitive go-to-market activities and improve operational efficiency.

- 

Deliver measurable results: During the first 90 days, develop a clear understanding of why the company wins and loses, refresh competitive materials, take ownership of analyst evaluation activities, and deliver an end-to-end launch. Within the first year, help improve competitive win rates, establish consistent launch practices, strengthen analyst and review-site positioning, and maintain trusted messaging for employees and AI agents.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced B2B SaaS product marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, strong commercial judgment, and a practical approach to AI-enabled work. Required and preferred qualifications include:

- 

At least five years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, selling to mid-market and enterprise buyers, including experience as a lead or sole product marketer.

- 

Demonstrated ability to position complex platforms for both business and technical audiences and compete successfully against established market leaders.

- 

An AI-native approach to work, with experience using AI agents—ideally Claude—to automate practical go-to-market workflows and examples of solutions you have built.

- 

Strong sales enablement skills, including the ability to develop compelling narratives and useful sales materials, train field teams, and measure whether those resources are being adopted.

- 

Hands-on analyst relations experience, ideally including participation in a Forrester Wave or Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluation.

- 

Excellent writing and communication skills, with the ability to make complex product concepts clear, specific, and persuasive without resorting to generic messaging.

- 

Ability to work independently, set priorities, move quickly, and deliver results in an environment with limited layers and a lean team structure.

- 

Preferred: Experience with Claude Cowork, Claude Skills, or similar agentic tools in everyday work.

- 

Preferred: Background in event technology, marketing technology, or another platform serving marketing teams.

- 

Preferred: Experience marketing AI-first or agentic products to enterprise customers.

- 

Preferred: Experience developing value propositions for multiple stakeholder groups, such as organizers, attendees, and sponsors.

- 

Preferred: Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong, including the ability to retrieve and analyze data directly from these platforms.

Benefits:

- 

Annual salary: $100,000–$150,000, as stated in the source posting under New York pay transparency requirements.

- 

Comprehensive insurance options with employer premium coverage.

- 

Generous paid time-off benefits.

- 

Quarterly mental health days to support employee well-being.

- 

Quarterly team-building events designed to strengthen collaboration and workplace connections.

- 

401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.

- 

Equity program.

- 

Paid parental leave.

- 

Sabbatical leave on milestone work anniversaries.

- 

An opportunity to shape product marketing strategy, influence competitive performance, and work closely with senior leadership.

- 

A collaborative, AI-forward environment that encourages experimentation, workflow automation, and independent execution.

- Sales Enablement Materials: Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop effective sales tools, including pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, FAQs, and other resources that support sales and business development teams.

- Content Creation and Design: Write, design, and maintain polished marketing and sales materials using Canva, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines and making resources easy for sales teams to access and use.

- Customer Stories and Case Studies: Gather customer testimonials, success stories, and examples of measurable results, working with Communications to transform them into compelling marketing content.

- Events and Brand Promotions: Support the planning and execution of events, trade shows, conferences, and promotional initiatives, coordinating marketing materials, signage, logistics, and other deliverables.

- Vendor and Freelancer Coordination: Brief and manage external creative partners, freelancers, and vendors as needed, ensuring projects meet quality standards, stay within budget, and are delivered on schedule.

- Brand Consistency: Collaborate with Creative to ensure marketing assets and promotional activities reflect the organization's brand identity, visual standards, tone, and messaging.

- Campaign Support: Work alongside Growth Marketing to create copy and Canva assets for email, social media, websites, and other marketing channels, contributing to integrated campaigns and demand generation activities.

- Event Marketing: Experience supporting events, trade shows, conferences, or promotional activities, including coordinating materials and logistics.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Marketing - Healthcare
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Manager, Marketing – Healthcare based in the United States.

As a Senior Marketing Manager, you will lead the execution of integrated go-to-market strategies designed to accelerate growth across the healthcare sector. You will connect demand generation, content marketing, field events, and sales enablement to create compelling buyer journeys that drive pipeline and revenue. Working closely with Sales, Product Marketing, and cross-functional teams, you will translate business priorities into targeted campaigns and effective industry messaging. This hands-on leadership role combines strategic planning, budget management, performance optimization, and team development. You will use customer insights, market intelligence, and campaign analytics to refine marketing investments and improve conversion outcomes. By leveraging AI-powered tools and automation, you will help strengthen marketing efficiency, personalize engagement, and deliver measurable business impact in a remote-first environment.

- Go-to-Market Strategy and Execution: Execute the annual healthcare vertical marketing plan, aligning initiatives with approved business priorities, strategic objectives, and investment guidelines.

- Integrated Campaign Management: Coordinate demand generation, content marketing, field and event marketing, and sales enablement to deliver a cohesive buyer journey that supports pipeline development and revenue growth.

- Healthcare Messaging and Positioning: Adapt approved product and corporate messaging to the healthcare audience, developing relevant campaigns, industry content, sales narratives, and enablement materials while maintaining established product claims and positioning.

- Product Launch Activation: Coordinate marketing activities for product launches within the healthcare vertical, leveraging established launch strategies, value propositions, supporting evidence, and messaging from Product Marketing.

- Sales and Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as the primary day-to-day marketing partner for healthcare Sales leaders, collaborating with Product Marketing and other stakeholders to align priorities, strengthen execution, and support shared pipeline and bookings objectives.

- Budget and Investment Management: Manage the vertical marketing budget and optimize spending across audiences, channels, and programs to improve marketing efficiency and maximize contribution to pipeline and bookings.

- Performance Analysis and Optimization: Monitor campaign performance, pipeline contribution, funnel conversion, and program-level efficiency. Partner with Sales to identify performance gaps, improve lead quality, and implement corrective actions.

- Marketing Operations and Processes: Establish repeatable workflows, campaign briefs, performance dashboards, and playbooks that improve execution speed, consistency, transparency, and overall marketing effectiveness.

- Team Leadership and Development: Guide and develop team members while remaining actively involved in campaign reviews, prioritization, messaging adaptation, and content quality assurance.

- Market and Competitive Intelligence: Gather insights from healthcare buyers, sales teams, industry developments, and competitors, translating findings into actionable recommendations for Product Marketing and cross-functional partners.

- AI and Marketing Innovation: Apply AI-enabled tools and automation to improve research, audience personalization, campaign execution, reporting, and operational efficiency.

- Business Impact and Accountability: Measure success through vertical pipeline and bookings contribution, pipeline generated per program investment, funnel conversion, timely product launch activation, and sales adoption of marketing initiatives.

## Requirements

- Professional Marketing Experience: At least 7 years of B2B marketing experience spanning multiple disciplines, including integrated campaigns, demand generation, content marketing, field marketing, or sales enablement.

- Leadership Experience: At least 2 years of experience leading team members, marketing programs, or complex cross-functional initiatives, with the ability to motivate contributors and drive projects to completion.

- Budget Management: Demonstrated experience managing marketing budgets, allocating resources effectively, and optimizing program investments against measurable business outcomes.

- Sales Partnership: A strong track record of collaborating with Sales teams to achieve shared pipeline generation, conversion, and bookings goals.

- Go-to-Market Expertise: Experience translating business and product priorities into coordinated marketing plans, audience-specific campaigns, and actionable sales enablement strategies.

- Messaging and Positioning: Ability to adapt established product messaging to a specific industry or audience while preserving approved claims, value propositions, and positioning.

- Performance Analytics: Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret campaign data, evaluate funnel performance, identify improvement opportunities, and communicate actionable recommendations.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills, with the ability to align multiple teams around shared priorities and execution plans.

- Hands-On Leadership: A balance of strategic thinking and practical execution, including the ability to review campaigns, refine messaging, prioritize initiatives, and maintain high standards for marketing content.

- Market Awareness: Ability to understand buyer needs, industry dynamics, competitive positioning, and sales challenges, using these insights to improve marketing effectiveness.

- Technology and Innovation: Interest in applying AI-powered tools and automation to enhance marketing productivity, personalization, research, and reporting.

- Preferred Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare marketing, healthcare technology, or marketing to healthcare organizations would be valuable for understanding sector-specific audiences and business priorities.

## Benefits

- Competitive Base Salary: Annual starting salary ranging from $117,200 to $157,500, depending on qualifications, experience, market conditions, and other business considerations.

- Remote Work Flexibility: A remote-friendly working environment offering flexibility to work from anywhere within the United States.

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Comprehensive healthcare coverage to support employees' health and well-being.

- Parental Leave: Generous parental leave benefits to support employees and their families.

details.full_description_markdown:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Manager, Marketing – Healthcare based in the United States.

As a Senior Marketing Manager, you will lead the execution of integrated go-to-market strategies designed to accelerate growth across the healthcare sector. You will connect demand generation, content marketing, field events, and sales enablement to create compelling buyer journeys that drive pipeline and revenue. Working closely with Sales, Product Marketing, and cross-functional teams, you will translate business priorities into targeted campaigns and effective industry messaging. This hands-on leadership role combines strategic planning, budget management, performance optimization, and team development. You will use customer insights, market intelligence, and campaign analytics to refine marketing investments and improve conversion outcomes. By leveraging AI-powered tools and automation, you will help strengthen marketing efficiency, personalize engagement, and deliver measurable business impact in a remote-first environment.

- Go-to-Market Strategy and Execution: Execute the annual healthcare vertical marketing plan, aligning initiatives with approved business priorities, strategic objectives, and investment guidelines.

- Integrated Campaign Management: Coordinate demand generation, content marketing, field and event marketing, and sales enablement to deliver a cohesive buyer journey that supports pipeline development and revenue growth.

- Healthcare Messaging and Positioning: Adapt approved product and corporate messaging to the healthcare audience, developing relevant campaigns, industry content, sales narratives, and enablement materials while maintaining established product claims and positioning.

- Product Launch Activation: Coordinate marketing activities for product launches within the healthcare vertical, leveraging established launch strategies, value propositions, supporting evidence, and messaging from Product Marketing.

- Sales and Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as the primary day-to-day marketing partner for healthcare Sales leaders, collaborating with Product Marketing and other stakeholders to align priorities, strengthen execution, and support shared pipeline and bookings objectives.

- Budget and Investment Management: Manage the vertical marketing budget and optimize spending across audiences, channels, and programs to improve marketing efficiency and maximize contribution to pipeline and bookings.

- Performance Analysis and Optimization: Monitor campaign performance, pipeline contribution, funnel conversion, and program-level efficiency. Partner with Sales to identify performance gaps, improve lead quality, and implement corrective actions.

- Marketing Operations and Processes: Establish repeatable workflows, campaign briefs, performance dashboards, and playbooks that improve execution speed, consistency, transparency, and overall marketing effectiveness.

- Team Leadership and Development: Guide and develop team members while remaining actively involved in campaign reviews, prioritization, messaging adaptation, and content quality assurance.

- Market and Competitive Intelligence: Gather insights from healthcare buyers, sales teams, industry developments, and competitors, translating findings into actionable recommendations for Product Marketing and cross-functional partners.

- AI and Marketing Innovation: Apply AI-enabled tools and automation to improve research, audience personalization, campaign execution, reporting, and operational efficiency.

- Business Impact and Accountability: Measure success through vertical pipeline and bookings contribution, pipeline generated per program investment, funnel conversion, timely product launch activation, and sales adoption of marketing initiatives.

## Requirements

- Professional Marketing Experience: At least 7 years of B2B marketing experience spanning multiple disciplines, including integrated campaigns, demand generation, content marketing, field marketing, or sales enablement.

- Leadership Experience: At least 2 years of experience leading team members, marketing programs, or complex cross-functional initiatives, with the ability to motivate contributors and drive projects to completion.

- Budget Management: Demonstrated experience managing marketing budgets, allocating resources effectively, and optimizing program investments against measurable business outcomes.

- Sales Partnership: A strong track record of collaborating with Sales teams to achieve shared pipeline generation, conversion, and bookings goals.

- Go-to-Market Expertise: Experience translating business and product priorities into coordinated marketing plans, audience-specific campaigns, and actionable sales enablement strategies.

- Messaging and Positioning: Ability to adapt established product messaging to a specific industry or audience while preserving approved claims, value propositions, and positioning.

- Performance Analytics: Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret campaign data, evaluate funnel performance, identify improvement opportunities, and communicate actionable recommendations.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills, with the ability to align multiple teams around shared priorities and execution plans.

- Hands-On Leadership: A balance of strategic thinking and practical execution, including the ability to review campaigns, refine messaging, prioritize initiatives, and maintain high standards for marketing content.

- Market Awareness: Ability to understand buyer needs, industry dynamics, competitive positioning, and sales challenges, using these insights to improve marketing effectiveness.

- Technology and Innovation: Interest in applying AI-powered tools and automation to enhance marketing productivity, personalization, research, and reporting.

- Preferred Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare marketing, healthcare technology, or marketing to healthcare organizations would be valuable for understanding sector-specific audiences and business priorities.

## Benefits

- Competitive Base Salary: Annual starting salary ranging from $117,200 to $157,500, depending on qualifications, experience, market conditions, and other business considerations.

- Remote Work Flexibility: A remote-friendly working environment offering flexibility to work from anywhere within the United States.

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Comprehensive healthcare coverage to support employees' health and well-being.

- Retirement Savings: A 401(k) program with employer matching contributions.

- Flexible Paid Time Off: Flexible PTO to support personal well-being and work-life balance.

- Parental Leave: Generous parental leave benefits to support employees and their families.

- Wellness Programs: Resources and initiatives designed to support physical and mental health.

- Pet Insurance: Access to pet insurance options.

- Legal and Identity Protection: Benefits designed to help protect employees' personal interests and identity.

- Tuition Reimbursement: Financial support for eligible education and professional development opportunities.

- Charitable Giving Support: Access to a Donations for Doers program that encourages and supports community involvement.

- Professional Growth: Opportunities to strengthen marketing leadership, develop cross-functional expertise, and contribute to high-impact healthcare marketing initiatives.

- Purpose-Driven Work: The opportunity to help organizations serving healthcare and social-impact communities increase their effectiveness through technology.

 How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

job.title: Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead based in United States.

As Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead, you will own the digital experience that turns visitors into customers and first-time buyers into loyal, repeat customers. You will lead website optimization, lifecycle marketing, email communication, and brand positioning across multiple product lines. Working closely with leadership, product, design, engineering, and marketing teams, you will translate customer insights into compelling messaging and measurable business outcomes. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, experiment with new ideas, and implement improvements from concept to execution. In a fast-paced, fully remote environment, your work will directly influence conversion rates, customer retention, and recurring revenue. This is an opportunity for a hands-on marketing leader who combines analytical thinking, persuasive copywriting, and a strong sense of ownership to drive meaningful growth.

- 

Website Strategy and Conversion Optimization: Own the structure, messaging, and conversion performance of the website and key product pages. Develop and execute A/B tests, collaborate with design and engineering teams, and implement improvements that increase conversion rates.

- 

Lifecycle Marketing: Design and optimize end-to-end customer journeys, including onboarding, reorder triggers, retention campaigns, win-back initiatives, and repeat-purchase flows. Partner with the Head of Marketing to drive recurring revenue and customer lifetime value.

- 

Positioning and Messaging: Develop clear, differentiated positioning for each product line and customer segment. Maintain a consistent source of truth for messaging across the website, advertising, sales materials, and AI-powered sales tools.

- 

Email Marketing: Plan, write, launch, and optimize lifecycle and marketing email campaigns that support customer acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.

- 

Customer Research and Insights: Gather insights from sales calls, customer conversations, and reviews, translating them into stronger messaging, improved web pages, and actionable experimentation opportunities.

- 

Performance Measurement and Reporting: Track and analyze business-critical metrics, including conversion rates, repeat revenue, repeat order value, and CRM performance. Use data to prioritize initiatives and demonstrate measurable impact.

- 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with executive leadership and relevant teams to influence product direction, improve customer workflows, and align marketing execution with broader business objectives.

### Requirements:

- 

Professional Experience: At least 4 years of experience in B2B or e-commerce marketing, with hands-on ownership of website conversion optimization, messaging, lifecycle marketing, or email programs.

- 

Customer-Centric Copywriting: Demonstrated ability to create effective copy and landing pages grounded in customer research, market insights, and real-world feedback rather than assumptions.

- 

Lifecycle Marketing Expertise: Experience building and managing lifecycle or email marketing programs, with measurable results in revenue, activation, retention, or repeat purchases.

- 

Experimentation and Analytics: Solid understanding of A/B testing principles, including sample sizes, primary success metrics, and minimum detectable or practically meaningful effects. Ability to interpret results and make evidence-based decisions.

- 

End-to-End Ownership: Proven ability to take initiatives from strategy and planning through execution, testing, launch, and optimization, working independently with minimal supervision.

- 

Communication Skills: Excellent written English, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and develop persuasive messaging for different audiences.

- 

Analytical Thinking and Problem-Solving: Strong business acumen, logical reasoning, and the ability to break down ambiguous challenges into practical, high-impact solutions.

- 

Accountability and Adaptability: A proactive, ownership-driven mindset, combined with the ability to respond quickly to constructive feedback, adapt to changing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-moving environment.

- 

Preferred Qualifications: Experience with hybrid self-service and sales-led funnels; hands-on knowledge of CRM systems such as HubSpot or Pipedrive and email marketing platforms; experience developing prompts or knowledge bases for AI sales or support agents; and familiarity with custom manufacturing, branded merchandise, or print-on-demand businesses.

### Benefits:

- 

Competitive Compensation: A flexible, competitive compensation package tailored to the candidate's experience, capabilities, and expected impact.

- 

Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere globally, with flexible working hours and no requirement to report to a physical office.

- 

Full-Time Engagement: An exclusive, full-time independent contractor arrangement offering substantial responsibility and autonomy.

- 

Direct Leadership Exposure: Work closely with executive leadership, gaining visibility into strategic decisions and opportunities for professional development.

- 

Strategic Influence: Contribute directly to product development, customer experience improvements, business workflows, and company strategy.

- 

Autonomy and Ownership: Take responsibility for your domain, lead initiatives end to end, and make decisions with minimal bureaucracy.

- 

Growth Opportunities: Join a scaling business where you can expand your responsibilities, strengthen your expertise, and accelerate your professional growth.

- 

Flexible Work Environment: Collaborate with a distributed, international team in a results-oriented environment that values initiative, accountability, and continuous improvement.

 How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

job.title: Digital Marketing B2B HubSpot Growth Marketing and Automation Manager (Remote)
job.description:
Logical Media Group strives to create exceptional digital experiences for people to connect, transact, and explore. At the core of that lies with our partnership with our clients and ensuring their needs and goals are at the forefront of all our efforts. The focus of the B2B HubSpot Growth Marketing Manager will be to serve as an integral role in identifying and creating high value and high impact strategies for our clients across delivery and account management teams; this will involve supporting CRM standards and program strategies through omni-channel collaboration, monitoring the success of those initiatives, and continually enhancing and optimizing that service value for our clients. This role will primarily focus on the ideation and execution of B2B marketing and customer journey initiatives for our clients, contributing to the growth of this channel at Logical. 

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities Include: 

Working across Account Teams

- Collaborate with cross-functional account teams to ensure seamless execution of high impact initiatives and consumer journeys from kickoff to launch, with special attention to how client’s sales and marketing teams need to collaborate 

- Focus on the core business KPIs for clients, develop and implement cross-channel programs that align to key moments of need within the customer’s journey based on insights from analytics and behavioral science

- Partner with client stakeholders to operationalize program-based strategies and develop cross-channel programs and initiatives that increase key performance indicators

- Lead strategic meetings (both internally and externally) to align on client goals and ensure that programs are operating in service of unique customer journey needs

- Work across accounts to oversee the creation of emails, forms, landing pages, reports, and other related infrastructure to optimize performance of our marketing efforts

- Build custom multi channel reports and implement reporting processes that capture key insights, and define account success, while also identifying opportunities for continued improvements in efficiency, effectiveness, and impact of the complex, consumer-centric marketing strategies

- Maintain data hygiene and data/list integrity standards, including managing data and integrations between marketing and sales platforms (Hubspot, Salesforce, Marketo, Pardot, etc), and creating standards if they do not exist

- Participate in campaign planning to develop and maintain all project aspects, including timelines/schedules, budget, progress/status reports, and messaging/copy if needed.

- Identify customer segments for targeted marketing programs and plan consumer loyalty and engagement programs to deliver ROI-positive results

- Identify and mitigate risk, specifically how CRM changes may impact reporting and other processes; support account manager in managing client expectations, and ensuring client-delivery alignment between requirements and downstream deliverables.

Working with the Sales Team 

- Craft service narratives to communicate what we are building in service of our client’s mission, the outcomes we deliver to our customers, and the continued value Logical Media Group can provide to increase client success

- Assist Account Management and Director of Growth with creating clear business cases for new engagement opportunities, and get buy-in from key clients and stakeholders

- Articulate business and functional requirements of CRM, engaging in strategic storytelling to align and inspire a wide range of internal and external stakeholders

Requirements: 

- CRM platform proficiency, Hubspot preferred but not required. This includes but is not limited to competency in implementing, optimizing and speaking to workflows created as a part of a customer experience journey, list hygiene, and lead scoring. 

- An understanding of the nuances and challenges of tailoring performance marketing channels to unique customer journeys and/or Account Based Marketing needs

- Experience in identifying new marketing channels and target audiences, and devising marketing strategies that engage, inform and motivate innovation and ongoing optimization of performance for clients

- Comfortability with collaboration and presentation, both internally and client facing 

- Passion for creative problem-solving, working independently and sometimes without clear instruction. This position will be creating and optimizing processes in live time. 

- 2+ years of B2B strategy experience in-house or agency preferred 

Benefits

Logical Media Group Benefits

- Medical, Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, and Life insurance

- 401(k) plus match, to help plan for your future

- Paid time off (starting at 15 days), plus paid holidays, paid sick days, and paid personal days.

- Flexible Fridays

- Option to work completely remote

- Access to senior management and mentoring opportunities

- Optional COVID safe company gatherings

Logical is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. Each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company.

job.title: Digital Marketing Account Manager - Local SEO & Client Success
job.description:
Digital Marketing Account Manager – Local SEO & Client Success | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Mountain Time
 Location: Remote — LATAM, Philippines, or Pakistan
 Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
 Function: Digital Marketing / Account Management / Local SEO

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Digital Marketing Account Manager to manage relationships and marketing performance for a portfolio of local business clients.

This role combines client account management, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, performance reporting, and AI-assisted execution. You’ll be the primary point of contact for your clients, helping them understand their results while proactively identifying opportunities, resolving issues, and keeping their accounts moving forward.

The ideal candidate understands both sides of the role: strong client communication and hands-on digital marketing execution.

What You’ll Own

### Client Relationship Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients

- Build trust through consistent and proactive communication

- Develop a clear understanding of each client’s business, market, and goals

- Provide regular, specific updates on performance and ongoing work

- Track commitments and follow through on client requests

- Identify concerns early rather than waiting for clients to raise them

- Translate technical marketing information into clear, client-friendly language

### Local SEO & Google Business Profile

- Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles

- Maintain accurate business information and local listings

- Support review-management workflows

- Monitor local search visibility and ranking performance

You’ll be the primary point of contact for your clients, helping them understand their results while proactively identifying opportunities, resolving issues, and keeping their accounts moving forward.

The ideal candidate understands both sides of the role: strong client communication and hands-on digital marketing execution.

What You’ll Own

### Client Relationship Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients

- Build trust through consistent and proactive communication

- Develop a clear understanding of each client’s business, market, and goals

- Provide regular, specific updates on performance and ongoing work

- Track commitments and follow through on client requests

- Identify concerns early rather than waiting for clients to raise them

- Translate technical marketing information into clear, client-friendly language

### Local SEO & Google Business Profile

- Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles

- Maintain accurate business information and local listings

- Support review-management workflows

- Monitor local search visibility and ranking performance

- Implement appropriate on-page and off-page SEO tactics for local markets

- Identify opportunities to improve local organic visibility

- Monitor performance changes and investigate ranking declines

- Ensure Local SEO execution aligns with each client’s business objectives

### Analytics & Performance Reporting

- Monitor performance using Google Search Console and Google Analytics

- Review search visibility, traffic, rankings, and other relevant performance indicators

- Identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues

- Turn data into clear and actionable recommendations

- Prepare client-facing performance reports

- Explain results to non-technical clients in a straightforward way

- Use reporting to keep clients informed and engaged with their progress

### AI-Assisted Marketing Execution

- Use Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate day-to-day marketing workflows

- Draft client-facing and marketing content with AI assistance

- Conduct research and streamline recurring deliverables

- Review, edit, and quality-check AI-generated work before delivery

- Adapt outputs to each client’s brand, context, and objectives

- Apply independent judgment rather than relying on AI-generated output without review

### Issue Resolution & Account Ownership

- Identify performance dips or account concerns early

- Diagnose potential causes using available SEO and analytics data

- Coordinate internally to resolve client issues

- Communicate clearly with clients when problems arise

- Track issues through resolution

- Take end-to-end ownership of assigned accounts

### Growth & Upsell Opportunities

- Identify opportunities where additional marketing services could meaningfully benefit clients

- Recognize when services such as Google Ads may complement existing Local SEO efforts

- Communicate recommendations clearly and consultatively

- Focus on genuine client value rather than aggressive selling

- Coordinate internally when additional services are appropriate

Requirements

- 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, account management, or a related role

- Experience working with local businesses or SMB clients preferred

- Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles

- Experience with review management and local listing accuracy

- Working proficiency with Google Search Console

- Working proficiency with Google Analytics

- Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients

- Professional experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

- Strong editorial judgment when reviewing AI-generated content

- Excellent client communication and relationship-management skills

- Strong organizational and follow-up capabilities

- Ability to independently manage multiple client accounts

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team

- Availability to work full-time U.S. Mountain Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Google Ads

- Local SEO agency experience

- Experience managing multiple SMB or local-business accounts simultaneously

- Familiarity with local search ranking factors and optimization workflows

- Experience diagnosing organic search performance issues

- Experience identifying cross-sell or upsell opportunities

- Strong understanding of AI-assisted marketing workflows

Tools & Platforms

Google Business Profile | Google Search Console | Google Analytics | ChatGPT | Claude | Local SEO Tools | Google Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

- Communicate proactively so clients don’t need to chase you for updates

- Take ownership of accounts from start to finish

- Understand Local SEO beyond simply updating a Google Business Profile

- Can look at Search Console or Analytics data and identify what actually matters

- Explain technical marketing information clearly to business owners

- Flag performance issues early and take action

- Use AI as a productivity tool without sacrificing judgment or quality

- Know when AI-generated content needs significant rewriting

- Are organized enough to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deliverables

- Can work independently while staying aligned with a remote team

- Look for growth opportunities based on genuine client needs rather than pushing unnecessary services

Your day will operate on U.S. Mountain Time and balance proactive client management with hands-on marketing execution.

You may start by reviewing overnight client messages and identifying anything requiring immediate attention. From there, you could optimize Google Business Profiles, review Search Console for ranking changes or crawl issues, and analyze Google Analytics data for upcoming client reports.

You may use Claude or ChatGPT to accelerate content, research, or recommendations before applying your own judgment and editing the final output. Afternoons may include client check-ins or internal meetings to align on priorities and resolve outstanding issues.

- Client retention and satisfaction

- Quality and consistency of client communication

- Google Business Profile optimization and accuracy

- Local search visibility and performance

- Organic traffic and search trends

- Accuracy and usefulness of client reporting

- Timeliness of deliverables and follow-ups

- Speed of issue identification and resolution

- Account organization and ownership

- Appropriate identification of growth opportunities

- Quality and efficiency of AI-assisted workflows

Compensation, Hours & Location

Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
 Schedule: Full-Time, aligned with U.S. Mountain Time
 Location: Remote — open to candidates in LATAM, the Philippines, or Pakistan

Interview Process

- Initial Application & AI Rating

- Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview

- Recruiter Screen

- Client Interview

- Offer & Placement

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

- How do you structure your client communication cadence? What do clients typically hear from you, and how often?

- Are you available to work full-time on U.S. Mountain Time hours, and what does your current schedule look like?

This role is particularly well suited to someone who combines strong digital marketing execution with proactive, dependable client communication.

### Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads Specialist) – Remote

Meta Ads | Facebook & Instagram Advertising | Performance Marketing | Creative Strategy

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)
 Location: Remote

### About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads Specialist) to take full ownership of paid social advertising across multiple client and internal accounts.

This is far more than a campaign management role. You’ll own the entire performance lifecycle—from campaign strategy and creative direction to optimization, scaling, and performance reporting. Working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment, you’ll leverage data, creative testing, and audience insights to drive measurable business growth.

If you’ve successfully managed significant advertising budgets, consistently improved campaign performance, and understand how creative, offers, and analytics work together to generate results, this role is built for you.

### What You’ll Own

### Meta Ads Strategy & Campaign Management

- Build, launch, manage, and optimize Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Own campaign performance from planning through scaling.

- Manage multiple client and internal ad accounts simultaneously.

- Oversee monthly advertising budgets ranging from $10K–$250K+.

- Scale profitable campaigns while maintaining efficiency and profitability.

### Creative Strategy & Performance Marketing

- Develop high-converting campaign concepts, hooks, and messaging.

- Write compelling ad copy focused on improving:

- CTR

- CPL

- CPA

- ROAS

- Create detailed creative briefs for designers, editors, and content creators.

- Lead creative strategy across:

- Static image ads

- UGC-style videos

- Video scripts

- AI-assisted creative workflows

- Continuously test new creative angles and messaging.

### Campaign Optimization & Analytics

- Monitor campaign performance daily.

- Analyze:

- CTR

- CPC

- CPL

- CPA

- ROAS

- Frequency

- Conversion Rates

- Optimize audiences, creatives, offers, placements, and landing pages.

- Identify winning campaigns and scale them strategically.

- Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns using data-driven insights.

### Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with creative teams to produce high-performing advertising assets.

- Collaborate with leadership on growth initiatives and campaign priorities.

- Align paid advertising with broader marketing and revenue objectives.

- Stay current with Meta platform updates and advertising best practices.

### Requirements

### Must-Have Qualifications

### Experience

- 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Facebook and Instagram advertising.

- Proven experience managing at least $10,000/month in Meta ad spend.

- Experience managing 5 or more advertising accounts simultaneously.

### Core Skills

- Strong expertise with:

- Meta Ads Manager

- Facebook Business Suite

- Meta Pixel

- Conversion Tracking

- Attribution Modeling

- Funnel Optimization

- Excellent analytical and performance optimization skills.

- Strong direct-response copywriting and messaging abilities.

- Ability to identify and scale winning creatives.

- Deep understanding of performance marketing principles.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Reliable remote work environment with high-speed internet.

### Nice to Have

- Experience managing $100K–$250K+ monthly advertising budgets.

- Strong understanding of full-funnel marketing strategy.

- Experience producing or managing UGC advertising campaigns.

- Ability to brief creators, editors, and designers effectively.

- Experience using AI tools such as:

- ChatGPT

- AI creative generation tools

- Creative automation platforms

- Familiarity with:

- GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Close CRM

- Similar marketing platforms

- Previous experience within agencies or high-growth marketing teams.

### Tools & Platforms

- Meta Ads Manager

- Facebook Business Suite

- Meta Pixel

- ChatGPT & AI Creative Tools

- GoHighLevel (Preferred)

- Close CRM (Preferred)

- Marketing Analytics Platforms

### What Makes You a Strong Fit

- Highly analytical with a performance-first mindset.

- Strong creative instincts backed by data.

- Comfortable managing multiple high-budget campaigns.

- Excellent communicator who collaborates effectively across teams.

- Ownership-driven with strong accountability.

- Continuously tests, learns, and improves campaign performance.

### What a Typical Day Looks Like

- Review campaign dashboards and key performance metrics.

- Analyze winning and underperforming creatives.

- Launch and optimize Meta advertising campaigns.

- Write ad copy and develop new creative testing ideas.

- Prepare creative briefs for designers and video editors.

- Monitor CPL, CPA, CTR, ROAS, and conversion performance.

- Collaborate with internal teams on offers, funnels, and campaign strategy.

- Test new audiences, creatives, hooks, and messaging.

- Scale winning campaigns while optimizing underperforming ones.

In short: You own paid social growth by combining creative strategy, rapid experimentation, and data-driven optimization to deliver measurable business results.

### Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

- Cost Per Lead (CPL)

- Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)

- Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

- Click-Through Rate (CTR)

- Conversion Rate (CVR)

- Campaign scaling efficiency

- Revenue and pipeline contribution

- Creative testing velocity and continuous performance improvements

### Why This Role Stands Out

- High ownership over paid social strategy and execution.

- Opportunity to manage significant advertising budgets.

- Work in a fast-paced, performance-focused environment.

- Strong collaboration with creative and leadership teams.

- Fully remote work environment.

- Clear career progression into:

- Lead Media Buyer

- Performance Marketing Manager

- Growth Marketing Lead

- Director of Paid Media

### Interview Process

- Initial Phone Screen

- Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)

- Final Client Interview

- Offer & Background Verification

### What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

### Apply Now

If you’re passionate about performance marketing, thrive on scaling Meta advertising campaigns, and enjoy using creative strategy and data to drive measurable business growth, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key contributor to a high-performing marketing team.

- Close CRM

- Facebook Business Suite

- Meta Pixel

- ChatGPT & AI Creative Tools

- GoHighLevel (Preferred)

- Close CRM (Preferred)

- Marketing Analytics Platforms

### What Makes You a Strong Fit

- Highly analytical with a performance-first mindset.

- Strong creative instincts backed by data.

- Comfortable managing multiple high-budget campaigns.

- Excellent communicator who collaborates effectively across teams.

- Ownership-driven with strong accountability.

- Continuously tests, learns, and improves campaign performance.

### What a Typical Day Looks Like

- Review campaign dashboards and key performance metrics.

- Analyze winning and underperforming creatives.

- Launch and optimize Meta advertising campaigns.

- Write ad copy and develop new creative testing ideas.

- Prepare creative briefs for designers and video editors.

- Monitor CPL, CPA, CTR, ROAS, and conversion performance.

- Collaborate with internal teams on offers, funnels, and campaign strategy.

- Test new audiences, creatives, hooks, and messaging.

- Scale winning campaigns while optimizing underperforming ones.

- Fully remote work environment.

- Growth Marketing Lead

### Interview Process

- Final Client Interview

- Offer & Background Verification

### What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.
