job.title: Digital Marketing Account Manager - Local SEO & Client Success
job.description:
Digital Marketing Account Manager – Local SEO & Client Success | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Mountain Time
 Location: Remote — LATAM, Philippines, or Pakistan
 Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
 Function: Digital Marketing / Account Management / Local SEO

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Digital Marketing Account Manager to manage relationships and marketing performance for a portfolio of local business clients.

This role combines client account management, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, performance reporting, and AI-assisted execution. You’ll be the primary point of contact for your clients, helping them understand their results while proactively identifying opportunities, resolving issues, and keeping their accounts moving forward.

The ideal candidate understands both sides of the role: strong client communication and hands-on digital marketing execution.

What You’ll Own

### Client Relationship Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients

- Build trust through consistent and proactive communication

- Develop a clear understanding of each client’s business, market, and goals

- Provide regular, specific updates on performance and ongoing work

- Track commitments and follow through on client requests

- Identify concerns early rather than waiting for clients to raise them

- Translate technical marketing information into clear, client-friendly language

### Local SEO & Google Business Profile

- Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles

- Maintain accurate business information and local listings

- Support review-management workflows

- Monitor local search visibility and ranking performance

- Implement appropriate on-page and off-page SEO tactics for local markets

- Identify opportunities to improve local organic visibility

- Monitor performance changes and investigate ranking declines

- Ensure Local SEO execution aligns with each client’s business objectives

### Analytics & Performance Reporting

- Monitor performance using Google Search Console and Google Analytics

- Review search visibility, traffic, rankings, and other relevant performance indicators

- Identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues

- Turn data into clear and actionable recommendations

- Prepare client-facing performance reports

- Explain results to non-technical clients in a straightforward way

- Use reporting to keep clients informed and engaged with their progress

### AI-Assisted Marketing Execution

- Use Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate day-to-day marketing workflows

- Draft client-facing and marketing content with AI assistance

- Conduct research and streamline recurring deliverables

- Review, edit, and quality-check AI-generated work before delivery

- Adapt outputs to each client’s brand, context, and objectives

- Apply independent judgment rather than relying on AI-generated output without review

### Issue Resolution & Account Ownership

- Identify performance dips or account concerns early

- Diagnose potential causes using available SEO and analytics data

- Coordinate internally to resolve client issues

- Communicate clearly with clients when problems arise

- Track issues through resolution

- Take end-to-end ownership of assigned accounts

### Growth & Upsell Opportunities

- Identify opportunities where additional marketing services could meaningfully benefit clients

- Recognize when services such as Google Ads may complement existing Local SEO efforts

- Communicate recommendations clearly and consultatively

- Focus on genuine client value rather than aggressive selling

- Coordinate internally when additional services are appropriate

Requirements

- 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, account management, or a related role

- Experience working with local businesses or SMB clients preferred

- Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles

- Experience with review management and local listing accuracy

- Working proficiency with Google Search Console

- Working proficiency with Google Analytics

- Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients

- Professional experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

- Strong editorial judgment when reviewing AI-generated content

- Excellent client communication and relationship-management skills

- Strong organizational and follow-up capabilities

- Ability to independently manage multiple client accounts

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team

- Availability to work full-time U.S. Mountain Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Google Ads

- Local SEO agency experience

- Experience managing multiple SMB or local-business accounts simultaneously

- Familiarity with local search ranking factors and optimization workflows

- Experience diagnosing organic search performance issues

- Experience identifying cross-sell or upsell opportunities

- Strong understanding of AI-assisted marketing workflows

Tools & Platforms

Google Business Profile | Google Search Console | Google Analytics | ChatGPT | Claude | Local SEO Tools | Google Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

- Communicate proactively so clients don’t need to chase you for updates

- Take ownership of accounts from start to finish

- Understand Local SEO beyond simply updating a Google Business Profile

- Can look at Search Console or Analytics data and identify what actually matters

- Explain technical marketing information clearly to business owners

- Flag performance issues early and take action

- Use AI as a productivity tool without sacrificing judgment or quality

- Know when AI-generated content needs significant rewriting

- Are organized enough to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deliverables

- Can work independently while staying aligned with a remote team

- Look for growth opportunities based on genuine client needs rather than pushing unnecessary services

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day will operate on U.S. Mountain Time and balance proactive client management with hands-on marketing execution.

You may start by reviewing overnight client messages and identifying anything requiring immediate attention. From there, you could optimize Google Business Profiles, review Search Console for ranking changes or crawl issues, and analyze Google Analytics data for upcoming client reports.

You may use Claude or ChatGPT to accelerate content, research, or recommendations before applying your own judgment and editing the final output. Afternoons may include client check-ins or internal meetings to align on priorities and resolve outstanding issues.

In short: you’ll own client relationships while ensuring their Local SEO work is executed, measured, communicated, and continuously improved.

Key Metrics for Success

- Client retention and satisfaction

- Quality and consistency of client communication

- Google Business Profile optimization and accuracy

- Local search visibility and performance

- Organic traffic and search trends

- Accuracy and usefulness of client reporting

- Timeliness of deliverables and follow-ups

- Speed of issue identification and resolution

- Account organization and ownership

- Appropriate identification of growth opportunities

- Quality and efficiency of AI-assisted workflows

Compensation, Hours & Location

Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
 Schedule: Full-Time, aligned with U.S. Mountain Time
 Location: Remote — open to candidates in LATAM, the Philippines, or Pakistan

Interview Process

- Initial Application & AI Rating

- Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview

- Recruiter Screen

- Client Interview

- Offer & Placement

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Qualifying Questions

- Walk me through how you currently manage a Google Business Profile for a local business client. What does your optimization process look like?

- How do you use Claude or ChatGPT in your day-to-day work? Give a specific example of a task you handled with AI assistance and how you quality-checked the output.

- Describe a time when a client’s local search performance dropped. How did you diagnose the issue, and what steps did you take?

- How do you structure your client communication cadence? What do clients typically hear from you, and how often?

- Are you available to work full-time on U.S. Mountain Time hours, and what does your current schedule look like?

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Digital Marketing Account Manager with hands-on expertise in Local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and AI-assisted marketing workflows, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who combines strong digital marketing execution with proactive, dependable client communication.

#AccountManager #DigitalMarketing #LocalSEO #GoogleBusinessProfile #GoogleSearchConsole #GoogleAnalytics #ClientSuccess #SEO #ChatGPT #ClaudeAI #GoogleAds #DigitalMarketingJobs #RemoteMarketing #RemoteJobs

#LI-AG1

- Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients

- Build trust through consistent and proactive communication

- Develop a clear understanding of each client’s business, market, and goals

- Provide regular, specific updates on performance and ongoing work

- Track commitments and follow through on client requests

- Identify concerns early rather than waiting for clients to raise them

- Translate technical marketing information into clear, client-friendly language

- Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles

- Maintain accurate business information and local listings

- Support review-management workflows

- Monitor local search visibility and ranking performance

- Implement appropriate on-page and off-page SEO tactics for local markets

- Identify opportunities to improve local organic visibility

- Monitor performance changes and investigate ranking declines

- Ensure Local SEO execution aligns with each client’s business objectives

- Monitor performance using Google Search Console and Google Analytics

- Review search visibility, traffic, rankings, and other relevant performance indicators

- Identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues

- Turn data into clear and actionable recommendations

- Prepare client-facing performance reports

- Explain results to non-technical clients in a straightforward way

- Use reporting to keep clients informed and engaged with their progress

- Use Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate day-to-day marketing workflows

- Draft client-facing and marketing content with AI assistance

- Conduct research and streamline recurring deliverables

- Review, edit, and quality-check AI-generated work before delivery

- Adapt outputs to each client’s brand, context, and objectives

- Apply independent judgment rather than relying on AI-generated output without review

- Identify performance dips or account concerns early

- Diagnose potential causes using available SEO and analytics data

- Coordinate internally to resolve client issues

- Communicate clearly with clients when problems arise

- Track issues through resolution

- Communicate recommendations clearly and consultatively

- Focus on genuine client value rather than aggressive selling

- Coordinate internally when additional services are appropriate

- Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles

- Working proficiency with Google Analytics

- Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients

- Professional experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

- Strong editorial judgment when reviewing AI-generated content

- Excellent client communication and relationship-management skills

- Strong organizational and follow-up capabilities

- Ability to independently manage multiple client accounts

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team

- Availability to work full-time U.S. Mountain Time hours

- Local SEO agency experience

- Experience managing multiple SMB or local-business accounts simultaneously

- Familiarity with local search ranking factors and optimization workflows

- Experience diagnosing organic search performance issues

- Experience identifying cross-sell or upsell opportunities

- Strong understanding of AI-assisted marketing workflows

- Flag performance issues early and take action

- Use AI as a productivity tool without sacrificing judgment or quality

- Know when AI-generated content needs significant rewriting

- Are organized enough to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deliverables

- Can work independently while staying aligned with a remote team

- Look for growth opportunities based on genuine client needs rather than pushing unnecessary services

- Client retention and satisfaction

- Quality and consistency of client communication

- Google Business Profile optimization and accuracy

- Local search visibility and performance

- Organic traffic and search trends

- Accuracy and usefulness of client reporting

- Timeliness of deliverables and follow-ups

- Speed of issue identification and resolution

- Account organization and ownership

- Appropriate identification of growth opportunities

- Quality and efficiency of AI-assisted workflows

Compensation, Hours & Location

Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
 Schedule: Full-Time, aligned with U.S. Mountain Time
 Location: Remote — open to candidates in LATAM, the Philippines, or Pakistan

Interview Process

- Initial Application & AI Rating

- Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview

- Recruiter Screen

- Client Interview

- Offer & Placement

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Qualifying Questions

- Walk me through how you currently manage a Google Business Profile for a local business client. What does your optimization process look like?

- How do you use Claude or ChatGPT in your day-to-day work? Give a specific example of a task you handled with AI assistance and how you quality-checked the output.

- Describe a time when a client’s local search performance dropped. How did you diagnose the issue, and what steps did you take?

- How do you structure your client communication cadence? What do clients typically hear from you, and how often?

- Are you available to work full-time on U.S. Mountain Time hours, and what does your current schedule look like?

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Digital Marketing Account Manager with hands-on expertise in Local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and AI-assisted marketing workflows, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who combines strong digital marketing execution with proactive, dependable client communication.

job.description:
### Head of Sales & Marketing – B2B Revenue Growth & GTM | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

### About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Head of Sales & Marketing to own the commercial engine across sales, marketing, pipeline generation, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who can combine revenue strategy with hands-on execution. You’ll build predictable pipeline, improve conversion, lead sales and marketing teams, and develop scalable go-to-market systems.

### What You’ll Own

- Develop and execute the overall sales and marketing strategy

- Own revenue, pipeline, customer acquisition, and conversion targets

- Lead and develop sales and marketing teams

- Define ICP, positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy

- Oversee:

- Outbound sales

- Inbound marketing

- Paid acquisition

- Demand generation

- Partnerships

- Build scalable sales processes, playbooks, and operating systems

- Monitor the full funnel from lead generation → opportunity → close

- Own forecasting, pipeline reviews, and revenue reporting

- Identify funnel bottlenecks and improve conversion rates

- Recruit, onboard, coach, and develop commercial team members

- Partner directly with executive leadership on growth initiatives

### Requirements

- 7+ years of sales and/or marketing experience

- 3+ years in a sales, marketing, or revenue leadership role

- Demonstrated experience building and scaling revenue functions

- Strong understanding of B2B sales and marketing funnels

- Experience managing commercial teams and budgets

- Strong knowledge of:

- Pipeline generation

- Customer acquisition

- Sales conversion

- Demand generation

- GTM strategy

- Revenue forecasting

- Strong financial and analytical understanding of CAC, LTV, pipeline, conversion, and revenue

- Proven ability to manage performance against measurable targets

- Strategic thinker who is equally comfortable with hands-on execution

- Strong leadership and executive communication skills

### What Success Looks Like

- Predictable, growing sales pipeline

- Consistent revenue growth and improved conversion

- Clear alignment between sales and marketing

- Efficient customer acquisition and healthy CAC/LTV economics

- Accurate forecasting and revenue visibility

- Scalable sales and marketing processes

- High-performing, accountable commercial teams

### Interview Process

- Initial Screening Call

- Spark Hire Video Interview

- Recruiter Interview

- Executive/Client Interview

- Offer & Onboarding

### Apply Now

If you’ve successfully built revenue engines, led sales and marketing teams, scaled B2B pipeline, and improved commercial performance, this is an opportunity to take ownership of growth at the leadership level.

#HeadOfSales #HeadOfMarketing #SalesLeadership #MarketingLeadership #RevenueGrowth #B2BSales #DemandGeneration #GTM #BusinessDevelopment #RemoteJobs

job.title: Google Ads Specialist
job.description:
### Google Ads Specialist

Search + Performance Max | Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
 Location: Remote

### About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Google Ads Specialist to manage, optimize, and scale paid search campaigns across multiple client accounts.

This is a hands-on performance marketing role — not a strategy-only position.

You’ll be actively working inside Google Ads accounts every day to:

- Optimize Search and Performance Max campaigns

- Reduce Cost per Lead (CPL)

- Improve lead quality and conversion rates

- Troubleshoot conversion tracking

- Test new campaign strategies

- Scale campaigns that are performing

- Deliver clear, data-backed performance insights

If you live inside Google Ads, understand lead generation, and know how to diagnose and improve underperforming campaigns, this role is built for you.

### What You’ll Own

### Google Ads Campaign Management & Optimization

Manage campaigns across:

- Google Search Ads

- Performance Max

You’ll actively optimize:

- Bids

- Budgets

- Keywords

- Search terms

- Targeting

- Ad copy

- Campaign structure

Your focus will be on improving:

- Cost per Lead (CPL)

- Conversion rates

- Lead quality

- Campaign efficiency

- ROI

This role requires active account management — campaigns should never simply be placed on autopilot.

### Lead Generation & Performance Optimization

- Manage paid campaigns specifically focused on generating qualified leads

- Analyze campaign and funnel performance

- Identify wasted spend and inefficient targeting

- Improve keyword and search-term quality

- Optimize budgets toward the strongest-performing campaigns

- Identify opportunities to scale without sacrificing lead quality

- Make fast, data-driven adjustments when performance changes

### Campaign Setup & Testing

Build Google Ads campaigns from scratch, including:

- Campaign structure

- Ad groups

- Keywords

- Audience targeting

- Ad copy

- Conversion goals

Conduct ongoing:

- Keyword research

- Competitor analysis

- Ad testing

- Landing-page testing

- Targeting experiments

- A/B testing

Use results to continuously improve campaign performance.

### Conversion Tracking & Technical Setup — Critical

Implement and maintain accurate conversion tracking using:

- Google Tag Manager

- Google Analytics

You’ll:

- Configure conversion events

- Validate tracking accuracy

- Troubleshoot broken or missing conversions

- Investigate data discrepancies

- Ensure reliable attribution

- Confirm campaigns are optimizing against meaningful business outcomes

You should be comfortable fixing tracking yourself rather than relying entirely on another technical team.

### Analytics & Performance Monitoring

Monitor campaign performance using:

- Google Ads

- Google Analytics

- Google Tag Manager

- Campaign reporting dashboards

Analyze metrics such as:

- Cost per Lead (CPL)

- Conversion Rate

- Cost per Conversion

- Click-Through Rate (CTR)

- CPC

- Lead volume

- Campaign efficiency

- ROI

Identify underperformance quickly and take corrective action.

### Reporting & Communication

Prepare weekly performance reports that clearly explain:

- What’s working

- What’s not working

- Why performance changed

- What should happen next

Translate advertising data into practical recommendations for internal teams and stakeholders.

### Required Experience & Skills

### Non-Negotiables

- 2+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience

- Active Google Ads Certification

- Proven experience managing lead generation campaigns

- Strong hands-on experience with:

- Google Search Ads

- Performance Max

- Google Tag Manager

- Google Analytics

- Experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking

- Strong understanding of keyword research and campaign optimization

- Ability to analyze performance and make data-driven decisions

- Strong written and verbal English communication

- Ability to work during U.S. business hours

- Ability to manage multiple campaigns or accounts simultaneously

### Nice to Have

- Google Shopping Ads experience

- Meta Ads / Paid Social experience

- GoHighLevel familiarity

- Agency or multi-client account experience

- Landing-page and conversion-rate optimization knowledge

- Experience working with CRM-based lead attribution

### What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

- Are inside Google Ads accounts regularly, not just reviewing reports

- Know how to diagnose why CPL is increasing

- Understand the difference between generating more leads and generating better leads

- Can troubleshoot tracking without immediately handing the problem to someone else

- Make decisions based on performance data

- Test continuously instead of relying on one campaign setup

- Proactively identify problems before they become expensive

- Can confidently manage multiple client accounts

- Take ownership of performance and outcomes

### Who This Role Is NOT For

This role is not a strong fit for:

- Candidates with only basic Google Ads knowledge

- Marketers who have primarily observed campaigns rather than managed them

- Strategy-only marketers without hands-on execution experience

- Candidates without lead generation campaign experience

- Candidates who rely entirely on others for tracking setup and troubleshooting

- People uncomfortable managing multiple accounts simultaneously

### What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

- Reviewing performance across client accounts

- Identifying campaigns with rising CPL or declining conversions

- Adjusting bids, budgets, keywords, and targeting

- Reviewing search terms and eliminating wasted spend

- Optimizing Search and Performance Max campaigns

- Launching new ads or campaign tests

- Conducting keyword and competitor research

- Troubleshooting a conversion-tracking discrepancy

- Checking Google Analytics and Tag Manager

- Reviewing lead quality and campaign efficiency

- Preparing client or internal performance reports

- Identifying opportunities to scale successful campaigns

In short: you actively manage Google Ads performance every day, ensuring campaigns generate qualified leads efficiently and tracking remains accurate.

### Key Metrics for Success

- Reduced Cost per Lead (CPL)

- Increased qualified lead volume

- Improved conversion rates

- Improved campaign ROI

- Accurate and reliable conversion tracking

- Efficient budget utilization

- Consistent campaign testing and optimization

- Fast identification and resolution of performance issues

- Clear and actionable reporting

- Strong performance across multiple client accounts

### Why This Role Stands Out

- Direct ownership of paid media performance

- Hands-on management of multiple client accounts

- Strong focus on measurable lead-generation outcomes

- Opportunity to solve real tracking and attribution challenges

- Fast-paced environment with significant learning exposure

- Direct impact on client growth and marketing ROI

- Fully remote environment

- Career growth opportunities into:

- Senior Google Ads Specialist

- Paid Media Lead

- Performance Marketing Manager

- Head of Paid Media

### Interview Process

- Initial Phone Screen

- Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

- Client Interview

- Offer & Background Verification

### Apply Now

If you:

- Have 2+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience

- Hold an active Google Ads Certification

- Have managed Search and Performance Max campaigns

- Understand lead-generation performance deeply

- Can independently manage Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking

- Care about CPL, lead quality, conversions, and ROI — not just clicks

- Proactively optimize campaigns rather than leaving them on autopilot

We’d love to hear from you.

### Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of our application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

This is your opportunity to introduce yourself and highlight your experience with Google Ads, Search campaigns, Performance Max, lead generation, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization.

We recommend sharing specific examples of campaigns you’ve managed, including monthly ad spend, lead volume, CPL, conversion improvements, and how you diagnosed or fixed tracking and performance issues.

Please complete your Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation. Candidates who do not complete the video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

job.title: Digital Marketing Account Manager
job.description:
Position Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Mountain Time

About the Role:

We’re looking for an experienced Account Manager to manage a portfolio of local business clients and help them improve their online visibility and performance.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for building strong client relationships, managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles, monitoring local SEO performance, reviewing analytics, and turning data into clear recommendations. You’ll also use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to streamline research and content creation while applying your own judgment to ensure the final work is accurate, useful, and aligned with each client’s brand.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, comfortable working independently, and able to communicate digital marketing insights clearly to non-technical clients.

Key Responsibilities:

### Client Relationship Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients.

- Build strong client relationships through consistent communication and proactive updates.

- Understand each client’s goals, priorities, and business needs.

- Keep clients informed about progress, results, opportunities, and potential issues.

- Manage accounts end-to-end and follow through on client commitments.

### Local SEO Strategy & Execution

- Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles for local business clients.

- Monitor local search rankings and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Manage reviews and support accurate local business information and listings.

- Implement on-page and off-page SEO strategies tailored to local markets.

- Identify performance trends, ranking changes, and areas requiring attention.

- Recommend practical SEO improvements based on client goals and performance data.

### Performance Reporting & Analytics

- Use Google Search Console to monitor search performance, rankings, and potential issues.

- Use Google Analytics to analyze website and user performance.

- Interpret marketing data and identify meaningful trends and insights.

- Prepare clear, actionable performance reports for clients.

- Explain SEO and analytics results in a simple, easy-to-understand way for non-technical clients.

- Use reporting insights to guide recommendations and account strategy.

### AI-Assisted Workflow

- Use Claude and ChatGPT to support content creation, research, analysis, and day-to-day deliverables.

- Use AI tools to improve efficiency and streamline repetitive workflows.

- Review, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content before delivering it to clients.

- Ensure AI-assisted outputs meet quality, accuracy, brand, and client-specific standards.

- Know when AI output needs significant rewriting or should not be used.

### Issue Resolution & Escalation

- Monitor client accounts and identify performance dips or potential issues early.

- Investigate problems and determine appropriate next steps.

- Coordinate with internal teams to resolve client issues.

- Communicate proactively with clients when issues arise.

- Escalate concerns when necessary, with clear context and recommended solutions.

### Growth & Upsell Opportunities

- Identify opportunities where additional services could benefit clients.

- Recognize when services such as Google Ads may support a client's goals.

- Communicate recommendations clearly and professionally without being overly sales-focused.

- Work with the appropriate internal team when an additional service is identified.

Required Experience & Skills:

- 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, account management, or a related role.

- Experience working with local businesses or small-to-medium-sized businesses is strongly preferred.

- Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles.

- Experience with Google Business Profile review management and local listing accuracy.

- Working knowledge of Google Search Console and Google Analytics.

- Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients.

- Professional experience using AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT.

- Strong editorial judgment and ability to review and improve AI-generated content.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent organization and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple client accounts and priorities independently.

- Strong problem-solving and follow-through skills.

- Availability to work full-time during U.S. Mountain Time hours.

Nice to Have:

- Experience with Google Ads.

- Experience managing multiple local SEO accounts simultaneously.

- Experience working with local service businesses or other location-based businesses.

- Familiarity with additional SEO, analytics, reporting, or marketing platforms.

- Experience identifying opportunities for account growth or additional services.

Typical Day:

Your day will balance proactive account management, local SEO work, client communication, and performance analysis.

You may start by reviewing client messages and identifying anything that requires immediate attention. You’ll then work on tasks such as optimizing Google Business Profiles, reviewing Google Search Console for ranking or search-performance changes, analyzing Google Analytics data, and preparing client reports.

You’ll also use Claude or ChatGPT to assist with research and content-related tasks, while reviewing and refining the output before it is delivered. Throughout the day, you’ll communicate with clients, provide updates, address issues, coordinate with internal teams, and identify opportunities to improve account performance or introduce additional services where appropriate.

Interview Process:

- SparkHire Video Interview

- Client Interview

- Offer Stage

- Understand each client’s goals, priorities, and business needs.

- Keep clients informed about progress, results, opportunities, and potential issues.

- Manage accounts end-to-end and follow through on client commitments.

### Local SEO Strategy & Execution

- Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles for local business clients.

- Monitor local search rankings and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Manage reviews and support accurate local business information and listings.

- Implement on-page and off-page SEO strategies tailored to local markets.

- Identify performance trends, ranking changes, and areas requiring attention.

- Recommend practical SEO improvements based on client goals and performance data.

### Performance Reporting & Analytics

- Use Google Search Console to monitor search performance, rankings, and potential issues.

- Use Google Analytics to analyze website and user performance.

- Interpret marketing data and identify meaningful trends and insights.

- Prepare clear, actionable performance reports for clients.

job.description:
### Senior Marketing Coordinator – Remote

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours (PST Required)

### About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Marketing Coordinator to support marketing execution, social media, CRM operations, content coordination, program administration, and executive workflows.

This is a hands-on execution role, not a marketing strategy or leadership position. You’ll work closely with leadership to keep campaigns, content, systems, communication, and day-to-day operations organized and moving forward.

We’re looking for someone who is proactive, highly organized, digitally savvy, and excellent at follow-through.

### What You’ll Do

### Marketing & Social Media

- Create, schedule, and publish content across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and community platforms

- Manage engagement, DMs, and community interactions

- Support promotions, events, and advertising campaigns

- Track basic social performance and maintain reporting

### Content & Digital Assets

- Edit short-form videos and create social media graphics

- Use tools such as Canva, VEED, and OpusClip

- Organize and format workbooks, guides, scripts, and program materials

- Maintain consistent branding across digital content

### CRM & Email Marketing

- Build and manage workflows in GoHighLevel (GHL) and other CRM/automation platforms

- Execute email campaigns, outreach, and follow-up sequences

- Maintain clean CRM records and pipeline tracking

- Ensure leads and participant follow-ups are completed on time

### Executive & Operations Support

- Manage calendars, scheduling, communication, and administrative coordination

- Maintain task trackers and project management sheets

- Track deadlines, action items, and follow-ups

- Proactively identify gaps or delays in workflows

### Program & Community Support

- Coordinate onboarding and participant communication

- Organize digital program and membership resources

- Track participant progress and outstanding actions

- Troubleshoot minor platform or account issues

### Research & Lead Generation

- Research target audiences and build ICP/prospect lists

- Support lead generation and outbound marketing initiatives

- Assist with basic website updates, account setup, reporting, and documentation

### What We’re Looking For

- Experience in Marketing Coordination, Executive Assistance, Digital Marketing Operations, or Operations Support

- Strong experience with Google Workspace

- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL), CRM systems, or marketing automation

- Comfortable using Canva and video editing/content tools

- Good understanding of LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and community engagement

- Excellent written English and professional communication

- Strong organization, multitasking, and attention to detail

- Ability to work independently during U.S. PST business hours

Nice to have: Experience supporting founders, coaches, membership communities, or entrepreneurial businesses; email marketing, funnels, lead generation, paid ads, or landing pages.

### What Success Looks Like

- Content consistently published on schedule

- Clean and accurate CRM records

- Reliable email campaigns and follow-up workflows

- No missed lead or participant follow-ups

- Organized program materials and digital assets

- Responsive community engagement

- Leadership can confidently rely on your execution and follow-through

### Why Join?

- Fully remote opportunity

- High ownership across marketing and operations

- Direct exposure to leadership

- Hands-on experience with CRM, content, social media, automation, and digital programs

- Growth opportunities into Marketing Operations, Program Management, Digital Operations, or Executive Operations

### Interview Process

- Application Review

- Spark Hire Intro Video

- Marketing & Systems Interview

- Practical Task

- Client Interview

- Offer & Onboarding

### What Happens After You Apply

Qualified applicants will receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to complete a short Intro Video. This helps us learn more about your communication skills, marketing experience, systems knowledge, and approach to organization and execution.

Please check your inbox and spam/junk folder for the invitation.

### Apply Now

If you’re highly organized, comfortable with GoHighLevel, social media, content creation, and marketing operations, and enjoy keeping fast-moving businesses organized behind the scenes, we’d love to hear from you.

#MarketingCoordinator #MarketingOperations #GoHighLevel #SocialMedia #DigitalMarketing #ExecutiveAssistant #CRM #Canva #RemoteJobs #PSTJobs

job.title: Digital Marketing Account Manager
job.description:
Position Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Mountain Time

About the Role:

We’re looking for an experienced Account Manager to manage a portfolio of local business clients and help them improve their online visibility and performance.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for building strong client relationships, managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles, monitoring local SEO performance, reviewing analytics, and turning data into clear recommendations. You’ll also use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to streamline research and content creation while applying your own judgment to ensure the final work is accurate, useful, and aligned with each client’s brand.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, comfortable working independently, and able to communicate digital marketing insights clearly to non-technical clients.

Key Responsibilities:

### Client Relationship Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients.

- Build strong client relationships through consistent communication and proactive updates.

- Understand each client’s goals, priorities, and business needs.

- Keep clients informed about progress, results, opportunities, and potential issues.

- Manage accounts end-to-end and follow through on client commitments.

### Local SEO Strategy & Execution

- Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles for local business clients.

- Monitor local search rankings and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Manage reviews and support accurate local business information and listings.

- Implement on-page and off-page SEO strategies tailored to local markets.

- Identify performance trends, ranking changes, and areas requiring attention.

- Recommend practical SEO improvements based on client goals and performance data.

### Performance Reporting & Analytics

- Use Google Search Console to monitor search performance, rankings, and potential issues.

- Use Google Analytics to analyze website and user performance.

- Interpret marketing data and identify meaningful trends and insights.

- Prepare clear, actionable performance reports for clients.

- Explain SEO and analytics results in a simple, easy-to-understand way for non-technical clients.

- Use reporting insights to guide recommendations and account strategy.

### AI-Assisted Workflow

- Use Claude and ChatGPT to support content creation, research, analysis, and day-to-day deliverables.

- Use AI tools to improve efficiency and streamline repetitive workflows.

- Review, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content before delivering it to clients.

- Ensure AI-assisted outputs meet quality, accuracy, brand, and client-specific standards.

- Know when AI output needs significant rewriting or should not be used.

### Issue Resolution & Escalation

- Monitor client accounts and identify performance dips or potential issues early.

- Investigate problems and determine appropriate next steps.

- Coordinate with internal teams to resolve client issues.

- Communicate proactively with clients when issues arise.

- Escalate concerns when necessary, with clear context and recommended solutions.

### Growth & Upsell Opportunities

- Identify opportunities where additional services could benefit clients.

- Recognize when services such as Google Ads may support a client's goals.

- Communicate recommendations clearly and professionally without being overly sales-focused.

- Work with the appropriate internal team when an additional service is identified.

Required Experience & Skills:

- 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, account management, or a related role.

- Experience working with local businesses or small-to-medium-sized businesses is strongly preferred.

- Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles.

- Experience with Google Business Profile review management and local listing accuracy.

- Working knowledge of Google Search Console and Google Analytics.

- Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients.

- Professional experience using AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT.

- Strong editorial judgment and ability to review and improve AI-generated content.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent organization and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple client accounts and priorities independently.

- Strong problem-solving and follow-through skills.

- Availability to work full-time during U.S. Mountain Time hours.

Nice to Have:

- Experience with Google Ads.

- Experience managing multiple local SEO accounts simultaneously.

- Experience working with local service businesses or other location-based businesses.

- Familiarity with additional SEO, analytics, reporting, or marketing platforms.

- Experience identifying opportunities for account growth or additional services.

Typical Day:

Your day will balance proactive account management, local SEO work, client communication, and performance analysis.

You may start by reviewing client messages and identifying anything that requires immediate attention. You’ll then work on tasks such as optimizing Google Business Profiles, reviewing Google Search Console for ranking or search-performance changes, analyzing Google Analytics data, and preparing client reports.

You’ll also use Claude or ChatGPT to assist with research and content-related tasks, while reviewing and refining the output before it is delivered. Throughout the day, you’ll communicate with clients, provide updates, address issues, coordinate with internal teams, and identify opportunities to improve account performance or introduce additional services where appropriate.

Interview Process:

- SparkHire Video Interview

- Client Interview

- Offer Stage 

#LI-AG1

job.title: Marketing Manager | B2B Growth | Salesforce & AI
job.description:
### Marketing Manager – Remote

B2B Marketing | Demand Generation | Salesforce Pardot | AI-Powered Marketing

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Location: Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
 Compensation: $3,500–$5,000 USD/month

### About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Marketing Manager to lead and scale the entire marketing function for a growing B2B managed IT and wireless services company.

This is a high-ownership leadership role designed for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You’ll work directly with the CEO to drive lead generation, strengthen brand awareness, optimize marketing performance, and build scalable systems that contribute directly to pipeline and revenue growth.

This is not a marketing coordinator role. You’ll own marketing strategy, campaign execution, reporting, vendor management, and marketing operations while leveraging AI to improve efficiency and results.

If you enjoy building marketing functions, making data-driven decisions, and creating measurable business impact, this role is a strong fit.

### What You’ll Own

### Marketing Strategy & Growth

- Own the company’s marketing strategy and roadmap.

- Develop initiatives that drive:

- Lead generation

- Pipeline growth

- Brand awareness

- Revenue growth

- Analyze performance across all marketing channels and continuously optimize results.

- Partner directly with executive leadership on strategic growth initiatives.

- Identify opportunities to improve marketing processes, campaigns, and overall ROI.

### Marketing Analytics & Reporting

- Prepare and present monthly marketing KPI reports.

- Monitor performance across:

- LinkedIn

- Salesforce Pardot (MCAE)

- Salesforce Sales Engagement

- Zoom Webinars

- Google Search Console

- Google Business Profile

- Analyze campaign performance and identify trends.

- Deliver actionable recommendations based on data and marketing insights.

### Content Marketing & Thought Leadership

- Own the company’s LinkedIn strategy and execution.

- Create weekly LinkedIn content for:

- Company page

- Executive personal brands

- Produce and distribute a monthly newsletter to approximately 12,000 subscribers.

- Develop blog content strategies and editorial calendars.

- Coordinate customer success stories and case studies.

- Create content that supports:

- SEO

- Lead generation

- Brand positioning

- Audience engagement

### Webinar & Demand Generation

- Plan and execute webinars every 6–8 weeks.

- Manage:

- Registration campaigns

- Email invitations

- Reminder sequences

- Post-event follow-up

- Coordinate webinar logistics using Zoom.

- Repurpose webinar recordings into additional marketing assets.

- Support demand generation initiatives throughout the buyer journey.

### CRM & Sales Enablement

- Manage marketing campaigns inside Salesforce Pardot (MCAE).

- Build and optimize:

- Email nurture campaigns

- Marketing automation workflows

- Salesforce Sales Engagement cadences

- Ensure marketing and sales remain aligned throughout the customer journey.

- Support channel-partner marketing initiatives.

### Website & Digital Presence

- Manage website updates within Webflow.

- Maintain and optimize:

- Google Business Profile

- Local search visibility

- Monitor and respond to customer reviews.

- Support future website redesign and company rebranding initiatives.

### Contractor & Vendor Management

- Hire and manage external marketing contractors including:

- Graphic designers

- SEO specialists

- Web developers

- Copywriters

- Manage project timelines, budgets, and deliverables.

- Ensure quality standards across all outsourced work.

### Marketing Operations & AI

- Build scalable marketing systems and workflows.

- Improve reporting, campaign execution, and content production processes.

- Leverage AI tools such as:

- Claude

- ChatGPT

- Gemini

- Use AI to accelerate:

- Content creation

- Campaign planning

- Research

- Performance analysis

- Workflow automation

- Continuously identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and ROI.

### Requirements

### Must-Have Qualifications

- 4–7 years of B2B marketing experience.

- Experience owning or leading a marketing function.

- Strong understanding of demand generation and revenue marketing.

- Excellent written English communication skills.

- Experience creating:

- LinkedIn content

- Email newsletters

- Blog strategies

- Hands-on experience with:

- Salesforce

- Salesforce Pardot (MCAE)

- Salesforce Sales Engagement

- LinkedIn

- Webflow

- Zoom Webinars

- Canva

- Google Search Console

- Google Business Profile

- Strong understanding of marketing analytics and KPI reporting.

- Experience managing marketing vendors or contractors.

- Strong knowledge of B2B sales cycles.

- Active experience integrating AI tools into daily marketing workflows.

- Ability to explain how AI improves marketing execution and business outcomes.

### Nice to Have

- Experience within:

- Managed IT Services (MSP)

- Telecommunications

- Networking

- Technology services

- Experience marketing through:

- Channel partners

- VARs

- Reseller networks

- SEO knowledge.

- Experience leading:

- Company rebrands

- Website redesigns

- Website migrations

- Experience scaling marketing operations for companies between $5M–$50M ARR.

- Advanced experience with:

- Claude

- ChatGPT

- Gemini

- AI-powered marketing workflows

### What Makes You a Strong Fit

- Strategic thinker who enjoys executing.

- Highly analytical and data-driven.

- Comfortable owning an entire marketing function.

- Strong business judgment and prioritization skills.

- Self-starter who thrives with autonomy.

- Organized and capable of managing multiple priorities.

- Excellent communicator and collaborator.

- Curious, resourceful, and continuously learning.

- Naturally looks for ways to improve marketing systems and performance.

### What a Typical Day Looks Like

- Review marketing dashboards and KPI performance.

- Create and schedule LinkedIn content.

- Manage email marketing campaigns and newsletters.

- Coordinate webinar planning and promotion.

- Update website content in Webflow.

- Meet with contractors and review deliverables.

- Analyze campaign performance and pipeline contribution.

- Collaborate with leadership on growth initiatives.

- Identify optimization opportunities.

- Use AI tools to accelerate planning, content creation, reporting, and decision-making.

In short: You own the company’s marketing engine—driving demand generation, content, marketing operations, and measurable pipeline growth while continuously improving systems and performance.

### Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

- Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)

- Marketing pipeline contribution

- LinkedIn audience growth and engagement

- Newsletter open and click-through rates

- Webinar registrations and attendance

- Website traffic and organic search growth

- Lead conversion rates

- Google Business Profile engagement

- Campaign ROI

- Marketing efficiency and execution quality

### Why Join Us?

- Direct collaboration with executive leadership.

- Full ownership of the marketing function.

- Opportunity to build and scale a modern B2B marketing engine.

- Budget authority to hire and manage specialized contractors.

- Fully remote work environment.

- Competitive compensation.

- Opportunity to lead future rebranding and website transformation initiatives.

- High-impact role with significant long-term growth potential.

### Interview Process

- Application Review

- Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)

- Final Client Interview

- Offer & Onboarding

### Assessment Process

Finalists will receive a sample monthly KPI report before the final interview. During the interview, you’ll discuss your priorities, recommendations, growth opportunities, and strategic decisions based on the data provided.

The assessment is designed to evaluate your marketing judgment, analytical thinking, and decision-making, rather than presentation design or memorization.

### What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

**Position:** Content Marketing Manager - Fintech Growth
**Type:** Full-Time Remote | Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
**Location:** South Africa

**About This Opportunity:**
Join a fast-growing fintech company as their Content Marketing Manager and build brand authority in the cross-border payments space. Own the complete content marketing function while driving organic growth through strategic storytelling and digital presence.

**What You'll Do:**
• Develop and execute comprehensive content strategy focused on fintech brand authority
• Create long-form articles, LinkedIn posts, newsletters, case studies, and AI-powered video content
• Manage organic presence across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouTube, and diaspora platforms
• Launch and manage branded podcast or webinar series for thought leadership
• Execute digital PR strategy with media outreach and speaking opportunities
• Build foundational SEO strategy and optimize on-page content for organic growth
• Nurture digital communities within fintech and cross-border payment ecosystems
• Maintain rolling 30-day content calendar with consistent execution

**What You Bring:**
• 3-5 years digital marketing or content-driven brand growth experience
• Proven content marketing portfolio with measurable organic growth impact
• Strong storytelling ability and exceptional written English skills
• Hands-on experience with AI-driven video content tools (Gemini, Vio, SmartViti)
• Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, and SEO fundamentals
• Organic social media strategy and execution experience across multiple platforms
• Experience in fintech, cross-border payments, or B2B SaaS (preferred)
• Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote work setup

**Key Success Metrics:**
• Organic follower growth and engagement rates across platforms
• SEO ranking improvements and organic traffic growth
• Podcast/webinar audience growth and participation rates
• Media mentions and brand amplification achievements
• Consistent 30-day content calendar execution

**Why You'll Love This Role:**
• Own the complete content marketing function for growing fintech company
• Work directly with founders in dynamic startup environment
• Build thought leadership in exciting cross-border payments space
• Creative freedom with content strategy and execution approach
• Remote flexibility with established content marketing processes

**Ready to build fintech brand authority?** Apply now with your content portfolio.

#ContentMarketing #Fintech #DigitalMarketing #RemoteWork #SouthAfrica

job.title: Digital Marketing Account Manager
job.description:
Position Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Mountain Time

About the Role:

We’re looking for an experienced Account Manager to manage a portfolio of local business clients and help them improve their online visibility and performance.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for building strong client relationships, managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles, monitoring local SEO performance, reviewing analytics, and turning data into clear recommendations. You’ll also use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to streamline research and content creation while applying your own judgment to ensure the final work is accurate, useful, and aligned with each client’s brand.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, comfortable working independently, and able to communicate digital marketing insights clearly to non-technical clients.

Key Responsibilities:

### Client Relationship Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients.

- Build strong client relationships through consistent communication and proactive updates.

- Understand each client’s goals, priorities, and business needs.

- Keep clients informed about progress, results, opportunities, and potential issues.

- Manage accounts end-to-end and follow through on client commitments.

### Local SEO Strategy & Execution

- Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles for local business clients.

- Monitor local search rankings and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Manage reviews and support accurate local business information and listings.

- Implement on-page and off-page SEO strategies tailored to local markets.

- Identify performance trends, ranking changes, and areas requiring attention.

- Recommend practical SEO improvements based on client goals and performance data.

### Performance Reporting & Analytics

- Use Google Search Console to monitor search performance, rankings, and potential issues.

- Use Google Analytics to analyze website and user performance.

- Interpret marketing data and identify meaningful trends and insights.

- Prepare clear, actionable performance reports for clients.

- Explain SEO and analytics results in a simple, easy-to-understand way for non-technical clients.

- Use reporting insights to guide recommendations and account strategy.

### AI-Assisted Workflow

- Use Claude and ChatGPT to support content creation, research, analysis, and day-to-day deliverables.

- Use AI tools to improve efficiency and streamline repetitive workflows.

- Review, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content before delivering it to clients.

- Ensure AI-assisted outputs meet quality, accuracy, brand, and client-specific standards.

- Know when AI output needs significant rewriting or should not be used.

### Issue Resolution & Escalation

- Monitor client accounts and identify performance dips or potential issues early.

- Investigate problems and determine appropriate next steps.

- Coordinate with internal teams to resolve client issues.

- Communicate proactively with clients when issues arise.

- Escalate concerns when necessary, with clear context and recommended solutions.

### Growth & Upsell Opportunities

- Identify opportunities where additional services could benefit clients.

- Recognize when services such as Google Ads may support a client's goals.

- Communicate recommendations clearly and professionally without being overly sales-focused.

- Work with the appropriate internal team when an additional service is identified.

Required Experience & Skills:

- 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, account management, or a related role.

- Experience working with local businesses or small-to-medium-sized businesses is strongly preferred.

- Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles.

- Experience with Google Business Profile review management and local listing accuracy.

- Working knowledge of Google Search Console and Google Analytics.

- Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients.

- Professional experience using AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT.

- Strong editorial judgment and ability to review and improve AI-generated content.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent organization and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple client accounts and priorities independently.

- Strong problem-solving and follow-through skills.

- Availability to work full-time during U.S. Mountain Time hours.

Nice to Have:

- Experience with Google Ads.

- Experience managing multiple local SEO accounts simultaneously.

- Experience working with local service businesses or other location-based businesses.

- Familiarity with additional SEO, analytics, reporting, or marketing platforms.

- Experience identifying opportunities for account growth or additional services.

Typical Day:

Your day will balance proactive account management, local SEO work, client communication, and performance analysis.

You may start by reviewing client messages and identifying anything that requires immediate attention. You’ll then work on tasks such as optimizing Google Business Profiles, reviewing Google Search Console for ranking or search-performance changes, analyzing Google Analytics data, and preparing client reports.

You’ll also use Claude or ChatGPT to assist with research and content-related tasks, while reviewing and refining the output before it is delivered. Throughout the day, you’ll communicate with clients, provide updates, address issues, coordinate with internal teams, and identify opportunities to improve account performance or introduce additional services where appropriate.

Interview Process:

- SparkHire Video Interview

- Client Interview

- Offer Stage

job.title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager
job.description:
Role at a glance

What: As Sr. Growth Marketing Manager, you'll own pipeline coverage and top-of-funnel demand gen end-to-end — deciding how we get there, not just executing a fixed plan.

Impact: You'll build and run the demand engine that gets Rally and our recently launched Agent and MCP in front of the buyers evaluating an AI-native research stack, directly shaping whether pipeline turns into revenue.

Team: You'll join our Marketing team and work closely with Sales, the founders, and cross-functional partners across Product and Engineering. At our size, the lines between them ebb and flow, so you'll always be working cross-functionally.

Where: Remote-first across the US, with hubs in New York and Boston.

About Rally

In a world where anyone can ship anything, the teams building closest to their users win. But talking to users is still way harder than it should be. Pulling lists, chasing consent, juggling calendars, sending incentives: it's why most product teams skip research altogether.

We're here to end manual recruitment.

Rally is agentic research infrastructure: the system that lets companies talk to their own users safely, at any scale. Tell Rally what you want to learn, and Rally Agent builds the study, finds the right participants, and handles outreach, scheduling, and incentives, all within your company's guardrails. It works from the Rally app, from Slack, or from the AI tools you already use. Agents handle the busywork, so people focus on the human parts: learning from each other.

Today, teams at Google, Meta, Figma, Ramp, Perplexity, and MongoDB run their research on Rally. And we're building a company that lasts, investing in the product and the team for the long haul.

The opportunity

We believe teams will always need to talk to their users, however far AI goes, and most companies still don't have a safe way to let team members outside of traditional UX Research do it. We recently launched Rally's Agent and MCP, and we're going after the biggest companies in the world. The product is catching up to the vision, with plenty of exciting challenges still ahead.

That's where you come in. You'd join Marketing, a small, high-ownership team that's a little obsessed with our users. We work side by side with the researchers and product builders who use Rally every day, and yes, we use Rally to build Rally.

This role exists because demand gen and pipeline need a dedicated owner unafraid to take risks — you'd own it end-to-end, with real latitude to build the approach that works.

What you'll do

- 

Identify and test new channels or tactics to diversify pipeline sources

- 

Run events, email marketing strategy, and social campaigns

- 

Partner with sales to align campaigns with pipeline targets and feedback from the field

- 

Collaborate with product marketing on product-focused campaigns and joint strategy building, ensuring positioning and messaging translate into pipeline-generating activity

- 

Continuously optimize based on CAC, conversion rates, and pipeline velocity

What you'll bring

- 

6+ years running demand gen or growth marketing, with a track record of owning a pipeline number and measurable results to show for it

- 

Built and owned experience across paid, events, and content

- 

Tech/SaaS background, startup to mid-market, comfortable operating with limited resources and ambiguity

- 

You'd rather figure out the right approach yourself than wait to be told what to do

Nice to have

- 

Managing paid campaigns (Google and LinkedIn) and hosted webinars

- 

Experience in UXR or adjacent research/product tooling

- 

Startup experience, particularly at Series A/B stage

Don’t check every box? Apply anyway. We care a lot more about what you can do than a perfect match to a list.

How we work

We’re remote-first, but we’re not strangers.

Async by default: We write things down, keep each other in the loop, and save meetings for decisions and real connection.

Together when it counts: We get together in person throughout the year to plan, build, and celebrate.

Owners, not order-takers: You’ll have real responsibility from day one and the trust to figure out how to get there.

User first, always: We talk to users constantly, and it shapes every decision we make.

AI-native, inside and out: We’re building an agentic product, and we work like it. Everyone here is experimenting with AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.

This might not be for you if…

- 

You want a clearly defined lane. Roles here stretch, and priorities shift as we learn.

- 

You’d rather hand work off than own it end to end.

- 

You need a lot of process or a big team around you to do your best work.

- 

You're not curious about how AI is changing the way we work (we're rethinking it constantly).

- 

You'd rather guess what users want than go ask them.

- 

You need a big team or agency behind you to run paid, events, and content

If you read that and thought, “that’s exactly why I’d love it here,” we’d really like to hear from you!

Compensation & benefits

Base salary range (US): $120,000 - $140,000 USD per year.

This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hires in this role across the United States. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job‑related skills, experience, and location.

Additional compensation: This role is eligible for variable compensation such as equity in accordance with Rally’s applicable plans. Any such compensation is not guaranteed and is determined at Rally’s discretion under the terms of those plans.

We want you to feel taken care of, so you can do your best work. For US-based full-time employees, that includes:

- 

Competitive pay and meaningful equity

- 

Great medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 

14 weeks of fully paid parental leave, for every parent

- 

Unlimited PTO (and we want you to use it)

- 

Home office and co-working support

- 

Mental health and wellness support

- 

401(k)

- 

Opportunities for in-person time with coworkers

Benefits may vary based on role, level, and location, and are subject to change as Rally grows.

Our hiring process

We want interviewing with us to feel like a preview of working here: structured, transparent, and focused on real work. Steps can vary a bit by role, but here’s the usual flow:

- 

Recruiter chat (30 min): Get to know each other and make sure the role fits what you’re looking for.

- 

Hiring manager conversation (45 min): Dig into the role, your experience, and what success looks like.

- 

Practical exercise: A take-home or working session based on the work you’d actually do. No brain teasers.

- 

Final interviews: 3–5 conversations with future teammates, cross-functional partners, and one of our founders.

- 

References and offer: We move fast here.

We’ll tell you what to expect at every step. And since we’re a research company, we’d love your feedback on the process too.

We’re building a team that reflects the range of people who use products like ours, and we’re committed to paying fairly for the work. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market data for our size, stage, and industry, and may adjust over time as the market evolves.

Rally is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We’re committed to providing reasonable accommodations to candidates with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need support or an adjustment at any point, please let us know how we can help.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work for this role. It is not a complete list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Employment with Rally is “at will,” which means either you or Rally may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason or no reason at all.

fields.responsibilities:
- 

Identify and test new channels or tactics to diversify pipeline sources

- 

Run events, email marketing strategy, and social campaigns

- 

Partner with sales to align campaigns with pipeline targets and feedback from the field

- 

Collaborate with product marketing on product-focused campaigns and joint strategy building, ensuring positioning and messaging translate into pipeline-generating activity

- 

Continuously optimize based on CAC, conversion rates, and pipeline velocity

What you'll bring

- 

6+ years running demand gen or growth marketing, with a track record of owning a pipeline number and measurable results to show for it

- 

Built and owned experience across paid, events, and content

- 

Tech/SaaS background, startup to mid-market, comfortable operating with limited resources and ambiguity

- 

You'd rather figure out the right approach yourself than wait to be told what to do

Nice to have

- 

Managing paid campaigns (Google and LinkedIn) and hosted webinars

- 

Experience in UXR or adjacent research/product tooling

- 

Startup experience, particularly at Series A/B stage

Don’t check every box? Apply anyway. We care a lot more about what you can do than a perfect match to a list.

How we work

We’re remote-first, but we’re not strangers.

Async by default: We write things down, keep each other in the loop, and save meetings for decisions and real connection.

Together when it counts: We get together in person throughout the year to plan, build, and celebrate.

Owners, not order-takers: You’ll have real responsibility from day one and the trust to figure out how to get there.

User first, always: We talk to users constantly, and it shapes every decision we make.

AI-native, inside and out: We’re building an agentic product, and we work like it. Everyone here is experimenting with AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.

This might not be for you if…

- 

You want a clearly defined lane. Roles here stretch, and priorities shift as we learn.

- 

You’d rather hand work off than own it end to end.

- 

You need a lot of process or a big team around you to do your best work.

- 

You're not curious about how AI is changing the way we work (we're rethinking it constantly).

- 

You'd rather guess what users want than go ask them.

- 

You need a big team or agency behind you to run paid, events, and content

If you read that and thought, “that’s exactly why I’d love it here,” we’d really like to hear from you!

Compensation & benefits

Base salary range (US): $120,000 - $140,000 USD per year.

This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hires in this role across the United States. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job‑related skills, experience, and location.

Additional compensation: This role is eligible for variable compensation such as equity in accordance with Rally’s applicable plans. Any such compensation is not guaranteed and is determined at Rally’s discretion under the terms of those plans.

We want you to feel taken care of, so you can do your best work. For US-based full-time employees, that includes:

- 

Competitive pay and meaningful equity

- 

Great medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 

14 weeks of fully paid parental leave, for every parent

- 

Unlimited PTO (and we want you to use it)

- 

Home office and co-working support

- 

Mental health and wellness support

- 

401(k)

- 

Opportunities for in-person time with coworkers

Benefits may vary based on role, level, and location, and are subject to change as Rally grows.

Our hiring process

We want interviewing with us to feel like a preview of working here: structured, transparent, and focused on real work. Steps can vary a bit by role, but here’s the usual flow:

- 

Recruiter chat (30 min): Get to know each other and make sure the role fits what you’re looking for.

- 

Hiring manager conversation (45 min): Dig into the role, your experience, and what success looks like.

- 

Practical exercise: A take-home or working session based on the work you’d actually do. No brain teasers.

- 

Final interviews: 3–5 conversations with future teammates, cross-functional partners, and one of our founders.

- 

References and offer: We move fast here.

We’ll tell you what to expect at every step. And since we’re a research company, we’d love your feedback on the process too.

We’re building a team that reflects the range of people who use products like ours, and we’re committed to paying fairly for the work. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market data for our size, stage, and industry, and may adjust over time as the market evolves.

Rally is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We’re committed to providing reasonable accommodations to candidates with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need support or an adjustment at any point, please let us know how we can help.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work for this role. It is not a complete list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Employment with Rally is “at will,” which means either you or Rally may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason or no reason at all.

What: As Sr. Growth Marketing Manager, you'll own pipeline coverage and top-of-funnel demand gen end-to-end — deciding how we get there, not just executing a fixed plan.

Impact: You'll build and run the demand engine that gets Rally and our recently launched Agent and MCP in front of the buyers evaluating an AI-native research stack, directly shaping whether pipeline turns into revenue.

Team: You'll join our Marketing team and work closely with Sales, the founders, and cross-functional partners across Product and Engineering. At our size, the lines between them ebb and flow, so you'll always be working cross-functionally.

Where: Remote-first across the US, with hubs in New York and Boston.

About Rally

In a world where anyone can ship anything, the teams building closest to their users win. But talking to users is still way harder than it should be. Pulling lists, chasing consent, juggling calendars, sending incentives: it's why most product teams skip research altogether.

We're here to end manual recruitment.

Rally is agentic research infrastructure: the system that lets companies talk to their own users safely, at any scale. Tell Rally what you want to learn, and Rally Agent builds the study, finds the right participants, and handles outreach, scheduling, and incentives, all within your company's guardrails. It works from the Rally app, from Slack, or from the AI tools you already use. Agents handle the busywork, so people focus on the human parts: learning from each other.

Today, teams at Google, Meta, Figma, Ramp, Perplexity, and MongoDB run their research on Rally. And we're building a company that lasts, investing in the product and the team for the long haul.

The opportunity

We believe teams will always need to talk to their users, however far AI goes, and most companies still don't have a safe way to let team members outside of traditional UX Research do it. We recently launched Rally's Agent and MCP, and we're going after the biggest companies in the world. The product is catching up to the vision, with plenty of exciting challenges still ahead.

That's where you come in. You'd join Marketing, a small, high-ownership team that's a little obsessed with our users. We work side by side with the researchers and product builders who use Rally every day, and yes, we use Rally to build Rally.

This role exists because demand gen and pipeline need a dedicated owner unafraid to take risks — you'd own it end-to-end, with real latitude to build the approach that works.
