job.title: Director, Marketing Technology
job.description:
About Step

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

 

About the Role

Marketing at Step runs on data. Every acquisition channel, lifecycle campaign, rewards drop, and measurement decision depends on clean, connected, well-modeled data flowing between our product, our warehouse, and a dozen marketing platforms. Today, much of that work lands on engineering. We're hiring a Director, Marketing Technology, to own it end-to-end.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role for someone with a software or data engineering background who wants to apply that skill set to growth. You'll be the architect and operator of Step's marketing technology stack: owning our ad channel and attribution integrations, managing our vendor ecosystem (Segment, AppsFlyer, Braze, Funnel, and others), building the data models and analytical tooling the marketing team runs on, and shipping the monthly rewards and offers that drive engagement. You'll act as the bridge between Marketing, Product, and Engineering taking on the technical work that currently pulls engineers away from the core product, and raising the bar on what marketing can measure, automate, and personalize.

You'll start as a hands-on individual contributor with the opportunity to build and lead a marketing technology team as the function scales.

In this role, you will:

Own the marketing technology stack

  • Own the architecture, roadmap, and day-to-day operation of Step's martech ecosystem including CDP, MMP, lifecycle messaging, data aggregation, and analytics tooling along with the documentation, QA, and governance standards that keep it reliable and privacy-compliant 
  • Manage all marketing technology partners (Segment, AppsFlyer, Braze, Funnel, and similar), including evaluation, implementation, optimization, and contract/renewal input

Build and optimize ad channel and measurement integrations

  • Configure, validate, and maintain integrations with paid channels (Meta, Google, TikTok, and similar), including server-side conversion APIs, event schemas, setup counting methods, attribution windows, and first-party audience syncs 
  • Own attribution and mobile measurement (AppsFlyer/Segment): SKAN/postback configuration, conversion windows, deduplication, and channel-level data quality
  • Partner on GA4 implementation including event taxonomy, funnel conversion configuration, and custom reporting; leveraging GA4 data to fill attribution gaps across channels and inform incrementality analysis

Be the data backbone of the marketing team

  • Build and maintain the pipelines and data models that power marketing reporting, audience segmentation, and campaign measurement  with identity, event, and audience definitions kept consistent across product, warehouse, and activation platforms
  • Develop self-serve analytical tools, dashboards, and automations so marketers can answer their own questions (ie. spend pacing, funnel conversion, LTV, incrementality)

Ship marketing programs

  • Own the technical build of Step's monthly rewards and offers program end to end targeting logic, delivery, tracking, and post-campaign readout
  • Support lifecycle and CRM campaign execution in Braze: triggers and data feeds

Partner across the company

  • Serve as marketing's technical counterpart to Product, Engineering, and Data scoping requests, setting priorities, and taking build work off engineering's plate

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 7+ years across software engineering, data engineering, or marketing technology, with meaningful time spent as a hands-on engineer
  • Proven experience owning a modern martech stack at a consumer company: CDP (Segment or similar), MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch), and lifecycle platforms (Braze or similar)
  • Strong SQL and working proficiency in a scripting language (Python or JavaScript); comfortable with APIs, webhooks, event-driven architectures, and cloud data warehouses
  • Deep understanding of mobile and web attribution: conversion APIs, SKAdNetwork, postbacks, deduplication, and incrementality
  • A clear communicator who bridges marketing, engineering, and executive audiences
  • You are hungry for action and you'd rather ship a working solution this week than a perfect one next quarter
  • Experience operating martech at larger scale, ideally through viral moments or campaign-driven traffic spikes

Some of the technology we use:

  • Kotlin
  • gRPC
  • Protocol Buffers
  • Dagger
  • Postgres
  • JOOQ
  • BigQuery
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform

Logistics

Location: Remote (US) or San Mateo, CA, with occasional travel for team offsites and key meetings

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

Education: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you.

How we're different

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of Beast Industries, the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

Come work with us!

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you!

Step is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Step is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need an accommodation, please let us know at people@step.com and we'll work with you to provide appropriate support.

  • Lead go-to-market strategy, planning, and launches for the entire portfolio: core banking, credit, rewards, lending, and investing  
  • Own the cross-functional operations between Step and Beast Industries, developing and launching collabs, product integrations, and partnership expansion
  • Drive strategy and lead a full-funnel lifecycle marketing perspective from top-of-funnel awareness through ongoing engagement and retention
  • Deliver best-in-class loyalty and gamification programs at scale
  • Partner with the broader marketing team to execute campaigns that drive new signups, expansion, and/or product adoption
  • Advocate for our customers through research and discovery work; translate their needs to inform and influence our product roadmaps
  • Effectively partner with product, design, customer support, engineering, and other company functions while focusing on down-funnel conversion and retention
  • Oversee and lead the team’s development of annual and quarterly plans to drive growth across the customer lifecycle to generate high-impact and meaningful learnings.
  • Build, develop, and mentor a product marketing team including lifecycle marketers; lead with a passion for learning and development

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing; 5+ of those years in product marketing, with a preference for some experience in a startup environment 
  • Product marketing experience working across the funnel in B2C tech and/or a consumer app
  • Strong preference for a player-coach role, unafraid to roll up your sleeves and get hands-on with campaign development 
  • Experience managing a nascent product marketing/lifecycle marketing team with direct responsibility for owned communication channels 
  • Excellent written communication skills, with an ability to craft a clear and compelling narrative for unique audiences

job.title: Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) / SVP, Growth / Director of Marketing
job.description:
Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) / SVP, Growth / Director of Marketing 
DTC Lead Generation | High-Volume, Performance-Driven
Superior Executive & Legal Recruiting is seeking a senior marketing leader to scale direct-to-consumer lead generation for a high-volume plaintiff-side employment litigation firm. Own the full funnel—from acquisition to intake to signed clients—with a focus on ROI, growth, and operational efficiency.
Target Background: Healthcare, insurance, financial services, education, or similar high-volume DTC sectors.

Responsibilities
Own and scale paid acquisition (Google Ads, Meta), managing $150K+ monthly spend
Drive full-funnel performance across landing pages, intake, and call center conversion
Build and optimize growth systems including testing frameworks, CRM/MarTech, and attribution
Improve speed-to-lead and conversion rates in partnership with intake and operations
Optimize across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels to maximize lead quality and signed clients

Qualifications
8+ years in DTC/performance marketing with proven revenue impact (not just CPL optimization)
Hands-on paid media experience building and managing campaigns directly
Experience in high-volume, complex funnel environments with strong testing and optimization rigor
Familiarity with multi-channel acquisition (paid, SEO, lifecycle) and CRM/MarTech systems
Proven leadership experience building and scaling high-performing teams
Critical Requirement:
Must have personal, hands-on experience (not solely team or agency oversight) building campaigns in Google Ads and Meta. While the CMO will not be expected to actively build campaigns as part of this position, deep subject matter expertise is the most important requirement of this job. Candidates must have executed campaign builds, optimizations, and creative strategy at a high level with six-figure budgets.

job.title: Manager, Web & Marketing Platforms
job.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
 
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. 
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. 
 
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD. 

Own the technical architecture, development, reliability, and evolution of the company’s marketing website and supporting marketing technology platforms. This role serves as the primary technical owner of the Next.js and Payload CMS web platform, overseeing the development lifecycle from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring, optimization, and ongoing feature development. 
 
The role also supports the broader marketing technology ecosystem, including analytics, consent management, integrations, SEO/AIO, automation, and emerging AI technologies, while partnering with Marketing, IT, Security, Legal, and external vendors.

- 

Own the development lifecycle and technical roadmap for the Next.js / Payload CMS marketing website. 

- 

Architect, develop, review, test, deploy, and maintain scalable web applications and CMS functionality. 

- 

Establish development standards, CI/CD processes, environment management, documentation, and release practices. 

- 

Translate marketing and business requirements into sustainable technical solutions and development priorities. 

- 

Own website performance, reliability, accessibility, technical SEO/AIO, security, and overall platform health. 

- 

Design and maintain integrations between the website, APIs, CMS, search, CRM/MAP, analytics, consent, automation, and other marketing platforms. 

- 

Own technical implementation and governance of GTM, GA4, consent management, and marketing measurement. 

- 

Partner with Legal, Security, and IT to maintain appropriate privacy, security, vulnerability-management, and data-governance practices. 

- 

Troubleshoot complex application, deployment, data, tracking, and integration issues. 

- 

Evaluate new platforms and AI-enabled technologies for scalability, security, maintainability, and business value. 

- 

Manage technical vendors and external development partners while reducing unnecessary dependency on outside resources. 

- 

Maintain technical project planning and operational visibility through tools such as Monday.com. 

- 

Help build and eventually lead a dedicated Web & Marketing Platforms function as organizational needs grow.

 

- 4+ years of professional web development experience, with significant experience using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. 

- 

Professional experience with Next.js strongly preferred, including modern application architecture and server/client rendering patterns. 

- 

Experience with a modern headless CMS; Payload CMS experience preferred. 

- 

Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, webhooks, and modern web architecture. 

- 

Experience with Git-based development workflows, code review, CI/CD, deployment environments, and production release management. 

- 

Familiarity or willingness to work with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Copilot. 

- 

Familiarity with Google Tag Manager (GTM), GA4, Google Consent Mode, and digital analytics implementation. 

- 

Familiarity with cookie consent / CMP platforms such as Securiti, OneTrust, or similar technologies. 

- 

Experience integrating third-party APIs and SaaS platforms into modern web applications. 

- 

Familiarity with search platforms such as Algolia or comparable search/indexing technologies. 

- 

Working knowledge of technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, website performance, and web security best practices. 

- 

Experience troubleshooting production applications, integrations, deployments, tracking implementations, and data flows. 

- 

Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, databases, automation platforms, and data pipelines is a plus. 

- 

Experience providing technical direction to developers, contractors, agencies, or vendors preferred.

Strong candidates should also be able to translate business and marketing needs into technical requirements, communicate technical tradeoffs to nontechnical stakeholders, prioritize competing initiatives, and balance new development against reliability, security, technical debt, and long-term maintainability. 

 The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location.  
 
Why AHEAD:
 
Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
 
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.
 
USA Employment Benefits include: 
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 
- 401(k) 
- Paid company holidays 
- Paid time off 
- Paid parental and caregiver leave 
- Plus more! See benefits https://www.aheadbenefits.com/ for additional details. 
 
Use of AI:
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, assessing responses, or to capture recordings and create transcriptions or summaries during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
 
If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Notice or contact us at privacy@ahead.com. 
 
You may opt-out of the review or analysis of your application and resume by AI tools by using the General Application. Please include the role you wish to apply for in the Additional Information field. You may also choose to opt-out of recording and transcription at any time, including after joining an interview.  Candidates will not be penalized for choosing to opt-out.

job.title: Manager, Marketing Operations - Ad Tech Lead
job.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

We create technology to help businesses grow and succeed. Our Marketing Operations team is looking for a technically sharp, operationally minded Manager to own the infrastructure behind our paid media program — from pixel to pipeline, feed to finance. This role is the engine behind our buying team, ensuring every campaign we run is accurately tracked and our media buyers can focus on performance rather than data.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Own the full signal path for Paid: serve as the single technical owner across Tracking/Pixels, Program/Campaign, Audience/Conversions API, and Control Tower - partnering with Paid on requirements once and carrying them across every team, rather than Paid routing to individuals separately
  • Tag & pixel infrastructure: own event tracking, conversion signals, and audience data flows across ad platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, Bing, ChatGPT, etc.) via offline conversion tracking and server-side tagging
  • Marketing automation: manage and optimize Marketo paid program setup, scoring, audience segmentation, and integration with ad platforms
  • Data operations: manage CRM audience syncs and data pipelines between source systems and ad platforms using ETL systems
  • UTM & tracking governance: define and enforce naming conventions, UTM taxonomy, QA checklists, and bulk build processes to ensure every campaign launched is trackable and consistent
  • Platform integrations & API management: manage connections between marketing tech systems (Marketo, Salesforce, ad platforms) and troubleshoot data discrepancies across the stack
  • Launch playbooks & QA framework: build and maintain the launch playbook for new vendors, channels, and tests; own time-to-launch as a core metric and continuously shrink it
  • Control Tower & monitoring: own Paid's coverage within our Control Tower alerting suite, publish and follow a QA cadence (daily monitors, monthly tests, quarterly audits), and drive down time-to-detect on data issues
  • Reporting & analytics infrastructure: maintain and QA the data pipelines that feed performance dashboards, ensuring campaign, lead, and conversion data is accurate and available for stakeholder reporting
  • Audience operations: build, maintain, and refresh CRM-based audience lists for suppression, retargeting, and lookalike seeding across ad platforms

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years in marketing operations, ad tech, or marketing analytics
  • Experience managing infrastructure for paid spend at $10M+ a year across 3+ ad platforms
  • Hands-on experience with offline conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or equivalent), including sending CRM-stage conversions back to platforms
  • Experience with a marketing automation platform (Marketo, HubSpot, or similar)
  • Experience with CRM systems and lead routing logic (Salesforce or equivalent)
  • Experience managing data pipelines and integrations via Hightouch or similar ETL tools
  • Strong UTM governance and tracking QA across multi-channel paid campaigns
  • Track record operating as an embedded technical partner to a Paid/growth team — driving requirements proactively rather than waiting on tickets
  • Ability to troubleshoot data discrepancies and communicate findings to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong attention to detail and a bias toward process and documentation
  • A sense of humor

Special Sauce* (nice to haves)

  • Owned a cost efficiency metric as part of your function
  • Part of the team or led the move to value-based bidding with measurable CAC or pipeline impact
  • Experience working within a B2B SaaS environment
  • Proficiency with Marketo, including program setup, lead scoring, and ad platform integrations
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, including lead routing, campaign attribution, and data hygiene
  • Experience with a CDP or data warehouse tool (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery)
  • Familiarity with SQL for data QA and ad-hoc reporting
  • Experience with TikTok or other emerging ad platform integrations beyond Meta and Google
  • Prior experience in an embedded ops role supporting a paid media team

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.


Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A
$124,000—$198,000 USD
Zone B
$108,000—$173,000 USD
Zone C
$97,000—$155,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

------

For roles in the United States, it is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

job.title: Marketing Analyst, New Business and M&A
job.description:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
Toptal is looking for a Marketing Analyst to build and own the marketing data infrastructure to support new businesses and companies we acquire through M&A. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. You will track paid advertising performance and translate it into metrics such as LTV and ROAS that inform budget allocation and channel strategy, from structuring the underlying data pipelines to developing the reports that help marketing and business leaders make data-driven decisions.
Are you passionate about bringing rigor to how early-stage businesses measure and optimize acquisition spend from day one? If so, we encourage you to apply! This person will define the metrics that matter, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports that drive decisions. They will also build models, forecast outcomes, run experiments, and perform in-depth diagnostic analysis.
Ultimate success goes beyond data-related activities, you’ll be delivering the “so what” that drives decisions and real business impact. It is imperative to fully understand each business (processes, objectives, organization, performance drivers, barriers), and connect the dots between paid acquisition data, marketing strategy, and financial and operational effectiveness. This role partners closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions, ensuring marketing performance insights are integrated with the broader business and revenue picture. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not.
This Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions.
Build, own, and maintain the marketing data infrastructure, from ad impression and click through lead acquisition to revenue, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms as required.
Rapidly assess and integrate the marketing data of newly acquired (M&A) companies, establishing tracking, attribution, and reporting so their acquisition spend is measured with the same rigor as the rest of Toptal.
Measure and diagnose paid advertising performance across channels and businesses—analyzing spend efficiency, CAC, funnel conversion, lead value, ROAS, and LTV—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy.
Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives, including consistent definitions of LTV, ROAS, and payback across businesses.
Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders and business owners.
Partner closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions to connect marketing performance with revenue, unit economics, and the broader business picture.
Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation.
Proactively identify and surface opportunities to improve efficiency, conversion, revenue generation, client and talent experience, operations, communication, systems & tools, cash usage, etc.
Leverage Generative AI tools to accelerate analysis and automate reporting workflows.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal, quickly learning about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision.
Shadow key teams to learn the core of each new business and its paid acquisition channels.
In the first month, expect to:
Understand the marketing data generated and where/how it is stored, especially as it relates to the Business Analytics team.
Obtain a basic understanding of each business’s paid advertising channels, spend, and operations.
Assess the current state of tracking, attribution, performance metrics, reports, dashboards, and models in use, and identify gaps and discrepancies.
Begin supporting business leaders with relevant paid performance insights and reports for leadership meetings.
In the first three months, expect to:
Develop proficiency in the marketing data elements of each business and obtain a robust understanding of the paid acquisition funnel from ad spend to revenue.
Deliver a first version of the marketing data infrastructure and ROAS/LTV reporting for the new businesses, and gain the ability to assess the drivers and impacts of marketing decisions on financial performance.
Begin identifying new opportunities to explore in the quest to improve performance continually while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
In the first six months, expect to:
Begin to solve real business problems as a team that will move the needle on key marketing performance metrics and financial performance.
Help us align and standardize LTV, ROAS, and other metric definitions across the new businesses and the company.
Perform detailed root cause analysis to expose critical drivers of channel performance, and stand up a repeatable playbook for onboarding the marketing data of newly acquired companies.
In the first year, expect to:
Inform significant strategic initiatives, goals, priorities, and performance indicators, including budget allocation and channel strategy for the new businesses.
Become an expert both on marketing process and data flow, and help build an outstanding marketing analytics function for new businesses and M&A.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics.
Demonstrated experience analyzing paid advertising performance (e.g., Google Ads and other paid media platforms) and translating it into metrics such as LTV, CAC, and ROAS is required.
Demonstrated experience building or owning marketing data infrastructure (tracking, attribution, data pipelines, and reporting) is required.
Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus.
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.).
Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus.
Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting.
Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance.
Track record of linking data and analytics to marketing strategy, financial performance, and operations to drive real impact.
Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus.
Experience in a startup, early-stage business, or M&A integration environment is a plus.
Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots.
The ideal candidate needs to have a strong technical background particularly when it comes to marketing data infrastructure and Google products (Google Analytics, Google Ads) while having the ability to master marketing processes of diverse nature.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics.
Demonstrated experience analyzing paid advertising performance (e.g., Google Ads and other paid media platforms) and translating it into metrics such as LTV, CAC, and ROAS is required.
Demonstrated experience building or owning marketing data infrastructure (tracking, attribution, data pipelines, and reporting) is required.
Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus.
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.).
Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus.
Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting.
Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance.
Track record of linking data and analytics to marketing strategy, financial performance, and operations to drive real impact.
Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus.
Experience in a startup, early-stage business, or M&A integration environment is a plus.
Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots.
The ideal candidate needs to have a strong technical background particularly when it comes to marketing data infrastructure and Google products (Google Analytics, Google Ads) while having the ability to master marketing processes of diverse nature.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
